# Leon Vasari: Curved VHS Archive (exact recreation prompt)

Give me the superdetailed exact prompt to recreate this page exactly as it is, including the correct asset URL, all elements, animations, and fonts. This is that prompt.

## What it is

Build a single-screen **film archive hero** for a fictional director, Leon Vasari. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript in one file, with no framework and no libraries.

The page is warm off-white paper.
- **The shelf:** across the middle, worn VHS tapes stand on a **curved arc that recedes into depth**. Spines get smaller, darker and more tightly packed toward both edges, about 11 per side. They turn slightly toward the centre and sit lower as they go back, like a shelf bent into a shallow bowl.
- **The active tape:** the tape at the centre is **turned 90° in 3D** so its illustrated front cover faces you, pushed slightly forward, over a soft floor shadow.
- **Background:** two columns of giant halftone kanji, **映画** on the left and **の記憶** on the right, sit behind the shelf.
- **Caption:** under the cover, the film's title is set big and bold in cobalt, with its romanised and kanji titles, a short rule and "YEAR — GENRE". Arrows sit on either side.
- **Timeline:** a ruler from 1955 to 1990 runs along the bottom. A cobalt dot glides to the active film's year.
- **Detail sheet:** clicking the cover grows a sheet of paper out of it into a full-screen detail page. Its poster bleeds in like ink.

Everything runs on one `requestAnimationFrame` loop plus the Web Animations API. There are no opacity fades: every reveal is a mask slide, a clip or a scale.

## Media: every asset URL

All 24 images come from **four Higgsfield GPT Image 2.5 sheets** with transparent backgrounds, loaded through the Higgsfield image proxy as WebP. The art is fictional, unbranded VHS art. Each spine and cover is a rectangle cropped out of a sheet with CSS backgrounds; there are no separate image files.

| Sheet id | Size (px) | Contents | URL |
|---|---|---|---|
| covers | 1744 × 2336 | all 12 covers in a 4 × 3 grid | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261029_010644_837e04ca-2418-45c1-b8e0-0233265c4cd5.png&w=1744&q=85 |
| spines | 2688 × 1152 | 12 spines in one row (9 used) | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261029_010738_a3e47ead-18f2-4974-9468-06d16a25edc5.png&w=2688&q=85 |
| fix | 1520 × 2688 | re-drawn spine RIVER OF SALT | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261029_010831_3ebb874b-93dc-433e-87ed-6299aba720f0.png&w=1520&q=85 |
| fix2 | 1520 × 2688 | re-drawn spines THE OBSERVER and LIGHT IN THE STORM | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261029_092020_f96bc094-db7b-46de-9298-074a24e0a3b8.png&w=1520&q=85 |

**What the art looks like:**
- **Spines** (about 1:6): worn cardboard, a small illustration at the top, the title vertical in a condensed serif, then "VASARI" and a boxed "VHS".
- **Covers** (about 1:1.95): "A LEON VASARI FILM" at the top, a big condensed serif title, a duotone screen-print illustration in ink, cobalt, vermilion and cream, and a "VHS" badge.

Crop boxes are in sheet pixels, `x, y, w, h`:

| Film id | Spine sheet | Spine box | Cover sheet | Cover box |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| valley | spines | 266, 31, 189, 1089 | covers | 497, 72, 344, 659 |
| bluehour | spines | 492, 31, 189, 1089 | covers | 914, 72, 342, 659 |
| river | fix | 197, 54, 324, 2566 | covers | 1332, 72, 344, 659 |
| summer | spines | 937, 31, 188, 1089 | covers | 74, 813, 344, 676 |
| green | spines | 1157, 31, 185, 1090 | covers | 497, 815, 344, 674 |
| noon | spines | 44, 32, 184, 1088 | covers | 74, 72, 347, 659 |
| observer | fix2 | 371, 15, 349, 2655 | covers | 915, 815, 342, 675 |
| birds | spines | 1573, 31, 183, 1089 | covers | 1331, 815, 345, 675 |
| storm | fix2 | 808, 15, 347, 2656 | covers | 74, 1571, 345, 681 |
| tide | spines | 2012, 31, 188, 1089 | covers | 496, 1577, 343, 678 |
| war | spines | 2236, 31, 189, 1089 | covers | 913, 1579, 343, 676 |
| door | spines | 2462, 31, 188, 1089 | covers | 1331, 1579, 344, 677 |

**Cropping:**
- Store the tables as `SHEET[id] = [url, W, H]` and `CROP['spine-<id>'|'cover-<id>'] = [sheet, x, y, w, h]`.
- A face's background is `background-image:url(sheet); background-size:(W/w·100)% (H/h·100)%; background-position:(x/(W−w)·100)% (y/(H−h)·100)%`.
- **Detail poster:** an SVG `<image>` of the sheet with `x=−x·474/w`, `y=−y·900/h`, `width=W·474/w`, `height=H·900/h` and `preserveAspectRatio="none"`, clipped to a 474 × 900 rect.
- Preload the four sheets as `Image()` objects on start.

## Fonts (all embedded as base64 WOFF2)

| Family | Weight | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Inter Tight (variable 100–900) | 500, 600 | Every label, the caption title, the detail title, years |
| Newsreader (variable 200–800, roman and italic) | 400 | Detail synopsis and italic credit |
| Noto Sans JP | 500 | All small Japanese text (labels, kanji titles); second in the sans stack |
| Noto Serif SC | 700 | (embedded, not visible in this layout) |
| "Noto Sans JP Big" | 800 | The giant 映画 / の記憶 only: a Google Fonts subset of Noto Sans JP 800 with `text=映画の記憶`, `font-display:block` |

- **Sans stack:** `"Inter Tight","Noto Sans JP",system-ui,sans-serif`.
- **Serif stack:** `"Newsreader",Georgia,serif`.

## Tokens

```css
--paper:#ECE8E0; --sheet:#F3F0EA; --ink:#141414; --muted:#6D6A63; --cobalt:#1F3FB0; --rule:rgba(20,20,20,.9);
--ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
--H:min(47vh,33vw);  /* tape height; min(68vw,40svh) on phones */
--cy:41%;            /* shelf centre line; 43% on phones */
```

- `body` is paper, with hidden overflow, `user-select:none` and antialiasing. On `(pointer:fine)` the native cursor is hidden.
- **Paper grain:** a fixed full-screen layer (z 40, no pointer events, `mix-blend-mode:multiply`, opacity .6). It is a 220px SVG tile: `feTurbulence` fractalNoise (baseFrequency .85, 3 octaves, stitchTiles) through `feColorMatrix` `0 0 0 0 .45 / 0 0 0 0 .42 / 0 0 0 0 .38 / 0 0 0 .22 0`.
- **`.lbl`:** Inter Tight 600, 10.5px, line-height 1, letter-spacing .14em, uppercase.
- **`.box`:** inline-flex, 21px tall, 0 8px padding, 1px `--rule` border.

## Layout (desktop; everything fixed)

1. **Top bar:** 76px tall, 36px side padding, space-between, all cobalt.
   - **Left:** a link `.lbl` "LEON VASARI", a 40 × 1px line, then "FILM ARCHIVE", with 16px gaps.
   - **Right:** "FILMS", "ABOUT", "JOURNAL" (34px gaps), then a burger of two 1.5px lines, 26 × 12px.
2. **Halftone kanji:**
   - Fixed, z 1, `writing-mode:vertical-rl`, font "Noto Sans JP Big" 800 at `min(19vh,12.5vw)`, line-height 1.02, letter-spacing .02em.
   - The fill is a dot screen: transparent text with `background-clip:text` over `radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(64,82,138,.55) 0 36%, transparent 40%)` at 3 × 3px, plus a flat `rgba(110,122,160,.26)` wash.
   - **映画** sits at left 2.4vw, top 13vh. **の記憶** sits at right 2.4vw, top 9vh.
3. **Floor shadow:**
   - Position: centred at `top:calc(--cy + H×.47)`, width `min(96vw, H×3.6)`, height `H×.26`.
   - Fill: `radial-gradient(50% 50% at 50% 40%, rgba(40,32,20,.30), rgba(40,32,20,.10) 55%, transparent 72%)`.
4. **Shelf:**
   - The section spans the full width, top `--cy − H/2 − 50px`, height `H + 100px`, with `perspective:1400px` at `50% 50%`, z 10 and `touch-action:pan-y`.
   - A zero-size `.stage` at the centre has `preserve-3d`.
   - **Each tape** is a zero-size `preserve-3d` box with two faces. Faces are H tall, top −H/2, `backface-visibility:hidden`, radius 2px.
     - **Spine face `.sp`:** width `ws`, `translateZ(d/2)`.
     - **Cover face `.cv`:** width `d`, `rotateY(90deg) translateZ(ws/2)`, shadow `0 34px 60px -30px rgba(20,16,10,.6)`.
   - **Shading:** each face has a black `::after` whose opacity comes from `--shade`.
5. **Play ring:** a fixed 42px circle with a 1px cobalt border, `rgba(236,232,224,.8)` fill and a 12px cobalt triangle. It sits on the cover's lower-left corner (`left = W/2 − d/2 − 6`, `top = shelfCentre + .36H`).
6. **Caption:** a centred grid at `top: --cy + H/2 + 4.2vh`, 10px gap. Each line sits in an overflow mask, `min(80vw,640px)` wide.
   - **Title:** Inter Tight 600, `clamp(28px,3.4vw,46px)`, letter-spacing −.015em, cobalt (e.g. **Noon in Ashes**).
   - **Subtitle:** a cobalt `.lbl` at 9.5px, letter-spacing .24em, "ROMAJI / kanji" (e.g. `HAI NO SHOGO / 灰の正午`).
   - **Rule:** 18 × 1px, cobalt.
   - **Year line:** Inter Tight 500, 10.5px, letter-spacing .08em, ink, `YEAR — GENRE` (e.g. `1971 — WESTERN`).
7. **Arrows:** two 44px cobalt buttons on the title's line, at `50% ± min(19vw,250px)`. They hold 24 × 12 arrow SVGs (1.2px stroke): `M6 1L1 6l5 5M1 6h23` and its mirror.
8. **Timeline:** left and right 36px, bottom 64px, 40px tall.
   - A cobalt 1px line at 12px (opacity .75).
   - A tick for every year 1955–1990. Majors every 5 years are 13px tall at .75 opacity; minors are 7px at .4.
   - Year labels in Inter Tight 500 9.5px, cobalt, under the majors (the first is left-aligned, 1990 right-aligned).
   - A 9px cobalt dot rides the line.
   - A click area covers it.
9. **Footer:** left/right 36px, bottom 24px, cobalt `.lbl`s: "© LEON VASARI. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED." on the left and "FB / TW" (links) on the right.
10. **Cursor:** 58px, fixed, z 100.
    - **Parts:** a 1.5px ink ring, a 6px ink dot, and a hidden white label "OPEN" over "開く" in Inter Tight 600 10px.
    - **Movement:** it follows with `1 − e^(−16dt)` smoothing.
    - **States:**
      - `.open` (over the settled cover): the ring scales to 1.75 and fills cobalt, and the label pops in.
      - `.spine` (over other tapes): .72.
      - `.btn` (over buttons, links or the timeline): .55 with no dot.
    - **Transitions:** ring .5s, colours .4s, dot .4s, label .45s.

## Film data (shelf order; the page opens on index 5)

| # | id | Title | Romaji | Kanji | Year | Genre | Min | Synopsis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | valley | The Silent Valley | SHIZUKANA TANI | 静かな谷 | 1958 | Drama | 104 | A schoolteacher returns to the mountain village that exiled her father, and finds the valley has kept every one of its secrets. |
| 1 | bluehour | The Blue Hour | AO NO TOKI | 青の刻 | 1962 | Romance | 97 | Over one long evening in a harbour town, a widow and a stranger trade small lies until the light runs out. |
| 2 | river | River of Salt | SHIO NO KAWA | 塩の川 | 1964 | Drama | 121 | Two brothers drag a salt barge downriver to a city that no longer wants anything they carry. |
| 3 | summer | The Last Summer | SAIGO NO NATSU | 最後の夏 | 1966 | Drama | 109 | The summer before the dam floods their village, three friends set fire to everything they cannot take with them. |
| 4 | green | The Green Road | MIDORI NO MICHI | 緑の道 | 1969 | Mystery | 101 | A surveyor mapping a forest road keeps finding the same footprints, always one day ahead of him. |
| 5 | noon | Noon in Ashes | HAI NO SHOGO | 灰の正午 | 1971 | Western | 112 | A rider crosses a white desert to settle an old debt, and learns too late who sent him. |
| 6 | observer | The Observer | KANSATSUSHA | 観察者 | 1973 | Thriller | 96 | A night watchman begins to suspect that the building he guards has started watching him back. |
| 7 | birds | The Fallen Birds | OCHITA TORI | 落ちた鳥 | 1975 | Drama | 118 | When the birds stop singing over a frontier town, the mayor’s daughter is the only one who goes looking for the reason. |
| 8 | storm | Light in the Storm | ARASHI NO HI | 嵐の灯 | 1978 | Drama | 127 | A lighthouse keeper and his son wait out a three-day storm with a shipwrecked sailor who will not give his name. |
| 9 | tide | The Long Tide | NAGAI SHIO | 長い潮 | 1981 | Drama | 99 | A fisherman’s wife counts the tides on the harbour wall while her husband’s boat fails to come home. |
| 10 | war | A Quiet War | SHIZUKANA SENSO | 静かな戦争 | 1985 | Comedy | 103 | Two neighbours fight a silent war over a garden wall for thirty years, and neither will say how it began. |
| 11 | door | Red Door | AKAI TOBIRA | 赤い扉 | 1989 | Thriller | 114 | A projectionist follows a reel of unknown film through the corridors of a cinema on its final night. |

Render the 12 films three times (36 tapes, virtual index `v = copy×12 + i`). Start at `s = T = 5 + 12`.

## Arc geometry (the core of this design)

### Measured values
Measure H with a probe element of `height:var(--H)`. Then:
- `ws = H·142/840`, `d = H·474/900`, `gap = H·.035`
- `U = H·1.3` on desktop, `H·1.05` below 768px (the depth falloff)
- `P = 1400` (the CSS perspective)

### Functions
- **Relative index:** `rel(v,s) = ((v−s) mod 36)` mapped into [−18, 18).
- **Arc length from the centre:** `F(r) = r·(ws+gap) + (d − ws + 1.4·gap)·B(r)`, where `B(r) = (r + sin(πr)/π)/2` for |r| < 1 and `±.5` otherwise. The open cover pushes its neighbours apart smoothly.
- **Screen scale at arc length u:** `scl(u) = 1/(1 + (|u|/U)^1.6)`.
- **Screen x:** the integral of `scl`. Precompute `XS` by stepping u from 0 to 3U in 2px steps, accumulating `2/(1+(u/U)^1.6)`. Then `xsc(u) = sign(u)·XS[|u|/2]`. Far spines pack tighter in screen space.

### Per tape, every frame
- `o = smoothstep(max(0, 1−|r|))`: 0 for a spine, 1 for the open cover.
- `u = F(r)`. If `|u| > U·1.95`, hide the tape.
- `sc = scl(u)` and `k = 1/sc`. The tape sits at the depth that gives this on-screen scale:
  - `z = P·(1−k) + o·H·.1`
  - `x = xsc(u)·k`
  - `y = (H·.5·(1−sc)·.42 + o·H·.012 − lift·H·.05)·k`, so far tapes sink a little, forming the bowl.
- `rotateY = sign(u)·min(1,|u|/U)·26°·(1−o) − 90°·o + tiltY·o`, and `rotateX = tiltX·o`.
- Transform: `translate3d(x,y,z) rotateX() rotateY()`. z-index `round(3000+z)`.
- **Shading:** the spine's `--shade` is `min(.6, o·.55 + (1−sc)·.32)`, so far spines darken. The cover's `--shade` is `(1−o)·.82`.
- **Hover lift:** a hovered non-active tape (`|r| > .5`) eases its lift to 1 at `1−e^(−12dt)`.

### Motion
- **Spring:** `s += (T−s)·(1−e^(−k·dt))`, with k = 5.2, or 18 while dragging. `dt` is capped at 50ms. When `s` passes ±4 loops, shift `s` and `T` by whole loops.
- **Active film:** `round(s) mod 12`. On change, swap the caption with `dir = sign(T−s)`.
- **Timeline dot:** interpolate the year between the films at `floor(s)` and `floor(s)+1`. On the 1989 → 1958 wrap, jump at the halfway point. It eases at `1−e^(−14dt)` and jumps directly when more than 6 years away. Left is `(year−1955)/35`.
- **Cover tilt:**
  - The pointer is "on the cover" when it is within `.55d` of the screen centre and `.55H` of the shelf centre, the shelf has settled (`|T−s| < .3`) and the detail is closed.
  - On the cover: `tiltY → (mx−W/2)/(.55d)·8°` and `tiltX → −(my−cy)/(H/2)·5°`.
  - Elsewhere: `tiltY → (mx−W/2)/W·4°` and `tiltX → 0`.
  - Both ease at `1−e^(−7dt)`.
- **Play ring scale:** `smoothstep(max(0, 1−|T−s|·3))`, or 0 while the detail is open.

### Inputs
- **Click a tape:** the active one opens the detail; any other glides to `round(T + r)`. Clicks are ignored after a drag.
- **Arrows and keys:** arrows and ←/→ step ±1. Enter opens, Escape closes.
- **Drag:** `T = T0 − dx/(ws+gap)` once moved more than 5px. Release snaps to the nearest integer.
- **Wheel:** `T += delta/(ws+gap)·.5`, using the larger axis, then snaps after 160ms idle. It is ignored while the detail is open.
- **Timeline click:** convert x to a year and jump to the film with the nearest year by the shortest way round.

## Caption swap (mask slide)

- A new span is appended over the old one inside the mask.
- The new span slides from `translateY(dir·105%)` to 0.
- Each old span slides from its current transform to `translateY(−dir·105%)` and is then removed.
- Timing: 650ms, `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, `fill both`.

## Detail sheet

**Structure:** a fixed full-screen `.detail` in `--sheet`, z 60, hidden until opened.
- **Grid:** two columns with a 4vw gap and padding `110px 6vw 56px 7vw`.
- **Close button:** a boxed `.lbl` "CLOSE / 閉じる" at 36px, 28px.
- **Brand:** a cobalt copy of the brand ("LEON VASARI —— FILM ARCHIVE") top right.

**Left column:** centred vertically, max 520px, 18px gap. Every line sits in its own mask:
1. The cobalt subtitle `.lbl`.
2. The title in Inter Tight 600, `clamp(44px,5.2vw,80px)`, letter-spacing −.03em, cobalt.
3. The muted meta line `YEAR / GENRE / N min`.
4. The synopsis in Newsreader 17px/1.5, max 42ch.
5. The italic muted credit "Written and directed by Leon Vasari. 監督作品".
6. A 44px cobalt-bordered button "WATCH THE FILM / 映画を見る".

**Right column:** the poster SVG (viewBox 474 × 900, height `min(100%,78vh)`).
- **Image:** the cover crop, masked by seven white circles in a group.
- **Ink filter on that group:** `feTurbulence` fractalNoise, baseFrequency .011, 3 octaves, seed 7, into `feDisplacementMap` with scale 120 (R/G channels).
- **Circles** (cx, cy, delay ms): (150,330,0) (340,600,120) (250,120,220) (90,760,300) (400,250,360) (260,860,420) (230,470,180).

**Open:**
1. Snap T, fill in the texts, aim the poster image, and reset the radii to 0.
2. Read the cover face's projected `getBoundingClientRect`.
3. Animate the sheet's `clip-path` from `inset(top right bottom left round 3px)` (the cover rect) to `inset(0 round 0)` over **1050ms** with `cubic-bezier(.76,0,.18,1)`. A blank rectangle of paper grows straight out of the cover to fill the screen.
4. The text lines rise from `translateY(110%)` over 900ms, with delays of `620 + i·75` ms.
5. From 520ms, each circle grows from 0 to r = 720 over 1250ms after its delay (ease-out cubic). The poster bleeds in as ragged ink blots.

**Close:** the reverse clip back to the current cover rect over 850ms, then hide the sheet and cancel its animations.

## Phones (≤ 767px)
- `--H:min(68vw,40svh)` and `--cy:43%`.
- **Top bar:** 60px, 16px padding. The nav text is hidden (the burger stays) and the brand line is 22px.
- **Kanji:** 22vw at .8 opacity.
- **Caption:** the title is 27px. The arrows drop to bottom 118px at the screen edges.
- **Timeline:** 16px sides, bottom 54px, and every other year label is hidden.
- **Detail:** one scrolling column with the poster first at 46svh and a 42px title.
- No custom cursor; finger drag scrubs the shelf.

## Reduced motion
- The spring and lift are instant.
- Captions swap without sliding.
- The sheet and text animations take 1ms.
- The ink starts 5s in the past, so the poster shows at once.

# Leon Vasari: Curved VHS Archive (exact recreation prompt)

Give me the superdetailed exact prompt to recreate this page exactly as it is, including the correct asset URL, all elements, animations, and fonts. This is that prompt.

## What it is

Build a single-screen **film archive hero** for a fictional director, Leon Vasari. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript in one file, with no framework and no libraries.

The page is warm off-white paper.
- **The shelf:** across the middle, worn VHS tapes stand on a **curved arc that recedes into depth**. Spines get smaller, darker and more tightly packed toward both edges, about 11 per side. They turn slightly toward the centre and sit lower as they go back, like a shelf bent into a shallow bowl.
- **The active tape:** the tape at the centre is **turned 90° in 3D** so its illustrated front cover faces you, pushed slightly forward, over a soft floor shadow.
- **Background:** two columns of giant halftone kanji, **映画** on the left and **の記憶** on the right, sit behind the shelf.
- **Caption:** under the cover, the film's title is set big and bold in cobalt, with its romanised and kanji titles, a short rule and "YEAR — GENRE". Arrows sit on either side.
- **Timeline:** a ruler from 1955 to 1990 runs along the bottom. A cobalt dot glides to the active film's year.
- **Detail sheet:** clicking the cover grows a sheet of paper out of it into a full-screen detail page. Its poster bleeds in like ink.

Everything runs on one `requestAnimationFrame` loop plus the Web Animations API. There are no opacity fades: every reveal is a mask slide, a clip or a scale.

## Media: every asset URL

All 24 images come from **four Higgsfield GPT Image 2.5 sheets** with transparent backgrounds, loaded through the Higgsfield image proxy as WebP. The art is fictional, unbranded VHS art. Each spine and cover is a rectangle cropped out of a sheet with CSS backgrounds; there are no separate image files.

| Sheet id | Size (px) | Contents | URL |
|---|---|---|---|
| covers | 1744 × 2336 | all 12 covers in a 4 × 3 grid | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261029_010644_837e04ca-2418-45c1-b8e0-0233265c4cd5.png&w=1744&q=85 |
| spines | 2688 × 1152 | 12 spines in one row (9 used) | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261029_010738_a3e47ead-18f2-4974-9468-06d16a25edc5.png&w=2688&q=85 |
| fix | 1520 × 2688 | re-drawn spine RIVER OF SALT | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261029_010831_3ebb874b-93dc-433e-87ed-6299aba720f0.png&w=1520&q=85 |
| fix2 | 1520 × 2688 | re-drawn spines THE OBSERVER and LIGHT IN THE STORM | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261029_092020_f96bc094-db7b-46de-9298-074a24e0a3b8.png&w=1520&q=85 |

**What the art looks like:**
- **Spines** (about 1:6): worn cardboard, a small illustration at the top, the title vertical in a condensed serif, then "VASARI" and a boxed "VHS".
- **Covers** (about 1:1.95): "A LEON VASARI FILM" at the top, a big condensed serif title, a duotone screen-print illustration in ink, cobalt, vermilion and cream, and a "VHS" badge.

Crop boxes are in sheet pixels, `x, y, w, h`:

| Film id | Spine sheet | Spine box | Cover sheet | Cover box |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| valley | spines | 266, 31, 189, 1089 | covers | 497, 72, 344, 659 |
| bluehour | spines | 492, 31, 189, 1089 | covers | 914, 72, 342, 659 |
| river | fix | 197, 54, 324, 2566 | covers | 1332, 72, 344, 659 |
| summer | spines | 937, 31, 188, 1089 | covers | 74, 813, 344, 676 |
| green | spines | 1157, 31, 185, 1090 | covers | 497, 815, 344, 674 |
| noon | spines | 44, 32, 184, 1088 | covers | 74, 72, 347, 659 |
| observer | fix2 | 371, 15, 349, 2655 | covers | 915, 815, 342, 675 |
| birds | spines | 1573, 31, 183, 1089 | covers | 1331, 815, 345, 675 |
| storm | fix2 | 808, 15, 347, 2656 | covers | 74, 1571, 345, 681 |
| tide | spines | 2012, 31, 188, 1089 | covers | 496, 1577, 343, 678 |
| war | spines | 2236, 31, 189, 1089 | covers | 913, 1579, 343, 676 |
| door | spines | 2462, 31, 188, 1089 | covers | 1331, 1579, 344, 677 |

**Cropping:**
- Store the tables as `SHEET[id] = [url, W, H]` and `CROP['spine-<id>'|'cover-<id>'] = [sheet, x, y, w, h]`.
- A face's background is `background-image:url(sheet); background-size:(W/w·100)% (H/h·100)%; background-position:(x/(W−w)·100)% (y/(H−h)·100)%`.
- **Detail poster:** an SVG `<image>` of the sheet with `x=−x·474/w`, `y=−y·900/h`, `width=W·474/w`, `height=H·900/h` and `preserveAspectRatio="none"`, clipped to a 474 × 900 rect.
- Preload the four sheets as `Image()` objects on start.

## Fonts (all embedded as base64 WOFF2)

| Family | Weight | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Inter Tight (variable 100–900) | 500, 600 | Every label, the caption title, the detail title, years |
| Newsreader (variable 200–800, roman and italic) | 400 | Detail synopsis and italic credit |
| Noto Sans JP | 500 | All small Japanese text (labels, kanji titles); second in the sans stack |
| Noto Serif SC | 700 | (embedded, not visible in this layout) |
| "Noto Sans JP Big" | 800 | The giant 映画 / の記憶 only: a Google Fonts subset of Noto Sans JP 800 with `text=映画の記憶`, `font-display:block` |

- **Sans stack:** `"Inter Tight","Noto Sans JP",system-ui,sans-serif`.
- **Serif stack:** `"Newsreader",Georgia,serif`.

## Tokens

```css
--paper:#ECE8E0; --sheet:#F3F0EA; --ink:#141414; --muted:#6D6A63; --cobalt:#1F3FB0; --rule:rgba(20,20,20,.9);
--ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
--H:min(47vh,33vw);  /* tape height; min(68vw,40svh) on phones */
--cy:41%;            /* shelf centre line; 43% on phones */
```

- `body` is paper, with hidden overflow, `user-select:none` and antialiasing. On `(pointer:fine)` the native cursor is hidden.
- **Paper grain:** a fixed full-screen layer (z 40, no pointer events, `mix-blend-mode:multiply`, opacity .6). It is a 220px SVG tile: `feTurbulence` fractalNoise (baseFrequency .85, 3 octaves, stitchTiles) through `feColorMatrix` `0 0 0 0 .45 / 0 0 0 0 .42 / 0 0 0 0 .38 / 0 0 0 .22 0`.
- **`.lbl`:** Inter Tight 600, 10.5px, line-height 1, letter-spacing .14em, uppercase.
- **`.box`:** inline-flex, 21px tall, 0 8px padding, 1px `--rule` border.

## Layout (desktop; everything fixed)

1. **Top bar:** 76px tall, 36px side padding, space-between, all cobalt.

6. **Caption:** a centred grid at `top: --cy + H/2 + 4.2vh`, 10px gap. Each line sits in an overflow mask, `min(80vw,640px)` wide.
   - **Title:** Inter Tight 600, `clamp(28px,3.4vw,46px)`, letter-spacing −.015em, cobalt (e.g. **Noon in Ashes**).

10. **Cursor:** 58px, fixed, z 100.

    - **Movement:** it follows with `1 − e^(−16dt)` smoothing.
    - **States:**
      - `.open` (over the settled cover): the ring scales to 1.75 and fills cobalt, and the label pops in.
      - `.spine` (over other tapes): .72.
      - `.btn` (over buttons, links or the timeline): .55 with no dot.
    - **Transitions:** ring .5s, colours .4s, dot .4s, label .45s.

## Film data (shelf order; the page opens on index 5)

| # | id | Title | Romaji | Kanji | Year | Genre | Min | Synopsis |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | valley | The Silent Valley | SHIZUKANA TANI | 静かな谷 | 1958 | Drama | 104 | A schoolteacher returns to the mountain village that exiled her father, and finds the valley has kept every one of its secrets. |
| 1 | bluehour | The Blue Hour | AO NO TOKI | 青の刻 | 1962 | Romance | 97 | Over one long evening in a harbour town, a widow and a stranger trade small lies until the light runs out. |
| 2 | river | River of Salt | SHIO NO KAWA | 塩の川 | 1964 | Drama | 121 | Two brothers drag a salt barge downriver to a city that no longer wants anything they carry. |
| 3 | summer | The Last Summer | SAIGO NO NATSU | 最後の夏 | 1966 | Drama | 109 | The summer before the dam floods their village, three friends set fire to everything they cannot take with them. |
| 4 | green | The Green Road | MIDORI NO MICHI | 緑の道 | 1969 | Mystery | 101 | A surveyor mapping a forest road keeps finding the same footprints, always one day ahead of him. |
| 5 | noon | Noon in Ashes | HAI NO SHOGO | 灰の正午 | 1971 | Western | 112 | A rider crosses a white desert to settle an old debt, and learns too late who sent him. |
| 6 | observer | The Observer | KANSATSUSHA | 観察者 | 1973 | Thriller | 96 | A night watchman begins to suspect that the building he guards has started watching him back. |
| 7 | birds | The Fallen Birds | OCHITA TORI | 落ちた鳥 | 1975 | Drama | 118 | When the birds stop singing over a frontier town, the mayor’s daughter is the only one who goes looking for the reason. |
| 8 | storm | Light in the Storm | ARASHI NO HI | 嵐の灯 | 1978 | Drama | 127 | A lighthouse keeper and his son wait out a three-day storm with a shipwrecked sailor who will not give his name. |
| 9 | tide | The Long Tide | NAGAI SHIO | 長い潮 | 1981 | Drama | 99 | A fisherman’s wife counts the tides on the harbour wall while her husband’s boat fails to come home. |
| 10 | war | A Quiet War | SHIZUKANA SENSO | 静かな戦争 | 1985 | Comedy | 103 | Two neighbours fight a silent war over a garden wall for thirty years, and neither will say how it began. |
| 11 | door | Red Door | AKAI TOBIRA | 赤い扉 | 1989 | Thriller | 114 | A projectionist follows a reel of unknown film through the corridors of a cinema on its final night. |

Render the 12 films three times (36 tapes, virtual index `v = copy×12 + i`). Start at `s = T = 5 + 12`.

## Arc geometry (the core of this design)

### Measured values
Measure H with a probe element of `height:var(--H)`. Then:
- `ws = H·142/840`, `d = H·474/900`, `gap = H·.035`
- `U = H·1.3` on desktop, `H·1.05` below 768px (the depth falloff)
- `P = 1400` (the CSS perspective)

### Functions
- **Relative index:** `rel(v,s) = ((v−s) mod 36)` mapped into [−18, 18).
- **Arc length from the centre:** `F(r) = r·(ws+gap) + (d − ws + 1.4·gap)·B(r)`, where `B(r) = (r + sin(πr)/π)/2` for |r| < 1 and `±.5` otherwise. The open cover pushes its neighbours apart smoothly.
- **Screen scale at arc length u:** `scl(u) = 1/(1 + (|u|/U)^1.6)`.
- **Screen x:** the integral of `scl`. Precompute `XS` by stepping u from 0 to 3U in 2px steps, accumulating `2/(1+(u/U)^1.6)`. Then `xsc(u) = sign(u)·XS[|u|/2]`. Far spines pack tighter in screen space.

### Per tape, every frame
- `o = smoothstep(max(0, 1−|r|))`: 0 for a spine, 1 for the open cover.
- `u = F(r)`. If `|u| > U·1.95`, hide the tape.
- `sc = scl(u)` and `k = 1/sc`. The tape sits at the depth that gives this on-screen scale:
  - `z = P·(1−k) + o·H·.1`
  - `x = xsc(u)·k`
  - `y = (H·.5·(1−sc)·.42 + o·H·.012 − lift·H·.05)·k`, so far tapes sink a little, forming the bowl.
- `rotateY = sign(u)·min(1,|u|/U)·26°·(1−o) − 90°·o + tiltY·o`, and `rotateX = tiltX·o`.
- Transform: `translate3d(x,y,z) rotateX() rotateY()`. z-index `round(3000+z)`.
- **Shading:** the spine's `--shade` is `min(.6, o·.55 + (1−sc)·.32)`, so far spines darken. The cover's `--shade` is `(1−o)·.82`.
- **Hover lift:** a hovered non-active tape (`|r| > .5`) eases its lift to 1 at `1−e^(−12dt)`.

### Motion
- **Spring:** `s += (T−s)·(1−e^(−k·dt))`, with k = 5.2, or 18 while dragging. `dt` is capped at 50ms. When `s` passes ±4 loops, shift `s` and `T` by whole loops.
- **Active film:** `round(s) mod 12`. On change, swap the caption with `dir = sign(T−s)`.
- **Timeline dot:** interpolate the year between the films at `floor(s)` and `floor(s)+1`. On the 1989 → 1958 wrap, jump at the halfway point. It eases at `1−e^(−14dt)` and jumps directly when more than 6 years away. Left is `(year−1955)/35`.
- **Cover tilt:**
  - The pointer is "on the cover" when it is within `.55d` of the screen centre and `.55H` of the shelf centre, the shelf has settled (`|T−s| < .3`) and the detail is closed.
  - On the cover: `tiltY → (mx−W/2)/(.55d)·8°` and `tiltX → −(my−cy)/(H/2)·5°`.
  - Elsewhere: `tiltY → (mx−W/2)/W·4°` and `tiltX → 0`.
  - Both ease at `1−e^(−7dt)`.
- **Play ring scale:** `smoothstep(max(0, 1−|T−s|·3))`, or 0 while the detail is open.

### Inputs
- **Click a tape:** the active one opens the detail; any other glides to `round(T + r)`. Clicks are ignored after a drag.
- **Arrows and keys:** arrows and ←/→ step ±1. Enter opens, Escape closes.
- **Drag:** `T = T0 − dx/(ws+gap)` once moved more than 5px. Release snaps to the nearest integer.
- **Wheel:** `T += delta/(ws+gap)·.5`, using the larger axis, then snaps after 160ms idle. It is ignored while the detail is open.
- **Timeline click:** convert x to a year and jump to the film with the nearest year by the shortest way round.

## Caption swap (mask slide)

- A new span is appended over the old one inside the mask.
- The new span slides from `translateY(dir·105%)` to 0.
- Each old span slides from its current transform to `translateY(−dir·105%)` and is then removed.
- Timing: 650ms, `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, `fill both`.

## Detail sheet

**Structure:** a fixed full-screen `.detail` in `--sheet`, z 60, hidden until opened.
- **Grid:** two columns with a 4vw gap and padding `110px 6vw 56px 7vw`.
- **Close button:** a boxed `.lbl` "CLOSE / 閉じる" at 36px, 28px.
- **Brand:** a cobalt copy of the brand ("LEON VASARI —— FILM ARCHIVE") top right.

**Left column:** centred vertically, max 520px, 18px gap. Every line sits in its own mask:
1. The cobalt subtitle `.lbl`.
2. The title in Inter Tight 600, `clamp(44px,5.2vw,80px)`, letter-spacing −.03em, cobalt.
3. The muted meta line `YEAR / GENRE / N min`.
4. The synopsis in Newsreader 17px/1.5, max 42ch.
5. The italic muted credit "Written and directed by Leon Vasari. 監督作品".
6. A 44px cobalt-bordered button "WATCH THE FILM / 映画を見る".

**Right column:** the poster SVG (viewBox 474 × 900, height `min(100%,78vh)`).
- **Image:** the cover crop, masked by seven white circles in a group.
- **Ink filter on that group:** `feTurbulence` fractalNoise, baseFrequency .011, 3 octaves, seed 7, into `feDisplacementMap` with scale 120 (R/G channels).
- **Circles** (cx, cy, delay ms): (150,330,0) (340,600,120) (250,120,220) (90,760,300) (400,250,360) (260,860,420) (230,470,180).

**Open:**
1. Snap T, fill in the texts, aim the poster image, and reset the radii to 0.
2. Read the cover face's projected `getBoundingClientRect`.
3. Animate the sheet's `clip-path` from `inset(top right bottom left round 3px)` (the cover rect) to `inset(0 round 0)` over **1050ms** with `cubic-bezier(.76,0,.18,1)`. A blank rectangle of paper grows straight out of the cover to fill the screen.
4. The text lines rise from `translateY(110%)` over 900ms, with delays of `620 + i·75` ms.
5. From 520ms, each circle grows from 0 to r = 720 over 1250ms after its delay (ease-out cubic). The poster bleeds in as ragged ink blots.

**Close:** the reverse clip back to the current cover rect over 850ms, then hide the sheet and cancel its animations.

## Phones (≤ 767px)
- `--H:min(68vw,40svh)` and `--cy:43%`.
- **Top bar:** 60px, 16px padding. The nav text is hidden (the burger stays) and the brand line is 22px.
- **Kanji:** 22vw at .8 opacity.
- **Caption:** the title is 27px. The arrows drop to bottom 118px at the screen edges.
- **Timeline:** 16px sides, bottom 54px, and every other year label is hidden.
- **Detail:** one scrolling column with the poster first at 46svh and a 42px title.
- No custom cursor; finger drag scrubs the shelf.

## Reduced motion
- The spring and lift are instant.
- Captions swap without sliding.
- The sheet and text animations take 1ms.
- The ink starts 5s in the past, so the poster shows at once.

items.prompt_text: # Mossline: Floating Moss Island Scroll Fly-In (exact recreation prompt) Build a single-file landing page for **Mossline**, a fictional environmental-data company that measures ecosystems with field sensors. The page is one long pinned scroll story followed by a white solutions section. The story has five beats: 1. **Hero:** a misty pale-grey sky with a huge floating rock island covered in moss and ferns, and the one-line headline "Measure the Living Planet". The island's ferns grow in front of the bottom of the headline letters. 2. **Fly-in:** scrolling scrubs a cinematic video in which the camera pushes into the island, glides over its mossy top and lands at eye level in a moss landscape facing a slim sensor mast. Two small floating rocks fly past the camera, and the vision statement resolves out of blur mid-flight. 3. **Landscape:** an accounting paragraph writes in word by word and four lime hotspots pop up on the moss. A fog bank rolls in from the left to keep the sky behind the text clean. 4. **Station:** a heading, a glass "Accumulated carbon balance" card with a count-up and a drawing sparkline, and a five-row feature list. 5. **Solutions:** a white rounded panel slides up with a heading, three tilting image cards and four count-up stats. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written. --- ## 1. Page basics - ``, title `Mossline — Measure the Living Planet`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8. - **Fonts (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the five latin woff2 faces (Inter Tight 400/500/600, JetBrains Mono 400/500) as base64 `@font-face` rules instead of the link. - **CSS variables on `:root`:** - `--ink:#10291a`, `--ink2:#2c4434` - `--mist:#e7ebe8`, `--paper:#f6f7f4` - `--lime:#c6f35c`, `--lime2:#a9dd3a` - `--glass:rgba(244,247,243,.16)`, `--line:rgba(255,255,255,.28)` - `--sans:"Inter Tight","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif` - `--mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace` - **Global reset and base:** - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`. - `html` and `body` background `var(--mist)`; body font `var(--sans)`, colour `var(--ink)`, `-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased`, `overflow-x:hidden`. - Links inherit colour with no underline. - **`.mono` utility:** mono font, uppercase, letter-spacing .14em, 11px. - **`.chip`** (the lime tag used everywhere): inline-flex, centred, height 22px, padding 0 9px, background `--lime`, colour `--ink`, radius 3px, mono 10.5px, letter-spacing .16em, uppercase. ## 2. Assets (all URLs exact) All images are Higgsfield results served through the images.higgs.ai proxy. The video is a direct CloudFront mp4. 1. **Fly-in video (Kling 4.0, 5.04 s, 24 fps, 121 frames, 1912×1080, no audio):** `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261106_025717_906b686d-9a9a-4dea-bab4-ae2454f8390e.mp4` Content: the camera starts on the floating moss island in the misty sky, pushes forward and descends over its mossy top through fog, and lands at eye level in a moss-and-fern landscape facing a slim grey sensor mast (white louvered sensor housings, small solar panel). Distant floating rocks hang in the haze behind. 2. **High-res hero still (GPT Image 2.5 recreation of video frame 0, 2688×1520):** `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_031618_8ce6dca1-972d-429d-8d13-bf0691c37848.png&w=2400&q=88` 3. **Transparent cut-out of that still (big island plus two small side rocks on transparency):** `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_031657_baaa3380-5ece-482a-a623-a1838fd7653c.png&w=2400&q=90` 4. **Floating rock sprite sheet (three mossy rocks in a row on transparency, treated as a 1200×678 coordinate frame):** `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_025635_82593f6a-1cf7-41c1-94ac-96fb89ebfd1a.png&w=2400&q=85` 5. **Sensor-mast landscape still (used for two solution cards):** `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_025630_9a37a1e0-2547-4973-8160-c75205993914.png&w=1400&q=82` 6. **Floating island in clouds still (used for the middle solution card):** `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_025545_b003e5cc-e68f-4fee-b686-c217a5d81eea.png&w=1400&q=82` ## 3. Navigation (fixed) - **Bar:** fixed to the top, z-index 50, a three-column grid (`1fr auto 1fr`), items centred, padding 22px 34px. - **Logo (left):** - Flex with 9px gap; Inter Tight 600, 21px, letter-spacing -.02em; text "Mossline". - Icon: a 26×26 inline SVG on a 32×32 viewBox. - A hexagon filled with currentColor: path `M16 2l12 7v14l-12 7-12-7V9z`. - A lime `#c6f35c` leaf on top: path `M16 8c-4 4-5 9-1 16 1-5 4-9 8-11-3 0-5 1-7 3 0-3 0-5 0-8z`. - **Menu (centre):** - Four links with a 30px gap: "Solutions", "Our tech", "Company", "Resources". - Each is mono 11.5px, letter-spacing .14em, uppercase, with a 7px gap before a chevron. - Chevron: a 6×6 box with 1.3px right and bottom borders in currentColor, `translateY(-2px) rotate(45deg)`. - Hover colour `--lime2`. - **Right:** - "LET'S TALK" in mono 11.5px, letter-spacing .16em, with a 12px gap before a 20×20 lime square (radius 3px) holding "›" in ink. - On hover the square shifts 3px right (.3s transition). ## 4. Scroll story structure - **`#story`:** position relative, height **640vh**. - **Stage:** sticky at top 0, height 100vh, overflow hidden, background `#dfe3e0`. Inside it, in stacking order: 1. **Camera box `.cam`:** absolute with inset `-9% -3% -3%` (it overhangs the top by 9% and the other sides by 3%), `will-change:transform`. It contains: - A ``. - The high-res still (asset 2) as ``, absolutely filling the box with `object-fit:cover`, stacked above the canvas. - A `.mist` div at inset -10% with two radial gradients: `40% 30% at 20% 80%` white .55 → transparent 70%, and `35% 25% at 85% 30%` white .4 → transparent 70%. It runs a "drift" animation (18 s ease-in-out infinite alternate) to `translate3d(4%,-2%,0)`. 2. **Hidden `

items.title: Main Character
items.prompt_text: # Main Character Mode: Interactive Life-Sim Social Post (exact recreation prompt) Build a single-file, interactive 4:5 social-media post in the style of a life-simulation game. A stylish young woman sits on an invisible chair on a bright green hill under a clear blue sky. A green rotating crystal gem floats above her head, and cream pill-shaped action bubbles fan out around her like a game pie menu: "Gossip", "Flirt", "Change Outfit", "Ask About Mood", "Talk About Pet", "More Choices…". The woman subtly comes alive in a looping video. Each bubble triggers its own effect: - floating hearts - a speech bubble with gibberish - a sparkle-swirl outfit change - a mood panel - a thought bubble - a second page of choices Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written. --- ## 1. Page basics - ``, title `Main Character Mode`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8. - **Font (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Nunito:wght@700;800;900&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the three latin woff2 faces (Nunito 700/800/900) as base64 `@font-face` rules instead of the link. - **CSS variables:** `--navy:#1f3f8f`, `--pill1:#fffaf4`, `--pill2:#f3e9de`, `--sky:#3f8fd8`. - **Reset and base:** - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`. - `html,body` fill the height with `overflow:hidden` and background `#3d86cf`. - body font `"Nunito","Trebuchet MS",system-ui,sans-serif`, antialiased, `user-select:none`. ## 2. Assets (all URLs exact) 1. **Idle loop video (Kling 4.0, 5.04 s, 24 fps, 1288×1608, 4:5, no audio):** a static camera; she breathes, slowly turns her head to the camera with a slight smile, then turns back to look off to the side; a breeze ripples the grass and her curls. The first frame equals the last frame, so it loops seamlessly. `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261106_062821_b3d651fe-7fbe-4e60-b4f5-77b953e1d1ce.mp4` 2. **Scene still and poster (GPT Image 2.5, 1792×2240, 4:5):** a bright gradient blue sky with fine film grain and a lush green grass hill sloping down from the left. A young woman with short dark curly hair and gold hoops sits on an invisible chair, one knee raised, hands on the knee, looking off to her right. She wears an oversized pastel-yellow and white striped short-sleeve shirt, wide-leg cream trousers and plain white chunky sneakers. Two patches of red flowers sit in the grass, and a long soft shadow falls to the right. `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_062711_9bf7546c-1db2-4093-97d4-0e32ea8d2abd.png&w=1800&q=86` 3. **Second outfit still (same frame, pixel-aligned):** a cropped cobalt-blue bomber jacket over a white tee, baggy light-wash jeans and chunky red sneakers. `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_062819_17105efe-2915-4316-bf1a-e0df5aaf09f5.png&w=1800&q=86` 4. **Icon sticker sheet (transparent PNG, glossy cartoon icons, treated as a 1300×735 frame).** Eight icons in a 4×2 grid: - lips at (185,225) - pink heart at (492,225) - blue cap at (795,225) - two speech bubbles ("chat") at (1115,225) - white puppy ("dog") at (175,500) - laughing face ("laugh") at (495,500) - gold four-point star at (797,505) - purple music note at (1102,500) `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_062315_19b00fc8-cf66-4329-9c8f-9a6b05569d1a.png&w=1300&q=90` **Icon sprite helper `icon(el,key)`:** cell size c=210. Set the background-image to the sheet, `background-size: (1300/c*100)% (735/c*100)%`, and `background-position: ((cx-c/2)/(1300-c)*100)% ((cy-c/2)/(735-c)*100)%`. ## 3. Layout - **Backdrop:** a fixed `.backdrop` at inset -8% shows the poster image `center/cover`, with `filter: blur(40px) saturate(1.1)` and `scale(1.05)`. - **Card `#scene`:** absolutely centred (translate -50%,-50%), overflow hidden, shadow `0 30px 80px rgba(10,40,80,.35)`. - **Sizing (JS, on load and on resize):** `w = min(innerWidth, innerHeight*.8)`, `h = w*1.25`, and `font-size = w/100` px, so **1em = 1% of the card width**. Everything inside uses card % and em. - CSS variable `--hx: 51.6%` (her head's x). - **Stacking order inside the card:** 1. `

items.prompt_text: # Arriving Tomorrow: Mix-and-Match Outfit Drop Post (exact recreation prompt) Build a single-file, interactive, square (1:1) social-media post that teases a clothing drop. Below it sits an oversized hoodie, with relaxed drawstring sweat shorts underneath, both shot as clean ghost-mannequin product photos, plus thin ‹ › arrows on the left and right. - **Arrows:** clicking an arrow swaps the outfit to the next colourway. The hoodie slides out one way and the shorts the other, then the new pieces cross in from the opposite sides and land with a small tilt wobble. - **Single piece:** tapping just the hoodie or just the shorts changes only that piece, and dragging a piece sideways swipes it. - **Autoplay:** when idle, the post plays itself. Every colour is made in code from one white hoodie photo and one white shorts photo. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Every value below is exact. items.title: Card Stack
items.prompt_text:
# Opaque Stack: WebGL Leaning-Card Portfolio with Fly-to-Page Transition (exact recreation prompt)

Build a single-file portfolio home page for a fictional creative studio, **OPAQUE®**.

**The stack:** on an off-white `#fafafa` canvas, a long diagonal row of thin portrait image cards stands in 3D. Each card is turned −30° and the row leans from the lower left to the upper right, seen through a very narrow 5° lens from slightly above.

- **Scroll or drag:** the row slides endlessly along its diagonal, with eased momentum.
- **Hover:** the card under the cursor slides out of the stack, and its uppercase title follows the cursor.
- **Click a card:**
  1. Every other card vanishes at once.
  2. The clicked card glides to the centre of the screen, turns to face the viewer and becomes square, while the camera flies to a straight-on view.
  3. The project page fades in over it: a centred title and description, a two-column image grid, and a "Next project" row.
- **Back:** clicking "OPAQUE® PROJECTS" (or pressing Esc) returns to the stack, and the row flies in again.

Each card's edges blur softly into the page through a custom shader: sharp in the middle, blurred towards every edge.

Use plain HTML, CSS and JS in one file, with **three.js r128** and **GSAP 3.12.5** from cdnjs. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written.

---

## 1. Page basics

- `<html lang="en">`, title `OPAQUE® Projects`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8.
- **Font (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the Inter latin woff2 faces (400 and 500) as base64 `@font-face` rules instead.
- **Scripts, in this order before the inline script:**
  - `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js`
  - `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js`
- **Variables:** `--bg:#fafafa`, `--ink:#141414`, `--mute:#a9a9a9`, `--line:rgba(0,0,0,.08)`.
- **Reset and base:**
  - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`.
  - `html,body` fill the height, `overflow:hidden`, background `var(--bg)`.
  - body font `"Inter","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif`, ink colour, antialiased.
- **Utility class `.u`:** 11px, letter-spacing .02em, uppercase.
- **The body starts with class `loading`.**

## 2. The single image asset

All twelve projects come from **one 4×3 contact sheet** (2336×1744, white gutters): twelve moody editorial images.

| Row | Images |
|---|---|
| 1 | Red glossy lips with a gold ring; soft white cumulus clouds in blue sky; red neon tubes at night; a white mannequin bust in hard venetian-blind light |
| 2 | A blue-tinted woman's face close-up; a woman's silhouette against warm orange light; liquid chrome metal spheres; a glowing blue jellyfish in the dark |
| 3 | Grey concrete stairs with a hard diagonal shadow; a rainbow prism light leak; car headlights in fog; a black-and-white crashing wave |

URL (exact):

`https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_084005_ab0d1fcf-a93f-4e32-a277-1523e1768fbe.png&w=2400&q=88`

**Cutting the sheet into cells:**

- Load it with `crossOrigin='anonymous'`.
- Use the sheet constants `SW=2336, SH=1744, CW=.2425, CG=.01, RH=.3244, RG=.0134`.
- Cell i is at column `c=i%4` and row `r=floor(i/4)`. With `k = naturalWidth/SW`, the cell is at:
  - x `c*(CW+CG)*SW*k`, width `CW*SW*k`
  - y `r*(RH+RG)*SH*k`, height `RH*SH*k`
- `cellCanvas(i,size)` draws a cell into a square canvas. For each project:
  - the **sharp** texture is a 512px canvas (`THREE.CanvasTexture`);
  - the **blur** texture is a 24px canvas (`CanvasTexture`, `minFilter = magFilter = LinearFilter`), so upscaling it is the blur;
  - `url` is the 512px canvas as a JPEG data URL (quality .7), used for the corner thumbnail.
- After each project, add `100/12` to the loading progress and wait 30ms.

**Projects** (name, category, year):

| # | Name | Category | Year |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Velvet Mouth | Graphic identity | 2025 |
| 1 | Cumulus | Site design | 2025 |
| 2 | No Signal | Video | 2024 |
| 3 | Still Life | 3D | 2024 |
| 4 | Memories | AI | 2025 |
| 5 | Shadowplay | Graphic identity | 2024 |
| 6 | Mercury | 3D | 2025 |
| 7 | Abyss | Site design | 2024 |
| 8 | Concrete Poem | Graphic identity | 2023 |
| 9 | Prism | AI | 2025 |
| 10 | Headlights | Video | 2023 |
| 11 | Tide | Site design | 2024 |

- **Categories:** `All, Graphic identity, Site design, AI, Video, 3D`.
- **REPEAT = 3:** the twelve projects appear three times, giving 36 cards.

## 3. Renderer and camera

- **Canvas `#gl`:** `position:fixed; inset:0`, full size, `touch-action:none`.
  - `body.hov #gl` gets `cursor:pointer`; `body.drag #gl` gets `cursor:grabbing`.
- **Renderer:** `THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas, antialias:true, alpha:false})`, clear colour `#fafafa`, pixel ratio `min(devicePixelRatio,2)`.
- **Camera:** `PerspectiveCamera(5, innerWidth/innerHeight, .1, 1000)`.
  - `placeCamera()`: position `(0, 100/7.5, aspect<1 ? 55 : 35)`, then `lookAt(0,0,0)`.
  - On resize: set the renderer size, update the aspect and projection, and call `placeCamera()` unless a project is open.
- **Group:** one `world` group in the scene holds every card.

## 4. Card shader (ShaderMaterial, transparent)

**Vertex shader:** pass `vUv`; standard projection.

**Fragment shader**, with uniforms `uMeshSize` (vec2), `uImageSize` (vec2, set to 1,1), `uImageTexture`, `uBlurTexture`, `uOpacity`:

```
ratio = vec2(min((mesh.x/mesh.y)/(img.x/img.y),1.0), min((mesh.y/mesh.x)/(img.y/img.x),1.0))
uvCover = vUv*ratio + (1-ratio)*0.5
progress = 1.0; margin = 0.15
on each of the four edges: progress.rgb *= smoothstep(edge, edge±margin, vUv)
blur.a *= 0.75
color = mix(sharp, blur, 1.0 - progress.r)
color.a *= uOpacity
```

The middle 70% of the card is sharp, and the outer 15% on each side fades into the blurred copy.

## 5. Cards and layout

- **Sizes:** `GAP=.375`, `BE=4/3`, `SC=1-(BE-1)*.5`, `H0=1.5*SC`, `W0=1.5*BE*SC`.
- **Geometry:** `BoxGeometry(H0, W0, .0175)`, a thin portrait slab.
- **Each card is:**
  - `mesh`: the shader material, with `uMeshSize = (H0, W0)`;
  - `hit`: the same geometry with an invisible `MeshBasicMaterial` (opacity 0, transparent, no depth write), `scale.x = 1.5`, a generous hover target;
  - `inner` group: holds the mesh and slides on hover;
  - `holder` group: holds `inner` and `hit`, and is placed on the row.
- **Card state:** `{n, i, mesh, hit, inner, holder, order:n, visK:1, on:true}`.
- **Motion state:**
  - `scroll = {current:0, previous:0}`
  - `mouse = {x:-1, y:-1, drag:{x,y,active}, on:{x,y}, down}`
  - `M = 0` (eased drag)
  - `intro = {x:-20}`
  - `wrap(min,max,v)` = modulo wrap
- **layout(), every frame:**
  1. Ease the drag: `M += (drag.x - drag.y - M) * .1`.
  2. Ease the scroll: `scroll.previous += (current - previous) * .15`.
  3. Set `J = scroll.previous/25 - M/100 + intro.x`.
  4. Take the visible (filtered) cards: `N` = their count, `len = max(N,24)`, `F = len*GAP/2`, `step = len/N`. Each visible card gets `order = k*step`, which spreads a filtered set along a loop of at least 24 slots.
  5. For every card:
     - `visK += ((on?1:0) - visK) * .12`, and `uOpacity = visK`.
     - If nothing is open:
       - `x = wrap(-F, F, (order - J)*GAP)`
       - `y = -(1 - visK)*1.2`, so filtered-out cards sink
       - `z = aspect<1 ? -x*6 : -x*aspect*1.5`
       - `rotation.x = 0`, `rotation.y = -π/6`
       - visible only while `visK > .02` and `|z| < 12.5`

## 6. Interaction

- **Hover:**
  - Each frame, raycast the visible cards' `hit` meshes at the mouse NDC. Skip this before ready, while open, while dragging, or with no mouse.
  - On a new hovered card:
    - The previous card's `inner.position` goes back to (0,0), expo.out 0.5s.
    - The new card's `inner.position` goes to `x: 2/3, y: -.1`, expo.out 0.5s.
    - The body gets `hov`.
    - `#label` shows the project name.
    - `#thumb` shows its image.
- **Wheel:** `scroll.current += (deltaY + deltaX)/20`, passive, ignored before ready or while open.
- **Arrow keys:** ±12. **Esc:** closes the project.
- **Drag:**
  - pointerdown on the canvas stores `on = drag - client` and captures the pointer.
  - Once the pointer has moved more than 3px:
    - drag mode starts and the body gets `drag`;
    - `world.scale` → 0.825 (expo.out .75s);
    - `drag = on + client`.
  - On pointerup, drag mode ends and the scale returns to 1 (expo.out .75s).
  - A pointerup without a drag on a hovered card opens it.
- **Cursor label `#label`:**
  - Fixed, 11px Inter 500 uppercase ink, `pointer-events:none`.
  - Follows at `translate(x+14px, y+12px)`.
  - Opacity transition .2s.

## 7. Open a project (exact sequence)

`openTile(t)`:

1. Set `opened = t`, clear the hover, and add `opened` to the body (the side chrome fades out).
2. **Hide every other card at once.**
3. Snap `t.inner.position` to (0,0).
4. `t.holder.position.x` → 0, expo.out over `1.25/3*2` s. On each update, `z = -x*aspect*1.5`, so the card slides along the row to the centre.
5. `t.holder.rotation.y` → 0, expo.inOut 1.25s (it turns to face you).
6. `camera.position` → `(0, 0, innerWidth<640 ? 35 : 30)`, expo.inOut 1.25s, calling `lookAt(0,0,0)` on every update.
7. **When the camera tween completes:**
   - fill the page and make `#page` visible;
   - fade it `opacity 0 → 1` over 0.5s, power1.inOut;
   - then hide the card underneath.

`closeTile()`:

1. Kill the page tweens, hide the page (opacity 0, hidden), and remove `opened`.
2. Reset the card's `rotation.y` to `-π/6` and call `placeCamera()`.
3. Set `opened = null`.
4. The row flies in again: `intro.x = -20` → 0, expo.out 2s.

"OPAQUE® PROJECTS" (`#home`) calls `closeTile`.

## 8. Project page `#page`

- **Container:** fixed, inset 0, z-index 8, `overflow-y:auto`, `overscroll-behavior:none`, background `var(--bg)`, a flex column. It starts at opacity 0 and `visibility:hidden`.
- **Head section `.head`:**
  - Height 50vh (min 20rem), `margin-top:3.75rem`, content centred vertically, font-size 11px, line-height 1.0909.
  - The inner row has padding `5rem 14px`.
  - `h1` (the project name): width 12.5rem, Inter 500 11px uppercase.
  - `p` (the description): max-width 287px, padding `0 2px`.
- **Grid `.grid`:** two equal columns, no gap. Five blocks, all cut from the project's own sheet cell (as JPEG data URLs, quality .85):

  | Block | Crop (x, y, w, h of the cell) | Output size | Width | Aspect ratio |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | 1 | 0, .08, 1, .84 | 1200×1000 | half | 1.2 |
  | 2 | .18, 0, .64, 1 | 900×1400 | half | .64 |
  | 3 | 0, .2, 1, .6 | 1800×1080 | full (spans both columns) | 1.67 |
  | 4 | .05, .05, .5, .5 | 1000×1000 | half | 1 |
  | 5 | .45, .45, .5, .5 | 1000×1000 | half | 1 |

  - Each block is a relative box with overflow hidden and an absolutely-filled `object-fit:cover` image.
  - Images start at opacity 0 and fade in (`.in`, .6s `cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)`) as they load.
- **Next section `.next`:** height 50vh (min 20rem), centred, padding 14px, 11px uppercase.
  - Credits row: "Category" in an 8.25rem column at 30% opacity, then the category.
  - A full-width link: "Next project" in an 8.25rem column at 30% opacity (100% on hover, .5s), then the next project's name.
  - Clicking it fades the page to 0 over .25s, refills it with the next project, scrolls to the top, and fades back in over .5s (power1.inOut).
- **Descriptions** (by project index):
  0. A campaign built from close-up texture and saturated colour, shot and graded in-house.
  1. Site design and art direction for an atmospheric weather brand, all soft light and slow motion.
  2. A night-time film series exploring signal, noise and the glow of the city after dark.
  3. Still lifes rendered in 3D, mixing studio light with synthetic materials.
  4. An AI-assisted portrait series about memory, distortion and the faces we half remember.
  5. Visual identity built from shadow and warm light, for a theatre collective.
  6. Liquid-metal forms for a product launch, modelled, lit and animated in 3D.
  7. An immersive site for a deep-sea research lab, glowing in the dark.
  8. A typographic identity cast in concrete for an architecture biennale.
  9. Generative colour studies trained on refracted light.
  10. A short film shot entirely in fog, following two headlights through the night.
  11. An editorial site for a surf brand, built around the rhythm of the tide.

## 9. Chrome (all with class `chrome`, transition opacity .6s)

`body.loading` hides it. `body.opened` hides everything except the nav.

- **Nav** (fixed at left 6px, top 6px, flex, gap 3px, z-index 10, `.u`): four tiles.
  - Labels: `OPAQUE<sup>®</sup> PROJECTS` (198px wide, ink), `Research`, `Studio`, `Contact` (122px, mute).
  - Each tile: 58px tall, padding `0 10px 10px` with the text at the bottom, radius 4px.
  - Background `rgba(242,242,241,.5)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(14px)` and an inset 1px `var(--line)` ring.
  - Hover: ink text on `#ececeb`.
- **`#thumb`:** fixed at top-right 10px, 58×58, radius 3px, cover background. Filter `grayscale(1) contrast(1.1)`. Shows the hovered project's image (Memories at start).
- **Filter chips `#chips`:** fixed at right 10px, bottom 62px, a column aligned right, gap 5px.
  - One pill per category: 30px tall, padding `0 13px`, radius 30px, background `rgba(242,242,241,.9)`, line ring.
  - Text: Inter 500 10px uppercase, mute; ink when active or hovered.
  - A count in a 7px `<sup>`.
  - Clicking sets `t.on` for the matching cards: the others sink and fade through `visK`, and the remaining ones re-spread along the loop.
- **Mode switch `#mode`:** fixed at bottom-right 10px, padding 3px, radius 4px, the same glass. Two buttons, "Overview" and "Index": 34px tall, 11px uppercase. The active one is white with a line ring.
  - **Index** shows `#index`: a list fixed at left 10px, top 96px, width `min(420px,40vw)`.
  - Each row is a grid `28px 1fr auto auto`, holding number, name (500, ink), category and year, with a top border line.
  - Row hover: ink text, padding-left 12px.
  - Hovering a row scrolls the stack to that project and sets the thumbnail; clicking a row opens it.
- **At 760px or narrower:** nav tiles are 76px (first one 120px) and the index is 80vw.

## 10. Loader and intro

1. `#loader` covers the page (bg colour) with a centred "0%" (Inter 500 11px).
2. While the textures build: `prog.previous += (current - previous)*.1` each frame, shown as a rounded percent.
3. At 100:
   - The percent fades out (.5s, delay .25).
   - The loader fades out (.5s, delay .75, power1.inOut), then is removed, and `loading` is removed from the body.
4. After 750ms:
   - Set `ready = true`.
   - **The row flies in:** `intro.x` -20 → 0, expo.out 2s.
   - `world.scale` starts at 0.825 and eases to 1 (expo.out 1s, delay 1.25s).
   - The thumbnail shows project 4.
5. **The render loop** runs `layout()`, `pick()` and `renderer.render()` on every requestAnimationFrame.

# Opaque Stack: WebGL Leaning-Card Portfolio with Fly-to-Page Transition (exact recreation prompt)

Build a single-file portfolio home page for a fictional creative studio, **OPAQUE®**.

**The stack:** on an off-white `#fafafa` canvas, a long diagonal row of thin portrait image cards stands in 3D. Each card is turned −30° and the row leans from the lower left to the upper right, seen through a very narrow 5° lens from slightly above.

- **Scroll or drag:** the row slides endlessly along its diagonal, with eased momentum.
- **Hover:** the card under the cursor slides out of the stack, and its uppercase title follows the cursor.
- **Click a card:**
  1. Every other card vanishes at once.
  2. The clicked card glides to the centre of the screen, turns to face the viewer and becomes square, while the camera flies to a straight-on view.
  3. The project page fades in over it: a centred title and description, a two-column image grid, and a "Next project" row.
- **Back:** clicking "OPAQUE® PROJECTS" (or pressing Esc) returns to the stack, and the row flies in again.

Each card's edges blur softly into the page through a custom shader: sharp in the middle, blurred towards every edge.

Use plain HTML, CSS and JS in one file, with **three.js r128** and **GSAP 3.12.5** from cdnjs. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written.

---

## 1. Page basics

- `<html lang="en">`, title `OPAQUE® Projects`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8.
- **Font (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the Inter latin woff2 faces (400 and 500) as base64 `@font-face` rules instead.
- **Scripts, in this order before the inline script:**
  - `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js`
  - `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js`
- **Variables:** `--bg:#fafafa`, `--ink:#141414`, `--mute:#a9a9a9`, `--line:rgba(0,0,0,.08)`.
- **Reset and base:**
  - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`.
  - `html,body` fill the height, `overflow:hidden`, background `var(--bg)`.
  - body font `"Inter","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif`, ink colour, antialiased.
- **Utility class `.u`:** 11px, letter-spacing .02em, uppercase.
- **The body starts with class `loading`.**

## 2. The single image asset

All twelve projects come from **one 4×3 contact sheet** (2336×1744, white gutters): twelve moody editorial images.

| Row | Images |
|---|---|
| 1 | Red glossy lips with a gold ring; soft white cumulus clouds in blue sky; red neon tubes at night; a white mannequin bust in hard venetian-blind light |
| 2 | A blue-tinted woman's face close-up; a woman's silhouette against warm orange light; liquid chrome metal spheres; a glowing blue jellyfish in the dark |
| 3 | Grey concrete stairs with a hard diagonal shadow; a rainbow prism light leak; car headlights in fog; a black-and-white crashing wave |

URL (exact):

`https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261106_084005_ab0d1fcf-a93f-4e32-a277-1523e1768fbe.png&w=2400&q=88`

**Cutting the sheet into cells:**

- Load it with `crossOrigin='anonymous'`.
- Use the sheet constants `SW=2336, SH=1744, CW=.2425, CG=.01, RH=.3244, RG=.0134`.
- Cell i is at column `c=i%4` and row `r=floor(i/4)`. With `k = naturalWidth/SW`, the cell is at:

  - y `r*(RH+RG)*SH*k`, height `RH*SH*k`

  - the **sharp** texture is a 512px canvas (`THREE.CanvasTexture`);
  - the **blur** texture is a 24px canvas (`CanvasTexture`, `minFilter = magFilter = LinearFilter`), so upscaling it is the blur;
  - `url` is the 512px canvas as a JPEG data URL (quality .7), used for the corner thumbnail.

**Projects** (name, category, year):

| # | Name | Category | Year |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Velvet Mouth | Graphic identity | 2025 |
| 1 | Cumulus | Site design | 2025 |
| 2 | No Signal | Video | 2024 |
| 3 | Still Life | 3D | 2024 |
| 4 | Memories | AI | 2025 |
| 5 | Shadowplay | Graphic identity | 2024 |
| 6 | Mercury | 3D | 2025 |
| 7 | Abyss | Site design | 2024 |
| 8 | Concrete Poem | Graphic identity | 2023 |
| 9 | Prism | AI | 2025 |
| 10 | Headlights | Video | 2023 |
| 11 | Tide | Site design | 2024 |

- **Categories:** `All, Graphic identity, Site design, AI, Video, 3D`.

ratio = vec2(min((mesh.x/mesh.y)/(img.x/img.y),1.0), min((mesh.y/mesh.x)/(img.y/img.x),1.0))
uvCover = vUv*ratio + (1-ratio)*0.5
progress = 1.0; margin = 0.15
on each of the four edges: progress.rgb *= smoothstep(edge, edge±margin, vUv)
blur.a *= 0.75

  - Clicking sets `t.on` for the matching cards: the others sink and fade through `visK`, and the remaining ones re-spread along the loop.
- **Mode switch `#mode`:** fixed at bottom-right 10px, padding 3px, radius 4px, the same glass. Two buttons, "Overview" and "Index": 34px tall, 11px uppercase. The active one is white with a line ring.
  - **Index** shows `#index`: a list fixed at left 10px, top 96px, width `min(420px,40vw)`.
  - Each row is a grid `28px 1fr auto auto`, holding number, name (500, ink), category and year, with a top border line.
  - Row hover: ink text, padding-left 12px.
  - Hovering a row scrolls the stack to that project and sets the thumbnail; clicking a row opens it.
- **At 760px or narrower:** nav tiles are 76px (first one 120px) and the index is 80vw.

## 10. Loader and intro

1. `#loader` covers the page (bg colour) with a centred "0%" (Inter 500 11px).
2. While the textures build: `prog.previous += (current - previous)*.1` each frame, shown as a rounded percent.
3. At 100:
   - The percent fades out (.5s, delay .25).
   - The loader fades out (.5s, delay .75, power1.inOut), then is removed, and `loading` is removed from the body.
4. After 750ms:
   - Set `ready = true`.
   - **The row flies in:** `intro.x` -20 → 0, expo.out 2s.
   - `world.scale` starts at 0.825 and eases to 1 (expo.out 1s, delay 1.25s).
   - The thumbnail shows project 4.
5. **The render loop** runs `layout()`, `pick()` and `renderer.render()` on every requestAnimationFrame.
