items.prompt_text: # Prompt: "Marika Lindfors" WebGL ribbon hero Recreate this page exactly as described: a single, full-screen, black portfolio hero. Eight rounded project cards, each playing a looping preview video, form one continuous ribbon. The ribbon snakes in depth across a WebGL stage above a receding perspective grid floor. A virtual scroll (wheel, touch, keys) slides the cards through the curve, and scroll speed deepens and twists it. Phones get a looping vertical stack instead. Everything below is required; nothing is decorative guesswork. Build it as one self-contained `index.html` (inline CSS and JS, ES modules). Use three.js 0.160.0 for WebGL. Write custom GLSL `ShaderMaterial`s for the cards and the floor, not built-in materials. --- ## 1. Libraries, font and assets ### three.js - Load three.js through an import map: `three` → `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`. Import it as a namespace. ### Font: Inter Tight (variable, weights 100–900) - Google Fonts CSS: `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500&display=swap` - Latin woff2 file (one variable file covers 400 and 500): `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/intertight/v9/NGSwv5HMAFg6IuGlBNMjxLsH8ag.woff2` - Declare it with `@font-face`: family "Inter Tight", `font-weight: 100 900`, `font-display: swap`. In the shipped standalone file the woff2 is embedded as a base64 `data:font/woff2` URL, so the page needs no font request. - Fallbacks: the body uses `"Inter Tight", system-ui, sans-serif`. Canvas captions use `"Inter Tight", sans-serif`. - Before drawing any caption, wait for `document.fonts.load('400 18px "Inter Tight"')`. ### Card media There are eight motionsites.ai design previews. Each card has two pieces of media: - **Poster:** a still preview image, shown immediately. - **Video:** the design's own preview MP4, swapped in on its first decoded frame. Every URL below sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. Load every image and video with `crossOrigin = "anonymous"` so WebGL can sample it. Poster URL pattern (an images.higgs.ai WebP of the design's preview PNG, 1280 px wide, quality 85): `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2F.png&w=1280&q=85` Video URL pattern: `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/.mp4` Keep the card order exactly as listed (it is the ribbon order). The aspect ratio (width ÷ height) is the card's own shape; the media is cover-cropped into it. | # | Caption | Video `` | Poster `` | Card aspect | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | Living Portrait | `aaaf/living-portrait-hero` | `hf_20261031_044539_b7fde132-8c25-4dda-ab05-4e4be99bf3d3` | 1.745 | | 2 | Moss Island | `aaaf/mossline-hero` | `hf_20261106_032528_99eb9a00-a553-40b6-8b97-017e918971c6` | 1.700 | | 3 | Flower Valley | `aaaf/fernhollow` | `hf_20261103_061637_11907771-15ce-494b-81a4-9051861d6ce5` | 1.735 | | 4 | Runway Lookbook | `aaaf/vell-lookbook` | `hf_20261102_044911_1ad79156-a8dc-475a-8891-8408a9b61320` | 1.837 | | 5 | Shelf Hero | `aaaf/vasari-vhs-hero` | `hf_20261029_012401_8f947ed0-7b82-47d6-bdcd-b1ce1af0bf5f` | 1.526 | | 6 | Solar Fog | `aaaf/lumen-roof-hero` | `hf_20261102_041507_8e9c2d22-8be2-4652-8bbe-1f4556ea463a` | 1.658 | | 7 | Honey Bee | `designs/honey-bee-melli-landing` | `hf_20261017_154537_1384fa6d-282d-46e2-8748-a70be1cf681a` | 1.330 | | 8 | Spider Web | `aaaf/found-spider` | `hf_20261104_020746_7eebb7cf-e21b-4288-8211-0cb9d0728f48` | 1.610 | The full video URLs: 1. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/living-portrait-hero.mp4` 2. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/mossline-hero.mp4` 3. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/fernhollow.mp4` 4. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/vell-lookbook.mp4` 5. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/vasari-vhs-hero.mp4` 6. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/lumen-roof-hero.mp4` 7. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/honey-bee-melli-landing.mp4` 8. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/found-spider.mp4` Video facts: - H.264, 1600×900 (Shelf Hero is 1440×960, Honey Bee 1920×1414). - 6.5–7 s loops, about 24 MB in total. - Posters are 1280 px wide; most are 1280×714, Shelf Hero 1280×859, Honey Bee 1280×956. Do not download, re-encode or re-host any of these. Use the URLs above as given. --- ## 2. Page shell (HTML and CSS) ### Document - ``: **Marika Lindfors**. `lang="en"`, `meta viewport width=device-width, initial-scale=1`. ### Global - `* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0 }` - `html, body`: - `background: #000`, `color: #fff`, `height: 100%`, `overflow: hidden` - `overscroll-behavior: none`, `touch-action: none`, `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent` - There is no native scroll at all. - `body`: font as above, `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`. - `canvas#gl`: `position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block`, `aria-hidden="true"`. ### Design unit `--u` - Desktop: `--u = 100vw / 1500`, so 1u = 0.96 px at 1440 wide. - Phone (`max-width: 649px`): `--u = 100vw / 390`, so 1u = 0.9615 px at 375 wide. - The JS uses the same unit: `U = vw / 1500`, or `vw / 390` on phones. ### Corner navigation A `<nav class="ui" aria-label="Site">` holds four fixed elements. Each one: - `position: fixed; z-index: 5`, colour `#fff` - Font: `500 max(9px, 10u) / 1.4 "Inter Tight"`, `text-transform: uppercase`, `letter-spacing: 0` - No background, border or underline - Starts at `opacity: 0` with `transition: opacity .6s ease .2s`; becomes `opacity: 1` once `body.ready` is set | Element | Text (as written; CSS uppercases it) | Desktop position | Phone position | |---|---|---|---| | `<a class="tl" href="#">` | Marika Lindfors | left 80u, top 40u | left 40u, top 25u | | `<button class="tr">` | Profile | right 80u, top 40u | right 40u, top 25u | | `<a class="bl" href="#">` | `Featured <span>/</span> <span>Full</span>` | left 80u, bottom 40u | left 40u, bottom 25u | | `<button class="br">` | Newsletter | right 80u, bottom 40u | right 40u, bottom 25u | - Both spans in the bottom-left link ("/" and "Full") are at `opacity: .5`. - At 1440×900 the labels render at 9.6 px: left text at x = 76.8 px, top labels at y = 38.4 px. ### Loader (three dashes) - Fixed, centred with `translate(-50%, -50%)`, `display: flex; gap: 6px; z-index: 4`. - Three `<i>` bars, 2 px tall, white, widths **44 px, 44 px, 38 px**. - Each runs the keyframe `dash` (opacity 0.25 → 1 at 50% → 0.25) over **1 s ease-in-out infinite**. Delays are 0, 0.12 s and 0.24 s. - On `body.ready` it fades out over 0.4 s and gets `pointer-events: none`. ### Phone veil (phones only) - `.veil`: fixed, `inset: 0; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none`. - Two stacked gradients: one `to bottom`, one `to top`. Both use the same stops: `#000` at 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.77) at 5%, .42 at 10%, .14 at 15%, .02 at 20%, transparent at 26%. - It fades cards to black under the top and bottom labels. - `display: none` on desktop, `block` at ≤649 px. ### Screen-reader list - `<main class="sr" id="list" aria-label="Featured work">`, visually hidden (1×1 px, clipped). - One `<article><h2>{caption}</h2></article>` per card, in order. --- ## 3. Renderer, camera and world mapping ### Renderer - `WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: false })`, clear colour `#000`, output colour space sRGB. - Pixel ratio `min(devicePixelRatio, 2)`. Size = `clientWidth × innerHeight`. ### Camera - `PerspectiveCamera(fov 53.4°, aspect vw/vh, near 0.1, far 2000)` at **(0, 0, 41.18)**, looking down −z. - These are the reference site's live camera values. ### World units - `H = tan(fov/2) · 41.18` (≈ 20.71) is the half-height of the z = 0 plane. - `W = H · aspect` is its half-width. - `k = 2H / vh` converts CSS px to world units on z = 0. - A card laid out at CSS rect (x, y, w, h) becomes a plane at: - world x = `(x + w/2 − vw/2) · k` - world y = `−(y + h/2 − vh/2) · k` - scale `(w·k, h·k)` ### Cards - Each card is a `PlaneGeometry(1, 1, 96, 24)` scaled to size. - Render settings: `transparent`, `depthTest: false`, `depthWrite: false`, `frustumCulled: false`, renderOrder 0. - Enable derivatives (fwidth). --- ## 4. Layout ### Desktop (viewport wider than 649 px) - **Card height** `cardH = min(0.435 · innerHeight, 550u)`. That is 391.5 px at 900 tall. - **Card width** = `cardH × aspect`. - **Row:** cards sit in one horizontal row, in table order, with a **10u gap**, vertically centred. - **Corner radius:** 20u. - **Loop:** loop length L = Σ(width + gap). Each card's base x is the running sum. - **Placement each frame:** - x = base − current - wrap into `[left, left + L)`, where `left = −(L − vw)/2` - The row is endless; the wrap seam is always off-screen. - **Start:** current = target = **100** px, so the first frame matches the reference. - Card 1 is cut at the left; card 2 (Moss Island) starts at about 40% across and faces the camera. - Card 3 (Flower Valley) recedes on the right. - At 1440×900, card edges land at about x = 558, 569, 1180 and 1192 px. ### Phone (viewport 649 px or narrower) - **Card width** = vw − 40u (20u margin each side). **Height** = width ÷ aspect. - **Stack:** cards stack vertically with a **20u gap**, centred horizontally. - **Corner radius:** 15u. - **Loop:** L = Σ(height + gap). Cards wrap within `[top, top + L)`, where `top = −(L − vh)/2`. - **Start:** current = target = `−0.177 · vh`, so card 1's top sits about 18% down the screen. Card 8 (Spider Web) peeks in above it under the veil. - **Mode switch:** when the layout crosses 649 px, reset current and target to that mode's start and clear any pending scroll. - **Resize:** run layout again 100 ms after the last resize. This recomputes sizes, the unit, the camera aspect, the reflection target (half resolution) and every overlay. --- ## 5. Card surface: overlay and media ### Overlay Each card has a transparent canvas, the overlay, drawn at scale `s = 2 · min(dpr, 2) / 1.5`. The canvas is card width·s × card height·s. **Caption** (the card's title): - Font `400` Inter Tight, **18u** on desktop and **16u** on phone. - Letter-spacing −0.05em, white, alphabetic baseline. - Inset **20u** from the left on desktop, **10u** on phone. - Baseline at `canvas height − 10u − 0.22 · font size`. - Drop shadow `rgba(0,0,0,.5)` with 12u blur, so it stays legible over bright frames. **Pill button:** - Black circle, radius 12.5u (25u diameter). - Inset 20u (desktop) or 10u (phone) from the right, and 10u from the bottom. - White icon stroke, 1.4u wide, round caps and joins, arm length a = 4.5u: - **Desktop: "+"**, a horizontal and a vertical stroke, each ±a through the centre. - **Phone: "→"**, a horizontal stroke ±a, plus an arrowhead from (+0.2a, −0.8a) to (+a, 0) to (+0.2a, +0.8a). **Texture:** use the overlay as a `CanvasTexture` with sRGB colour, maximum anisotropy and trilinear mipmaps. WebGL2 texture storage cannot change size, so when the canvas size changes (resize or mode switch), dispose of the texture and create a new one. ### Media - First a `Texture` of the poster image (sRGB, max anisotropy). - Unless reduced motion is on, create a `<video>` per card: - `crossOrigin = anonymous`, `muted` and `defaultMuted`, `loop`, `playsInline` (also set the `playsinline` and `muted` attributes), `preload = auto`, `src` = the card's video URL. - On the first presented frame, swap the poster for a `VideoTexture` (sRGB). Use `requestVideoFrameCallback` where available, otherwise the `playing` event. ### Cover crop The crop is done in the shader with `u_crop = (offsetX, offsetY, scaleX, scaleY)`: - ma = media width ÷ media height; a = the card's aspect - If a > ma: scaleY = ma / a, scaleX = 1. Otherwise scaleX = a / ma, scaleY = 1. - offset = (1 − scale) / 2, so the crop is centred. - Media UV = offset + vUv · scale. ### Playback management (every frame) - A card's video plays only while that card is on or near the screen; otherwise it pauses. - Desktop: its row x satisfies `x + w > −0.5·vw` and `x < 1.5·vw`. - Phone: `y + h > −0.5·vh` and `y < 1.5·vh`. - Nothing plays while `document.hidden`. All videos pause when the tab is hidden. - `play()` rejections are ignored. --- ## 6. Card shader: the ribbon (exact math) Uniforms per card: | Uniform | Desktop | Phone | |---|---|---| | u_sheetW | W | H | | u_sheetD | per frame | per frame | | u_sheetT | 1.15 (SPAN) | 1 | | u_sheetC | 1 (S-curve) | 0 (bowl) | | u_sheetP | 1 | 1 | | u_sheetV | per frame | 0 | | u_leanA | W · (−0.12) | 0 | | u_leanW | W | 0 | | u_diag | 0.03 | 0 | | u_axis | 0 | 1 | | u_dent | 0.035 | 0.035 | | u_shade | 1 | 0 | | u_shadeS | 1 | 0.6 | | u_corner | 20u ÷ card height | 15u ÷ card height | `u_hover` is per card, per frame. `u_res` is the card size in world units. Constants: PI = 3.141592653589793, BANK = −0.16, REAR_Y = 0.1, REAR_Z = 0.2, VTWIST = 1.8, TAIL = 1.0, SHIFT = −0.2. ### Shape functions (wx = world x) - **q(wx)** = wx / W · T + SHIFT - **shape(q)** = mix(1 − q², sin(πq), C) · e^(−TAIL·q²) - C = 1 gives a Gaussian-damped sine, the S-curve. - C = 0 gives a damped bowl. - **shapeSlope(q)** = mix(bowl′, ess′, C) · e^(−q²), where - bowl′ = −2q(1 + TAIL(1 − q²)) - ess′ = π·cos(πq) − 2·TAIL·q·sin(πq) - **z(wx)** = −D · shape(q(wx)): the ribbon recedes where the shape is positive and comes forward where it is negative. - **roll(wx)** = BANK · shapeSlope(q) / π · C: the resting bank that follows the S. ### Vertex stage 1. **Hover dent.** If hovered, push the vertex back in z by `hover · dent · resY · dome(uv)`, where dome(uv) = (1 − qx²)(1 − qy²) with q = 2·uv − 1. 2. **To world space.** Transform with the model matrix. 3. **Phone axis swap.** If u_axis = 1, swap world x and y, so the same ribbon runs down y. Swap back after step 7. 4. **Wind.** Rotate (y, z) about the x axis by angle a = roll(x). If V > 0, add the velocity wring: `VTWIST · V · smoothstep(0.3, 0.9, |x/W|) · sign(x/W)`. It does nothing at the centre and twists the two edges in opposite directions. 5. **Bend.** z += z(x). 6. **Diagonal and rear lift.** - y += diag · x (the ribbon climbs slightly to the right). - If V > 0, with m = 1 − smoothstep(−1, 0.3, x/W): y += REAR_Y · W · V · m and z += REAR_Z · W · V · m. The left/rear part lifts and comes forward while moving. 7. **Lean ("door").** z += leanA · ramp(x / leanW), where ramp(s) = s·(1.5 − 0.5s²) with s clamped to [−1, 1]. With leanA negative, the right side swings away and the left side swings toward the camera. ### Fragment stage 1. Sample the media at the crop UV. Composite the overlay over it: rgb = mix(media, overlay.rgb, overlay.a). 2. **Depth darkening** (desktop): depth = clamp((D − z(wx)) / 2D, 0, 1), plus the hover dome term, clamped. Then rgb = mix(rgb, vec3(0.059), shade · 0.8 · depth^shadeS). Receding parts darken heavily (about 68% at the far crest) and near parts only lightly (about 12%). 3. **Lighting.** Light direction L = normalize(−0.4, 0.5, 1). - The normal comes from the analytic slopes: dz/dx = −D · shapeSlope(q) · T / W, plus (leanA/leanW) · leanSlope, plus the hover dome derivatives, then rotated by roll(wx). leanSlope(s) = 1.5 · (1 − min(|s|, 1)²). - Diffuse: rgb *= 1 − 0.12 · (1 − (n·L · 0.5 + 0.5)). - Specular sheen: Blinn-Phong with gloss 48 and strength 0.35, against the view vector to the displaced point. 4. **Rounded corners.** Signed-distance rounded box in card space (aspect × 1) with radius u_corner, anti-aliased with fwidth. Multiply the result into alpha. 5. **Fade-in.** alpha also multiplies u_alpha. --- ## 7. Floor (desktop only) ### Geometry and placement - `PlaneGeometry(1, 1, 48, 24)` rotated −90° about x. - Render settings: transparent, no depth test or write, double-sided, renderOrder −1. - **Height:** y = a = −cardH·k/2 − 0.06H, just under the cards. - **Run (depth behind the strip):** o = 6H. - **Near edge:** near = min(41.18 · (1 − |a|/H) + 0.2H, 41.18 · 0.8). - **Scale:** (W · 2 · 4, 1, near + o). **Position:** z = (near − o)/2. - **Grid:** cell size = 0.22H; repeat count = (width / cell, o / cell). ### Vertex - vFar = −worldZ / o, so 0 is at the strip, 1 at the far end and negative toward the camera. - Apply the same lean as the cards (leanA = −0.12W, leanW = W, k = 1). The floor turns with the ribbon. ### Fragment - fade = 1 − smoothstep(0.2, 0.95, vFar) - The base colour is black: both tints are #000, mixed by smoothstep(0, 0.8, vFar). - Contact shadow: multiply by 1 − 0.55 · e^(−14|vFar|). - **Grid lines:** g = (uv.x · cellsX, vFar · cellsY). line = max over both axes of 1 − smoothstep(0, 1.5·fwidth(g), |fract(g) − 0.5|). col += line · 0.08 · fade. These are hairlines at 8% white. - **Reflection** (on the lines only): - A mirrored camera, a clone of the main camera, sits at y = 2m − camY, where m = a − 0.07H. - Each frame, render the cards into a half-resolution render target with the floor hidden. - In the shader, project the floor point through that camera's view-projection. Spread it from a light at x = −0.6W: wp.x −= (x − lightX) · 0.35 · |vFar|. - Sample with a soft 10% edge falloff. Weight by e^(−6·vFar) behind the strip or e^(2.2·vFar) in front of it. - col += reflection · line · 0.5 · weight · edges · fade. - Output alpha = u_alpha · fade, with u_alpha fading in to 0.9. The floor is hidden on phones, and the reflection pass is skipped there. --- ## 8. Virtual scroll, velocity and inertia (the reference's input model) ### State - `target` (where the strip should go) and `current` (where it is), in CSS px along the strip axis. ### Wheel (passive) - Ignore events with ctrlKey. - Delta: use the larger of deltaY and deltaX. Multiply by 16 for line mode, or by vh for page mode. - **Big flick:** |delta| ≥ 40, at least 30 ms since the previous event, and no burst within 500 ms (a burst means events arriving less than 30 ms apart). A big flick adds delta · 1.25 · 2 to a `pending` pool. - Any other event pushes delta · 1.25 immediately. - Each frame, the pending pool eases in by `pending · (1 − (1 − 0.22)^(min(dt·60, 4)))`. Once it is under 0.05, flush the remainder. ### Touch (passive) - touchmove pushes (previousY − currentY) · 3.25. - touchend pushes the last move's delta · 35 (the fling). ### Keys - ArrowDown and ArrowRight: +100. ArrowUp and ArrowLeft: −100. - PageDown: +0.9·vh. PageUp: −0.9·vh. Space: ±0.9·vh (Shift reverses it). - Ignore keys pressed with Meta, Ctrl or Alt, and call preventDefault on the ones handled. ### Push and lag clamp - push(d) adds d to target. - **Desktop only:** soft-clamp the lag to one viewport width: target = current + tanh((target − current)/vw) · vw. ### Each frame - ratio = min(dt · 60, 2), with dt capped at 50 ms. - current += (target − current) · 0.1 · ratio, rounded to 0.01 px. - With reduced motion, current = target exactly. ### Velocity (drives the bend) - t = tanh((target − current) / N), where N = 550 on desktop and 245 on phones. - vel = t · |t| (signed square). r = min(1, |vel|), or 0 with reduced motion. - **Desktop:** - D = W · 0.2 · (1 + 1.1·r): the S deepens by up to 2.1× while moving. - V = r: the edge wring and rear lift come in. - At rest D ≈ 6.63 world units at 16:10. - **Phone:** - D = H · 0.18 · 1.1 · r. The stack is perfectly flat at rest and bows into the bowl shape only while it moves. - The ends come toward the viewer and look larger mid-swipe. - V = 0, there's no lean, and there's no depth shading. --- ## 9. Hover (desktop pointer) - Track the pointer in normalised device coordinates. Leaving the document resets it off-screen. - **Picking:** each frame, rebuild each card's deformed outline on the CPU with the same sheet and lean formulas. Use 5 columns × top and bottom edges, projected through the camera. The pointer must fall inside that outline's screen bounding box. - The hovered card's `hover` value eases toward 1 at a rate of 1 − e^(−8·dt), and back to 0 at 1 − e^(−6·dt). - The hovered card dents inward (the dome term), darkens in the middle and shifts its sheen. - The cursor becomes a pointer over a card. - Hover is off on phones and with reduced motion. --- ## 10. Loading and entrance 1. **Boot:** run layout, then start the frame loop at once (the floor and cards are at alpha 0). 2. **In parallel:** load the font and all 8 poster images. 3. **When they're ready:** for each card, set up its media (poster texture plus its video), paint its overlay, set loaded = true, and add `body.ready`. - The corner labels fade in (0.6 s, after 0.2 s). - The loader fades out (0.4 s). 4. **Fades:** - Each card's u_alpha rises linearly over **0.6 s** to 1, once its overlay exists. - The floor's u_alpha rises over **0.8 s** to 0.9. 5. **Failsafe:** add `body.ready` after **8 s** regardless, and if loading fails. 6. Each video replaces its poster on its first decoded frame, with no black flash. --- ## 11. Reduced motion With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: - No videos are created; cards keep their still posters. - No inertia: current snaps to target. - r = 0, so no velocity bend, wring or rear lift. The resting S-curve stays. - No hover dent. --- ## 12. Accessibility and miscellany - The canvas, veil and loader are `aria-hidden`. The project titles exist as the hidden list in §2. - The corner nav is real links and buttons. - Everything except the importmap, the three.js module and the media URLs is inline; there are no other network requests. - Expected result: - **At 1440×900:** a black stage, an S-shaped ribbon of three visible playing cards over a faint grid floor that reflects them on its lines, and the four tiny uppercase corner labels. - **At 375×812:** a looping column of four cards with arrow pills, faded at the top and bottom under the labels.

Eight rounded project cards, each playing a looping preview video, form one continuous ribbon. The ribbon snakes in depth across a WebGL stage above a receding perspective grid floor. A virtual scroll (wheel, touch, keys) slides the cards through the curve, and scroll speed deepens and twists it. Phones get a looping vertical stack instead. Everything below is required; nothing is decorative guesswork. Build it as one self-contained `index.html` (inline CSS and JS, ES modules). Use three.js 0.160.0 for WebGL. Write custom GLSL `ShaderMaterial`s for the cards and the floor, not built-in materials. --- ## 1. Libraries, font and assets ### three.js - Load three.js through an import map: `three` → `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js`. Import it as a namespace. ### Font: Inter Tight (variable, weights 100–900) - Google Fonts CSS: `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500&display=swap` - Latin woff2 file (one variable file covers 400 and 500): `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/intertight/v9/NGSwv5HMAFg6IuGlBNMjxLsH8ag.woff2` - Declare it with `@font-face`: family "Inter Tight", `font-weight: 100 900`, `font-display: swap`. In the shipped standalone file the woff2 is embedded as a base64 `data:font/woff2` URL, so the page needs no font request. - Fallbacks: the body uses `"Inter Tight", system-ui, sans-serif`. Canvas captions use `"Inter Tight", sans-serif`. - Before drawing any caption, wait for `document.fonts.load('400 18px "Inter Tight"')`. ### Card media There are eight motionsites.ai design previews. Each card has two pieces of media: - **Poster:** a still preview image, shown immediately. - **Video:** the design's own preview MP4, swapped in on its first decoded frame. Every URL below sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. Load every image and video with `crossOrigin = "anonymous"` so WebGL can sample it. Poster URL pattern (an images.higgs.ai WebP of the design's preview PNG, 1280 px wide, quality 85): `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2F.png&w=1280&q=85` Video URL pattern: `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/.mp4` Keep the card order exactly as listed (it is the ribbon order). The aspect ratio (width ÷ height) is the card's own shape; the media is cover-cropped into it. | # | Caption | Video `` | Poster `` | Card aspect | |---|---|---|---|---| | 1 | Living Portrait | `aaaf/living-portrait-hero` | `hf_20261031_044539_b7fde132-8c25-4dda-ab05-4e4be99bf3d3` | 1.745 | | 2 | Moss Island | `aaaf/mossline-hero` | `hf_20261106_032528_99eb9a00-a553-40b6-8b97-017e918971c6` | 1.700 | | 3 | Flower Valley | `aaaf/fernhollow` | `hf_20261103_061637_11907771-15ce-494b-81a4-9051861d6ce5` | 1.735 | | 4 | Runway Lookbook | `aaaf/vell-lookbook` | `hf_20261102_044911_1ad79156-a8dc-475a-8891-8408a9b61320` | 1.837 | | 5 | Shelf Hero | `aaaf/vasari-vhs-hero` | `hf_20261029_012401_8f947ed0-7b82-47d6-bdcd-b1ce1af0bf5f` | 1.526 | | 6 | Solar Fog | `aaaf/lumen-roof-hero` | `hf_20261102_041507_8e9c2d22-8be2-4652-8bbe-1f4556ea463a` | 1.658 | | 7 | Honey Bee | `designs/honey-bee-melli-landing` | `hf_20261017_154537_1384fa6d-282d-46e2-8748-a70be1cf681a` | 1.330 | | 8 | Spider Web | `aaaf/found-spider` | `hf_20261104_020746_7eebb7cf-e21b-4288-8211-0cb9d0728f48` | 1.610 | The full video URLs: 1. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/living-portrait-hero.mp4` 2. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/mossline-hero.mp4` 3. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/fernhollow.mp4` 4. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/vell-lookbook.mp4` 5. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/vasari-vhs-hero.mp4` 6. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/lumen-roof-hero.mp4` 7. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/honey-bee-melli-landing.mp4` 8. `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/found-spider.mp4` Video facts: - H.264, 1600×900 (Shelf Hero is 1440×960, Honey Bee 1920×1414). - 6.5–7 s loops, about 24 MB in total. - Posters are 1280 px wide; most are 1280×714, Shelf Hero 1280×859, Honey Bee 1280×956. Do not download, re-encode or re-host any of these. Use the URLs above as given. --- ## 2. Page shell (HTML and CSS) ### Document - ``: **Marika Lindfors**. `lang="en"`, `meta viewport width=device-width, initial-scale=1`. ### Global - `* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0 }` - `html, body`: - `background: #000`, `color: #fff`, `height: 100%`, `overflow: hidden` - `overscroll-behavior: none`, `touch-action: none`, `-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent` - There is no native scroll at all. - `body`: font as above, `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased`. - `canvas#gl`: `position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block`, `aria-hidden="true"`. ### Design unit `--u` - Desktop: `--u = 100vw / 1500`, so 1u = 0.96 px at 1440 wide. - Phone (`max-width: 649px`): `--u = 100vw / 390`, so 1u = 0.9615 px at 375 wide. - The JS uses the same unit: `U = vw / 1500`, or `vw / 390` on phones. ### Corner navigation A `<nav class="ui" aria-label="Site">` holds four fixed elements. Each one: - `position: fixed; z-index: 5`, colour `#fff` - Font: `500 max(9px, 10u) / 1.4 "Inter Tight"`, `text-transform: uppercase`, `letter-spacing: 0` - No background, border or underline - Starts at `opacity: 0` with `transition: opacity .6s ease .2s`; becomes `opacity: 1` once `body.ready` is set | Element | Text (as written; CSS uppercases it) | Desktop position | Phone position | |---|---|---|---| | `<a class="tl" href="#">` | Marika Lindfors | left 80u, top 40u | left 40u, top 25u | | `<button class="tr">` | Profile | right 80u, top 40u | right 40u, top 25u | | `<a class="bl" href="#">` | `Featured <span>/</span> <span>Full</span>` | left 80u, bottom 40u | left 40u, bottom 25u | | `<button class="br">` | Newsletter | right 80u, bottom 40u | right 40u, bottom 25u | - Both spans in the bottom-left link ("/" and "Full") are at `opacity: .5`. - At 1440×900 the labels render at 9.6 px: left text at x = 76.8 px, top labels at y = 38.4 px. ### Loader (three dashes) - Fixed, centred with `translate(-50%, -50%)`, `display: flex; gap: 6px; z-index: 4`. - Three `<i>` bars, 2 px tall, white, widths **44 px, 44 px, 38 px**. - Each runs the keyframe `dash` (opacity 0.25 → 1 at 50% → 0.25) over **1 s ease-in-out infinite**. Delays are 0, 0.12 s and 0.24 s. - On `body.ready` it fades out over 0.4 s and gets `pointer-events: none`. ### Phone veil (phones only) - `.veil`: fixed, `inset: 0; z-index: 3; pointer-events: none`. - Two stacked gradients: one `to bottom`, one `to top`. Both use the same stops: `#000` at 0%, rgba(0,0,0,.77) at 5%, .42 at 10%, .14 at 15%, .02 at 20%, transparent at 26%. - It fades cards to black under the top and bottom labels. - `display: none` on desktop, `block` at ≤649 px. ### Screen-reader list - `<main class="sr" id="list" aria-label="Featured work">`, visually hidden (1×1 px, clipped). - One `<article><h2>{caption}</h2></article>` per card, in order. --- ## 3. Renderer, camera and world mapping ### Renderer - `WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: false })`, clear colour `#000`, output colour space sRGB. - Pixel ratio `min(devicePixelRatio, 2)`. Size = `clientWidth × innerHeight`. ### Camera - `PerspectiveCamera(fov 53.4°, aspect vw/vh, near 0.1, far 2000)` at **(0, 0, 41.18)**, looking down −z. - These are the reference site's live camera values. ### World units - `H = tan(fov/2) · 41.18` (≈ 20.71) is the half-height of the z = 0 plane. - `W = H · aspect` is its half-width. - `k = 2H / vh` converts CSS px to world units on z = 0. - A card laid out at CSS rect (x, y, w, h) becomes a plane at: - world x = `(x + w/2 − vw/2) · k` - world y = `−(y + h/2 − vh/2) · k` - scale `(w·k, h·k)` ### Cards - Each card is a `PlaneGeometry(1, 1, 96, 24)` scaled to size. - Render settings: `transparent`, `depthTest: false`, `depthWrite: false`, `frustumCulled: false`, renderOrder 0. - Enable derivatives (fwidth). --- ## 4. Layout ### Desktop (viewport wider than 649 px) - **Card height** `cardH = min(0.435 · innerHeight, 550u)`. That is 391.5 px at 900 tall. - **Card width** = `cardH × aspect`. - **Row:** cards sit in one horizontal row, in table order, with a **10u gap**, vertically centred. - **Corner radius:** 20u. - **Loop:** loop length L = Σ(width + gap). Each card's base x is the running sum. - **Placement each frame:** - x = base − current - wrap into `[left, left + L)`, where `left = −(L − vw)/2` - The row is endless; the wrap seam is always off-screen. - **Start:** current = target = **100** px, so the first frame matches the reference. - Card 1 is cut at the left; card 2 (Moss Island) starts at about 40% across and faces the camera. - Card 3 (Flower Valley) recedes on the right. - At 1440×900, card edges land at about x = 558, 569, 1180 and 1192 px. ### Phone (viewport 649 px or narrower) - **Card width** = vw − 40u (20u margin each side). **Height** = width ÷ aspect. - **Stack:** cards stack vertically with a **20u gap**, centred horizontally. - **Corner radius:** 15u. - **Loop:** L = Σ(height + gap). Cards wrap within `[top, top + L)`, where `top = −(L − vh)/2`. - **Start:** current = target = `−0.177 · vh`, so card 1's top sits about 18% down the screen. Card 8 (Spider Web) peeks in above it under the veil. - **Mode switch:** when the layout crosses 649 px, reset current and target to that mode's start and clear any pending scroll. - **Resize:** run layout again 100 ms after the last resize. This recomputes sizes, the unit, the camera aspect, the reflection target (half resolution) and every overlay. --- ## 5. Card surface: overlay and media ### Overlay Each card has a transparent canvas, the overlay, drawn at scale `s = 2 · min(dpr, 2) / 1.5`. The canvas is card width·s × card height·s. **Caption** (the card's title): - Font `400` Inter Tight, **18u** on desktop and **16u** on phone. - Letter-spacing −0.05em, white, alphabetic baseline. - Inset **20u** from the left on desktop, **10u** on phone. - Baseline at `canvas height − 10u − 0.22 · font size`. - Drop shadow `rgba(0,0,0,.5)` with 12u blur, so it stays legible over bright frames. **Pill button:** - Black circle, radius 12.5u (25u diameter). - Inset 20u (desktop) or 10u (phone) from the right, and 10u from the bottom. - White icon stroke, 1.4u wide, round caps and joins, arm length a = 4.5u: - **Desktop: "+"**, a horizontal and a vertical stroke, each ±a through the centre. - **Phone: "→"**, a horizontal stroke ±a, plus an arrowhead from (+0.2a, −0.8a) to (+a, 0) to (+0.2a, +0.8a). **Texture:** use the overlay as a `CanvasTexture` with sRGB colour, maximum anisotropy and trilinear mipmaps. WebGL2 texture storage cannot change size, so when the canvas size changes (resize or mode switch), dispose of the texture and create a new one. ### Media - First a `Texture` of the poster image (sRGB, max anisotropy). - Unless reduced motion is on, create a `<video>` per card: - `crossOrigin = anonymous`, `muted` and `defaultMuted`, `loop`, `playsInline` (also set the `playsinline` and `muted` attributes), `preload = auto`, `src` = the card's video URL. - On the first presented frame, swap the poster for a `VideoTexture` (sRGB). Use `requestVideoFrameCallback` where available, otherwise the `playing` event. ### Cover crop The crop is done in the shader with `u_crop = (offsetX, offsetY, scaleX, scaleY)`: - ma = media width ÷ media height; a = the card's aspect - If a > ma: scaleY = ma / a, scaleX = 1. Otherwise scaleX = a / ma, scaleY = 1. - offset = (1 − scale) / 2, so the crop is centred. - Media UV = offset + vUv · scale. ### Playback management (every frame) - A card's video plays only while that card is on or near the screen; otherwise it pauses. - Desktop: its row x satisfies `x + w > −0.5·vw` and `x < 1.5·vw`. - Phone: `y + h > −0.5·vh` and `y < 1.5·vh`. - Nothing plays while `document.hidden`. All videos pause when the tab is hidden. - `play()` rejections are ignored. --- ## 6. Card shader: the ribbon (exact math) Uniforms per card: | Uniform | Desktop | Phone | |---|---|---| | u_sheetW | W | H | | u_sheetD | per frame | per frame | | u_sheetT | 1.15 (SPAN) | 1 | | u_sheetC | 1 (S-curve) | 0 (bowl) | | u_sheetP | 1 | 1 | | u_sheetV | per frame | 0 | | u_leanA | W · (−0.12) | 0 | | u_leanW | W | 0 | | u_diag | 0.03 | 0 | | u_axis | 0 | 1 | | u_dent | 0.035 | 0.035 | | u_shade | 1 | 0 | | u_shadeS | 1 | 0.6 | | u_corner | 20u ÷ card height | 15u ÷ card height | `u_hover` is per card, per frame. `u_res` is the card size in world units. Constants: PI = 3.141592653589793, BANK = −0.16, REAR_Y = 0.1, REAR_Z = 0.2, VTWIST = 1.8, TAIL = 1.0, SHIFT = −0.2. ### Shape functions (wx = world x) - **q(wx)** = wx / W · T + SHIFT - **shape(q)** = mix(1 − q², sin(πq), C) · e^(−TAIL·q²) - C = 1 gives a Gaussian-damped sine, the S-curve. - C = 0 gives a damped bowl. - **shapeSlope(q)** = mix(bowl′, ess′, C) · e^(−q²), where - bowl′ = −2q(1 + TAIL(1 − q²)) - ess′ = π·cos(πq) − 2·TAIL·q·sin(πq) - **z(wx)** = −D · shape(q(wx)): the ribbon recedes where the shape is positive and comes forward where it is negative. - **roll(wx)** = BANK · shapeSlope(q) / π · C: the resting bank that follows the S. ### Vertex stage 1. **Hover dent.** If hovered, push the vertex back in z by `hover · dent · resY · dome(uv)`, where dome(uv) = (1 − qx²)(1 − qy²) with q = 2·uv − 1. 2. **To world space.** Transform with the model matrix. 3. **Phone axis swap.** If u_axis = 1, swap world x and y, so the same ribbon runs down y. Swap back after step 7. 4. **Wind.** Rotate (y, z) about the x axis by angle a = roll(x). If V > 0, add the velocity wring: `VTWIST · V · smoothstep(0.3, 0.9, |x/W|) · sign(x/W)`. It does nothing at the centre and twists the two edges in opposite directions. 5. **Bend.** z += z(x). 6. **Diagonal and rear lift.** - y += diag · x (the ribbon climbs slightly to the right). - If V > 0, with m = 1 − smoothstep(−1, 0.3, x/W): y += REAR_Y · W · V · m and z += REAR_Z · W · V · m. The left/rear part lifts and comes forward while moving. 7. **Lean ("door").** z += leanA · ramp(x / leanW), where ramp(s) = s·(1.5 − 0.5s²) with s clamped to [−1, 1]. With leanA negative, the right side swings away and the left side swings toward the camera. ### Fragment stage 1. Sample the media at the crop UV. Composite the overlay over it: rgb = mix(media, overlay.rgb, overlay.a). 2. **Depth darkening** (desktop): depth = clamp((D − z(wx)) / 2D, 0, 1), plus the hover dome term, clamped. Then rgb = mix(rgb, vec3(0.059), shade · 0.8 · depth^shadeS). Receding parts darken heavily (about 68% at the far crest) and near parts only lightly (about 12%). 3. **Lighting.** Light direction L = normalize(−0.4, 0.5, 1). - The normal comes from the analytic slopes: dz/dx = −D · shapeSlope(q) · T / W, plus (leanA/leanW) · leanSlope, plus the hover dome derivatives, then rotated by roll(wx). leanSlope(s) = 1.5 · (1 − min(|s|, 1)²). - Diffuse: rgb *= 1 − 0.12 · (1 − (n·L · 0.5 + 0.5)). - Specular sheen: Blinn-Phong with gloss 48 and strength 0.35, against the view vector to the displaced point. 4. **Rounded corners.** Signed-distance rounded box in card space (aspect × 1) with radius u_corner, anti-aliased with fwidth. Multiply the result into alpha. 5. **Fade-in.** alpha also multiplies u_alpha. --- ## 7. Floor (desktop only) ### Geometry and placement - `PlaneGeometry(1, 1, 48, 24)` rotated −90° about x. - Render settings: transparent, no depth test or write, double-sided, renderOrder −1. - **Height:** y = a = −cardH·k/2 − 0.06H, just under the cards. - **Run (depth behind the strip):** o = 6H. - **Near edge:** near = min(41.18 · (1 − |a|/H) + 0.2H, 41.18 · 0.8). - **Scale:** (W · 2 · 4, 1, near + o). **Position:** z = (near − o)/2. - **Grid:** cell size = 0.22H; repeat count = (width / cell, o / cell). ### Vertex - vFar = −worldZ / o, so 0 is at the strip, 1 at the far end and negative toward the camera. - Apply the same lean as the cards (leanA = −0.12W, leanW = W, k = 1). The floor turns with the ribbon. ### Fragment - fade = 1 − smoothstep(0.2, 0.95, vFar) - The base colour is black: both tints are #000, mixed by smoothstep(0, 0.8, vFar). - Contact shadow: multiply by 1 − 0.55 · e^(−14|vFar|). - **Grid lines:** g = (uv.x · cellsX, vFar · cellsY). line = max over both axes of 1 − smoothstep(0, 1.5·fwidth(g), |fract(g) − 0.5|). col += line · 0.08 · fade. These are hairlines at 8% white. - **Reflection** (on the lines only): - A mirrored camera, a clone of the main camera, sits at y = 2m − camY, where m = a − 0.07H. - Each frame, render the cards into a half-resolution render target with the floor hidden. - In the shader, project the floor point through that camera's view-projection. Spread it from a light at x = −0.6W: wp.x −= (x − lightX) · 0.35 · |vFar|. - Sample with a soft 10% edge falloff. Weight by e^(−6·vFar) behind the strip or e^(2.2·vFar) in front of it. - col += reflection · line · 0.5 · weight · edges · fade. - Output alpha = u_alpha · fade, with u_alpha fading in to 0.9. The floor is hidden on phones, and the reflection pass is skipped there. --- ## 8. Virtual scroll, velocity and inertia (the reference's input model) ### State - `target` (where the strip should go) and `current` (where it is), in CSS px along the strip axis. ### Wheel (passive) - Ignore events with ctrlKey. - Delta: use the larger of deltaY and deltaX. Multiply by 16 for line mode, or by vh for page mode. - **Big flick:** |delta| ≥ 40, at least 30 ms since the previous event, and no burst within 500 ms (a burst means events arriving less than 30 ms apart). A big flick adds delta · 1.25 · 2 to a `pending` pool. - Any other event pushes delta · 1.25 immediately. - Each frame, the pending pool eases in by `pending · (1 − (1 − 0.22)^(min(dt·60, 4)))`. Once it is under 0.05, flush the remainder. ### Touch (passive) - touchmove pushes (previousY − currentY) · 3.25. - touchend pushes the last move's delta · 35 (the fling). ### Keys - ArrowDown and ArrowRight: +100. ArrowUp and ArrowLeft: −100. - PageDown: +0.9·vh. PageUp: −0.9·vh. Space: ±0.9·vh (Shift reverses it). - Ignore keys pressed with Meta, Ctrl or Alt, and call preventDefault on the ones handled. ### Push and lag clamp - push(d) adds d to target. - **Desktop only:** soft-clamp the lag to one viewport width: target = current + tanh((target − current)/vw) · vw. ### Each frame - ratio = min(dt · 60, 2), with dt capped at 50 ms. - current += (target − current) · 0.1 · ratio, rounded to 0.01 px. - With reduced motion, current = target exactly. ### Velocity (drives the bend) - t = tanh((target − current) / N), where N = 550 on desktop and 245 on phones. - vel = t · |t| (signed square). r = min(1, |vel|), or 0 with reduced motion. - **Desktop:** - D = W · 0.2 · (1 + 1.1·r): the S deepens by up to 2.1× while moving. - V = r: the edge wring and rear lift come in. - At rest D ≈ 6.63 world units at 16:10. - **Phone:** - D = H · 0.18 · 1.1 · r. The stack is perfectly flat at rest and bows into the bowl shape only while it moves. - The ends come toward the viewer and look larger mid-swipe. - V = 0, there's no lean, and there's no depth shading. --- ## 9. Hover (desktop pointer) - Track the pointer in normalised device coordinates. Leaving the document resets it off-screen. - **Picking:** each frame, rebuild each card's deformed outline on the CPU with the same sheet and lean formulas. Use 5 columns × top and bottom edges, projected through the camera. The pointer must fall inside that outline's screen bounding box. - The hovered card's `hover` value eases toward 1 at a rate of 1 − e^(−8·dt), and back to 0 at 1 − e^(−6·dt). - The hovered card dents inward (the dome term), darkens in the middle and shifts its sheen. - The cursor becomes a pointer over a card. - Hover is off on phones and with reduced motion. --- ## 10. Loading and entrance 1. **Boot:** run layout, then start the frame loop at once (the floor and cards are at alpha 0). 2. **In parallel:** load the font and all 8 poster images. 3. **When they're ready:** for each card, set up its media (poster texture plus its video), paint its overlay, set loaded = true, and add `body.ready`. - The corner labels fade in (0.6 s, after 0.2 s). - The loader fades out (0.4 s). 4. **Fades:** - Each card's u_alpha rises linearly over **0.6 s** to 1, once its overlay exists. - The floor's u_alpha rises over **0.8 s** to 0.9. 5. **Failsafe:** add `body.ready` after **8 s** regardless, and if loading fails. 6. Each video replaces its poster on its first decoded frame, with no black flash. --- ## 11. Reduced motion With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`: - No videos are created; cards keep their still posters. - No inertia: current snaps to target. - r = 0, so no velocity bend, wring or rear lift. The resting S-curve stays. - No hover dent. --- ## 12. Accessibility and miscellany - The canvas, veil and loader are `aria-hidden`. The project titles exist as the hidden list in §2. - The corner nav is real links and buttons. - Everything except the importmap, the three.js module and the media URLs is inline; there are no other network requests. - Expected result: - **At 1440×900:** a black stage, an S-shaped ribbon of three visible playing cards over a faint grid floor that reflects them on its lines, and the four tiny uppercase corner labels. - **At 375×812:** a looping column of four cards with arrow pills, faded at the top and bottom under the labels.

Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Year Recap"** in the **Portfolio** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `year-recap`
- **Category:** Portfolio (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/halftone-recap.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_001441_a517a376-cfaa-415e-95d8-ea8b61c1727c.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#FF5656`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"Year Recap"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/halftone-recap.mp4) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"Year Recap"** (Portfolio) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.
3. **Interactive Bento / Feature Architecture:**
   - 3-to-4 interactive cards or live calculator/filter controls depending on the archetype of **"Year Recap"**.
   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).

The big word "Design" sits behind her and "*Trends*" in script overlaps her hair. A band of image cards scrolls left across her middle, in front of her. 2. **Slides 2–6, the five trends.** Each has a justified paragraph at the top, an overlapping collage of 4 images, a blue number and a big two-line heading: - 01 Surveillance Graphics - 02 Naive Illustration - 03 Punk/Grunge - 04 Curated Objects - 05 Distorted Portraits 3. **End card:** a sky-blue slide with "WHICH ONE BELONGS IN YOUR BRAND'S WORLD?", a short paragraph, "LET'S TALK" with a hand-drawn blue circle that draws itself, and the wordmark "HALFTONE.". How you interact with it: - **Changing slides:** drag or swipe between slides (rubber-banding at the first and last slide), use the round arrow buttons (shown on hover), the dots, or ← →. - **On arrival:** each slide's collage wipes in one image after another, and its heading slides up. - **Collage images:** you can drag them around like a moodboard; they lift and tilt while moving. - **Cover band:** slows almost to a stop while hovered. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written. --- ## 1. Page basics - ``, title `Trend Carousel`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8. - **Fonts (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lexend:wght@300;400;500&family=Pinyon+Script&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the Lexend (300/400/500) and Pinyon Script latin woff2 files as base64 `@font-face` rules instead. - **Variables:** `--blue:#5f93cf`, `--paper:#f3f3f2`, `--ink:#151515`, `--accent:#2f62e0`. - **Reset and base:** - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`. - `html,body` fill the height, `overflow:hidden`, background `#e7e8ea`. - Body font `"Lexend","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif`, ink colour, antialiased, no selection. - **Post `#post`:** absolutely centred (translate -50%,-50%), a square of side `S = min(innerWidth, innerHeight)`, `font-size S/100` px (**1em = 1% of the side**). Overflow hidden, background paper, `touch-action:pan-y`, `cursor:grab` (`grabbing` while dragging). - **Track `#track`:** absolute, inset 0, a flex row. Each `.slide` is `flex:0 0 100%`, full height, relative, overflow hidden, background paper. ## 2. Assets (all URLs exact) 1. **Cover photo (2048², powder-blue seamless studio):** a young woman with a copper-red bob, a fringe and thin silver glasses. She wears a cream open-knit cardigan, cream wide trousers, white socks and burgundy patent loafers. She sits cross-legged on the floor, right arm raised across her chest, index finger pointing down, eyes down. `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_110008_97f7187c-1b33-4746-ac94-dc00336495be.png&w=1600&q=88` 2. **Cut-out of the same model (transparent, the same 2048² frame, pixel-aligned):** `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_110121_f40c2be8-ab96-4085-a3aa-7314ae0f62d6.png&w=1600&q=88` 3. **Contact sheet A (2336×1744, a 4×3 grid of original images with white gutters):** `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_110010_4359ec6f-574d-413b-a403-0325ee9182ab.png&w=2336&q=88` - The **cut-out**: `img.ph`. Her arm and head cover parts of "Design". 5. `.script` "Trends": left 53%, top 5.4%, Pinyon Script 400 at 16em/1. It sits in front, over her hair. 6. `.arent` "Aren't
new": right 6.2%, top 27.6%, 3.05em, right-aligned. 7. **The band:** left 0, right 0, top 39.4%, height 29.4%, overflow hidden. - A `.row` flex with a .55em gap holds the cells `A1, B0, B8, A4, B9, A10, B11, A6`, twice over. Each card is 29.4em × 100%, painted square. 8. `.found` "They've
simply
found.": left 5.2%, top 72.4%, 3.05em. 9. `.nts` "New
things
to say": left 78.6%, top 72.4%, 3.05em. 10. A thin white arrow SVG (viewBox 0 0 100 40, path `M0 20H96M78 4l18 16-18 16`, stroke 1.6): right 6.5%, bottom 5.6%, width 9.5%. All cover text is white Lexend 300, uppercase except where noted, line-height 1.16, `pointer-events:none`. **Band motion (rAF):** - `unit = (29.4+.55)·S/100`, `loop = unit·8`. - `off = (off + unit/2.05·spd·dt) mod loop`, then `translateX(−off)`: one card every ~2.05 s. - `spd` eases to .22 while the band is hovered and to 1 otherwise, at a rate of `dt·3`. ## 4. Trend slides **Shared elements:** - **`.copy`:** left and right 7.6%, top 7.4%, 2.28em/1.3, Lexend 300, justified. - **`.num`:** left 7.6%, top 66.6%, 2.6em, weight 400, colour `--accent`. - **`.head` (h2):** left 7.4%, top 71.2%, 8.75em, weight 400, uppercase, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing −.012em, z-index 1. - Each line is a span with overflow hidden around an `` that starts at `translateY(105%)`. - When the slide gets `.on`, the `` moves to none over .9s `cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1)`; the second line is delayed .08s. - **`.piece` (collage image):** absolute, painted, box-shadow `0 .25em .8em rgba(0,0,0,.08)`, `cursor:move`, `touch-action:none`. - It starts at `clip-path: inset(100% 0 0 0)` and wipes to `inset(0)` when the slide is `.on`: .8s `cubic-bezier(.65,0,.25,1)`, delay `.12 + k·.09` s. - While dragged (`.lift`): shadow `0 1.6em 3em rgba(0,0,0,.22)`, scale 1.04. **Collage pieces** are `[cell, left%, top%, width%, height%, focusX, focusY]`. **01 Surveillance / graphics.** Copy: "Security-cam stills, timecodes and tracking boxes turn the act of watching into a visual language. It has no interest in looking technically perfect; it feels playful, friendly and human, ideal for brands that want to seem looser and more open." | Cell | left | top | width | height | focus | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | A6 | 8.5 | 23 | 22 | 30 | .5, .25 | | A5 | 27 | 40 | 21 | 27 | | | A7 | 51 | 23 | 32 | 41 | | | A4 | 69 | 57 | 25 | 34 | | Extra: a yellow (`#f3cf2a`) scribble SVG at left 21%, top 20%, 17%×14%, stroke 6 with round caps. Its paths: - `M8 60C30 10 40 70 55 25S80 50 92 12` - `M14 72C34 30 52 66 68 30` **03 Punk/ / grunge.** Copy: "Smudged type, xerox grain and ripped-paper layouts pull straight from homemade zines and gig flyers. End card - **Background:** `linear-gradient(180deg, #86b1e2 0%, #a5c6ec 48%, #d4e3f3 100%)`, white text. - **Faint grid:** one vertical line at 8.6% and one horizontal line at 42%, each 1px `rgba(255,255,255,.16)`. - **h2** "Which one

Chrome and controls - **Arrows `#prev` and `#next`:** round white `rgba(255,255,255,.88)` buttons, 6.4em, at left and right 2.4%, vertically centred. - Chevron SVG with stroke 2, shadow `0 .3em 1.2em rgba(0,0,0,.12)`, z-index 5. - Hidden until the post is hovered (opacity .3s); hidden at the ends; scale .92 while pressed. - **Dots `#dots`:** bottom 2.6%, centred, gap 1.1em. 1.25em circles in `rgba(255,255,255,.55)`; the active one is white at scale 1.25. - On light slides (classes `#post.light`, slides 2–6), dots are `rgba(0,0,0,.18)` and the active one is ink. - Clicking a dot goes to its slide. - **go(i):** 1. Clamp i, reset the drag offset, and animate the track to `translateX(−cur·S)` over .62s `cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.2,1)`. 2. Give the current slide `.on` and remove it from the others, which replays that slide's entrance. 3. Update the dots, the `light` class and the arrow disabled states. - **Swipe:** - pointerdown on the post (not on the arrows, dots or a piece) records x, y and time, and captures the pointer. - After 6px the gesture locks to horizontal or vertical. A horizontal gesture moves the track live, with a .28 resistance past the first and last slide. - On release, it changes slide if the distance is over 18% of S or the speed is over .45 px/ms; otherwise it springs back. - **Piece drag:** pointerdown on a piece of the current slide lifts it and raises its z-index. - Moving updates left and top in % of the slide, and rotates it by `clamp(dx/40, −6°, 6°)`. - On release it drops (rotation back to 0). - **Keys:** ← and → change slide. - **Resize:** recompute S and place the track without animation.

items.prompt_text: # Spin Product: 360° Drag-to-Rotate Fashion Product Page (exact recreation prompt) Build a single-file, interactive fashion e-commerce product page for a fictional label, **OKTA/9**, on a flat pale cool-grey background. In the centre, a full-body model stands in an oversized **metallic silver puffer jacket with a topographic contour-line print**, charcoal wide-leg jeans and silver sneakers. She is a real 360° turntable clip. - **Rotate:** drag left or right to turn her a full circle. She coasts with inertia, and after 3 s idle she slowly spins on her own. - **Notched white cards:** a product info card on the left and a size and buy card on the right, linked to the jacket by thin white connector lines. - **Hotspots:** when she faces front, three pulsing "+" pins pop up on the jacket and open callouts on hover. - **Look thumbnails:** front and back thumbnails spin her to that side. - **Size selector:** a black highlight slides between sizes. - **Accordion:** the [+] rows open one at a time. - **Save:** toggles to "Saved". - **Pre-order:** flies a thumbnail in an arc into the bag, which bounces as BAG/0 counts up. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written. --- ## 1. Page basics - ``, title `Spin Product`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8. - **Fonts (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Inter+Tight:wght@500&family=Tinos&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the latin woff2 files as base64 `@font-face` rules instead. - **Variables:** `--bg:#e2e4e8`, `--card:#fff`, `--ink:#111`, `--mute:#7b7e84`, `--chip:#eceef1`, `--line:#b9bcc2`. - **Reset and base:** - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`. - `html,body` fill the height, `overflow:hidden`, background `var(--bg)`. - Body font `"IBM Plex Mono"`, ink colour, antialiased, no selection. - Buttons inherit the font, with no border or background. - **Artboard `#art`:** a fixed 1500×1000 px board, absolutely positioned, `transform-origin:0 0`. - On load and resize: `K = min(innerWidth/1500, innerHeight/1000)`. - Place the board at `left: innerWidth/2`, `top: innerHeight/2` with `transform: scale(K) translate(-750px,-500px)`. ## 2. Asset (URL exact) **Turntable clip:** Kling 4.0, image-to-video with the same start and end frame, 10.04 s, 24 fps, 732×1296, no audio. - The camera orbits a full 360° around the model, who stands still with her hands in her pockets, on a uniform pale grey seamless backdrop. - Frame 0 and the last frame are the same front view. The back view is at the midpoint. `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261107_112151_ae5c9a8f-07da-4b83-8dd8-47c762a5dfc0.mp4` ## 3. Header - **`#logo` "OKTA/9":** left 28, top 18, Inter Tight 500 at 27px, letter-spacing −.01em. - **`#crumb` "HOME > SHOP > COATS & JACKETS":** left 28, top 54, 11px, letter-spacing .03em. - **Pills `.pill`:** - 35px tall, padding `0 17px`, white, radius 4px, 13px uppercase, letter-spacing .03em, no wrapping. - Notched corners: `clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 6px) 0, 100% 6px, 100% 100%, 6px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 6px))`. - Hover: `#f6f6f7`. - **`#nav`:** centred at top 16 with a 6px gap: "Shop", "Collections", "Explore". - **`#acct`:** right 28: a search icon (circle r7 plus a handle, stroke 2.6), "Log in", and "Bag/" followed by `0`. - The bag bumps when an item lands: the count jumps 6px up at scale 1.4, over .5s `cubic-bezier(.3,1.8,.5,1)`. ## 4. Turntable `#stage` - **Size and position:** left 480, top 70, 540×960, `cursor:grab` (`grabbing` while dragging), `touch-action:none`. - **Media:** it holds the `

# Spindle: Dark 3D Cover Flow Music Website (exact recreation prompt) Build a single-file, interactive hero page for a fictional music streaming service, **SPINDLE**. The centrepiece is a faithful recreation of the classic portable media player **Cover Flow** on a glossy black floor: - **Layout:** sixteen square album covers stand in 3D. The centre album faces you flat, and the others are turned 72° and packed tightly on both sides, set back. - **Reflections:** every cover has a mirror reflection on the floor that fades down. - **Moving:** the flow follows the target with the device's quick exponential ease-out, and the leaving cover swings from flat to 72° as it slides away. - **Letter box:** a white rounded box under the centre album shows the artist's initial. - **Flip:** clicking the centre album lifts it forward and flips it 180° into a large tracklist, with a grey-blue glossy header and a glossy blue highlight row. - **Website layer:** a nav, a big headline, a now-playing title with a progress scrubber, an A–Z index, and a soft glow tinted by the centre album's colours. Use plain HTML, CSS (3D transforms) and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written. --- ## 1. Page basics - ``, title `Spindle`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`, charset utf-8. - **Font (Google Fonts):** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap`, with preconnects to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the Inter latin woff2 files as base64 `@font-face` rules instead. - **Variables:** `--bg:#050506`, `--ink:#f4f4f5`, `--mute:#8a8a90`, `--glow:120,90,200` (rgb triplet). - **Reset and base:** - Universal `box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0`. - `html,body` fill the height, `overflow:hidden`, background `--bg`. - Body font Inter, antialiased, no selection. ## 2. Asset (URL exact) **One 2048×2048 contact sheet**: a 4×4 grid of original album covers with white gutters. - Cell column x-ranges: `[24,507] [529,1014] [1035,1519] [1541,2024]` - Cell row y-ranges: `[24,505] [526,1012] [1032,1516] [1537,2023]` `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_114939_622a32d2-97e3-4fb9-8553-77eab7d548f0.png&w=2048&q=90` Albums in cell order, as artist, title, then tracks: 0. **Aurel Vance**, *Northern Lights*: Northern Lights, Lake Effect, Altitude, Paper Planes, Sunlit Rooms, Driftwood, Long Exposure, Home by Morning. *(Cover: a mountain lake at sunset with a pink sun.)* 1. **Bluehour**, *Low Tide*: Low Tide, Undertow, Salt, Coral, Holding Breath, The Blue Hour. *(An underwater swimmer in blue light rays.)* 2. **Cass Mirelle**, *Velvet Static*: Velvet Static, Channel 9, Rewind, Red Light, Snow on Screen, Tracking, After Credits. *(A woman's profile in red VHS light.)* 3. **Dune Theory**, *Mirage*: Mirage, Heatwave, Chrome Sun, Oasis, Sand in the Gears, Horizon Line. *(A chrome sphere over orange dunes.)* 4. **Echo Park Kids**, *Summer Reruns*: Summer Reruns, Car Roof, Polaroid, Fireflies, Last Day of School, Reruns (Reprise). *(A faded polaroid of friends on a car roof.)* 5. **Fennel**, *Greenhouse*: Greenhouse, Condensation, Fern, Window Light, Slow Grow, Watering Can, Bloom. *(Plants behind foggy glass.)* 6. **Grey Harbor**, *Fog Signals*: Fog Signals, Lighthouse, Northbound, Tidewater, Harbor Lights, Morse. *(A lighthouse in fog.)* 7. **Halcyon Drive**, *Night Swim*: Night Swim, Chlorine, Deep End, Lifeguard Off Duty, Turquoise, Pool Lights, Dry Off. *(A neon pool at night.)* 8. **Juno Vale**, *Paper Moons*: Paper Moons, Scissors, Crescent, Glue Stick Heart, Origami, Phases. *(A cut-paper moon.)* 9. **Kaito Rei**, *Neon Rain*: Neon Rain, Shibuya 2AM, Umbrella, Puddles, Taxi Light, Last Train, Signal. *(A rainy neon street.)* 10. **Lumen**, *Afterglow*: Afterglow, Liquid, Ember, Prism, Violet Hour, Fade. *(An orange and violet gradient.)* 11. **Marlowe**, *Slow Burn*: Slow Burn, Matchstick, Smoke, Kindling, Embers, Ash, Relight. *(A lit match.)* 12. **Nadia Sol**, *Gold Hour*: Gold Hour, Lens Flare, Sun on Skin, Halo, Late August, Golden. *(A golden backlit portrait.)* 13. **Oslo Club**, *Cold Water*: Cold Water, Grid, Blue Circle, Helvetica, Fjord, Minimal. *(A swiss poster with a blue circle.)* 14. **Pale Atlas**, *Satellites*: Satellites, Star Trails, Observatory, Long Night, Orbit, Signal Lost, Dawn. *(Star trails over an observatory.)* 15. **Rivers & Co**, *Long Drive Home*: Long Drive Home, Mile Marker, Windshield, Gas Station Coffee, Exit 14, Headlights, Driveway. *(A highway at dusk through a windshield.)* **Track items.prompt_text: # Recreate the "Adrian Korvel" portfolio hero exactly Build a single-file, full-viewport portfolio hero for a fictional independent designer, Adrian Korvel. It is one screen, with no scrolling on desktop. The page is a deep burnt-terracotta scene. A giant, softly glowing condensed serif name sits behind an illustrated portrait of a young man with long curly hair that blows in the wind. Dark agave leaves sway in the bottom corners, and small sparkles twinkle. Around this sit small uppercase typewriter-style text blocks, a minimal nav and a strip of five badges along the bottom. Everything below must be reproduced exactly: values, text, assets, timings. --- ## 1. Assets (use these exact URLs; do not re-host, crop or re-encode) | Role | Type | URL | Size | How it is used | |---|---|---|---|---| | Scene still (background plate) | PNG, served as WebP through the image proxy | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_011718_f1fd2b4c-d260-44ae-a0a2-8256134a4c35.png&w=2048&q=85` | 2048 × 1360 (3:2) | CSS background of the plate box, stretched to the box (`background-size:100% 100%`). Terracotta field, soft central glow, dark brown agave clusters in the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, 3 small white four-point sparkles. No text, no person. | | Scene loop video | MP4 H.264, 1764 × 1172, 24 fps, 5.04 s, no audio | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261107_013821_69b8d7f5-48e9-43bb-8986-621494771aff.mp4` | ~2.4 MB | Same framing as the scene still. Agave leaves bend and whip hard in a gusting wind, sparkles twinkle, glow stays constant. Starts and ends on the still, so it loops seamlessly. Plays on top of the still inside the plate box. | | Portrait still on chroma green | PNG, served as WebP through the image proxy | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_011718_86327298-00a4-468f-bc16-1555fc51ab6a.png&w=2048&q=85` | 2048 × 1360 (3:2) | The young man (long dark-brown curly hair to the shoulders, oatmeal crew-neck chunky knit sweater, flat painterly vector illustration style) on flat #00FF00. Keyed to transparency in WebGL; shown until the video has frames and permanently for reduced motion. Must load with `crossOrigin="anonymous"` (the proxy sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`). | | Portrait loop video on chroma green | MP4 H.264, 1764 × 1172, 24 fps, 5.04 s, no audio | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261107_013339_aa2bb827-96c2-470c-be0f-f718d4c1cfcf.mp4` | ~6.2 MB | Same framing as the portrait still. His hair streams and whips to the right in a strong wind, the sweater ripples, he breathes and blinks once; the green never changes. Starts and ends on the still (seamless loop). Never shown directly: it is drawn into a WebGL canvas and keyed every frame. CloudFront sends `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, so it must be created with `crossOrigin="anonymous"`. | All four media share one geometry: a 3:2 image placed in a 1440 × 900 design frame at **left 0, top −28.125, width 1440, height 956.25** design units. That is a centred 16:10 crop of the 3:2 source, with 28.125 units hidden above and below. ## 2. Fonts (self-hosted latin WOFF2 from Google Fonts) | CSS family name | Google font | Weight(s) | File URL | Used for | |---|---|---|---|---| | "Caslon Cond" | Libre Caslon Condensed (variable) | 400–700 range, used at 500 | `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/librecasloncondensed/v3/flUpRrasxYEyVwtcWIsbLunUPow3bHNaxvyEX6gqZQ.woff2` | The giant two-line name | | "Instrument Serif" | Instrument Serif | 400 | `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/instrumentserif/v5/jizBRFtNs2ka5fXjeivQ4LroWlx-6zUTjg.woff2` | "Korvel" wordmark | | "Plex Mono" | IBM Plex Mono | 400 | `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ibmplexmono/v20/-F63fjptAgt5VM-kVkqdyU8n1i8q1w.woff2` | Body copy, badges, CHAT | | "Plex Mono" | IBM Plex Mono | 500 | `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ibmplexmono/v20/-F6qfjptAgt5VM-kVkqdyU8n3twJwlBFgg.woff2` | Nav links, BOOK A CALL | `font-display: block` for Caslon Cond (the name must never flash in a fallback face); `swap` for the others. In the standalone file all four are embedded as base64 data URIs. ## 3. Head and colour tokens - ``: Adrian Korvel — Independent Designer - meta description: "Adrian Korvel is an independent designer based in Lisbon, building calm, honest digital interfaces for studios that value clarity and craft." - viewport: `width=device-width, initial-scale=1` | Token | Value | Use | |---|---|---| | --bg | #aa4820 | Page background, plate fallback | | --ink | #fff8f1 | All small text and icons | | --name | #fae5d5 | Giant name | | --pill | #f4ede6 | BOOK A CALL background | | --pill-ink | #a03815 | BOOK A CALL text and arrow | Global reset (`*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}`). `html, body` height 100%, background --bg, colour --ink. `body` uses Plex Mono, `overflow:hidden` on desktop, `-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased`. Links inherit colour, no underline. ## 4. The scaling system (three units) Everything was measured on a 1440 × 900 mockup. One design unit is 1 mockup pixel. - `--u` (cover) = `max(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)`. Used only for the scene plate, which must always cover the whole viewport. - `--uc` (contain) = `min(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)`. Used for the content frame (name and portrait) and for the four copy blocks, so they always fit inside the viewport. - `--n` (nav) = `clamp(0.62px, 100vw/1440, 1.25px)`. Used for the nav and the badge strip, which are pinned to viewport edges and scale with width only. - `--ft` = `100vh − 900·--uc`, the y position where the content frame starts. Containers: - `.hero`: `position:relative`, 100vw × 100vh (100svh where supported), `overflow:hidden`, background --bg. - `.cover` (scene plate holder): absolute, `left:50%`, `bottom:0`, width 1440·--u, height 900·--u, `translateX(-50%)`. It is **bottom-anchored**: on wide, short screens the top of the scene is cropped, never the agave. - `.frame` (content): the same box but with `--u` redefined to `--uc`. Absolute, `left:50%`, `bottom:0`, 1440·--uc × 900·--uc, `translateX(-50%)`. It sits on the viewport's bottom edge. - Inside each: `.plate` and `.man` are at left 0, top −28.125·u, width 1440·u, height 956.25·u. ## 5. Layer stack and exact desktop layout (design units on the 1440 × 900 frame) From back to front: 1. **Plate** (`.cover > .plate`). The background image is the scene still (stretched 100% 100%), with the scene video as a child `<video class="plate-vid">` (absolute, inset 0, 100% × 100%, `object-fit:cover`, opacity 0 → 1 over 0.8 s ease once it fires `playing`). The video is muted, looped, `playsinline`, `preload=auto`, `crossOrigin=anonymous` and `aria-hidden`. Lines are split with `<br>` exactly as shown: - `.c1`: left 62·--n, top --ft + 152·--uc. Text: "I design calm, honest / digital interfaces — / shaped like architecture, / warm like baked clay." - `.c2`: left 62·--n, top --ft + 366·--uc. Text: "No noise. No fluff. Just / craft. Every detail earns / its own place." - `.c3`: left `100vw − 214·uc − 62·n + 62·uc`, top --ft + 152·--uc. Text: "Based / in Lisbon, / remote" - `.c4`: left `100vw − 291·uc − 62·n + 62·uc`, top --ft + 363·--uc. Text: "Independent designer for / studios that value / clarity, craft, and the / long-lasting simplicity." - At exactly 1440 × 900 this puts the blocks at x 62, 62, 1226 and 1149. Ink x 1184–1214. - "BOOK A CALL" pill: inline-flex, gap 8·n, height 32·n, padding 0 13·n, radius 999px, background #f4ede6, colour #a03815, Plex Mono 500, 12.6·n, letter-spacing 0.03em. Phone layout (max-width 820px) - `body` scrolls (`overflow:auto`). `--n` becomes 100vw/390. - `.hero` becomes a flex column, height auto, min-height 100svh. - Nav: static, height 64·n, padding 0 18·n. Wordmark 30·n. Links and CHAT are hidden; the pill is 34·n high with 12·n text. - A separate `.mcopy` block (hidden on desktop) appears under the nav: padding 6·n 18·n 0, Plex Mono 11.2·n, line-height 1.45, uppercase. (2) "No noise. No fluff. Just / craft. Every detail earns / its own place." (3) "Independent designer for / studios that value / clarity, craft, and the / long-lasting simplicity." There are 12·n gaps between rows. The desktop `.copy` blocks are hidden. - `.stage` is relative, `flex:1`, min-height 560·n, `overflow:hidden`. It holds a cropped view of the same scene: both `.cover` and `.frame` use `--u = 100vw/700`, left −370·u, bottom −20·u, no transform. This shows frame x 370–1070, with the name and portrait centred. - The fade is 110·n tall. - Badges: absolute, bottom 12·n, wrap and centre, row-gap 7·n, column-gap 16·n, padding 0 18·n, 10·n text, 12·n icons, gap 6·n, no dot separators. ## 9. The glowing name sits behind the portrait, and the portrait's hair overlaps the letters with clean keyed edges and no green fringe. - Both videos play and loop seamlessly. Hair visibly whips in the wind and the agave sways hard; nothing else in the scene moves. - On a wide, short window (e.g. 1536 × 776) the name never touches the nav, the copy blocks stay fully visible, and the scene still covers edge to edge. - At 390 × 844 the copy sits above the scene, with no horizontal scroll and no overlaps. - Reduced motion shows the stills with no animation. - No external requests other than the four media URLs above and the four font files (or none for fonts in the standalone build).

It is one screen, with no scrolling on desktop. The page is a deep burnt-terracotta scene. A giant, softly glowing condensed serif name sits behind an illustrated portrait of a young man with long curly hair that blows in the wind. Dark agave leaves sway in the bottom corners, and small sparkles twinkle. Around this sit small uppercase typewriter-style text blocks, a minimal nav and a strip of five badges along the bottom. Everything below must be reproduced exactly: values, text, assets, timings. --- ## 1. Terracotta field, soft central glow, dark brown agave clusters in the bottom-left and bottom-right corners, 3 small white four-point sparkles. No text, no person. | | Scene loop video | MP4 H.264, 1764 × 1172, 24 fps, 5.04 s, no audio | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261107_013821_69b8d7f5-48e9-43bb-8986-621494771aff.mp4` | ~2.4 MB | Same framing as the scene still. Agave leaves bend and whip hard in a gusting wind, sparkles twinkle, glow stays constant. Starts and ends on the still, so it loops seamlessly. Plays on top of the still inside the plate box. | | Portrait still on chroma green | PNG, served as WebP through the image proxy | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261107_011718_86327298-00a4-468f-bc16-1555fc51ab6a.png&w=2048&q=85` | 2048 × 1360 (3:2) | The young man (long dark-brown curly hair to the shoulders, oatmeal crew-neck chunky knit sweater, flat painterly vector illustration style) on flat #00FF00. Remove `js-pending`, then animate with easing `cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.15,1)` and `fill:'backwards'`: | Element | From → to | Delay (ms) | Duration (ms) | |---|---|---|---| | Plate (still + video) | opacity 0, scale(1.06) → 1, scale(1) | 0 | 1600 | | Name line 1 | opacity 0, blur(14px), its own translateX + translateY(40px) → opacity 1, blur 0, its translateX | 250 | 1400 | | Name line 2 | same | 410 | 1400 | | Portrait | opacity 0, translateY(60px) → 1, none | 520 | 1500 | | Nav children (logo, links, right group) | opacity 0, translateY(−12px) → 1, none | 700, 790, 880 | 900 | | Copy c1, c2, c3, c4 (in DOM order; on phones the single .mcopy block) | opacity 0, translateY(14px), clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) → 1, none, inset(0 0 0% 0) | 1000 + i × 120 | 1000 | | Badge items 1–5 | opacity 0, translateY(10px) → 1, none | 1300 + i × 80 | 800 | **Reduced motion.** With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, all CSS transitions and animations are disabled, the entrance timeline is skipped (content appears at once), both videos are paused, the scene video is hidden and the keyed portrait still is redrawn. The page listens for changes to the setting and switches live. ## 8. Phone layout (max-width 820px) - `body` scrolls (`overflow:auto`). `--n` becomes 100vw/390. - `.hero` becomes a flex column, height auto, min-height 100svh. - Nav: static, height 64·n, padding 0 18·n. Wordmark 30·n. Links and CHAT are hidden; the pill is 34·n high with 12·n text. - A separate `.mcopy` block (hidden on desktop) appears under the nav: padding 6·n 18·n 0, Plex Mono 11.2·n, line-height 1.45, uppercase. Rows: (1) "I design calm, honest / digital interfaces — / shaped like architecture, / warm like baked clay." on the left and "Based / in Lisbon, / remote" on the right (`space-between`, gap 14·n). (2) "No noise. No fluff. Just / craft. Every detail earns / its own place." (3) "Independent designer for / studios that value / clarity, craft, and the / long-lasting simplicity." There are 12·n gaps between rows. The desktop `.copy` blocks are hidden. - `.stage` is relative, `flex:1`, min-height 560·n, `overflow:hidden`. It holds a cropped view of the same scene: both `.cover` and `.frame` use `--u = 100vw/700`, left −370·u, bottom −20·u, no transform. This shows frame x 370–1070, with the name and portrait centred. - The fade is 110·n tall. - Badges: absolute, bottom 12·n, wrap and centre, row-gap 7·n, column-gap 16·n, padding 0 18·n, 10·n text, 12·n icons, gap 6·n, no dot separators. ## 9. Acceptance checklist - At 1440 × 900 the page matches the measurements above within 2 px. The glowing name sits behind the portrait, and the portrait's hair overlaps the letters with clean keyed edges and no green fringe. - Both videos play and loop seamlessly. Hair visibly whips in the wind and the agave sways hard; nothing else in the scene moves. - On a wide, short window (e.g. 1536 × 776) the name never touches the nav, the copy blocks stay fully visible, and the scene still covers edge to edge. - At 390 × 844 the copy sits above the scene, with no horizontal scroll and no overlaps. - Reduced motion shows the stills with no animation. - No external requests other than the four media URLs above and the four font files (or none for fonts in the standalone build).
