items.title: Veyra Electric
items.prompt_text:
# Recreate VEYRA — complete coding-agent prompt

You are an implementation agent with access to a terminal, filesystem and browser. Create and run the approved VEYRA automotive website in my local workspace. Complete the implementation and verification; do not stop at a plan.

## Objective and source of truth

Reproduce the finished interactive scene from this public release:

- Repository: https://github.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car
- Approved tag: `v1.0.0`
- Source ZIP: https://github.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.0.zip
- Desktop reference: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car/v1.0.0/docs/images/desktop.png
- Phone reference: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car/v1.0.0/docs/images/mobile.png
- Asset base: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car/v1.0.0/public/media/

The reference source, media and stylesheet are authoritative. This is a faithful reproduction task. Obtain the pinned release and reuse its implementation. Do not substitute a freshly invented landing page, a different car, a simulated video, a new UI system or newly generated imagery. Do not claim that a text-only generative reconstruction is identical to the reference.

If Git/network tools are unavailable, explain the precise blocker and ask me to provide the release ZIP. Do not make a visually unrelated placeholder and call the task complete.

## Bootstrap

1. Inspect the current directory. If it already contains this project, read its instructions and check the working tree before making changes. Preserve local work. If the directory contains a different project, create a clearly named child directory; do not overwrite it or reset its Git history.
2. In a clean workspace, clone the tag:

```sh
git clone --branch v1.0.0 https://github.com/amirmushichge/veyra-interactive-car.git
cd veyra-interactive-car
git switch -c my-veyra
```

3. Read `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/MEDIA.md` and `docs/VERIFICATION.md`. Inspect both reference screenshots.
4. Use Node.js 22 or later and pnpm 10.15.1. Install pnpm if needed with the environment's normal package-manager mechanism. Keep the release dependency versions and lockfile. Do not introduce new application libraries.
5. Run:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test
pnpm verify:reference
pnpm build
pnpm dev
```

6. Use http://127.0.0.1:5220/ as the local preview. If another process occupies it, identify the process and reuse it only if it serves this exact project. Do not kill unrelated processes. Use one deliberate alternate port only if necessary and report it clearly.

If adapting into another toolchain is explicitly required by my environment, first get the original Vite release running. Preserve the same React components, CSS, content and asset bytes; isolate framework plumbing from the reference behaviour. Report that the result is an adaptation if any reference files differ.

## Product and page

VEYRA is a fictional independent electric-vehicle design study. The page title is `VEYRA — Electric, inside out.` It is a single interactive scene with a lightweight header, title row, framed media, four hotspots, contextual menus, two technical detail views and a compact footer.

The header shows the `VEYRA` wordmark, `Electric vehicle design` on sufficiently wide screens, and `Independent concept`. The overview title is `Electric, inside out.` Supporting copy reads `Explore beneath the surface.` and `Select a point to begin.`

The footer has four aligned text groups: Electric drive, Battery architecture, Body finishes, Wheel designs. Preserve their exact text from App.tsx. A slim baseline shows `VEYRA — Design study` and the current scene's supporting sentence. Appearance menus temporarily replace the footer notes visually, leaving the car unobstructed.

Do not add buy buttons, prices, range estimates, performance specifications, brand claims, navigation sections, testimonials, cards or a contact form. Do not turn the page into a multi-screen marketing site. There is no runtime 3D model, no scroll-scrubbing timeline and no looping autoplay background.

## Visual contract

- Font: Space Grotesk, weight 400 only. Use the release font import. No synthetic bold.
- Primary colours: studio `#6b879d`, sky `#708fa2`, white `#ffffff`, muted text `#e1eaf0`, panel `#35586e`, electric green `#edff39`, dark accent text `#10190c`, thin white-alpha lines.
- The wordmark has restrained kerning. The title hierarchy comes from size and spacing, not heavier font weights.
- One shared image plane holds media and hotspots at a nominal 1672:941 ratio. Preserve the existing measurement formula and CSS variables.
- One white 3px outer frame encloses all media states; radius 16px on larger screens and 12px on phones. It must not alter media coordinates. No feather masks, background recolouring or duplicated blurred car silhouettes.
- Preserve the full visible car, both wheels, open hood and ground shadow.
- Hotspots are 48px interaction targets with compact electric-green discs, dark thin plus icons and restrained hover labels. Keep keyboard focus visible.
- Appearance panels use a consistent blue surface, 12px radius, thin border and readable labels. The panel stays outside the vehicle image, below the frame.
- Desktop header/title/media/footer align to the same measured width. At widths at most 900px, use the release stacked layout, 20px side margins and a two-column text footer.
- At desktop heights at most 780px, technical descriptions flow below the media. Do not shrink or move the image during entry/return to accommodate them.

Reuse `src/index.css` in full. These notes explain its intent; they do not replace the precise reference rules.

## Asset contract

Use the release's `public/media` directory with unchanged bytes. All assets are supplied. Keep filenames and nested paths case-exact.

Active exterior: `exterior-polished.png`.

Hover pairs:

- Drive: `hood-hover-forward.mp4`, `hood-hover-reverse.mp4`.
- Battery: `battery-hover-forward.mp4`, `battery-hover-reverse.mp4`.

Active technical images: `drive-blue.png`, `battery-blue.png`.

Paint: original exterior for Studio Silver; `config/electric-green.png`, `config/lime-green.png`, `config/sky-blue.png`, `config/graphite.png` for the remaining four choices.

Wheels: original exterior for Multi-spoke; `config/wheels-aero.png` for Aero Disc; `config/wheels-forged.png` for Sport Forged.

Keep earlier/dormant stills in the release too. `optics` and disabled detail-flight clip metadata in `content.ts` are not active features. Do not enable them or fabricate their missing videos.

Do not resize, recompress, retime, recolour or regenerate approved media. Do not send assets to an external generation provider during reproduction. Prefer local files served by Vite; do not leave playback dependent on temporary provider URLs.

## Interaction contract

There are exactly four overview points:

- Drive at x=25%, y=48%: hover/focus opens the hood; click enters the drive detail.
- Battery at x=64%, y=72%: hover/focus reveals the battery; click enters its detail.
- Paint at x=55%, y=51%: opens body-colour selection.
- Wheels at x=48%, y=71%: opens wheel selection.

Coordinates are image-relative. Do not position them against the whole screen.

### Hover playback

Retain `HoverVideo.tsx` exactly. It uses four off-DOM video elements and one canvas. Show frames only after decoding. Hold the last displayed frame at every handoff. Distinguish the currently settled pose from the latest desired hotspot.

Finish the active short forward clip before reversing. Finish its reverse before starting another system. Do not seek in the middle of independently retimed forward/reverse files to guess a matching pose. Rapid pointer changes update the desired target rather than starting overlapping playback.

On detail entry, freeze the currently visible hover frame until the opaque cutaway covers it. Reset only after that handoff. Preserve failure handling, the watchdog, cleanup and reduced-motion behaviour. Never introduce a black clearing frame.

### Detail navigation

Keep `overview → entering → detail → returning → overview` and the release's timing and guards. Do not trigger transitions while loading, already transitioning, or configuring appearance.

Drive and Battery each show their existing title, description, three component points/list entries and driver-oriented explanation. Click a point or list row to toggle its explanation. Keep the Back control and Escape return. Keep screen-reader status, focus handling and disabled states.

Click-to-detail is the approved CSS zoom/crossfade into a still image. Do not replace it with a new generated flight.

### Appearance

Only one mode is active at a time. On opening Paint or Wheels, stop requesting a hover pose and wait for the authored return to the neutral car. Show the selected appearance only when neutral and decoded. Do not place an appearance render over an open hood or X-ray frame.

Keep original hover/focus ownership, pointer corridor, pin-on-selection behaviour, leave timer, close timing and Escape. Disable unrelated points while the panel is active/closing. On close, restore the original car and unlock the other functions. Paint and wheel choices are independent render alternatives, not a combined configuration engine.

The menu must remain reachable from its point and must not cover the body or wheels. Preserve the desktop horizontal dock and phone-sized compact dock. Do not introduce an invisible full-page click blocker to keep it open.

## Verification

Treat the release source/media hashes as the reference test. If `pnpm verify:reference` fails during exact reproduction, identify why and restore the correct files. Do not regenerate the manifest just to pass.

Run existing unit checks and the production build. Inspect the actual browser, not just the source. At minimum check 1440x900, 1280x720 and 390x844; also check 1920x1080, 768x1024 and around 360px when the environment allows.

Exercise: default scene; every paint and wheel option; close and reopen; hood opening and return; battery reveal and return; rapid travel between system points; entry/return for both detail views; annotation toggles; Tab/Enter/Escape; pointer travel from hotspot to displaced menu; reduced motion. Verify no horizontal overflow, clipped primary controls, black endpoint, lost wheel, scale jump or video playing over an appearance selection.

Compare desktop and phone screenshots against the supplied references at matching viewport sizes. Allow normal browser/font rasterisation differences; do not claim pixel identity across every OS. Note any testing limits honestly, especially physical iOS/Safari and real touch devices.

Read known limitations before reporting a newly discovered regression. The reference contains an appearance-close focus race that can leave focus on the body; do not silently change behaviour in a reproduction task. Flag it and keep any future fix separately scoped.

## Optional LTX workflow

Do not use LTX to complete the reproduction. The files are already bundled. If I separately request new media, read `docs/LTX_API.md` and use https://console.ltx.io/api-keys for my own key. Never request that I paste the key into the conversation or expose it in a VITE_ variable.

Prepare a local dry run first. A paid submission needs my authorization for the specific cost and input upload. Keep outputs in `generated/`, preserve the saved job ID and resume interrupted polling instead of submitting twice. New generation cannot reproduce the approved image/video bytes deterministically.

## Finish

Return the working local preview URL, location of the project, release tag used, verification results and any real limitations. Keep the site running for review. Do not publish a website, push to my GitHub, create an account or incur generation charges unless I separately request that action. Preserve the repository license and attribution.

Active exterior: `exterior-polished.png`.

Hover pairs:

- Drive: `hood-hover-forward.mp4`, `hood-hover-reverse.mp4`.
- Battery: `battery-hover-forward.mp4`, `battery-hover-reverse.mp4`.

Active technical images: `drive-blue.png`, `battery-blue.png`.

Paint: original exterior for Studio Silver; `config/electric-green.png`, `config/lime-green.png`, `config/sky-blue.png`, `config/graphite.png` for the remaining four choices.

Wheels: original exterior for Multi-spoke; `config/wheels-aero.png` for Aero Disc; `config/wheels-forged.png` for Sport Forged.

Keep earlier/dormant stills in the release too. `optics` and disabled detail-flight clip metadata in `content.ts` are not active features. Do not enable them or fabricate their missing videos.

Do not resize, recompress, retime, recolour or regenerate approved media. Do not send assets to an external generation provider during reproduction. Prefer local files served by Vite; do not leave playback dependent on temporary provider URLs.

## Interaction contract

There are exactly four overview points:

- Drive at x=25%, y=48%: hover/focus opens the hood; click enters the drive detail.
- Battery at x=64%, y=72%: hover/focus reveals the battery; click enters its detail.
- Paint at x=55%, y=51%: opens body-colour selection.
- Wheels at x=48%, y=71%: opens wheel selection.

Coordinates are image-relative. Do not position them against the whole screen.

### Hover playback

Retain `HoverVideo.tsx` exactly. It uses four off-DOM video elements and one canvas. Show frames only after decoding. Hold the last displayed frame at every handoff. Distinguish the currently settled pose from the latest desired hotspot.

Finish the active short forward clip before reversing. Finish its reverse before starting another system. Do not seek in the middle of independently retimed forward/reverse files to guess a matching pose. Rapid pointer changes update the desired target rather than starting overlapping playback.

On detail entry, freeze the currently visible hover frame until the opaque cutaway covers it. Reset only after that handoff. Preserve failure handling, the watchdog, cleanup and reduced-motion behaviour. Never introduce a black clearing frame.

### Detail navigation

Keep `overview → entering → detail → returning → overview` and the release's timing and guards. Do not trigger transitions while loading, already transitioning, or configuring appearance.

Drive and Battery each show their existing title, description, three component points/list entries and driver-oriented explanation. Click a point or list row to toggle its explanation. Keep the Back control and Escape return. Keep screen-reader status, focus handling and disabled states.

Click-to-detail is the approved CSS zoom/crossfade into a still image. Do not replace it with a new generated flight.

### Appearance

Only one mode is active at a time. On opening Paint or Wheels, stop requesting a hover pose and wait for the authored return to the neutral car. Show the selected appearance only when neutral and decoded. Do not place an appearance render over an open hood or X-ray frame.

Keep original hover/focus ownership, pointer corridor, pin-on-selection behaviour, leave timer, close timing and Escape. Disable unrelated points while the panel is active/closing. On close, restore the original car and unlock the other functions. Paint and wheel choices are independent render alternatives, not a combined configuration engine.

The menu must remain reachable from its point and must not cover the body or wheels. Preserve the desktop horizontal dock and phone-sized compact dock. Do not introduce an invisible full-page click blocker to keep it open.

## Verification

Treat the release source/media hashes as the reference test. If `pnpm verify:reference` fails during exact reproduction, identify why and restore the correct files. Do not regenerate the manifest just to pass.

Run existing unit checks and the production build. Inspect the actual browser, not just the source. At minimum check 1440x900, 1280x720 and 390x844; also check 1920x1080, 768x1024 and around 360px when the environment allows.

Exercise: default scene; every paint and wheel option; close and reopen; hood opening and return; battery reveal and return; rapid travel between system points; entry/return for both detail views; annotation toggles; Tab/Enter/Escape; pointer travel from hotspot to displaced menu; reduced motion. Verify no horizontal overflow, clipped primary controls, black endpoint, lost wheel, scale jump or video playing over an appearance selection.

Compare desktop and phone screenshots against the supplied references at matching viewport sizes. Allow normal browser/font rasterisation differences; do not claim pixel identity across every OS. Note any testing limits honestly, especially physical iOS/Safari and real touch devices.

Read known limitations before reporting a newly discovered regression. The reference contains an appearance-close focus race that can leave focus on the body; do not silently change behaviour in a reproduction task. Flag it and keep any future fix separately scoped.

## Optional LTX workflow

Do not use LTX to complete the reproduction. The files are already bundled. If I separately request new media, read `docs/LTX_API.md` and use https://console.ltx.io/api-keys for my own key. Never request that I paste the key into the conversation or expose it in a VITE_ variable.

Prepare a local dry run first. A paid submission needs my authorization for the specific cost and input upload. Keep outputs in `generated/`, preserve the saved job ID and resume interrupted polling instead of submitting twice. New generation cannot reproduce the approved image/video bytes deterministically.

## Finish

Return the working local preview URL, location of the project, release tag used, verification results and any real limitations. Keep the site running for review. Do not publish a website, push to my GitHub, create an account or incur generation charges unless I separately request that action. Preserve the repository license and attribution.

items.title: Vertex
items.prompt_text:
Build a single, self-contained, production-ready `index.html` — one file, no build step, no frameworks, no local assets. It renders a full-viewport dark hero section for a fictional e-commerce SaaS called "Vertex Shops". Every image loads from the absolute CloudFront URLs in §8. There is NO video anywhere in this page. Two components below are marked PIXEL CONTRACT. Those are the most commonly botched parts of this design. Implement them exactly as written, including the DO-NOT lists. Do not "improve" them, do not substitute a more conventional button/pill pattern, do not add glows or centring that is not specified. ===================================================================== 0. GLOBAL SHELL ===================================================================== , . Vision — Streamline the shop virtual FONTS — exactly these three tags in , in this order: Reset: *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box} html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#020204} /* page never scrolls */ body{font-family:Poppins,Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased} a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit} /* REQUIRED - button labels must never underline */ ===================================================================== 1. CORE ARCHITECTURE — A FIXED DESIGN CANVAS THAT IS SCALED ===================================================================== The single most important idea: the desktop composition is authored at a fixed 1172 x 657 px design canvas. EVERY element is absolutely positioned in raw design pixels — there is no flow layout, no flexbox column, no auto-centring on desktop. The whole canvas is then scaled by ONE transform to fit the viewport. The optical centre of every centred element is x=586. .stage{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:#020204} .canvas{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:1172px;height:657px; transform:translateX(-50%) scale(var(--k,1));transform-origin:50% 0} .canvas>*{position:absolute} .stack{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:300} /* layout shell, no box of its own */ .stack>*{position:absolute} .navmenu{display:contents} /* shell, invisible on desktop */ .burger{display:none} /* desktop */ Scale law, computed in JS on every resize: k = min(vw / W, vh / 560) Using 560 (not 657) as the height divisor is deliberate: it fills the width and lets the browser mock bleed off the bottom edge rather than letterboxing. W = 1172 on desktop; see §10 for the tablet ramp. Background (never animates — it is the stage): .bg{position:absolute;inset:0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(25,127,255,0) 38%, rgba(25,127,255,.042) 54%, rgba(25,127,255,.052) 68%, rgba(25,127,255,.030) 100%), #020204} STARFIELD — two 1x1px divs whose entire star field is one giant box-shadow list, generated in JS. .stars{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1px;height:1px; border-radius:50%;background:#fff} Layer A (#stA): 150 stars, blur 0px, alpha random .05–.30 Layer B (#stB): 18 stars, blur 1.2px, alpha random .35–.70 Each entry: "vw vh px 0 rgba(255,255,255,)", joined with commas, assigned to el.style.boxShadow. ===================================================================== 1.5 EXACT COORDINATE TABLE — NON-NEGOTIABLE ===================================================================== All values are design pixels inside the 1172 x 657 canvas. Reproduce every one. If your layout does not match this table, the layout is wrong. ELEMENT POSITION SIZE RADIUS .nav left 247, top 3 678 x 64 32 .mark left 21, top 19 (in nav) 24 x 24 — .wm left 50, top 0 (in nav) auto — .wm .kick left 3, top 20 auto — .wm .name left 0, top 26 auto — .links left 156, top 0 (in nav) auto x 62 — .nav .btn left 530.7,top 10.5 125.5 x 39.5 14 .badge left 462, top 95 250 x 39 12 .badge i left 4, top 4 (in badge) 29 x 29 8 .badge b left 45, top 0 (in badge) auto x 39 — .h1 (both lines) left 586, translateX(-50%) nowrap — #h1a first baseline y 204.5 ink width 563.5 cap height 37.2 #h1b first baseline y 258.5 ink width 197.5 cap height 37.2 .sub (both lines) left 586, translateX(-50%) nowrap — #sub1 first baseline y 300.5 ink width 389 cap height 8.4 #sub2 first baseline y 316.5 ink width 311 cap height 8.4 .cta2 left 526, top 349 121 x 54.5 13 .showcase left 0, top 0 1172 x 0 — .ring left 0, top 0 1172 x 657 — .card left 586, top 616 130 x 300 12 margin:-150px 0 0 -65px (so the card centres on that point) .browser left 165, top 558 842 x calc(99px + var(--fill,0px)) radius 28 28 0 0 .page left 7, right 6, top 42, bottom 0 10 10 0 0 .wa right 16, bottom 24 (in .stage, OUTSIDE .canvas) 56 x 56 50% Z-INDEX ORDER (front to back): .nav 400 · .stack / .h1 / .sub / .cta2 / .badge / .wa 300 · .browser 100 · .ring 5 · .bg 0. The browser mock MUST paint in FRONT of the carousel ring, overlapping its lower third. That overlap is the whole point of the composition. Remaining ink targets for the type fitter (§11): #wmName ink 51 cap 11.4 first baseline y 38.5 #badgeTxt ink 184 cap 9.4 transform pre 'translate(2px,-1px)' #ctaLabel ink 87 cap 8.9 then optically centred in its button #vpLabel ink 76 cap 9.5 then optically centred in its button .links a cap 7.9 (one shared size), then the whole row squeezed to width 317 ===================================================================== 2. PIXEL CONTRACT A — THE BADGE ===================================================================== The badge is a FIXED-SIZE absolutely-positioned box with an icon tile pinned to its left edge and a left-aligned label beside it. It is NOT a centred pill and NOT a flex row. .badge{left:462px;top:95px;width:250px;height:39px;border-radius:12px;z-index:300; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.115); /* faint bank of light along the foot, sampled off the prototype */ background:linear-gradient(to top, rgba(190,225,255,.175) 0px, rgba(190,225,255,.128) 2px, rgba(190,225,255,.075) 4px, rgba(190,225,255,.026) 6px, rgba(255,255,255,.012) 9px, rgba(255,255,255,.012) 100%); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);backdrop-filter:blur(12px); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.035)} .badge i{position:absolute;left:4px;top:4px;width:29px;height:29px;border-radius:8px; display:grid;place-items:center; background:linear-gradient(to top, #46afc8 0px, #35abc7 2px, #0b859d 4px, #026c84 6px, #004e66 8px, #053f58 10px, #012c3d 12px, #031a2a 14px, #061125 16px, #090f25 19px, #090c1c 23px, #060d16 29px); box-shadow:inset 1px 0 0 rgba(150,220,250,.40), inset -1px 0 0 rgba(150,220,250,.52), 0 0 6px rgba(60,190,230,.20), 0 3px 8px -5px rgba(90,220,255,.6)} .badge i svg{width:14px;height:16px;position:relative;top:-1px;left:0px} .badge b{position:absolute;left:45px;transform-origin:0 50%;top:0;height:39px; display:flex;align-items:center; font-size:13px;font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,.94);white-space:nowrap; padding-top:1.5px} Markup:
…bolt svg…Professionals at store startup
Bolt SVG: viewBox "5 1 14 22", preserveAspectRatio="none", fill rgba(16,112,152,.72), stroke rgba(190,236,255,.6), stroke-width 1.6, stroke-linejoin round, single path: "M13.9 1.6 5.5 13.6a.7.7 0 0 0 .6 1.1h4.2l-1 7.7a.7.7 0 0 0 1.25.55l8.3-12.1a.7.7 0 0 0-.6-1.1h-4.2l1-7.7a.7.7 0 0 0-1.25-.55Z" How it must LOOK: a dark, almost transparent 250x39 rounded rectangle with a 1px hairline border. At its far left, inset 4px, a small bright cyan-to-navy rounded square holding a white-stroked lightning bolt. The label begins 45px from the badge's left edge — a clear 12px gap after the tile — reads left-to-right, and is vertically centred in the 39px height. Tile and text NEVER overlap. DO NOT: - do not centre the label in the badge, and do not use justify-content:center, text-align:center, or margin:auto on .badge b - do not make .badge display:flex with a gap and let the icon and text flow - do not let the badge width grow to fit the text (it is exactly 250px; the text is scaled to a 184px ink width by the fitter) - do not put the icon on top of, or behind, the text - do not add an outer glow, drop-shadow, or coloured ring to .badge itself - do not increase the border-radius into a full pill (it is 12px, not 20px) ===================================================================== 3. PIXEL CONTRACT B — THE GLOW BUTTON (.btn), USED TWICE ===================================================================== The signature element: a near-black button with a bank of cyan light pooled at its FOOT. sections.content:
Build a single, self-contained, production-ready `index.html` — one file, no build step, no frameworks, no local assets. It renders a full-viewport dark hero section for a fictional e-commerce SaaS called "Vertex Shops". Every image loads from the absolute CloudFront URLs in §8. There is NO video anywhere in this page. Two components below are marked PIXEL CONTRACT. Those are the most commonly botched parts of this design. Implement them exactly as written, including the DO-NOT lists. Do not "improve" them, do not substitute a more conventional button/pill pattern, do not add glows or centring that is not specified. ===================================================================== 0. GLOBAL SHELL ===================================================================== , . Vision — Streamline the shop virtual FONTS — exactly these three tags in , in this order: Reset: *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box} html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#020204} /* page never scrolls */ body{font-family:Poppins,Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#fff;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased} a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit} /* REQUIRED - button labels must never underline */ ===================================================================== 1. CORE ARCHITECTURE — A FIXED DESIGN CANVAS THAT IS SCALED ===================================================================== The single most important idea: the desktop composition is authored at a fixed 1172 x 657 px design canvas. EVERY element is absolutely positioned in raw design pixels — there is no flow layout, no flexbox column, no auto-centring on desktop. The whole canvas is then scaled by ONE transform to fit the viewport. The optical centre of every centred element is x=586. .stage{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:#020204} .canvas{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:1172px;height:657px; transform:translateX(-50%) scale(var(--k,1));transform-origin:50% 0} .canvas>*{position:absolute} .stack{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:300} /* layout shell, no box of its own */ .stack>*{position:absolute} .navmenu{display:contents} /* shell, invisible on desktop */ .burger{display:none} /* desktop */ Scale law, computed in JS on every resize: k = min(vw / W, vh / 560) Using 560 (not 657) as the height divisor is deliberate: it fills the width and lets the browser mock bleed off the bottom edge rather than letterboxing. W = 1172 on desktop; see §10 for the tablet ramp. Background (never animates — it is the stage): .bg{position:absolute;inset:0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(25,127,255,0) 38%, rgba(25,127,255,.042) 54%, rgba(25,127,255,.052) 68%, rgba(25,127,255,.030) 100%), #020204} STARFIELD — two 1x1px divs whose entire star field is one giant box-shadow list, generated in JS. .stars{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1px;height:1px; border-radius:50%;background:#fff} Layer A (#stA): 150 stars, blur 0px, alpha random .05–.30 Layer B (#stB): 18 stars, blur 1.2px, alpha random .35–.70 Each entry: "vw vh px 0 rgba(255,255,255,)", joined with commas, assigned to el.style.boxShadow. ===================================================================== 1.5 EXACT COORDINATE TABLE — NON-NEGOTIABLE ===================================================================== All values are design pixels inside the 1172 x 657 canvas. Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Orla Fashion"** in the **Fashion** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `orla-fashion`
- **Category:** Fashion (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/cooraldfashionArea.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20260914_051133_318774e7-6f37-421b-8425-9c9150ea61e8.png&w=1920&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#F8F7F4`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#EFECE6`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#141413`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(20,20,19,0.10)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"Orla Fashion"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/cooraldfashionArea.mp4) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"Orla Fashion"** (Fashion) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.

items.prompt_text:
Build a single, self-contained index.html file (all HTML, CSS and JS inline — no external files except Google Fonts and the video URL below) for a full-viewport website FOOTER section called "meridian". Reproduce every detail below exactly. ═══════════════════════════════════════ 1. OVERALL CONCEPT ═══════════════════════════════════════ A calm, vintage, engraved-illustration footer. The page contains ONLY the footer (no other sections, no demo spacer). The footer is exactly one viewport tall, with NO vertical or horizontal scroll at any screen size. The text block (compass logo, wordmark, tagline, nav, copyright) is centred at the top. A background video fills the footer: a pen-and-ink engraving of a long stone arched viaduct bridge in dark green ink; after about a second a stagecoach pulled by three trotting horses enters from the left, crosses the whole bridge, and exits right, trailing dust. The camera is static. Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Jelly Garden"** in the **3D** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `jelly-garden`
- **Category:** 3D (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/jelly-garden-webgl.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261004_105655_51bde6d4-0e83-4484-9fd7-ffe9c55166a6.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"Jelly Garden"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/jelly-garden-webgl.mp4) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"Jelly Garden"** (3D) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.
3. **Interactive Bento / Feature Architecture:**
   - 3-to-4 interactive cards or live calculator/filter controls depending on the archetype of **"Jelly Garden"**.
   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).

Responsive
Break on composition, not a generic device width.

When max-aspect-ratio is 114/100 (portrait-leaning tablets and phones):
- --small-min 12px
- --m clamp(16px, 3.2vw, 32px)
- --bar-top calc(var(--m) * .64)
- logo, tagline, contact, and actions use that top; logo left and actions right use --m
- photo width becomes var(--vh) * 138.6, top var(--vh) * 15, and the mask switches to a top fade: transparent 0, black at 11%
- services top is var(--vh) * 44; first label left --m, second left 50%, third right --m
- rule top is var(--vh) * 44 + 2.1em, font-size var(--small)
- headline font-size is (100vw - 2 * var(--m)) / 6.3063, bottom max(0.49140em, 18px + safe-area-inset-bottom)

When that aspect also has max-width 679px, move to two rows:
- --small-min 11.5px
- --bar-top includes safe-area-inset-top
- logo width 104px
- actions gap 14px
- tagline left --m, top 70px plus safe-area top, spans stay block
- contact right --m, same top, text-align right

When that aspect also has max-width 309px:
- contact drops to 70px + 3em + 12px plus safe-area top
- service labels may wrap, width min-content; center is centered, right is right-aligned
- photo top --ptop is the max of 15vh and the min of (150px + safe-area top) and (71vh minus the headline bottom offset minus 2.30em of headline size minus 56px), using --F = (100vw - 2 * --m) / 6.3063
- services top is --ptop + 29vh
- rule top is --ptop + 29vh + 3.1em

Landscape phones, max-height 479px and min-aspect-ratio 1141/1000, keep the desktop composition:
- --small-min 11.5px
- --mL max(16px, safe-area left), --mR max(16px, safe-area right)
- --bar-top 16px * .64
- logo left --mL
- tagline left is --mL + 96px + 2em
- contact is right-anchored at --mR + 8.83em + 2em
- actions right --mR
- services use the safe-area margins, with the center label centered in the remaining width
- headline is centered in that same safe width, bottom max(0.49140em, 8px + safe-area bottom)

If that landscape case is also under 560px wide, contact moves under the controls: right --mR, top --bar-top + 2.6em, text-align right.

On coarse pointers, enlarge hit areas without changing the drawn shapes. .lang, .menu, .logo, and the contact link get a centered ::after at least 44px tall. Lang extends 12px left and half the action gap right. Menu extends half the gap left and 10px right. Logo extends 10px each side. The mail link extends 6px each side, height max(100%, 32px).

Entrance, once on load
Before first paint, if motion is allowed, add class is-entering to the html element and set a 4500ms failsafe that removes is-entering and is-playing. If prefers-reduced-motion is reduce, skip the class. If JS never runs, the page is simply static.

The video and grid never animate. Only the foreground does, and only while html.is-entering is present. Animations start paused via --au-state:paused, then run when is-playing is added.
Easings:
- --e-expo: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)
- --e-quint: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)
- --e-sweep: cubic-bezier(.76, 0, .24, 1)

Keyframes:
- au-rise: translate from 0 var(--rise) to 0 0
- au-soft: that same rise plus opacity 0 to 1
- au-draw: scaleX 0 to 1
- au-wipe: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0 0 0 0)
- au-on: opacity 0 to 1

Timing:
- rule draws from the left, origin 0 50%, au-draw .85s --e-sweep, delay .24s
- each headline track rises 1em, au-rise 1.05s --e-expo; delays .10s, .18s, .26s. Clip is inset(-.8em -3.6em -.05em -3.6em)
- service labels rise by calc(100% + .6em), au-rise .8s --e-quint; delays .56s, .62s, .68s. Each li is clipped with inset(-.25em -.4em -.35em -.4em), and .rv is inline-block
- logo squares switch on in .14s ease-out. Delays by square order: 0.700s, 0.735s, 0.840s, 0.910s, 0.805s, 0.945s, 0.700s
- tagline lines, contact lines, and EN rise .55em with opacity, au-soft .75s --e-quint. Tagline delays .78s, .83s, .88s. Contact delays .88s, .93s. EN duration .6s, delay .98s
- Menu wipes open last, au-wipe .6s cubic-bezier(.25, 1, .5, 1), delay 1.02s
- will-change translate, transform on the headline tracks, rule, and service labels
- when motion is allowed, Menu background-color transitions in .15s

Playback script
After fonts are ready, or after 1200ms if they are not, add is-playing on the next frame. Wait for every animation whose name starts with "au-" to finish, and also set a 2200ms timeout. Then remove is-entering and is-playing and clear the failsafe so nothing keeps running. If reduced motion is set, remove autoplay from the hero video and pause it.

Do not add a menu panel, language menu, loader, footer, or extra copy. Menu and EN are visual controls only.

Responsive
Break on composition, not a generic device width.

When max-aspect-ratio is 114/100 (portrait-leaning tablets and phones):
- --small-min 12px
- --m clamp(16px, 3.2vw, 32px)
- --bar-top calc(var(--m) * .64)
- logo, tagline, contact, and actions use that top; logo left and actions right use --m
- photo width becomes var(--vh) * 138.6, top var(--vh) * 15, and the mask switches to a top fade: transparent 0, black at 11%
- services top is var(--vh) * 44; first label left --m, second left 50%, third right --m
- rule top is var(--vh) * 44 + 2.1em, font-size var(--small)
- headline font-size is (100vw - 2 * var(--m)) / 6.3063, bottom max(0.49140em, 18px + safe-area-inset-bottom)

When that aspect also has max-width 679px, move to two rows:
- --small-min 11.5px
- --bar-top includes safe-area-inset-top
- logo width 104px
- actions gap 14px
- tagline left --m, top 70px plus safe-area top, spans stay block
- contact right --m, same top, text-align right

When that aspect also has max-width 309px:
- contact drops to 70px + 3em + 12px plus safe-area top
- service labels may wrap, width min-content; center is centered, right is right-aligned
- photo top --ptop is the max of 15vh and the min of (150px + safe-area top) and (71vh minus the headline bottom offset minus 2.30em of headline size minus 56px), using --F = (100vw - 2 * --m) / 6.3063
- services top is --ptop + 29vh
- rule top is --ptop + 29vh + 3.1em

Landscape phones, max-height 479px and min-aspect-ratio 1141/1000, keep the desktop composition:
- --small-min 11.5px
- --mL max(16px, safe-area left), --mR max(16px, safe-area right)
- --bar-top 16px * .64
- logo left --mL
- tagline left is --mL + 96px + 2em
- contact is right-anchored at --mR + 8.83em + 2em
- actions right --mR
- services use the safe-area margins, with the center label centered in the remaining width
- headline is centered in that same safe width, bottom max(0.49140em, 8px + safe-area bottom)

If that landscape case is also under 560px wide, contact moves under the controls: right --mR, top --bar-top + 2.6em, text-align right.

On coarse pointers, enlarge hit areas without changing the drawn shapes. .lang, .menu, .logo, and the contact link get a centered ::after at least 44px tall. Lang extends 12px left and half the action gap right. Menu extends half the gap left and 10px right. Logo extends 10px each side. The mail link extends 6px each side, height max(100%, 32px).

Entrance, once on load
Before first paint, if motion is allowed, add class is-entering to the html element and set a 4500ms failsafe that removes is-entering and is-playing. If prefers-reduced-motion is reduce, skip the class. If JS never runs, the page is simply static.

The video and grid never animate. Only the foreground does, and only while html.is-entering is present. Animations start paused via --au-state:paused, then run when is-playing is added.
Easings:
- --e-expo: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)
- --e-quint: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1)
- --e-sweep: cubic-bezier(.76, 0, .24, 1)

- au-soft: that same rise plus opacity 0 to 1
- au-draw: scaleX 0 to 1
- au-wipe: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0 0 0 0)
- au-on: opacity 0 to 1

Timing:
- rule draws from the left, origin 0 50%, au-draw .85s --e-sweep, delay .24s
- each headline track rises 1em, au-rise 1.05s --e-expo; delays .10s, .18s, .26s. Clip is inset(-.8em -3.6em -.05em -3.6em)
- service labels rise by calc(100% + .6em), au-rise .8s --e-quint; delays .56s, .62s, .68s. Each li is clipped with inset(-.25em -.4em -.35em -.4em), and .rv is inline-block
- logo squares switch on in .14s ease-out. Delays by square order: 0.700s, 0.735s, 0.840s, 0.910s, 0.805s, 0.945s, 0.700s
- tagline lines, contact lines, and EN rise .55em with opacity, au-soft .75s --e-quint. Tagline delays .78s, .83s, .88s. Contact delays .88s, .93s. EN duration .6s, delay .98s
- Menu wipes open last, au-wipe .6s cubic-bezier(.25, 1, .5, 1), delay 1.02s
- will-change translate, transform on the headline tracks, rule, and service labels
- when motion is allowed, Menu background-color transitions in .15s

Playback script
After fonts are ready, or after 1200ms if they are not, add is-playing on the next frame. Wait for every animation whose name starts with "au-" to finish, and also set a 2200ms timeout. Then remove is-entering and is-playing and clear the failsafe so nothing keeps running. If reduced motion is set, remove autoplay from the hero video and pause it.

Do not add a menu panel, language menu, loader, footer, or extra copy. Menu and EN are visual controls only.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `fin-coin`
- **Category:** 3D (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/fin-coin-landing.mp4

- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`

- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

items.title: Atrium MTL
items.prompt_text:
Build ONE self-contained file: index.html — no build step, no npm, no React/Vue, no external CSS/JS libraries. Everything in a single document: inline <style>, inline SVG icons, vanilla JavaScript only. Page title: "ATRIUM MTL — An archive of light cast in stone". Viewport meta: width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover.

IMPORTANT — MEDIA: There is NO <video> element and NO CloudFront video URL on this page. The right-hand mosaic uses four CloudFront WEBP photos + one CloudFront SVG grain texture (listed below). Continuous motion is pure CSS @keyframes on columns (14.6s loop), timed to match a reference recording (0.342 card-heights per second). Do not embed or link any video file.

Use these EXACT remote asset URLs in :root (do not substitute local paths for images/grain):

--img-sculpt: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/fc524fc3-03c3-40a1-9954-22eab1322592.webp)
--img-man: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/1d56967e-0ed5-40f8-812d-9360e5ec1780.webp)
--img-visit: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/5f3f6135-26b9-4c48-92ad-105161327cbc.webp)
--img-sil: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e7b68ae9-9240-4f52-a0a2-89082df4b8d0.webp)
--grain: url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/40b7fef3-410d-4ef3-bd67-0a2fc7ee5a1d.svg)

FONTS — self-hosted @font-face (required for pixel match):
@font-face Archivo: weight 100–900, font-stretch 62%–125%, woff2 at assets/fonts/archivo.woff2
@font-face Inter: weight 100–900, woff2 at assets/fonts/inter.woff2
--display: "Archivo","Arial Black",Impact,system-ui,sans-serif
--sans: "Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif
font-display: block on both. Body uses --sans with antialiased/geometricPrecision.

DESIGN TOKENS (:root):
--paper #f5f4ef (page bg)
--ink #0f0f0e
--card-dark #151515, --card-cream #f9f6f1
--red #ef5d44, --yellow #fcdd71, --blue #9fd5f7
White header theme: --nav-bg/#ffffff, --nav-bar/#ffffff, --nav-fg/--ink, --nav-muted #62615d, --nav-line rgba(15,15,14,.08), --nav-rule rgba(15,15,14,.16), --nav-search #e8e7e2, --nav-cta var(--ink), --nav-cta-fg #fff
Grid desktop tokens: --col 205.33px, --gap 13px, --pitch 282.5px, --r 22px

OVERALL LAYOUT (editorial museum / brutalist archive):
Warm off-white full viewport. Floating white header card (rounded bottom corners 22px, subtle border + shadow). Left: oversized uppercase headline + body + CTAs. Right: 3-column staggered mosaic of rounded tiles (photos + solid color blocks) scrolling vertically forever; grid sits under header z-index. No page scroll on desktop/tablet/mobile — viewport-locked compositions using 100svh and overflow:hidden where specified.

DOM STRUCTURE (inside .stage):
1) .grid[aria-hidden=true] — 6 columns (.col): optional wide-screen .x3,.x2,.x1 (hidden by default) + main .c1,.c2,.c3. Each column has exactly 5 .cell children in this order:

x3: i-man, blue, dark, i-sculpt, yellow
x2: yellow, i-sil, cream, red, i-visit
x1: blue, i-man, red, i-sculpt, cream
c1: red, i-sculpt f-sculpt, i-man f-man, blue, i-visit
c2: yellow, i-visit f-visit visit, dark, i-sil, red
c3: blue, cream, i-sil f-sil, yellow, i-sculpt

Photo cells: .ph + .i-sculpt|.i-man|.i-visit|.i-sil — image via ::before { background: var(--pic) } where --pic maps to --img-* custom properties.
Solid cells: .red, .yellow, .blue, .cream (inset 1px #e9e6df), .dark (inset 1px rgba(255,255,255,.14)).
Grain overlay on solid tiles: ::after with background-image var(--grain), opacity .13 multiply; .dark ::after screen .035.

NUMERIC PHOTO CROPS (desktop hero tiles — ::before on .f-*):
.f-sculpt: width 124.19%, height 112.57%, left -16.07%, top -8.5%, background-size 100% 100%
.f-man: 113.48%, 103.36%, -5.36%, -3.54%
.f-visit: 110.07%, 100%, -3.9%, 8.5%; tile bg linear-gradient(90deg,#c6c5c3,#9b9a98 55%,#7a7977); ::after top fade rgba(0,0,0,.26)→0 at 13%
.f-sil: 139.29%, 126.37%, -8.77%, -56.64%
Mobile: .f-visit and .f-sil fall back to cover; .f-visit ::after hidden on mob.

COLUMN MARQUEE (CSS):
@keyframes colDown: translate3d 0→-50%; colUp: -50%→0
Default .col: colDown 14.6s linear infinite
.c2, .x1, .x3: colUp
.c1 left 0 top 86px; .c2 left calc(col+gap) top -11.5px; .c3 left calc(2*(col+gap)) top 86.5px
Extra cols: x1/x2/x3 at negative left offsets; display:none until html.desk.ex1|ex2|ex3
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .col animation none }

JS clones each column’s 5 cells once (duplicate appendChild) so 50% translate loops seamlessly.

DESKTOP MODE (html.desk):
Reference canvas 1280×800. .stage fixed, transform scale(--s) from origin 0 0, width calc(var(--W)*1px), height calc(var(--H)*1px).
--s = cover viewport: if vw/vh > 1280/800 then vh/800 else vw/1280 (no letterboxing).
--W = vw/s, --H = vh/s. class .tall if vh/s > 845.
Extra columns: extra = clamp(0..3, floor((vw/s - 1294)/218.33)); add ex1/ex2/ex3.
.grid: absolute right 62px top 0 bottom 0 width calc(3*col + 2*gap).

HEADER (desktop absolute positions — white theme):
.hdr: left/right 40px, height 142px, z-index 5, radius 0 0 22px 22px, shadow 0 0 0 1px nav-line, 0 16px 36px -24px rgba(15,15,14,.30)
Utility strip .util height 40px, border-bottom nav-line:
  Phone p1 tel:+14188386000 — "House of Brutalism : 418" line break "838-6000" (16px phone SVG)
  Vertical rule at 313px
  Phone p2 tel:+14188386001 — "Studio Exhibitions : 418" / "838-6001"
  .unav links (14px, weight 500): Programmes, Events, Photo-prints (two-line), Visits, Help preserve (two-line); search button 39×39 #e8e7e2, radius 5px 0 0 5px, magnifier SVG 13×13
Main row:
  Logo: ATRIUM MTL (Archivo 900, 31px, stretch 85%, stroke .35px) + small "AN ARCHIVE OF LIGHT CAST IN STONE" (8.6px, muted)
  Nav: Installations + 24px black circle arrow; separator; Interviews; Photographs; Menu burger + label
  CTA: black pill "Tickets" 116×63 radius 22px + 64×64 circle ticket SVG (rotated -45°)

HERO (desktop):
left 86px, top calc(200px + (var(--H,800)-800)*0.5px), width 480px
h1 four lines (each .ln inside span): "An archive" / "of light" / "cast in" / "stone"
Typography: Archivo 900, 80px, line-height 75.3px, letter-spacing -.06em, uppercase, stroke 1.1px; spans .95em, letter-spacing -.05em
p at top 344px, 460px wide, 18px/26.6px: "ATRIUM MTL archives old structures as raw photographs from across Montreal, a collection at an **Annual Photography Retrospective**, autumn 2026."
.acts at top 460px: Tickets pill + ticket circle + "Installations" bold link with 32px arrow circle (same ticket SVG style)

RESPONSIVE MODES — CSS-only --mode on :root, JS mirrors class on <html>:
Default --mode:mob
mob-l: min-width 560px AND aspect-ratio ≥ 1/1
tab-p: min-width 600px, min-height 820px, max-aspect-ratio 21/20
tab-l: min-width 900px, min-height 540px, min-aspect-ratio 21/20
desk: min-width 1097px AND min-aspect-ratio 27/25

JS: MODES array desk,mob,mob-l,tab,tab-l,tab-p; readMode from computed --mode; add matching class; tab* → also class tab, mob* → class mob; on resize/orientationchange run fit().

MOBILE (html.mob + html.mob body overflow hidden):
.stage flex column 100svh. Header grid: Logo | Menu only; all other header links in expandable panel (header[data-open]). Safe area insets. Tokens --tm, --hp, --row, --hh, --h1, --fp, --btn, menu rhythm --m-ph/u/p/fu/fp. Hero order 1, grid order 2 flex 1 min-height 0. Grid --gw calc(100vw - 2*tm), responsive --col/--pitch/--r. Stagger tops for c1/c2/c3 negative pitch fractions. Menu navIn animation stagger on open. Landscape phone html.mob-l: CSS grid stage — hero left, grid right (--lgw), column tops aligned to header height.

TABLET (html.tab):
--tm clamp 20–40px, --hh 142px, --h1 clamp up to 80px. Header: utility strip visible; logo + Menu + Tickets visible; main nav links in menu panel. tab-l: side-by-side hero + right grid like desktop native px. tab-p: stage grid rows header / hero block / grid band.

MENU BEHAVIOR (mob + tab only):
.menu-btn toggles header[data-open], aria-expanded. Escape closes. Click outside closes. Click nav link closes. Keyboard open focuses first item.

LOAD ENTRANCE (once, skip if prefers-reduced-motion):
Before main script: if not reduced-motion, add class intro to html; safety remove intro after 4s.
intro CSS: header translated up off-screen; many elements opacity 0; h1 lines translateY(110%). h1.masking uses clip-path inset per line.

WAAPI timeline (easing EXPO 0.16,1,0.3,1 | QUART 0.25,1,0.5,1 | QUINT 0.22,1,0.36,1):
- Header slide down 0.95s from translateY(calc(-100% - 48px))
- Utility fade stagger from 0.32s
- Logo drop 10px, nav items drop 8px stagger, CTA drop
- Each h1 .ln rise from 110% over 1s, stagger 0.085s from 0.30s
- Visible grid columns: custom translateY entrance ending at HANDOFF=2.10s with CRUISE=3.42 %/s and EXTRA=8% quint-out drift; opacity fade; then pause CSS marquee animations until T0+2100ms so handoff is seamless
- Hero p rise 14px; .acts children rise 12px stagger
On complete: remove masking, set data-entrance=done

ACCESSIBILITY:
Focus visible outline #3b82f6 offset 3px. aria-labels on logo, search, menu, ticket links. nav aria-labels "Useful links" / "Main navigation". Grid decorative aria-hidden.

COPY EXACTLY (English):
All strings as in DOM above — brand ATRIUM MTL, tagline AN ARCHIVE OF LIGHT CAST IN STONE, phones, nav labels, hero headline lines, body paragraph with bold "Annual Photography Retrospective", autumn 2026, Tickets, Installations, Menu.

QUALITY BAR:
Match spacing, typography weights, letter-spacing, pill radii, tile corner radius, header overlap with grid, infinite scroll speed (14.6s = 5 tiles × 2.92s), alternating column directions, wide-screen extra columns, and all five responsive architectures. Output must render identically at 1280×800 desktop and scale cleanly on mobile portrait/landscape and tablet without document scroll where specified.

x2: yellow, i-sil, cream, red, i-visit
x1: blue, i-man, red, i-sculpt, cream
c1: red, i-sculpt f-sculpt, i-man f-man, blue, i-visit
c2: yellow, i-visit f-visit visit, dark, i-sil, red
c3: blue, cream, i-sil f-sil, yellow, i-sculpt

Photo cells: .ph + .i-sculpt|.i-man|.i-visit|.i-sil — image via ::before { background: var(--pic) } where --pic maps to --img-* custom properties.
Solid cells: .red, .yellow, .blue, .cream (inset 1px #e9e6df), .dark (inset 1px rgba(255,255,255,.14)).
Grain overlay on solid tiles: ::after with background-image var(--grain), opacity .13 multiply; .dark ::after screen .035.

NUMERIC PHOTO CROPS (desktop hero tiles — ::before on .f-*):
.f-sculpt: width 124.19%, height 112.57%, left -16.07%, top -8.5%, background-size 100% 100%
.f-man: 113.48%, 103.36%, -5.36%, -3.54%
.f-visit: 110.07%, 100%, -3.9%, 8.5%; tile bg linear-gradient(90deg,#c6c5c3,#9b9a98 55%,#7a7977); ::after top fade rgba(0,0,0,.26)→0 at 13%
.f-sil: 139.29%, 126.37%, -8.77%, -56.64%
Mobile: .f-visit and .f-sil fall back to cover; .f-visit ::after hidden on mob.

COLUMN MARQUEE (CSS):
@keyframes colDown: translate3d 0→-50%; colUp: -50%→0
Default .col: colDown 14.6s linear infinite
.c2, .x1, .x3: colUp
.c1 left 0 top 86px; .c2 left calc(col+gap) top -11.5px; .c3 left calc(2*(col+gap)) top 86.5px
Extra cols: x1/x2/x3 at negative left offsets; display:none until html.desk.ex1|ex2|ex3

JS clones each column’s 5 cells once (duplicate appendChild) so 50% translate loops seamlessly.

DESKTOP MODE (html.desk):
Reference canvas 1280×800. .stage fixed, transform scale(--s) from origin 0 0, width calc(var(--W)*1px), height calc(var(--H)*1px).
--s = cover viewport: if vw/vh > 1280/800 then vh/800 else vw/1280 (no letterboxing).
--W = vw/s, --H = vh/s. class .tall if vh/s > 845.
Extra columns: extra = clamp(0..3, floor((vw/s - 1294)/218.33)); add ex1/ex2/ex3.
.grid: absolute right 62px top 0 bottom 0 width calc(3*col + 2*gap).

HEADER (desktop absolute positions — white theme):
.hdr: left/right 40px, height 142px, z-index 5, radius 0 0 22px 22px, shadow 0 0 0 1px nav-line, 0 16px 36px -24px rgba(15,15,14,.30)
Utility strip .util height 40px, border-bottom nav-line:
  Phone p1 tel:+14188386000 — "House of Brutalism : 418" line break "838-6000" (16px phone SVG)
  Vertical rule at 313px
  Phone p2 tel:+14188386001 — "Studio Exhibitions : 418" / "838-6001"
  .unav links (14px, weight 500): Programmes, Events, Photo-prints (two-line), Visits, Help preserve (two-line); search button 39×39 #e8e7e2, radius 5px 0 0 5px, magnifier SVG 13×13
Main row:
  Logo: ATRIUM MTL (Archivo 900, 31px, stretch 85%, stroke .35px) + small "AN ARCHIVE OF LIGHT CAST IN STONE" (8.6px, muted)
  Nav: Installations + 24px black circle arrow; separator; Interviews; Photographs; Menu burger + label
  CTA: black pill "Tickets" 116×63 radius 22px + 64×64 circle ticket SVG (rotated -45°)

HERO (desktop):
left 86px, top calc(200px + (var(--H,800)-800)*0.5px), width 480px
h1 four lines (each .ln inside span): "An archive" / "of light" / "cast in" / "stone"
Typography: Archivo 900, 80px, line-height 75.3px, letter-spacing -.06em, uppercase, stroke 1.1px; spans .95em, letter-spacing -.05em

mob-l: min-width 560px AND aspect-ratio ≥ 1/1
tab-p: min-width 600px, min-height 820px, max-aspect-ratio 21/20
tab-l: min-width 900px, min-height 540px, min-aspect-ratio 21/20
desk: min-width 1097px AND min-aspect-ratio 27/25

Stagger tops for c1/c2/c3 negative pitch fractions. Menu navIn animation stagger on open. Landscape phone html.mob-l: CSS grid stage — hero left, grid right (--lgw), column tops aligned to header height.

--tm clamp 20–40px, --hh 142px, --h1 clamp up to 80px. Header: utility strip visible; logo + Menu + Tickets visible; main nav links in menu panel. tab-l: side-by-side hero + right grid like desktop native px. tab-p: stage grid rows header / hero block / grid band.

On complete: remove masking, set data-entrance=done

ACCESSIBILITY:
Focus visible outline #3b82f6 offset 3px. aria-labels on logo, search, menu, ticket links. nav aria-labels "Useful links" / "Main navigation". Grid decorative aria-hidden.

COPY EXACTLY (English):
All strings as in DOM above — brand ATRIUM MTL, tagline AN ARCHIVE OF LIGHT CAST IN STONE, phones, nav labels, hero headline lines, body paragraph with bold "Annual Photography Retrospective", autumn 2026, Tickets, Installations, Menu.

QUALITY BAR:
Match spacing, typography weights, letter-spacing, pill radii, tile corner radius, header overlap with grid, infinite scroll speed (14.6s = 5 tiles × 2.92s), alternating column directions, wide-screen extra columns, and all five responsive architectures. items.prompt_text:
Build one standalone HTML file, index.html, that is a full-viewport hero section and nothing else. Output the file exactly as specified below. Do not redesign, rename, restyle, or omit any element, rule, or script. One page, no framework, no external CSS or JS. The background must be this remote video URL only — do not download it and do not use a local image or video:

https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261005_182346_a590ff3b-72e5-41ce-8f69-a8c823eaecaa.mp4

<video autoplay muted loop playsinline>, object-fit cover, pointer-events none. Three shade overlays sit on top of the video. The page background is #03080B. The stage is exactly 100dvh, overflow hidden, no letterboxing.

Fonts, declared with @font-face and these exact stacks:
- "RV Display" weight 300 from assets/fonts/rv-display.woff2, fallback "Poppins", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif. Used for the headline.
- "RV Brand" weight 600 from assets/fonts/rv-brand.woff2, fallback "Urbanist", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif. Used for "riverine.ai".
- "RV Text" weight 400 from assets/fonts/rv-text.woff2, fallback "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif. Used for nav, lede, buttons, and the scroll cue.
font-display: block. If the woff2 files are not available, keep the @font-face rules and the fallback stacks exactly; do not substitute other typefaces.

All layout is measured from a 1280×960 reference through one unit:
--u: max(0.62px, min(100vw/1280, 100dvh/960)).
Colors: shade 3,8,11; ink #F5FAF6; ink-2 #ECF1EF; teal #88DECC; icon teal #7EC4B5; chevron #7CCBBA; moth #315352; cream pills #EEF1EA; pine discs #122B2A; logo disc #030909.

Desktop composition, positions in --u:
- Top left: a 104×46 glass pill (rgba(150,220,130,.035), blur 12). Inside it, a 46px disc containing a teal delta-tree drawn as seven strokes, and to its right a mirrored moth in #315352.
- Top right of center: a black 442×47 pill. Links, absolutely placed: Work, Regenerate (current, with a small chevron), Nature, Earth, News. Then a cream "Partner" pill with a dark disc and a white right chevron.
- Far top right: a 48px blurred dark circle, speaker icon, aria-label "Ambient river sound", aria-pressed true. Clicking toggles aria-pressed; when false the two sound waves drop to opacity .25. No audio file.
- Bottom left hero: "riverine.ai" in teal; headline on three lines, "Where" / "Regeneration Fuels" / "Future Thinking", light weight, nowrap, per-line letter-spacing; lede on two lines, "Living waterways reveal a hidden logic of renewal" and "Nature's patterns guide more caring AI".
- Actions: cream pill "Shape our Future" linking to #future, with a dark disc and white chevron; text link "Discover the Rivers" linking to #rivers.
- Bottom right: "Scroll for Details" linking to #details, with a teal chevron.
- Nav hrefs: #work, #regenerate, #nature, #earth, #news, #partner. Logo links to # and is labeled "riverine.ai home".
- Hover: text links and the cue turn #88DECC; the Partner and CTA discs turn #26504d.
- Focus-visible: 2px teal outline.

Shade layers, desktop:
- Horizontal gradient, left to right, shade alpha .683, .595, .458, .221, .039, .054 at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100%.
- Vertical gradient, top to bottom, shade alpha .060, .023, .152, .300, .394, .632 at those same stops.
- Bottom-left radial ellipse 93.8% by 41.3% at 0% 100%, shade from 1 to 0.
Video object-position 50% 40%. At min-aspect-ratio 16/9, object-position 50% 24%.

Responsive, components keep desktop proportions and only placement changes:
- At max-width 649.98px or max-height 500px: --u is clamp(0.94px, 100vw/390, 1.2px); gutter clamp(18px, 5.6vw, 32px). Video object-position 63% 50%. Softer left shade and a stronger bottom shade; the corner radial is removed. Headline tracking switches to em values. Actions wrap. Touch padding on the text link and cue.
- At max-width 649.98px only: hide the nav pill. Header is logo, then a 48px black menu button, then the sound button. The menu button is three bars that become an X when aria-expanded is true. The nav becomes a black rounded panel under the header, hidden until .is-open. Links stack at 48px tall, 17px type. Partner sits under the links. Hero is inset by the gutter and sits above the scroll cue, which stays bottom-right. Title size is min(clamp(32px, 10.4vw, 60px), (100vw - 2 gutters) / 8.7). Honor safe-area insets.
- Menu behavior: click toggles the panel; Escape closes it and returns focus to the button; a click outside closes it; choosing a link closes it; when opened, focus the first link.
- Short landscape phones, max-height 500px and min-aspect-ratio 1/1: --u is clamp(0.82px, 100dvh/415, 0.94px). Keep the desktop nav when the screen is at least 650px wide. Hero stays bottom-left, title clamp(28px, 10dvh, 44px), actions do not wrap. Video object-position 50% 30%. Below 650px wide in that short landscape, the open menu is a two-column grid.
- Tablets, 650–1100px wide and at least 501px tall, and portrait screens at least 650px wide with max-aspect-ratio 4/5 and min-height 501px: stop shrinking and pin --u to 0.94px so type and the nav stay touch-safe. On the portrait case, scale the hero and cue by 1.1 and set video object-position to 58% 50%.
- prefers-reduced-motion: no transitions or animations, and skip the entrance.

Entrance, one pass after fonts are ready and the video has loaded data. If reduced motion is set, show the finished page immediately. A 3.5s failsafe removes the hidden state. While waiting, logo, nav, sound, menu, brand, title, lede, actions, and cue are opacity 0.
Timeline, using the Web Animations API with fill backwards, then remove the classes so no inline style remains:
- 0ms, 500ms, quart: logo fades in. Tree strokes draw on with stroke-dashoffset, 80ms plus 45ms per path, 820ms, grow ease cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.2, 1). Moth fades and scales from 0.92 at 420ms for 650ms, expo cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
- 120ms, 700ms, expo: nav or menu lifts 8px. Links ripple from 260ms, 45ms apart, lifting 4px. Sound lifts 8px at 200ms.
- 300ms: "riverine.ai" lifts 10px, 650ms.
- 380ms, then +90ms per line, 1050ms: each headline line rises from translateY(115%) inside its own clip mask.
- 800ms and 860ms: the two lede lines lift 14px, 800ms.
- 1000ms: CTA lifts 12px, 800ms. 1100ms: text link lifts 8px, 600ms, quart cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1).
- 1250ms: scroll cue lifts from -6px, 700ms.
Travel distances scale with the CTA height over 46, and are 0.8× below 650px wide, rounded to whole pixels. When every animation finishes, force a one-frame redraw of the logo and the action row, then leave the page as the static design.

Use these exact SVG paths. Logo tree, viewBox 0 0 46 46, stroke #7CC6B5, width 1.6, round caps:

M14.8 23V13.2c0-1.4.8-2.6 2.4-3.4
M24 24.2c-1.8-1.8-3.2-3.8-3.7-6.4-.5-2.6-.6-5.2-.3-7.2
M24.3 23.2c1.5-3 3.5-6.4 4.3-10.2.4-2.6 1.2-4.1 2.8-4.3H35
M24.6 25.7c3-.7 5.8-2.1 7.4-4.5 1.2-1.8 1.4-3.8 2.8-5.2 1.4-1.4 3.2-2.1 5.2-2.4
Moth, viewBox 0 0 39 30, fill #315352, one wing and the same path mirrored with matrix(-1 0 0 1 39 0):
M19.5 12.4C17.5 9.5 14 5 10.8 3 9.6 2.4 8 2.2 6 2.3 4.2 2.4 3.1 3 3 4.8L3.1 9.8C3.2 12.4 5 15 8.3 17.3 6.6 19.5 5.6 21.8 5.4 24.2 5.2 26.2 5.8 27.6 7.3 28 8.8 28.3 10.2 27.3 11.4 25.8 14.2 22.6 17.2 19.8 19.5 17.1Z
Chevrons: M.7.7 5.5 5.3 10.3.7. Partner arrow: M.5.5 3.5 3.5.5 6.5. CTA arrow: M.6.6 4 4 .6 7.4. Speaker: body M14.6 19.6h3.6l5.9-4.9v18.6l-5.9-4.9h-3.6z; waves M27.6 19.6c1.9 2.8 1.9 6 0 8.8 and M31.2 16.2c3.4 4.9 3.4 10.7 0 15.6. Menu bars: M1 1h16, M1 6h16, M1 11h16.

items.title: Vexel
items.prompt_text:
Build one standalone HTML document that is the entire Vexel hero screen. Output only that file. Reproduce the markup, CSS, SVG paths, type, motion, and responsive rules exactly. Do not restyle, simplify, rename classes, or substitute a different background.

Page
- Language English. Title: Vexel — Your next customer starts with a hello.
- Viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover. Theme color #01061a.
- One screen, no page scroll. Column, centered. Background #01061a with a horizontal sky gradient: #00061a 0%, #01071b 22%, #01071a 45%, #010718 62%, #010614 80%, #020511 100%.

Type
- Font family "Google Sans", then "Product Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif.
- Embed Google Sans with font-display:block:
  weight 400 from assets/google-sans-400.woff2
  weight 500 from assets/google-sans-500.woff2
- Antialiased, geometricPrecision, normal kerning.

Scale
- Reference frame is 1280×800. Every layout number is multiplied by --u. At 1280×800, --u is 1px.
- Default: --u = min(100dvh/800, max(100vw/1280, min(100vw/640, .75px))). Fall back to vh where dvh is unsupported.
- Colors: ink #ffffff; nav rgba(238,242,255,.9); subhead rgba(226,233,255,.74); link rgba(212,236,255,.77); hairline rgba(255,255,255,.19); button #ffffff with ink #0a0a0a.

Masthead, centered
- Wordmark link, aria-label "Vexel home", href "#". White filled SVG, viewBox "588 40.5 103.5 23.5", height max(23.5u, 17px), shifted left by 0.5u. Paths, in order:
  M588.6 40.8H594.9L601.4 56.6L606.5 40.8H612.6L604.2 63.5H597.8Z
  M612.8 40.8H630.5V45.2H619.2V49.8H628.3V54.4H619.2V58.9H631.5V63.5H612.8Z
  M631.3 40.8H637.9L642.5 47.4L646.5 40.8H653.1L646.4 52L653.6 63.5H647.1L642.5 56.4L638.3 63.5H631.4L638.8 52Z
  M653.6 40.8H669.6V63.5H653.6V58.9H664.3V54.4H657V49.8H664.3V45.2H653.6Z
  M672.4 40.8H677.6V58.9H690.5V63.5H672.4Z
- Top padding: safe-area-inset-top plus 40.5u.
- Hairline under the logo: width max(284u, 252px), 1px, margin-top 24u.
- Nav width matches the hairline. Three links, space-between, margin-top 17.4u, side padding 8.9u: Platform #platform, Company #company, Contact #contact. Size max(15u, 13px), tracking -0.033em, color the nav token, hover #fff.

Copy, centered
- A flexible gap above the copy flexes at 82.98 and never shorter than 24u.
- Headline, weight 400, size max(68u, 34px), line-height 0.9559, tracking -0.0279em, nowrap. Two masked lines:
  line 1: Your next customer
  line 2: starts with a hello.
  Line 2 tracking -0.0294em and shifted right 2.6u. Each line is a span.l containing a span.li.
- Subhead: "Make the first move. We’ll help with what follows." Join the words inside each sentence with U+00A0 no-break spaces. The only normal space is the space after the period, so that is the only wrap point. Size max(21u, 15px), tracking -0.005em, margin-top 18.98u, color the subhead token, text-wrap balance.
- Button "Start a conversation" to #contact. Width max(216u, 196px), height max(46u, 44px), radius max(4.5u, 4px), weight 500, size max(17u, 15px), tracking -0.0265em, margin-top 25.64u. Hover fill #e8eef7 and a 4u ring of rgba(120,200,255,.12).
- Link "Discover the platform" to #platform, size max(14.8u, 13px), tracking -0.051em, margin-top 20.55u. Beside it, a 0.68em by 0.85em stroke arrow, viewBox "0 0 11 12.6", stroke 1.45, round caps: M5.5 .4V12M1 7.5L5.5 12L10 7.5. On hover the arrow moves down 0.12em.

Background video
- Use this URL and no other asset. Do not download it and do not replace it with a local file or poster image:
  https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261005_182549_18378239-da8f-48a7-9666-d6e0a6a88561.mp4
- Video element: autoplay, muted, loop, playsinline, no controls, decorative.
- The field fills the remaining height (flex 318.68, min-height 160u) and is a size container. The video is absolutely centered, width auto, pointer-events none. Its horizon, 50.463% down the frame, sits 36.4u above the bottom of the copy. Height is the larger of fitting the field width at the artwork ratio 1619:971 and reaching the bottom edge: max(100cqw * 971/1619, (100cqh + 36.4u) / 0.49537 + 1px). Without container units, fall back to max(60vw, 105vh). Fade the top 4% of the video to transparent with a mask.

Focus
- Remove the default outline. Visible focus on the wordmark, nav links, and discover link is a 2px #7fd4ff outline offset 4px. The button uses offset 3px.

Responsive
- Tablet, 600px to 1099.98px wide and at least 541px tall: hold --u at min(100dvh/800, 1px, max(100vw/1280, 100dvh/1190, .86px)). Cap the video field at 48% of the screen height. Enlarge tap targets with negative margin so nothing moves: nav links 14px 8px, discover link 12px 10px.
- Portrait under 600px: same scale model, but use svh. Keep the two headline lines nowrap. Headline size is max(26px, min(68u, (100vw - 48px) / 8.235)). Subhead floor 16px, size min(21u, 3.345vw), line-height 1.25, overflow-wrap break-word. Hero side padding 24px. Hairline and nav width min(max(284u, 252px), 100vw - 32px). Field max-height 48%. Same enlarged tap targets.
- Landscape shorter than 540px: keep the desktop proportions and lower the floors — logo 13px, hairline and nav 210px, nav 11px, headline 28px, subhead 12px, button 150×34px at 12.5px, discover 11px, gap min 14u, field min 120u.
- Coarse pointer in that short landscape: grow tap targets only.
- At 359px and below, outside the portrait block, allow the headline to wrap at 30px.
- prefers-reduced-motion: no transitions, and do not run the entrance.

Entrance, once per load, only if Web Animations and matchMedia exist and reduced motion is off
- Add class "intro" immediately. If the entrance has not started within 3500ms, remove it.
- While intro is on: wordmark, nav items, subhead, button, and discover link start at opacity 0. Hairline starts at scaleX(0). Each headline line is clipped at its baseline and its inner span starts at translateY(104%).
- Wait for document.fonts.ready and for the video loadeddata event, but never longer than 900ms, then start.
- Distances scale with k, the logo height divided by 23.5, clamped from 0.65 to 1.
- Wordmark: from opacity 0 and translateY(-6k px), delay 60ms, 900ms, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
- Hairline: scaleX 0 to 1, delay 180ms, 1000ms, cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1).
- Nav: center link first at 420ms, then the outer links at 490ms. Each from opacity 0 and translateY(-4k px), 700ms, the same quint easing.
- Headline lines rise from translateY(104%) to none, 1100ms, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). First line delay 200ms, second 290ms.
- Subhead rises 10k px, delay 700ms, 850ms, quint.
- Button rises 12k px from scale 0.975, delay 860ms, 900ms, expo.
- Discover link rises 6k px, delay 1040ms, 700ms, quint.
- Arrow starts 5k px above and settles, delay 1120ms, 820ms, expo.
- All animations use fill both. When every animation finishes, remove intro, cancel the animations, and if focus is not inside the page, toggle the page display none for one reflow so the masks do not leave a separate GPU layer. Then set data-intro="done" on the document element.

About is visible first.
- Click the wash, the logo, a destination, or press Escape to close. Tab cycles the trigger and the six links. Resize recomputes the orbit. Logo and menu stay above the wash (z-index 90; menu overlay z-index 50). On tablet and below, html.menu-open .top uses isolation auto so the logo and trigger stay above the wash.
- Below 680px the preview, spokes, and caption are hidden. Links stack in a left column from the glyph: order 0°, 315°, 45°, 90°, 135°, 225°, 270°, 180°, center. Titles use clamp(25px, 8vw, 34px).

Responsive, desktop rules stay untouched above these breakpoints
- Apply the tablet rewrite at max-width 959.98px, or max-height 599.98px, or portrait. --u becomes clamp(0.85px, 100vw / 1280, 1px). Body overflow visible. Page height auto with min-height 100dvh. Outer margin --gx clamp(20px, 2.6vw, 28px). Column gap --gc clamp(40px, 6.5vw, 72px).
- The band becomes a 2-column grid: logo | menu, empty | See Further, headline | lead. Min-height 36svh. Headline size clamp(34px, (50vw − gx − gc/2) / 7.3, 96px), line-height 0.9655. Lead wraps, size clamp(16px, 0.55vw + 12px, 19px), line-height 1.42, max-width 30em. Video min-height max(300px, 50svh). News width min(800u, 100% − 2gx). Enlarge hit areas with a -6px pseudo inset, not the drawn size.
- At max-width 679.98px, gx is 20px. Grid becomes logo | menu, headline full width, lead full width, then See Further on the right. Band min-height 44svh. Headline clamp(32px, (100vw − 40px) / 7.3, 54px). Lead 16.5px, max-width 32em. Video min-height max(300px, 46svh). News is inset 12px on the left, right, and bottom, width auto, padding 10px 8px 10px 14px, gap 12px.

Build a single standalone file, index.html, containing one full-screen hero section. Everything (HTML, CSS, JS) is inline in that one file. No frameworks, no build step, no libraries, no local assets. The only external resources are the Inter font from Google Fonts and one image loaded from this exact URL: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/9212999e-7a4a-4f70-bc34-e4e1c4533b81.jpg That URL is a square 1024x1024 JPEG (NOT a video): a purple holographic foil print with a chrome octopus and the words "STRANGE BY DESIGN". It is served with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, so it can be used as a WebGL texture. Do not download it, embed it, or replace it. There is no video anywhere on the page. === WHAT THE PAGE IS === A light grey studio-wall hero, exactly 100vh tall. On the left-centre hangs a square holographic cloth, pinned by its two top corners, simulated in real time. The visitor can grab the cloth anywhere with mouse or finger and drag it around in 3D; when released it falls back and settles. To the right of the cloth is a two-line heading. A nav bar sits on top. === HEAD === - , charset utf-8, viewport width=device-width, initial-scale=1 - Peculiar Atelier — Unusual by intent - meta description: "Peculiar Atelier. Unusual by intent. Tug the cloth, I dare you." - preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com (crossorigin) and https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net (crossorigin) - Font: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500&display=swap === CSS TOKENS (on :root) === --paper: #e3e4e9 --paper-edge: #cfd1d9 --ink: #000000 --ink-soft: rgba(0,0,0,0.5) --violet: #5b07fb --violet-deep: #4a00d6 --white: #ffffff --gutter: clamp(20px, 3.2vw, 46px) --display: clamp(44px, min(7.65vw, 13.6vh), 168px) Global: box-sizing border-box everywhere; body margin 0, background var(--paper), font-family "Inter", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased; text-rendering optimizeLegibility. === MARKUP (in this order) ===

The only external resources are the Inter font from Google Fonts and one image loaded from this exact URL: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/9212999e-7a4a-4f70-bc34-e4e1c4533b81.jpg That URL is a square 1024x1024 JPEG (NOT a video): a purple holographic foil print with a chrome octopus and the words "STRANGE BY DESIGN". It is served with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, so it can be used as a WebGL texture. Do not download it, embed it, or replace it. Image loading: create an Image with crossOrigin = "anonymous", set src to the URL above. On load, upload with texImage2D (no Y flip), clamp to edge, linear magnification, mipmaps with LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR (the image is power-of-two), anisotropic filtering up to 8x if available. Show the print at full strength immediately on load and draw a frame straight away — do NOT fade it in over frames. On error, add "no-cloth". Loop: requestAnimationFrame, running only while the hero is on screen (IntersectionObserver) and the tab is visible; resume on visibilitychange. === QUALITY === Visible keyboard focus on all controls, no console errors, no horizontal scroll at any width, smooth at 60fps on a laptop. Result at 1280x724: cloth spans roughly from 11% to 65% of the width and 6% to 92% of the height, slightly rotated clockwise, bottom edge wider than the top, with a soft shadow below it; heading "Grab me" (black) over "I dare you" (50% black) on the right; "Peculiar Atelier" top-left; black "More" pill and violet "Start a brief" pill top-right.
