EXTERNAL RESOURCES (use these exact URLs) ================================================== - Font: Google Fonts Poppins, weights 300/400/500/600/700/800          - Three.js r169 via importmap:   "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/build/three.module.js"   "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/examples/jsm/"   Imports: GLTFLoader (loaders/GLTFLoader.js), mergeVertices + mergeGeometries (utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js), RoundedBoxGeometry (geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js). - 3D model (rounded cube GLB, CORS-enabled, load directly, do NOT download or replace):   const MODEL_URL = 'https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20260929_212926_92423081-b0e4-4f5a-b650-14af6c05c058.glb';   If it fails to load, fall back to new RoundedBoxGeometry(1, 1, 1, 8, 0.12). Page : "Design World — Explore New Ideas". ================================================== 2. PAGE STRUCTURE (HTML) ================================================== <section class="hero" id="hero">   <canvas id="scene" aria-label="Rotatable glass cube. Drag to rotate."></canvas>   <div class="ui">     <h1 class="sr-only">Explore New Ideas</h1>     <header class="nav">       <a href="#" class="logo"><i class="logo-mark"></i><b>Design</b><span>World</span></a>       <ul class="nav-links"><li><a>Home</a></li><li><a>Portfolio</a></li><li><a>Contact Us</a></li></ul>     </header>     <div class="arrows">       <button class="arrow" id="prev">[left-arrow SVG]</button>       <button class="arrow" id="next">[right-arrow SVG]</button>     </div>     <nav class="dots"><button class="dot"></button><button class="dot active"></button><button class="dot"></button></nav>     <p class="tagline">Let's Build the<br>Future of <strong>Design.</strong></p>     <div class="cta-row">       <a href="#" class="cta">Explore Now</a>       <span class="cta-line"></span>       <span class="count" aria-hidden="true">07</span>     </div>     <div class="loader" id="loader">Loading model</div>   </div> </section> Arrow SVGs: viewBox 0 0 24 24, fill none, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 2.6, round caps/joins.   prev path: "M19 12H5M11 6l-6 6 6 6"    next path: "M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" IMPORTANT: The big "Explore / New / Ideas" headline is NOT HTML text. It is drawn onto a 2D canvas inside WebGL so the glass cube can refract it (see section 4). The HTML only has a visually hidden <h1> for accessibility. ================================================== 3. CSS (exact values) ================================================== :root { --bg:#000; --fg:#fff; --pad-x: clamp(20px, 6.95vw, 120px) } html, body { height:100%; background:#000; color:#fff; font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased } .hero { position:relative; width:100%; height:100vh; height:100svh; min-height:520px; overflow:hidden; background:#000 } #scene { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; display:block; cursor:grab; touch-action:none } #scene.dragging { cursor:grabbing } .ui { position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:2 }   /* drags pass through to the canvas */ .ui a, .ui button { pointer-events:auto } .sr-only { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden; clip:rect(0 0 0 0); white-space:nowrap } NAV .nav { position:absolute; top:clamp(24px,4.7vh,40px); left:var(--pad-x); right:var(--pad-x); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between } .logo { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none; font-size:15px; letter-spacing:-0.01em } .logo-mark { width:20px; height:40px; background:#fff; border-radius:0 20px 20px 0 }   /* white "D" half-circle */ .logo b { font-weight:700 }   .logo span { font-weight:400 } .nav-links { display:flex; gap:clamp(20px,4.1vw,60px); list-style:none } .nav-links a { color:#fff; text-decoration:none; font-size:15px; font-weight:500; position:relative } .nav-links a::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:-4px; height:1px; background:currentColor; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:right; transition:transform .35s ease } .nav-links a:hover::after { transform:scaleX(1); transform-origin:left } ARROWS (top-right, left of the dots column) .arrows { position:absolute; top:18.9%; left:76.7%; display:flex; gap:32px; transform:translate(-19px,-50%) } .arrow { width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:50%; border:2.5px solid #fff; background:transparent; color:#fff; display:grid; place-items:center; cursor:pointer; transition:background .25s, color .25s } .arrow svg { width:18px; height:18px } .arrow:hover { background:#fff; color:#000 } PAGINATION DOTS (vertical, right edge) .dots { position:absolute; right:calc(var(--pad-x) - 7px); top:49.4%; transform:translateY(-50%); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:33px } .dot { width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid #fff; background:#fff; cursor:pointer; transition:background .25s } .dot.active { background:transparent }   /* active = hollow ring, middle one active by default */ TAGLINE (bottom-left) .tagline { position:absolute; left:var(--pad-x); bottom:clamp(40px,7.5vh,70px); font-size:clamp(24px,2.65vw,44px); line-height:1.2; font-weight:300; letter-spacing:-0.01em } .tagline strong { font-weight:700; display:block } CTA ROW (button → horizontal line → giant outlined "07" bleeding off the right edge) .cta-row { position:absolute; left:45.6%; right:-1vw; top:88.7%; transform:translateY(-50%); display:flex; align-items:center } .cta { flex:none; padding:0 15px; height:48px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85); border-radius:6px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.15); color:#fff; font-size:14px; font-weight:400; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background .25s, color .25s } .cta:hover { background:#fff; color:#000 } .cta-line { flex:1; height:1.5px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.8); min-width:40px } .count { flex:none; font-size:clamp(140px,19.8vw,360px); font-weight:400; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:transparent; -webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.9); transform:translateY(6%); user-select:none } LOADER .loader { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; opacity:.6; transition:opacity .6s } .loader.done { opacity:0 } RESPONSIVE @media (max-width:900px), (max-aspect-ratio:1/1) {   .arrows { left:auto; right:var(--pad-x); top:15%; transform:translateY(-50%); gap:14px }   .tagline { bottom:clamp(150px,20vh,220px) }   .cta-row { left:var(--pad-x); right:-3vw; top:auto; bottom:24px; transform:none }   .count { font-size:clamp(120px,22vw,200px) } } @media (max-width:640px) {   .nav-links { gap:16px }   .nav-links a, .logo { font-size:13px }   .dots { gap:20px; right:16px }   .dot { width:10px; height:10px }   .cta-row { right:-8vw }   .count { font-size:120px } } @media (max-width:420px) { .nav-links li:nth-child(2) { display:none } }   /* hide "Portfolio" */ No horizontal page scroll at any width. ================================================== 4. WEBGL SCENE (Three.js) ================================================== Renderer: WebGLRenderer({ canvas:#scene, antialias:true, alpha:false }), clearColor #000, outputColorSpace SRGBColorSpace, pixelRatio = min(devicePixelRatio, 2). Camera: PerspectiveCamera(fov 30, aspect W/H, 0.1, 100) at (0,0,10) looking at origin. 4a. Background headline (drawn into an offscreen 2D canvas → CanvasTexture) - Canvas size = viewport × DPR, filled #000. - mobile = (W < 768) || (W/H < 1). - fontSize fs = min(H*0.21, W*(mobile ? 0.21 : 0.118)); font = `800 ${fs}px Poppins`.   If the widest line is wider than W*(mobile ? 0.9 : 0.5), scale fs down to fit. - Lines: "Explore", "New", "Ideas". Fill #e9e9e9, textAlign center, baseline alphabetic. - Centre x = W*(mobile ? 0.5 : 0.505); centre y = H*(mobile ? 0.45 : 0.468).   Line gap = fs*1.07; cap height ≈ fs*0.7. Line i (0..2) baseline y = cy + cap/2 + (i-1)*gap. - Texture: colorSpace SRGB, LinearFilter, no mipmaps. Redraw on resize and on document.fonts 'loadingdone'. - Show it with a fullscreen quad (PlaneGeometry(2,2), ShaderMaterial, vertex outputs position.xy directly, fragment = texture2D(uTex, vUv) followed by #include <colorspace_fragment> ON ITS OWN LINE; depthTest/depthWrite false; frustumCulled false) in its own bgScene. - Wait for fonts before first draw: Promise.race([Promise.all([document.fonts.load('800 100px Poppins'), document.fonts.ready]), 2500ms timeout]) then layout() + start loop. 4b. Model loading - GLTFLoader.load(MODEL_URL). Traverse gltf.scene; for each mesh: clone geometry, delete 'uv','color','tangent' attributes, mergeVertices(g, 1e-4), computeVertexNormals(), applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld). Merge all parts with mergeGeometries. - Centre the geometry on its bounding box and scale uniformly so its largest dimension = 1. - Scene graph: scene → pivot (screen position + scale) → spinner (rotation) → cube mesh. On load add class "done" to #loader. 4c. Cube placement (in layout(), on load and on resize) - visH = 2*tan(fov/2)*10; visW = visH*aspect. - Screen-fraction centre: sx = mobile ? 0.5 : 0.517, sy = mobile ? 0.45 : 0.488.   pivot.position = ((sx-0.5)*visW, (0.5-sy)*visH, 0). - On-screen edge length px = min(H*0.44, W*(mobile ? 0.45 : 0.29)); pivot.scale = (px/H)*visH. - Initial spinner rotation: Euler(-0.42, 0.62, 0.18). 4d. Glass material — custom ShaderMaterial, screen-space refraction with 6-band chromatic dispersion, rendered in two passes (back faces, then front faces). Vertex shader:   varying vec3 vNormal; varying vec3 vEye;   worldPos = modelMatrix*position; mvPos = viewMatrix*worldPos; gl_Position = projectionMatrix*mvPos;   vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix*normal); vEye = normalize(mvPos.xyz); Fragment shader:   uv = gl_FragCoord.xy / uResolution (drawing-buffer size).   n = normalize(vNormal); if (uBackside > 0.5) n = -n;   // do NOT use gl_FrontFacing, three.js flips winding for BackSide   eye = normalize(vEye).   LOOP = 16 iterations; slide = i/LOOP * 0.045.   For each band compute refract(eye, n, 1.0/ior) with iorR/Y/G/C/B/P and sample uTexture at     uv + refr.xy * (uRefractPower + slide*k) * uChromatic, with k = 1 (R), 1 (Y), 2 (G), 2.5 (C), 3 (B), 1 (P):     r = tex(R).x*0.5     y = (tex(Y).x*2 + tex(Y).y*2 - tex(Y).z)/6     g = tex(G).y*0.5     c = (tex(C).y*2 + tex(C).z*2 - tex(C).x)/6     b = tex(B).z*0.5     p = (tex(P).z*2 + tex(P).x*2 - tex(P).y)/6     R = r + (2p + 2y - c)/3;  G = g + (2y + 2c - p)/3;  B = b + (2c + 2p - y)/3     color += vec3(R,G,B)   color /= LOOP; saturation adjust: mix(luma(color), color, uSaturation) with luma weights (0.2125, 0.7154, 0.0721).   Specular (Blinn-Phong, light vector = normalize(-light), view = -eye):     spec = specular(uLight, uShininess, uDiffuseness) + 0.6 * specular(vec3(1,1,-1), uShininess*0.6, uDiffuseness*0.5)     spec(x) = pow(max(dot(n,halfVec),0), shininess) + max(0,dot(n,lightVec))*diffuseness     color += spec * (backside ? 0.35 : 1.0)   Fresnel: f = pow(1.0 + dot(eye, n), uFresnelPower); color = mix(color, vec3(1), f * (backside ? 0.25 : 0.55)).   color += vec3(0.004, 0.005, 0.007). gl_FragColor = vec4(color,1); then #include <colorspace_fragment> on its own line. Uniform values:   uIorR 1.15, uIorY 1.16, uIorG 1.18, uIorC 1.22, uIorB 1.22, uIorP 1.22,   uRefractPower 0.30 (front) / 0.22 (back), uChromatic 0.5, uSaturation 1.08,   uShininess 90, uDiffuseness 0.02, uFresnelPower 5.0, uLight (-1, 1, 1),   uBackside 0 (frontMat, side FrontSide) / 1 (backMat, side BackSide). 4e. Render pipeline (every frame) - Two WebGLRenderTargets sized to drawing buffer (W*DPR × H*DPR), type HalfFloatType, default (linear) colour space: rtBack, rtFront. - backMat.uTexture = rtBack.texture; frontMat.uTexture = rtFront.texture.   1) render bgScene → rtBack   2) render bgScene → rtFront, then (autoClear=false) cube with backMat → rtFront   3) render bgScene → screen, then (autoClear=false, clearDepth) cube with frontMat → screen - This gives the look: text seen through the cube is magnified, mirrored and split into blue/yellow fringes, inner rounded edges of the cube are faintly visible, and the bevelled edges glow white. ================================================== 5. INTERACTION & ANIMATION ================================================== - Drag to rotate (pointer events on the canvas, setPointerCapture):   dx = Δx*0.008, dy = Δy*0.008; apply as world-space rotation: premultiply spinner.quaternion by axisAngle(Y, dx) then axisAngle(X, dy).   Track velocity per 16.67ms frame; add class "dragging" to the canvas while dragging. - Inertia after release: keep applying velocity, damped by 0.94^(dt*60) per frame. - Idle drift: 0.6s after release, blend in a constant slow rotation of 0.0035 rad/frame around Y and 0.0012 rad/frame around X (blend ramps 0→1 over 1s). It also runs from page load. - Prev/Next arrow buttons: smoothly rotate the cube -90°/+90° around Y (ease: each frame apply remaining*min(1, 0.09*dt*60) until remaining < 0.0005). Cancels inertia; dragging cancels the spin. - Dots: clicking a dot makes it the only .active one (hollow ring). - Hover transitions: nav link underline wipe (.35s), arrow and CTA buttons invert to white bg / black content (.25s). - Clamp frame dt to 0.05s. Recompute layout (renderer size, camera aspect, render-target sizes, uResolution, headline canvas, cube position/scale) on window resize. ================================================== 6. LAYOUT REFERENCE (desktop 1440×806) ================================================== - Logo at (100, 38), 40px tall. Nav links right-aligned, right edge ≈ 1340, vertical centre ≈ 58. - Arrow circles centred at ≈ (1105, 152) and (1175, 152). - Dots at x ≈ 1340, y ≈ 351 / 398 / 445 (middle one hollow). - Headline "Explore / New / Ideas" centred at x ≈ 727, ~170px ExtraBold, baselines ≈ 272 / 445 / 637. - Glass cube occupies ≈ x 510–1000, y 145–600, slightly right of centre, overlapping the headline. - Tagline "Let's Build the / Future of / Design." at left 100, bottom ≈ 60px, ~38px, Light with Bold "Design.". - "Explore Now" button at (657, 691), 48px tall; a 1.5px line runs right to a huge outlined "07" whose "0" starts at x ≈ 1140 and whose "7" is clipped by the right and bottom edges. - Pure black background, all UI white. Mobile (≤767px or portrait): headline and cube centred at 50% x / 45% y, headline up to 90% width, arrows move under the nav on the right, tagline sits above the CTA row, and the CTA row is pinned 24px from the bottom with "07" partly off-screen on the right. Output: one complete index.html, nothing else.

left:45.6%; right:-1vw; top:88.7%; transform:translateY(-50%); display:flex; align-items:center } .cta { flex:none; padding:0 15px; height:48px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85); border-radius:6px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.15); color:#fff; font-size:14px; font-weight:400; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background .25s, color .25s } .cta:hover { background:#fff; color:#000 } .cta-line { flex:1; height:1.5px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.8); min-width:40px } .count { flex:none; font-size:clamp(140px,19.8vw,360px); font-weight:400; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:transparent; -webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.9); transform:translateY(6%); user-select:none } LOADER .loader { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; opacity:.6; transition:opacity .6s } .loader.done { opacity:0 } RESPONSIVE @media (max-width:900px), (max-aspect-ratio:1/1) {   .arrows { left:auto; right:var(--pad-x); top:15%; transform:translateY(-50%); gap:14px }   .tagline { bottom:clamp(150px,20vh,220px) }   .cta-row { left:var(--pad-x); right:-3vw; top:auto; bottom:24px; transform:none }   .count { font-size:clamp(120px,22vw,200px) } } @media (max-width:640px) {   .nav-links { gap:16px }   .nav-links a, .logo { font-size:13px }   .dots { gap:20px; right:16px }   .dot { width:10px; height:10px }   .cta-row { right:-8vw }   .count { font-size:120px } } @media (max-width:420px) { .nav-links li:nth-child(2) { display:none } }   /* hide "Portfolio" */ No horizontal page scroll at any width. ================================================== 4. WEBGL SCENE (Three.js) ================================================== Renderer: WebGLRenderer({ canvas:#scene, antialias:true, alpha:false }), clearColor #000, outputColorSpace SRGBColorSpace, pixelRatio = min(devicePixelRatio, 2). Camera: PerspectiveCamera(fov 30, aspect W/H, 0.1, 100) at (0,0,10) looking at origin. 4a. Background headline (drawn into an offscreen 2D canvas → CanvasTexture) - Canvas size = viewport × DPR, filled #000. - mobile = (W < 768) || (W/H < 1). - fontSize fs = min(H*0.21, W*(mobile ? 0.21 : 0.118)); font = `800 ${fs}px Poppins`.   If the widest line is wider than W*(mobile ? 0.9 : 0.5), scale fs down to fit. - Lines: "Explore", "New", "Ideas". Fill #e9e9e9, textAlign center, baseline alphabetic. - Centre x = W*(mobile ? 0.5 : 0.505); centre y = H*(mobile ? 0.45 : 0.468).   Line gap = fs*1.07; cap height ≈ fs*0.7. Line i (0..2) baseline y = cy + cap/2 + (i-1)*gap. - Texture: colorSpace SRGB, LinearFilter, no mipmaps. Redraw on resize and on document.fonts 'loadingdone'. - Show it with a fullscreen quad (PlaneGeometry(2,2), ShaderMaterial, vertex outputs position.xy directly, fragment = texture2D(uTex, vUv) followed by #include <colorspace_fragment> ON ITS OWN LINE; depthTest/depthWrite false; frustumCulled false) in its own bgScene. - Wait for fonts before first draw: Promise.race([Promise.all([document.fonts.load('800 100px Poppins'), document.fonts.ready]), 2500ms timeout]) then layout() + start loop. 4b. Model loading - GLTFLoader.load(MODEL_URL). Traverse gltf.scene; for each mesh: clone geometry, delete 'uv','color','tangent' attributes, mergeVertices(g, 1e-4), computeVertexNormals(), applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld). Merge all parts with mergeGeometries. - Centre the geometry on its bounding box and scale uniformly so its largest dimension = 1. - Scene graph: scene → pivot (screen position + scale) → spinner (rotation) → cube mesh. On load add class "done" to #loader. 4c. Cube placement (in layout(), on load and on resize) - visH = 2*tan(fov/2)*10; visW = visH*aspect. - Screen-fraction centre: sx = mobile ? 0.5 : 0.517, sy = mobile ? 0.45 : 0.488.   pivot.position = ((sx-0.5)*visW, (0.5-sy)*visH, 0). - On-screen edge length px = min(H*0.44, W*(mobile ? 0.45 : 0.29)); pivot.scale = (px/H)*visH. - Initial spinner rotation: Euler(-0.42, 0.62, 0.18). 4d. Glass material — custom ShaderMaterial, screen-space refraction with 6-band chromatic dispersion, rendered in two passes (back faces, then front faces). Vertex shader:   varying vec3 vNormal; varying vec3 vEye;   worldPos = modelMatrix*position; mvPos = viewMatrix*worldPos; gl_Position = projectionMatrix*mvPos;   vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix*normal); vEye = normalize(mvPos.xyz); Fragment shader:   uv = gl_FragCoord.xy / uResolution (drawing-buffer size).   n = normalize(vNormal); if (uBackside > 0.5) n = -n;   // do NOT use gl_FrontFacing, three.js flips winding for BackSide   eye = normalize(vEye).   LOOP = 16 iterations; slide = i/LOOP * 0.045.   For each band compute refract(eye, n, 1.0/ior) with iorR/Y/G/C/B/P and sample uTexture at     uv + refr.xy * (uRefractPower + slide*k) * uChromatic, with k = 1 (R), 1 (Y), 2 (G), 2.5 (C), 3 (B), 1 (P):     r = tex(R).x*0.5     y = (tex(Y).x*2 + tex(Y).y*2 - tex(Y).z)/6     g = tex(G).y*0.5     c = (tex(C).y*2 + tex(C).z*2 - tex(C).x)/6     b = tex(B).z*0.5     p = (tex(P).z*2 + tex(P).x*2 - tex(P).y)/6     R = r + (2p + 2y - c)/3;  G = g + (2y + 2c - p)/3;  B = b + (2c + 2p - y)/3     color += vec3(R,G,B)   color /= LOOP; saturation adjust: mix(luma(color), color, uSaturation) with luma weights (0.2125, 0.7154, 0.0721).   Specular (Blinn-Phong, light vector = normalize(-light), view = -eye):     spec = specular(uLight, uShininess, uDiffuseness) + 0.6 * specular(vec3(1,1,-1), uShininess*0.6, uDiffuseness*0.5)     spec(x) = pow(max(dot(n,halfVec),0), shininess) + max(0,dot(n,lightVec))*diffuseness     color += spec * (backside ? 0.35 : 1.0)   Fresnel: f = pow(1.0 + dot(eye, n), uFresnelPower); color = mix(color, vec3(1), f * (backside ? 0.25 : 0.55)).   color += vec3(0.004, 0.005, 0.007). gl_FragColor = vec4(color,1); then #include <colorspace_fragment> on its own line. Uniform values:   uIorR 1.15, uIorY 1.16, uIorG 1.18, uIorC 1.22, uIorB 1.22, uIorP 1.22,   uRefractPower 0.30 (front) / 0.22 (back), uChromatic 0.5, uSaturation 1.08,   uShininess 90, uDiffuseness 0.02, uFresnelPower 5.0, uLight (-1, 1, 1),   uBackside 0 (frontMat, side FrontSide) / 1 (backMat, side BackSide). 4e. Render pipeline (every frame) - Two WebGLRenderTargets sized to drawing buffer (W*DPR × H*DPR), type HalfFloatType, default (linear) colour space: rtBack, rtFront. - backMat.uTexture = rtBack.texture; frontMat.uTexture = rtFront.texture.   1) render bgScene → rtBack   2) render bgScene → rtFront, then (autoClear=false) cube with backMat → rtFront   3) render bgScene → screen, then (autoClear=false, clearDepth) cube with frontMat → screen - This gives the look: text seen through the cube is magnified, mirrored and split into blue/yellow fringes, inner rounded edges of the cube are faintly visible, and the bevelled edges glow white. ================================================== 5. INTERACTION & ANIMATION ================================================== - Drag to rotate (pointer events on the canvas, setPointerCapture):   dx = Δx*0.008, dy = Δy*0.008; apply as world-space rotation: premultiply spinner.quaternion by axisAngle(Y, dx) then axisAngle(X, dy).   Track velocity per 16.67ms frame; add class "dragging" to the canvas while dragging. - Inertia after release: keep applying velocity, damped by 0.94^(dt*60) per frame. - Idle drift: 0.6s after release, blend in a constant slow rotation of 0.0035 rad/frame around Y and 0.0012 rad/frame around X (blend ramps 0→1 over 1s). It also runs from page load. - Prev/Next arrow buttons: smoothly rotate the cube -90°/+90° around Y (ease: each frame apply remaining*min(1, 0.09*dt*60) until remaining < 0.0005). Cancels inertia; dragging cancels the spin. - Dots: clicking a dot makes it the only .active one (hollow ring). - Hover transitions: nav link underline wipe (.35s), arrow and CTA buttons invert to white bg / black content (.25s). - Clamp frame dt to 0.05s. Recompute layout (renderer size, camera aspect, render-target sizes, uResolution, headline canvas, cube position/scale) on window resize. ================================================== 6. LAYOUT REFERENCE (desktop 1440×806) ================================================== - Logo at (100, 38), 40px tall. Nav links right-aligned, right edge ≈ 1340, vertical centre ≈ 58. - Arrow circles centred at ≈ (1105, 152) and (1175, 152). - Dots at x ≈ 1340, y ≈ 351 / 398 / 445 (middle one hollow). - Headline "Explore / New / Ideas" centred at x ≈ 727, ~170px ExtraBold, baselines ≈ 272 / 445 / 637. - Glass cube occupies ≈ x 510–1000, y 145–600, slightly right of centre, overlapping the headline. - Tagline "Let's Build the / Future of / Design." at left 100, bottom ≈ 60px, ~38px, Light with Bold "Design.". - "Explore Now" button at (657, 691), 48px tall; a 1.5px line runs right to a huge outlined "07" whose "0" starts at x ≈ 1140 and whose "7" is clipped by the right and bottom edges. - Pure black background, all UI white. Mobile (≤767px or portrait): headline and cube centred at 50% x / 45% y, headline up to 90% width, arrows move under the nav on the right, tagline sits above the CTA row, and the CTA row is pinned 24px from the bottom with "07" partly off-screen on the right. Output: one complete index.html, nothing else.

Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Genovera"** in the **Healthcare** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `genovera`
- **Category:** Healthcare (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/genovera-dna-landing.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261017_154349_20d235b7-22ff-49b7-af2a-ec403fe245b3.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"Genovera"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/genovera-dna-landing.mp4) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"Genovera"** (Healthcare) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.

   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).

items.prompt_text:
Build a single standalone HTML file (index.html): a dark-mode hero section for an AI assistant called "Iris", with an interactive 3D robot mascot rendered in Three.js. The robot's whole head turns toward the mouse, its pupils follow the cursor, and its two floating arms bob up and down. Everything goes in ONE file (inline CSS + one inline Imports in the module: THREE from "three"; GLTFLoader from "three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js"; EffectComposer, RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, OutputPass from "three/addons/postprocessing/..."; mergeVertices from "three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js". 3D models (Higgsfield-generated GLB files on CloudFront, CORS-enabled; load these exact URLs directly): const HEAD_GLB = "https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261018_172206_0181329a-86e2-41c9-8ab8-c496f29aaa53.glb"; const ARM_GLB = "https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261018_172137_cd6086ec-07ef-44dc-bd15-95a450ddaa8c.glb"; HEAD_GLB = spherical robot head with ear caps and two antenna rods (one mesh, ~9 MB). ARM_GLB = one smooth pill/egg-shaped arm (one mesh), used twice. Iris — Smart AI Assistant, , viewport meta with viewport-fit=cover. ================================================== 2. HTML STRUCTURE ==================================================
Iris
Overview · Ecosystem · Socials · Help (4 )
Get Iris
same 4 links

Introducing a
Smart AI Assistant

Easy to start. Effortless to explore.
Capable in every conversation.

Start free
================================================== 3. CSS (exact values) ================================================== :root { --bg:#0b0b11; --nav:#12131a; --line:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); --text:#fff; --muted:#a3a3b2; --link:#c8c8d4; --violet:#7c4dff; --violet-2:#8f66ff; --nav-h:62px; } * { box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0 } html, body { background:var(--bg); color:var(--text) } body { font-family:"Figtree", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; overflow-x:hidden } a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none } NAV .nav: position fixed, top/left/right 0, z-index 20, height var(--nav-h), background rgba(18,19,26,0.86), backdrop-filter blur(14px) (+ -webkit-), border-bottom 1px solid var(--line). .nav-inner: max-width 1344px, height 100%, margin 0 auto, padding 0 68px, flex, align-items center, justify-content space-between. .brand: flex, gap 11px, font-weight 600, 21px, letter-spacing -0.01em. .brand-orb: 26×26 circle, background radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #c9b8ff 0%, #8b6cff 38%, #5b3df0 72%, #3a24b8 100%), box-shadow 0 0 14px rgba(124,77,255,.55), inset -2px -3px 6px rgba(20,8,70,.55). .nav-right: flex, align center, gap 30px. .nav-links: flex, gap 38px, 14px, weight 500, color var(--link); hover → #fff (transition color .2s). .btn-open: background #fff, color #0b0b11, weight 600, 14px, padding 10px 19px, radius 999px; hover translateY(-1px) + box-shadow 0 6px 20px rgba(255,255,255,.15). .menu-btn: display none by default; 40×40, radius 12px, background rgba(255,255,255,.06), border 1px solid var(--line). Hamburger icon = the plus ::before/::after: three 16×1.6px white bars spaced 5px apart. When .nav has class .open: span turns transparent, ::before rotates 45deg and ::after -45deg (top 0) to form an X. .mobile-panel: display none; position absolute, top calc(var(--nav-h) + 8px), left/right 16px, background rgba(20,21,30,.96), 1px border var(--line), radius 18px, padding 8px, flex-direction column, box-shadow 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5). Links: padding 14px 16px, radius 12px, weight 500, color var(--link); hover background rgba(255,255,255,.05), color #fff. .nav.open .mobile-panel → display flex. JS: clicking #menuBtn toggles .open on #nav and updates aria-expanded. HERO .hero: position relative, min-height 100vh AND 100svh, overflow hidden, isolation isolate. #stage: position absolute, inset 0, 100%×100%, display block, z-index 0, touch-action pan-y. .hero::after (z-index 1, pointer-events none, inset 0): background = repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.012) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px) (faint vertical lines) layered with radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 0%, transparent 55%, rgba(0,0,0,.45) 100%) (vignette). .hero-inner: relative, z-index 2, pointer-events none, max-width 1344px, margin 0 auto, min-height inherit, padding calc(var(--nav-h) + 40px) 68px 80px, flex column, justify-content center. .copy: max-width 600px, pointer-events auto. h1: font-size clamp(40px, 5.1vw, 70px), line-height 1.04, weight 700, letter-spacing -0.025em. .sub: margin-top 26px, color var(--muted), font-size clamp(17px, 1.65vw, 22px), line-height 1.55, weight 400. .btn-try: inline-flex centered, margin-top 36px, height 59px, padding 0 38px, radius 999px, background linear-gradient(180deg, #8f66ff, #7c4dff), color #fff, weight 600, 20px, letter-spacing -0.005em, box-shadow ONLY inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22) (NO outer glow), transition transform .25s. Hover: translateY(-2px) + filter brightness(1.08). Reveal animation: .reveal starts opacity 0, translateY(18px), animation "rise" .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) forwards; delays .d1 .08s, .d2 .2s, .d3 .32s; @keyframes rise { to { opacity:1; transform:none } }. .loader: absolute, z-index 2, 46×46 circle, border 2px solid rgba(143,102,255,.18), border-top-color #8f66ff, spin 1s linear infinite (keyframes keep translate(-50%,-50%) and rotate 360deg), transform translate(-50%,-50%), transition opacity .5s; .hide → opacity 0. JS positions it at the robot anchor point. RESPONSIVE @media (max-width:1100px): .nav-inner and .hero-inner left/right padding 40px; .nav-links gap 26px. @media (max-width:860px): hide .nav-links; show .menu-btn (inline-flex); .nav-right gap 10px; .hero-inner justify-content flex-end, text-align center, align-items center, padding calc(var(--nav-h) + 20px) 24px 56px; .copy max-width 560px; h1 font-size clamp(36px, 9.2vw, 56px); .sub margin-top 16px; .btn-try margin-top 26px. (Text sits at the bottom, robot above it.) @media (max-width:480px): .nav-inner padding 0 16px; .hero-inner padding calc(var(--nav-h) + 16px) 16px 40px; .brand 19px; .btn-open padding 9px 15px, 13px; .btn-try height 54px, padding 0 32px, 18px. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): .reveal no animation, fully visible. ================================================== 4. THREE.JS SCENE ================================================== Renderer: WebGLRenderer({ canvas:#stage, antialias:true, powerPreference:"high-performance" }), pixelRatio min(devicePixelRatio, 2), ACESFilmicToneMapping, exposure 1.0, SRGBColorSpace. scene.background = #0b0b11. Camera: PerspectiveCamera(fov 28, near 0.1, far 100). Helper radialTexture(stops, size=256): canvas radial gradient from centre to edge with the given [offset, color] stops → CanvasTexture (SRGB). glowTex = radialTexture([[0,"rgba(160,120,255,1)"],[0.25,"rgba(124,77,255,.55)"],[0.6,"rgba(90,50,230,.12)"],[1,"rgba(60,30,200,0)"]]). Environment (a dark studio, NOT RoomEnvironment): build a separate scene with background #030305 and emissive "softboxes" made from SphereGeometry(0.5,32,16) meshes with MeshBasicMaterial(color × intensity), each scaled (w, h, 0.3) and lookAt(0,0,0): - white 5×3.2 at (-3, 4.5, 4) ×3.2 (key, top-left) - white 1.2×6 at (6, 0.5, 2) ×1.1 (strip, right) - white 3×1 at (1.5, 5, -1) ×0.8 (top) - #7c4dff 4×5 at (-5, 0, -4) ×1.0 (violet back-left) - #7c4dff 4×5 at (5, 0, -4) ×1.0 (violet back-right) - #5b30ff 6×3 at (0, -5, 1) ×0.35 (violet floor bounce) scene.environment = PMREMGenerator.fromScene(envScene, 0.02).texture; environmentIntensity 1.0. Use round softboxes (spheres), not planes, and NO point lights: both cause square bloom artifacts. Lights: HemisphereLight(0xdcd8f0, 0x1a0f3a, 2.3) + DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.55) at (-3, 4, 5). Post-processing: EffectComposer → RenderPass → UnrealBloomPass(strength 0.55, radius 0.4, threshold 0.92) → OutputPass. Resize the composer and bloom with the canvas. Fresnel rim shader rimMaterial(color, power, strength): ShaderMaterial, additive blending, transparent, depthWrite false. Vertex: pass the view-space normal and view direction. Fragment: f = pow(1 - max(dot(N, V), 0), power); gl_FragColor = vec4(color*f*strength, f). Added as a child "shell" mesh sharing each model mesh's geometry (renderOrder 2) for the lavender edge light. Rig: robot (Group: float/bob/intro scale) → body (Group: partial turn, holds the arms) → head (Group: full turn). Background haze: Sprite(glowTex, color 0x7a55ff, opacity 0.06, additive, toneMapped false, depthWrite false), scale 7.5, position (0, 0.1, -3). Floor glow: PlaneGeometry(1,1) facing the camera (NOT laid flat), MeshBasicMaterial(glowTex, color 0x8f6bff, opacity 0.95, additive, depthWrite false), position (0, -2.05, -0.6), scale (3.4, 0.42). ================================================== 5. MODEL PREP ================================================== prepareModel(root, {glossy, rim, tint, useMap, smooth}): collect the meshes FIRST into an array, then loop over it (adding children inside traverse recurses forever). If smooth: clone the geometry, delete normal/uv/uv1/tangent/color, mergeVertices(g, 1e-3), computeVertexNormals. Replace the material with MeshPhysicalMaterial: map only if useMap; color = tint; glossy → metalness 0.1, roughness 0.3, clearcoat 1.0, clearcoatRoughness 0.16, envMapIntensity 0.9; non-glossy → metalness 0, roughness 0.48, clearcoat 0.3, clearcoatRoughness 0.4, envMapIntensity 0.55. Add the rim shell if rim is given. HEAD: normaliseHead → scale so bbox depth (size.z) = 2, then position = (-centre.x, -(min.y + 1), -centre.z) so the sphere centre is at the origin. prepareModel with glossy:true, useMap:false (ignore the baked texture), tint "#4a4a56", rim {0x8a5cff, power 4.5, strength 0.32}. Then in mountHead: a) Raycast from (0,0,5) toward -Z; R = clamp(hit distance from origin, 0.85, 1.1) (sphere radius). b) sphereNormals: for every vertex whose distance from the head centre is within 7% of R, set its normal to the normalised position (converted with the mesh's inverse-transpose matrix), so reflections are perfectly smooth. c) addVisor(R): build a rounded-rectangle Shape, tessellate it (ShapeGeometry(shape, 48) → non-indexed → 3 rounds of 4-way midpoint subdivision), then wrap every vertex onto the sphere: z = sqrt(radius² - x² - y²); normals = normalised positions. - bezel: w 1.86, h 1.12, corner 0.46, centreY -0.07, radius R×1.03, MeshPhysical color #0c0c10, roughness 0.3, metalness 0.3, clearcoat 0.8, polygonOffset factor/units -6, renderOrder 3. - glass: w 1.74, h 1.0, corner 0.4, centreY -0.07, radius R×1.036, MeshPhysical color #000000, roughness 0.12, clearcoat 1, clearcoatRoughness 0.1, envMapIntensity 0.9, polygonOffset -8/-8, renderOrder 4. d) Eyes (procedural so they can track): at x = ±0.43, y = -0.08, z = sqrt((R×1.055)² - x² - y²); orient each eye group with quaternion.setFromUnitVectors((0,0,1), position.normalize()). Each eye group contains: - halo: CircleGeometry(0.42) with glowTex, color 0x8a5cff, opacity 0.24, additive, z -0.004, renderOrder 9 - ring: RingGeometry(0.168, 0.212, 64), MeshBasic color new THREE.Color(1.1, 0.88, 2.0) - iris: CircleGeometry(0.17), map = radialTexture([[0,"#d7c9ff"],[0.45,"#a07bff"],[0.8,"#7646f2"],[1,"#5c2fe0"]]), color (1.0, 0.95, 1.15), z 0.001 - pupilWrap group (moves with the cursor): pupil CircleGeometry(0.083) #07040f at z 0.003, plus a white glint CircleGeometry(0.022) at (0.032, 0.034, 0.005) - ALL eye materials: toneMapped false, depthWrite false, depthTest false, renderOrder 10, so the eyes are never hidden behind the visor glass when the head turns. e) Antenna balls: collect head-local vertices with y > 0.75 and |x| > 0.15; per side, find the top-most point, average the vertices within 0.2 of it to get the ball centre (y at least top.y - 0.1). Add there a SphereGeometry(0.118) with MeshPhysical color #8b62ff, emissive #6a3dff, emissiveIntensity 1.5, roughness 0.22, clearcoat 1, clearcoatRoughness 0.14, plus a glow Sprite(glowTex, color 0x9a6bff, opacity 0.85, additive, scale 0.5). ARMS: prepareModel(arm, glossy:false, useMap:false, smooth:true, tint "#1d1d23", rim {0x8a5cff, power 2.6, strength 1.05}). Make the copies BEFORE normalising: [tpl, tpl.clone(true)]. normaliseArm: scale so bbox height = 0.78, centre it, wrap in a Group. Rest poses (children of body): left: x -1.32, y -0.72, z 0.15, rotation.z -0.62, phase 0 right: x 1.32, y -0.72, z 0.15, rotation.z 0.62, phase π×0.85 FALLBACK (if a GLB fails to load): head = SphereGeometry(1) MeshPhysical #2c2c35 (roughness 0.26, clearcoat 1) with cylinder ear caps, antenna rods and violet balls plus rim shells; arms = CapsuleGeometry(0.22, 0.42) #1b1b21 with rim. The visor and eyes are still added by mountHead. Load both with Promise.allSettled, then hide the loader, set robot.scale to 0.001 and start the intro. ================================================== 6. LAYOUT (robot placement) ================================================== ResizeObserver on #hero → layout(): W, H = hero size; isMobile = W <= 860; set renderer/composer/bloom size. Desktop: robotPx = min(H×0.62, W×0.4, 640); anchor = (W×0.695, H×0.5 + 8). Mobile: copyTop = .copy top relative to the hero; room = max(copyTop - 62, 220); robotPx = min(room×0.92, W×0.82); anchor = (W/2, 62 + room×0.5). camera.position.z = (3.4 × H) / (robotPx × 2 × tan(fov/2)); camera.setViewOffset(W, H, W/2 - anchor.x, H/2 - anchor.y, W, H) (shifts the robot to the anchor without moving the camera); updateProjectionMatrix; put the loader at the anchor. ================================================== 7. INTERACTION + ANIMATION (requestAnimationFrame loop) ================================================== Pointer: listen on window for pointermove, pointerdown and touchmove (passive). target.x = clamp((clientX - anchor.x) / rx, -1.2, 1.2), target.y = clamp((clientY - anchor.y) / ry, -1.2, 1.2), with rx = max(W×0.55, 500) and ry = max(H×0.55, 400) on desktop, or W×0.5 and H×0.5 on mobile. Record the time of the last move. Idle: if there was no move for 3.5 s, target.x = sin(t×0.45)×0.45, target.y = sin(t×0.31 + 1.2)×0.2 (looks around slowly). Smoothing: look += (target - look) × (1 - 0.0025^dt), with dt capped at 0.05. Intro pop: intro goes 0→1 at dt×1.4; scale = 1 + 2.4(k-1)³ + 1.4(k-1)² (ease-out-back). m = 0.25 if prefers-reduced-motion, else 1. bob = sin(t×1.6)×0.09×m → robot.position.y. head.rotation: y = look.x×0.5, x = look.y×0.42, z = -look.x×0.06 + sin(t×1.1)×0.015×m. body.rotation: y = look.x×0.28, x = look.y×0.12. Arms, per arm: w = sin(t×2.0 + phase); position.y = restY + w×0.13×m - bob×0.35; position.x = restX + sign(restX)×look.x×-0.04; rotation.z = restRz + w×0.12×sign(restX)×m; rotation.x = sin(t×1.3 + phase)×0.08×m. Pupils: pupilWrap.position = (clamp(look.x×0.075, ±0.07), clamp(-look.y×0.06, ±0.06), 0). Blink every 2.5–6 s (random): eye scale.y goes 1 → 0.08 → 1 over 0.32 s. Floor glow follows the bob: scale (3.4 - bob×3, 0.42 - bob×0.4), opacity 0.7 + (0.09 - bob)×1.5. Antenna glow opacity = 0.7×(0.85 + sin(t×1.6)×0.15) + 0.15. Pause rendering with an IntersectionObserver when the hero is off-screen. Render with composer.render(). ================================================== 8. LOOK & FEEL CHECKLIST ================================================== - Near-black page (#0b0b11). Big bold white two-line headline "Introducing a / Smart AI Assistant" on the left, grey subline, violet pill button "Start free" with no glow. Glossy charcoal spherical robot on the right half, vertically centred. - The robot reads as polished dark-graphite plastic with smooth curved reflections, a clearly darker glossy black glass visor, two lavender-ringed violet eyes with a soft (not overpowering) glow, violet glowing antenna balls, a faint lavender edge light, a subtle violet haze behind it and a soft violet ellipse glow under it. - On ≤860px: hamburger menu, robot centred at the top, text and button centred at the bottom, no horizontal scroll down to 360px wide.

CSS (exact values) ================================================== :root { --bg:#0b0b11; --nav:#12131a; --line:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); --text:#fff; --muted:#a3a3b2; --link:#c8c8d4; --violet:#7c4dff; --violet-2:#8f66ff; --nav-h:62px; } * { box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0 } html, body { background:var(--bg); color:var(--text) } body { font-family:"Figtree", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; overflow-x:hidden } a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none } NAV .nav: position fixed, top/left/right 0, z-index 20, height var(--nav-h), background rgba(18,19,26,0.86), backdrop-filter blur(14px) (+ -webkit-), border-bottom 1px solid var(--line). .nav-inner: max-width 1344px, height 100%, margin 0 auto, padding 0 68px, flex, align-items center, justify-content space-between. .brand: flex, gap 11px, font-weight 600, 21px, letter-spacing -0.01em. .brand-orb: 26×26 circle, background radial-gradient(circle at 32% 28%, #c9b8ff 0%, #8b6cff 38%, #5b3df0 72%, #3a24b8 100%), box-shadow 0 0 14px rgba(124,77,255,.55), inset -2px -3px 6px rgba(20,8,70,.55). .nav-right: flex, align center, gap 30px. .nav-links: flex, gap 38px, 14px, weight 500, color var(--link); hover → #fff (transition color .2s). .btn-open: background #fff, color #0b0b11, weight 600, 14px, padding 10px 19px, radius 999px; hover translateY(-1px) + box-shadow 0 6px 20px rgba(255,255,255,.15). .menu-btn: display none by default; 40×40, radius 12px, background rgba(255,255,255,.06), border 1px solid var(--line). Hamburger icon = the plus ::before/::after: three 16×1.6px white bars spaced 5px apart. When .nav has class .open: span turns transparent, ::before rotates 45deg and ::after -45deg (top 0) to form an X. .mobile-panel: display none; position absolute, top calc(var(--nav-h) + 8px), left/right 16px, background rgba(20,21,30,.96), 1px border var(--line), radius 18px, padding 8px, flex-direction column, box-shadow 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5). Links: padding 14px 16px, radius 12px, weight 500, color var(--link); hover background rgba(255,255,255,.05), color #fff. .nav.open .mobile-panel → display flex. JS: clicking #menuBtn toggles .open on #nav and updates aria-expanded. HERO .hero: position relative, min-height 100vh AND 100svh, overflow hidden, isolation isolate. #stage: position absolute, inset 0, 100%×100%, display block, z-index 0, touch-action pan-y. .hero::after (z-index 1, pointer-events none, inset 0): background = repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.012) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px) (faint vertical lines) layered with radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 0%, transparent 55%, rgba(0,0,0,.45) 100%) (vignette). .hero-inner: relative, z-index 2, pointer-events none, max-width 1344px, margin 0 auto, min-height inherit, padding calc(var(--nav-h) + 40px) 68px 80px, flex column, justify-content center. .copy: max-width 600px, pointer-events auto. h1: font-size clamp(40px, 5.1vw, 70px), line-height 1.04, weight 700, letter-spacing -0.025em. .sub: margin-top 26px, color var(--muted), font-size clamp(17px, 1.65vw, 22px), line-height 1.55, weight 400. .btn-try: inline-flex centered, margin-top 36px, height 59px, padding 0 38px, radius 999px, background linear-gradient(180deg, #8f66ff, #7c4dff), color #fff, weight 600, 20px, letter-spacing -0.005em, box-shadow ONLY inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.22) (NO outer glow), transition transform .25s. Hover: translateY(-2px) + filter brightness(1.08). Reveal animation: .reveal starts opacity 0, translateY(18px), animation "rise" .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) forwards; delays .d1 .08s, .d2 .2s, .d3 .32s; @keyframes rise { to { opacity:1; transform:none } }. .loader: absolute, z-index 2, 46×46 circle, border 2px solid rgba(143,102,255,.18), border-top-color #8f66ff, spin 1s linear infinite (keyframes keep translate(-50%,-50%) and rotate 360deg), transform translate(-50%,-50%), transition opacity .5s; .hide → opacity 0. JS positions it at the robot anchor point. RESPONSIVE @media (max-width:1100px): .nav-inner and .hero-inner left/right padding 40px; .nav-links gap 26px. @media (max-width:860px): hide .nav-links; show .menu-btn (inline-flex); .nav-right gap 10px; .hero-inner justify-content flex-end, text-align center, align-items center, padding calc(var(--nav-h) + 20px) 24px 56px; .copy max-width 560px; h1 font-size clamp(36px, 9.2vw, 56px); .sub margin-top 16px; .btn-try margin-top 26px. (Text sits at the bottom, robot above it.) @media (max-width:480px): .nav-inner padding 0 16px; .hero-inner padding calc(var(--nav-h) + 16px) 16px 40px; .brand 19px; .btn-open padding 9px 15px, 13px; .btn-try height 54px, padding 0 32px, 18px. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): .reveal no animation, fully visible. ================================================== 4. THREE.JS SCENE ================================================== Renderer: WebGLRenderer({ canvas:#stage, antialias:true, powerPreference:"high-performance" }), pixelRatio min(devicePixelRatio, 2), ACESFilmicToneMapping, exposure 1.0, SRGBColorSpace. scene.background = #0b0b11. Camera: PerspectiveCamera(fov 28, near 0.1, far 100). Helper radialTexture(stops, size=256): canvas radial gradient from centre to edge with the given [offset, color] stops → CanvasTexture (SRGB). glowTex = radialTexture([[0,"rgba(160,120,255,1)"],[0.25,"rgba(124,77,255,.55)"],[0.6,"rgba(90,50,230,.12)"],[1,"rgba(60,30,200,0)"]]). Environment (a dark studio, NOT RoomEnvironment): build a separate scene with background #030305 and emissive "softboxes" made from SphereGeometry(0.5,32,16) meshes with MeshBasicMaterial(color × intensity), each scaled (w, h, 0.3) and lookAt(0,0,0): - white 5×3.2 at (-3, 4.5, 4) ×3.2 (key, top-left) - white 1.2×6 at (6, 0.5, 2) ×1.1 (strip, right) - white 3×1 at (1.5, 5, -1) ×0.8 (top) - #7c4dff 4×5 at (-5, 0, -4) ×1.0 (violet back-left) - #7c4dff 4×5 at (5, 0, -4) ×1.0 (violet back-right) - #5b30ff 6×3 at (0, -5, 1) ×0.35 (violet floor bounce) scene.environment = PMREMGenerator.fromScene(envScene, 0.02).texture; environmentIntensity 1.0. Use round softboxes (spheres), not planes, and NO point lights: both cause square bloom artifacts. Lights: HemisphereLight(0xdcd8f0, 0x1a0f3a, 2.3) + DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.55) at (-3, 4, 5). Post-processing: EffectComposer → RenderPass → UnrealBloomPass(strength 0.55, radius 0.4, threshold 0.92) → OutputPass. Resize the composer and bloom with the canvas. Fresnel rim shader rimMaterial(color, power, strength): ShaderMaterial, additive blending, transparent, depthWrite false. Vertex: pass the view-space normal and view direction. Fragment: f = pow(1 - max(dot(N, V), 0), power); gl_FragColor = vec4(color*f*strength, f). Added as a child "shell" mesh sharing each model mesh's geometry (renderOrder 2) for the lavender edge light. Rig: robot (Group: float/bob/intro scale) → body (Group: partial turn, holds the arms) → head (Group: full turn). Background haze: Sprite(glowTex, color 0x7a55ff, opacity 0.06, additive, toneMapped false, depthWrite false), scale 7.5, position (0, 0.1, -3). Floor glow: PlaneGeometry(1,1) facing the camera (NOT laid flat), MeshBasicMaterial(glowTex, color 0x8f6bff, opacity 0.95, additive, depthWrite false), position (0, -2.05, -0.6), scale (3.4, 0.42). ================================================== 5. MODEL PREP ================================================== prepareModel(root, {glossy, rim, tint, useMap, smooth}): collect the meshes FIRST into an array, then loop over it (adding children inside traverse recurses forever). If smooth: clone the geometry, delete normal/uv/uv1/tangent/color, mergeVertices(g, 1e-3), computeVertexNormals. Replace the material with MeshPhysicalMaterial: map only if useMap; color = tint; glossy → metalness 0.1, roughness 0.3, clearcoat 1.0, clearcoatRoughness 0.16, envMapIntensity 0.9; non-glossy → metalness 0, roughness 0.48, clearcoat 0.3, clearcoatRoughness 0.4, envMapIntensity 0.55. Add the rim shell if rim is given. HEAD: normaliseHead → scale so bbox depth (size.z) = 2, then position = (-centre.x, -(min.y + 1), -centre.z) so the sphere centre is at the origin. prepareModel with glossy:true, useMap:false (ignore the baked texture), tint "#4a4a56", rim {0x8a5cff, power 4.5, strength 0.32}. Then in mountHead: a) Raycast from (0,0,5) toward -Z; R = clamp(hit distance from origin, 0.85, 1.1) (sphere radius). b) sphereNormals: for every vertex whose distance from the head centre is within 7% of R, set its normal to the normalised position (converted with the mesh's inverse-transpose matrix), so reflections are perfectly smooth. c) addVisor(R): build a rounded-rectangle Shape, tessellate it (ShapeGeometry(shape, 48) → non-indexed → 3 rounds of 4-way midpoint subdivision), then wrap every vertex onto the sphere: z = sqrt(radius² - x² - y²); normals = normalised positions. - bezel: w 1.86, h 1.12, corner 0.46, centreY -0.07, radius R×1.03, MeshPhysical color #0c0c10, roughness 0.3, metalness 0.3, clearcoat 0.8, polygonOffset factor/units -6, renderOrder 3. - glass: w 1.74, h 1.0, corner 0.4, centreY -0.07, radius R×1.036, MeshPhysical color #000000, roughness 0.12, clearcoat 1, clearcoatRoughness 0.1, envMapIntensity 0.9, polygonOffset -8/-8, renderOrder 4. d) Eyes (procedural so they can track): at x = ±0.43, y = -0.08, z = sqrt((R×1.055)² - x² - y²); orient each eye group with quaternion.setFromUnitVectors((0,0,1), position.normalize()). Each eye group contains: - halo: CircleGeometry(0.42) with glowTex, color 0x8a5cff, opacity 0.24, additive, z -0.004, renderOrder 9 - ring: RingGeometry(0.168, 0.212, 64), MeshBasic color new THREE.Color(1.1, 0.88, 2.0) - iris: CircleGeometry(0.17), map = radialTexture([[0,"#d7c9ff"],[0.45,"#a07bff"],[0.8,"#7646f2"],[1,"#5c2fe0"]]), color (1.0, 0.95, 1.15), z 0.001 - pupilWrap group (moves with the cursor): pupil CircleGeometry(0.083) #07040f at z 0.003, plus a white glint CircleGeometry(0.022) at (0.032, 0.034, 0.005) - ALL eye materials: toneMapped false, depthWrite false, depthTest false, renderOrder 10, so the eyes are never hidden behind the visor glass when the head turns. e) Antenna balls: collect head-local vertices with y > 0.75 and |x| > 0.15; per side, find the top-most point, average the vertices within 0.2 of it to get the ball centre (y at least top.y - 0.1). Add there a SphereGeometry(0.118) with MeshPhysical color #8b62ff, emissive #6a3dff, emissiveIntensity 1.5, roughness 0.22, clearcoat 1, clearcoatRoughness 0.14, plus a glow Sprite(glowTex, color 0x9a6bff, opacity 0.85, additive, scale 0.5). ARMS: prepareModel(arm, glossy:false, useMap:false, smooth:true, tint "#1d1d23", rim {0x8a5cff, power 2.6, strength 1.05}). Make the copies BEFORE normalising: [tpl, tpl.clone(true)]. normaliseArm: scale so bbox height = 0.78, centre it, wrap in a Group. Rest poses (children of body): left: x -1.32, y -0.72, z 0.15, rotation.z -0.62, phase 0 right: x 1.32, y -0.72, z 0.15, rotation.z 0.62, phase π×0.85 FALLBACK (if a GLB fails to load): head = SphereGeometry(1) MeshPhysical #2c2c35 (roughness 0.26, clearcoat 1) with cylinder ear caps, antenna rods and violet balls plus rim shells; arms = CapsuleGeometry(0.22, 0.42) #1b1b21 with rim. The visor and eyes are still added by mountHead. Load both with Promise.allSettled, then hide the loader, set robot.scale to 0.001 and start the intro. ================================================== 6. LAYOUT (robot placement) ================================================== ResizeObserver on #hero → layout(): W, H = hero size; isMobile = W <= 860; set renderer/composer/bloom size. Desktop: robotPx = min(H×0.62, W×0.4, 640); anchor = (W×0.695, H×0.5 + 8). Mobile: copyTop = .copy top relative to the hero; room = max(copyTop - 62, 220); robotPx = min(room×0.92, W×0.82); anchor = (W/2, 62 + room×0.5). camera.position.z = (3.4 × H) / (robotPx × 2 × tan(fov/2)); camera.setViewOffset(W, H, W/2 - anchor.x, H/2 - anchor.y, W, H) (shifts the robot to the anchor without moving the camera); updateProjectionMatrix; put the loader at the anchor. ================================================== 7. INTERACTION + ANIMATION (requestAnimationFrame loop) ================================================== Pointer: listen on window for pointermove, pointerdown and touchmove (passive). target.x = clamp((clientX - anchor.x) / rx, -1.2, 1.2), target.y = clamp((clientY - anchor.y) / ry, -1.2, 1.2), with rx = max(W×0.55, 500) and ry = max(H×0.55, 400) on desktop, or W×0.5 and H×0.5 on mobile. Record the time of the last move. Idle: if there was no move for 3.5 s, target.x = sin(t×0.45)×0.45, target.y = sin(t×0.31 + 1.2)×0.2 (looks around slowly). Smoothing: look += (target - look) × (1 - 0.0025^dt), with dt capped at 0.05. Intro pop: intro goes 0→1 at dt×1.4; scale = 1 + 2.4(k-1)³ + 1.4(k-1)² (ease-out-back). m = 0.25 if prefers-reduced-motion, else 1. bob = sin(t×1.6)×0.09×m → robot.position.y. head.rotation: y = look.x×0.5, x = look.y×0.42, z = -look.x×0.06 + sin(t×1.1)×0.015×m. body.rotation: y = look.x×0.28, x = look.y×0.12. Arms, per arm: w = sin(t×2.0 + phase); position.y = restY + w×0.13×m - bob×0.35; position.x = restX + sign(restX)×look.x×-0.04; rotation.z = restRz + w×0.12×sign(restX)×m; rotation.x = sin(t×1.3 + phase)×0.08×m. Pupils: pupilWrap.position = (clamp(look.x×0.075, ±0.07), clamp(-look.y×0.06, ±0.06), 0). Blink every 2.5–6 s (random): eye scale.y goes 1 → 0.08 → 1 over 0.32 s. Floor glow follows the bob: scale (3.4 - bob×3, 0.42 - bob×0.4), opacity 0.7 + (0.09 - bob)×1.5. Antenna glow opacity = 0.7×(0.85 + sin(t×1.6)×0.15) + 0.15. Pause rendering with an IntersectionObserver when the hero is off-screen. Render with composer.render(). ================================================== 8. LOOK & FEEL CHECKLIST ================================================== - Near-black page (#0b0b11). Big bold white two-line headline "Introducing a / Smart AI Assistant" on the left, grey subline, violet pill button "Start free" with no glow. Glossy charcoal spherical robot on the right half, vertically centred. - The robot reads as polished dark-graphite plastic with smooth curved reflections, a clearly darker glossy black glass visor, two lavender-ringed violet eyes with a soft (not overpowering) glow, violet glowing antenna balls, a faint lavender edge light, a subtle violet haze behind it and a soft violet ellipse glow under it. - On ≤860px: hamburger menu, robot centred at the top, text and button centred at the bottom, no horizontal scroll down to 360px wide.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: RidgeAI hero

Build a single-file, full-viewport **AI app-builder landing hero** for a fictional company, **RidgeAI** ("ship real apps from a plain idea"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step.

## Look and feel

- **Background:** a full-bleed cinematic photograph of snowy alpine peaks at sunrise, with a low sun on the right, a calm blue sky across the upper half, and glowing amber circuit-like light paths tracing the dark forested valleys and converging at the bottom centre.
  - Over it sits a slow looping video of the same scene, where the light pulses through the paths and clouds drift.
  - On top of that are two screen-blended CSS layers: an amber bloom over the valleys that swells and fades (4.6s, alternate), and a soft light band that sweeps across them (6.5s).
  - A faint dark radial shade sits behind the centre copy so white text stays readable over the bright peaks.
- **Type:** **Inter** (variable, self-hosted).
  - headline 400 weight, white
  - nav ink `#2e2e2e`
  - accent amber `#ff8a12` (CTA, send button, "AI" in the logo)
  - prompt placeholder `#9389cf`
  - perk sparkles lime `#8fd61b`
- **Blueprint frame:** thin white lines (`rgba(255,255,255,.28)`) form an architectural grid over the photo:
  - two rails on each side and two horizontal rules
  - small white square handles at the intersections
  - diagonal hatching in two cells, upper-right and lower-left

## Layout (desktop)

Every size is in design units of a **1372×872 reference**, where `u = clamp(.5px, min(max(100vw/1372, .8px), 100vh/872), 2px)`.

1. **Top bar:** a white bar inset 27.8u from the sides and 20.8u from the top, 53.5u tall.
   - **Left:** an amber hexagon logo and the wordmark **Ridge**, with **AI** in amber, in Inter 600, 23.5u, with tight tracking.
   - **Centre:** the links **Product · Templates · Pricing · Changelog**.
   - **Right:** an amber **Start Climbing** button (115×29u, radius 3.4u) with a warm glow beneath it.
2. **Centre column:**
   - **Badge:** a glass pill with a sparkle icon, "Now with multi-agent app builders".
   - **Headline:** two lines at 60u / 61u line-height, **Ship Real Apps / from a Plain Idea.**
   - **Subline:** two lines at 14.9u: "Turn one sentence into a working app with auth, data, and payments. No code / to write. Describe the tool you need and RidgeAI builds, then ships."
   - **Prompt box:** white, 511×112u, radius 6u, with the placeholder "Build a booking app for a salon" and a 31u amber send button with a › chevron. It sends nothing.
   - **Perks:** three items with lime sparkle icons: No credit card required · Free plan available · Live in one click.
   - **Social proof:** five overlapping 34u circular **initial avatars** (MK, JL, AS, RT, EV, each on its own gradient, with white rings), and "Loved by 40,000 builders" under them.

## Motion

- **Entrance:** pure CSS, run once.
  - The bar drops in, then the badge settles.
  - Each headline line rises out of a clip mask, 0.13s apart.
  - The subline settles, then the prompt box with a 1.5% scale.
  - The perks, then the social-proof row, fade up last.
- **Reduced motion:** nothing animates and the still photo shows.

## Smaller screens (< 900px)

- The bar becomes a compact white bar with the logo, the Start Climbing button and a menu button that opens a white dropdown.
- The frame collapses to the two outer rails and two rules, with small hatched corner blocks.
- The copy stacks centred: the headline wraps (clamp 30–58px), the prompt box goes full width, and the perks wrap.

## Media (use these URLs)

- **Background still:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/fab71b48-e739-4ff3-b93a-232b2bb5b74f.jpg` (1920×1086 JPEG)
- **Background loop:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/d7dbb9fc-403e-411f-b640-58716b95355f.mp4` (1276×720, 5s, muted, loops, first frame = last frame). Use `object-fit: cover` and the same position as the still so the two align exactly.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- **Top:** the white bar sits at the top with the amber CTA.
- **Middle:** the blueprint grid frames the screen, and the centred headline, prompt box, perks and avatar row read clearly over the alpine scene.
- **Bottom:** the amber light paths in the valleys visibly pulse and glow, and a light band sweeps across them.
- **Content:** no real company or person names appear anywhere.

items.prompt_text:
Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Skyra AI"** in the **3D** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `skyra-ai`
- **Category:** 3D (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/skyra-ai-landing.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261017_154419_e967a732-a523-4e9d-92d5-abe97321f911.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`

# Prompt: KAIRN Alpine 26 hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a premium ski-goggle brand**, **KAIRN** (collection "Alpine 26"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is light-mode winter editorial: a full-bleed photo of a model in an all-white puffer suit and white knit beanie, seated in the snow and looking up, wearing mirrored **ice-blue goggles** that reflect glacier peaks. The background is a calm, almost studio-clean pale icy sky with only a faint low mountain ridge and light snow.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the background is ONE 16:10 photo (1728×1080): `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/18a4a3c1-2af7-4c4a-9045-f6ddff26f4ca.jpg`. `object-fit:cover`, position 50% 30% (phones: 50% 18%, then 50% 0).
- **Motion:** a 5s muted looping video of the same plate plays over it with **identical cover rules**: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/823d013d-bf03-4967-b08f-63c3752df435.mp4` (1152×720). Snow drifts across the frame, the model turns her head slightly and the goggle reflections glint.
  - Fade it in once its first frame is ready.
- **Readability:** a soft, cool navy side-shade (`rgba(22,52,84,.34)` → 0 by 55% from the left, and .2 at the far right) keeps white type readable on the pale sky.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Type and colour

- **Display:** **Anybody** (variable width), set wide (font-stretch 115–150%), for the logo, nav, headline, card titles and buttons.
- **Text:** **Inter** for small text.
- **Colours:** text white, accent **ice cyan `#44DAFD`**, cream card `#F3F1E9`, ink black.

## Layout (desktop: a measured 1546×1017 canvas scaled by --k = min(vw/1546, vh/1017))

- **Top left:** the text wordmark **"KAIRN"** at 28px, wide, with "KA" in cyan and "IRN" in white.
- **Top centre:** "COLLECTION / OUR WORLD", wide caps, 15.4px.
- **Top right:** an account icon, "BAG" and a round white counter "0".
- **Middle left:**
  - three slider dots (the first cyan)
  - the eyebrow "BUILT FOR THE WHITEST DAYS"
  - a huge wide, thin headline at about 106px: **"FORM." / "FUNCTION."**, then **"VISION"** in outline letters with a cyan stroke
- **Middle right, a 2×2 tile cluster:**
  - **Lens card** (cyan): "01 / LENS EDITION", a large bold "BLUE / FROST" and "A cooler perspective".
  - **Beside it:** "ALPINE / 26" in large wide type.
  - **Glass circle:** a frosted cool-blue circle with a ↗ arrow and "01 / 04" with a progress ring (cyan arc).
  - **Product card** (cream): the ice-blue mirrored goggles, then "MODEL 03" and "EXPLORE THE FRAME".
- **Bottom left:** a frosted navy glass story card with a skier thumbnail, "GLACIER COLLECTION" in cyan, and "Crafted for the summits. / KAIRN goggles sharpen every / view. Read more".
- **Bottom centre:** a cyan "EXPLORE COLLECTION" button sitting on a thin horizontal rule across the page.
- **Bottom right:** "FOLLOW US" and three round outline social icons (X, Facebook, Instagram), the first ringed in cyan.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** a one-time CSS entrance, about 2.2s.
  - The logo and nav settle; the dots, then the eyebrow.
  - Each headline line types up in turn.
  - The lens card, ALPINE 26, the glass circle and the product card arrive.
  - Then the story card and the button; the rule draws across; the social links fade in last.
- **Hover:** the button lightens to `#6FE3FF`.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Tablet and phone

- **Tablet:** a one-screen portrait composition: a header row, the photo, the headline, the story card with the 2×2 tiles, and the action row.
- **Phone:**
  - a viewport-height hero with the photo masked into the page
  - the nav moves into a burger menu
  - below come the 2×2 tiles, the story card and the social row

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- The pale icy hero shows the white-suited model with blue goggles in the centre, the big wide FORM / FUNCTION / VISION on the left and the cyan / cream tile cluster on the right.
- Snow visibly drifts and the goggles glint in the loop.
- **Content:** no real brand names.

items.title: Wander Far
items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Wander Far travel hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **travel-booking landing hero** for a fictional travel site: "Wander far. Rest easy." Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The design is clean, white and editorial: a huge black headline, a quiet search bar, and below them a wide cinematic photo panel of a Norwegian fjord at blue hour that comes alive with motion.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts** (self-hosted woff2):
  - Inter Display 700 for the headline (tight, about −0.035em)
  - Inter 400/500/600 for the UI
  - a small mono for the coordinate
- **Colours:**
  - **Base:** background `#FEFEFE`, headline ink `#0B0E0C`, text `#222223`, labels `#111313`
  - **Grey text:** muted `#6E7070`, lede `#727274`, hairlines `#E6E6E7`
  - **Accent:** fjord navy `#00286E` for the button, with `#0A2A72` for the field icons and the active-tab underline

## Scaling

- **Desktop:** the layout is authored at **1446×1088** with `--u = min(100vw/1446, max(100dvh/1088, .78px))`.
- **Height:** the page is exactly one viewport tall; the photo panel absorbs the spare height.

## Layout (desktop)

1. **Header row:**
   - **Left:** the headline **"Wander far. / Rest easy."** on two lines, about 90u.
   - **Right:** a right-aligned grey lede in two lines: "Find quiet fjords, cozy cabins, and the slow, wild / mornings you came for, all here in one place."
2. **Tabs:** Stays (active: semibold, with a navy underline) · Flights · Experiences, each with a thin line icon.
3. **Search bar:** one long hairline-bordered panel split into four cells.
   - **Fields:** each has a tiny caps label and a value with a navy icon. Where to? · Molde | Dates · Jun 18 – Jun 24 | Travelers · 3 travelers.
   - **Button:** a navy "Search" button with a magnifier icon.
4. **Photo panel:** full content width, filling the rest of the screen, square corners.
   - **Image:** `object-fit:cover`, centred. A 16:9 photo of a still fjord at blue hour: steep dark cliffs, low clouds clinging to the slopes, snowy peaks in the distance, a tall waterfall on the right, and a red cabin with lit windows and a small boat on the right shore, all mirrored in glassy water. Still: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/bd8d16a6-ac46-4cb8-bf0b-fb8e732ed31a.webp`.
   - **Motion:** a 5s muted looping video of the same frame plays on top with the identical cover rules: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/62b7e754-022b-4512-9b96-513173cb2e14.mp4` (1280×720). Clouds roll along the cliffs, the sky drifts, the waterfall pours and the reflections ripple. Fade it in when its first frame is ready.
   - **Label:** a small white location chip in the bottom-left corner: **"Geirangerfjord, Norge"** in semibold plus "62.10° N" in mono grey.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** a one-time CSS entrance. The headline lines rise and settle 0.14s apart, then the lede fades up, the tabs appear, the search panel slides in and the button pops last.
- **Rule:** the photo never animates in code; only the video moves.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Smaller screens

- **Layout:** stacked. The headline, then the lede, then the tabs.
- **Search:** the search fields stack vertically with a full-width navy button.
- **Photo:** the panel stays at least 240px tall, with the crop shifted right (`object-position:74%`) so the cabin and waterfall stay in view.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- The white page shows the black headline top-left and the grey lede top-right, then the tabs, the navy search bar and the wide fjord panel.
- The clouds and waterfall visibly move in the panel.
- **Content:** no brand logos.

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a personal-website builder** for a fictional product, **Eclipsio** ("Launch a Personal Brand That Outshines Every Résumé"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. It's pure black space with a total solar eclipse rising from the bottom edge: a dark sphere ringed by a blazing amber-orange corona, with solar flares curling off its rim and a few orange embers in the dark.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the eclipse is ONE 1448×1086 image: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b4b7e033-b082-4f09-8ec4-2fabca30c4b4.webp`.
  - **Composition:** the sphere fills the bottom of the frame, its rim apex about two thirds of the way down, and everything above it is black.
  - **Placement:** anchor it to the bottom of the screen at the reference height, centred, wider than the viewport if needed. It sits in its own clipped layer so it never causes sideways scroll.
- **Motion:** a 5s muted looping video of the same plate plays over it: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/48106c12-33c9-4cea-9780-4a080477405e.mp4` (1280×720). The corona boils and a large flare erupts and arcs off the rim; the sphere stays still.
  - The video is the plate mirror-padded 241/1448 on each side to 16:9. Give it the same height as the plate, **aspect-ratio 1930/1086**, centred the same way, so it lines up exactly.
  - Fade it in once it is playing.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Scaling

- **Desktop:** the layout is authored in a **1448×1086** reference with `--u = min(100vw/1448, 100dvh/1086)`.
- **Stack:** nav 124.5u · hero copy · logo strip · eclipse zone that takes the remaining height. The page is exactly one screen tall.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts:** **Inter** (variable) for everything; **Poppins 600** for the partner-logo names.
- **Colours:** black `#000`, white headline, sub-copy `#bcbcbe`, accent orange `#ee7f20` (button gradient `#f28a2a → #ec7a1c`).

## Layout (reference units)

1. **Nav** (top 34u, 37.7u tall):
   - **Logo:** a white rounded "U-n" stroke mark and "Eclipsio" at 27.8u, left 68u.
   - **Links:** Work · Showcase · Members · Journal, 16.25u, weight 600, centred, 42.6u apart.
   - **Button:** a white "Start Creating" pill, right 62u.
2. **Badge:** a dark warm-glass pill, 43.9u tall.
   - **Text:** a glowing peach dot `#f7c69b`, then "Shine Your Name Brighter Tonight" in 15.6u grey.
   - **Edge:** an orange rim lit from the lower-left, with a soft inner glow and a hairline sheen along the top.
3. **Headline:** two lines at 78.8u / 81u line-height, weight 750: **"Launch a Personal Brand That / Outshines Every Résumé"**.
4. **Subline:** 22.6u / 36u, tracking .031em: "Whether you're a designer, developer, or creator, Eclipsio will help / you glow brighter with a site that feels polished, and you."
5. **Buttons** (55.4u tall, 14u apart):
   - **"Start Creating":** a filled orange pill with a hairline white border.
   - **"View Samples":** black, with a gradient border running grey → burnt orange.
6. **Logo strip:** a frosted-glass pill, 892×56u.
   - **Glass:** a faint white gradient fill, a 1px warm border `rgba(255,190,140,.16)`, a 14px backdrop blur, and edges fading to black.
   - **Marquee:** an infinite 46s marquee of grey partner logos (Layers, Circooles, Quotient, Hourglass, Catalog), each a 34u grey icon plus its name. It pauses on hover.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** a one-time CSS sequence. The logo and nav fade in, the badge settles, each headline line rises, then the subline, the two buttons (staggered) and the logo strip.
- **Hover:** the orange button gains an orange glow, and the outline button brightens.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance, no marquee, no video.

## Phones

- **Nav:** the links collapse into a round menu button with a dropdown.
- **Copy:** the headline wraps to four lines, and the buttons sit side by side at full width.
- **Logo strip:** becomes a plain full-width soft-edged marquee (no pill).
- **Eclipse:** fills the bottom.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- The black hero matches the layout above, with the orange-rimmed badge and the orange "Start Creating" button.
- The frosted logo strip scrolls, and the eclipse below it flares and boils in motion.
- **Content:** no real brand names.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Meadowbell hero

Build a single-file **landing hero for an animated kids' farming series**, "Hollyoak's Plucky Sprout Squad", from a fictional studio, **Meadowbell**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a sunny hand-painted anime (Ghibli-like) afternoon: a boy and his beagle lie on a grassy hillside looking up at a big blue sky full of cumulus clouds, with a green valley far off on the right.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the whole scene is ONE 9:8 background image (2160×1920): `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/3ca5d10d-ea2f-4907-876f-33bde169469e.jpg`.
  - **Sky:** a deep-to-light blue sky across the top 60%, with a tall cumulus cloud on the left, another on the right, and wispy streaks top-right.
  - **Hillside:** the boy (messy brown hair, white shirt, blue shorts, hands behind his head) and a brown-and-white beagle lie at the left, looking up. Grass and wildflowers fill the bottom third, softly blurred at the very bottom.
- **Motion:** the scene moves only through a looping video of the same plate: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/d2cb5bef-f92b-4e91-ae93-8dc6555e56ac.mp4` (960×960, 5s, muted, loops; first frame = last frame).
  - The grass ripples in steady waves, daisies nod, the boy's hair and shirt flutter, the dog's ears lift, and the clouds drift right.
  - The video was rendered square from the plate mirror-padded 120/1920 at the top and bottom. Lay it over the plate at **100% width, 112.5% height, top −6.25%** so its middle sits exactly on the plate.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** the hero is **one 1440×1280 frame** (9:8) that scales with the viewport width: `--u = 100vw/1440`, height 1280u. On a 1440×900 screen the headline, buttons and the boy and dog show first, and the chapters row sits just below the fold.
- **Placement:** every element below is placed in frame units.

## Type and colour

- **Display:** **Grandstander 900**, a rounded, slightly bouncy display face, all white. It's used for the logo, the kicker, the headline and the section title.
- **Everything else:** **Inter** 400/500. Self-host the latin woff2 files.
- **Colours:** text is white with a soft blue shadow `0 4u 18u rgba(28,70,120,.28)` on the headline. Button text green is `#5b875c`.

## Layout (1440×1280 frame)

- **Nav:**
  - **Logo:** "Meadowbell" 29.5px with a small white two-leaf sprout icon, at (31, 23).
  - **Nav pill:** a translucent sage pill `rgba(173,196,174,.45)` with backdrop blur, 546×50 at (443, 13), radius 25. Inside: Farm · Gear · Chapters · Our Crew, Inter 500 19.5px, 54px apart, starting 49px in.
  - **Join us:** a white pill, 105×45 at (1311, 14), green Inter 500 18.5px.
- **Copy, centred:**
  - **Kicker:** "HOLLYOAK'S" 40.5px, cap top at y = 203.
  - **Headline:** **"PLUCKY / SPROUT SQUAD"**, 143.5px on a 118px line pitch, cap top at y = 261.
  - **Subline:** Inter 21.2px / 27px, three lines: "Learn the Ways of the Meadow with / Hollyoak's Plucky Sprout Squad! Each chapter is / packed with play, chores, and wonder."
  - **Join us button:** white pill, 144×59 at (550, 617), green 22px.
  - **Watch preview button:** translucent mint pill `rgba(204,218,173,.6)` with blur, 184×58 at (707, 619). It has a white rounded play triangle and white 19.5px text.
- **Chapters row:**
  - **Title:** "CHAPTERS" 36px at (137, 866).
  - **Link:** "browse all chapters ›" 22px, right-aligned to x = 1308.
  - **Cards:** three 378×273 cards at x = 133, 531, 929 (y = 913), radius 15, soft shadow, each with a white rounded play triangle 20px in from the bottom-left. Card art:
    - a vegetable garden with tomato stakes and a cottage: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/cd2d844f-ae3f-4fa9-8067-b077530b6e71.webp
    - a boy and dog on a hill path among sheep above the sea: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/48f5b97e-c27c-4afd-9427-eb35aebd1751.webp
    - a girl in a straw hat flying a kite on a breezy hill: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/cde5384e-ce4d-423f-925a-451b779066e0.webp

## Motion (UI only)

- **Entrance**, one Web Animations timeline, run once:
  - the logo, nav and Join us drop in
  - the kicker un-blurs
  - each headline line springs up out of a blur, 0.16s apart
  - then the subline, both buttons, the chapters title and link, and the three cards rise in turn
- **Hover:** the cards lift 8u and their art zooms to 1.05. The pills rise 2u, and the chevron nudges right.
- **Reduced motion:** no video and no transitions.

## Phones (≤ 820px)

- **Nav:** compact, with the logo and Join us.
- **Copy:** stacked and centred in flow, with the headline at 51px.
- **Chapters:** a swipeable row of cards.
- **Scene:** the 9:8 plate and video sit in one 9:8 box sized to the hero's height and shifted so the boy and dog stay in view (left 18%, translateX(−18%)).

## Acceptance check (1440×1280)

- The text, pills and cards sit at the coordinates above over the hillside scene.
- The grass visibly ripples, the boy's hair and the dog's ears move, and the clouds drift.
- The video lines up exactly with the still.
