Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Abyss Atlas"** in the **3D Viewer** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `abyss-atlas`
- **Category:** 3D Viewer (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/e2aaArea.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261020_121711_af5a7e01-30ce-401d-971c-8e38718c7e23.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"Abyss Atlas"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/e2aaArea.mp4) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.

   - 3-to-4 interactive cards or live calculator/filter controls depending on the archetype of **"Abyss Atlas"**.
   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).

# Prompt: murmur podcast hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a daily podcast** from a fictional show, **murmur** ("Daily Murmur Podcast"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The mood is calm and cinematic: blue hour seen through a rain-streaked apartment window, with a blurred city skyline in violet and pink, warm bokeh lights, and dark monstera leaves in the lower corners.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the whole background is ONE 16:10 image: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/7a7598ba-a6f8-42b4-ac39-98279dac4192.jpg`.
  - **Window:** a dark wooden window frame fills the middle and right. Its glass is covered in raindrops, with a blurred skyline behind it.
  - **Room:** a soft curtain hangs at the left, and big monstera leaves fill the lower-left and lower-right corners.
- **Motion:** the scene moves through a looping video of the same plate: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/d41b8c1d-f175-43b3-af22-7081133aa8de.mp4` (1280×720, 5s, muted, loops; first frame = last frame), with drops sliding and lights shimmering.
  - The video was rendered 16:9 from the plate mirror-padded 96/1728 on each side. Lay it at **111.11% width, left −5.556%** so its middle sits exactly on the plate.
  - **Lighting layers** (screen-blended, lighting only, never drawn objects):
    - **Bloom:** three soft radial glows over the city lights (pink, amber and periwinkle) breathe between 35% and 100% over 5.2s.
    - **Sweep:** a pale diagonal light band sweeps across the room every 7s, like headlights passing below.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** one **1440×900 frame** that covers the viewport: `--u = max(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)`, centred. Every element below is placed in frame units.

## Type and colour

- **Wordmark:** "murmur" in **Newsreader 500** (a bookish serif with moderate contrast), white, 139px, tracking +.05em, with a soft navy shadow.
- **Sans:** **Inter** 400/500. The subtitle is lavender `#dfe3fb`; the episode title is white.
- **Mono:** **IBM Plex Mono** 400 for the label, date line, About text and platform row. The label is `#b9c4ea` and the date line `#7583bd`.
- **Card:** deep navy glass `rgba(8,21,62,.84)` with an 18px blur, a 1px periwinkle border `rgba(132,146,255,.38)` and a deep shadow.

## Layout (1440×900 frame)

- **Wordmark:** "murmur", centred, x-height top at y = 133.
- **Subtitle:** "Daily Murmur Podcast", 33px, centred, at y = 225.
- **Label:** "LISTEN TO THE LATEST EPISODE", 12.6px mono, tracking .05em, centred 10px right of centre, at y = 319.
- **Player card:** 623.5×190 at (412.5, 350), radius 16.
  - **Cover:** 158×156 at (18.5, 16) inside the card, radius 7. The art is rooftop gardens over a dusk skyline, `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/6f03fd17-7c05-4c28-a079-6c53f2d397e6.webp`, with a white serif "murmur" over its lower left.
  - **Title:** "Why Cities Are Planting Forests / on Rooftops", Inter 500 20.6px on a 25.5px line, at (202.5, 33).
  - **Date line:** "Apr 25 · Daily Murmur Podcast", 11.2px mono, at y = 99.5.
  - **Waveform:** 62 thin rounded bars (1.9px) across 335×34 at (203, 138). Most are quiet; there's a tall bright burst at about 25%, softer bumps at 33% and 68%, and a colour drift from blue `#5560FF` through periwinkle `#86A2FF` to violet `#A083FF`, with a faint glow.
  - **Play button:** a 37px off-white circle with a navy play triangle at (566.5, 136.5).
- **About:** "ABOUT", 13px mono at (414, 595). Below it, four mono lines at 13.72px on a 19.3px pitch: "Every weekday morning, murmur slows the noise down to the four stories / worth carrying into your day: twenty quiet minutes of science, designs, / cities and culture, told by hosts who stay so curious about the / small things that make a city a home."
- **Platform row:** "LISTEN ON YOUR FAVORITE PODCAST PLATFORM", 11.4px mono at (414, 760). Four 21.5px round white icons start at x = 710 with an 11.7px gap: an outlined podcast mic, a sound-bars disc, a headphones disc and another bars disc. Use generic glyphs only, no real brand logos.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline.
  - The wordmark develops out of an 18px blur with a slight scale.
  - The subtitle rises, and the label's tracking tightens from .3em to .05em.
  - The card rises out of a blur, and the waveform wipes in left to right.
  - The About lines rise one by one, then the platform row.
- **Loops:** the waveform bars breathe on staggered 1.6s loops (scaleY .72↔1.08).
- **Hover:** the play button grows to 1.08 with a halo, and the icons lift 2px.
- **Reduced motion:** no video, no bloom or sweep, no breathing.

## Phones (≤ 820px)

- **Background:** the plate and video cover the screen behind everything.
- **Copy:** stacks centred: a 60–100px wordmark, the subtitle and the label.
- **Card:** compact. The cover sits beside the title and date, the waveform runs full width below, and play sits at the bottom-right.
- **Below the card:** the About block and the platform row, left-aligned.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- Every element sits at the coordinates above over the rainy-window plate.
- The loop lines up with the still, the city glow breathes, and a light band sweeps the room.
- **Content:** no real brands, logos or people.

# Prompt: Corvana AI hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for an AI copilot that runs clinic front desks** for a fictional company, **Corvana AI**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. It's bright, clean and warm: a white page, a coral accent, a pixel-art heartbeat line running behind the main button, and a strip of three tall rounded panels (a laughing patient, a check-ins chart and a patient-trust widget over a coral peony).

## Type and colour

- **Type:** a tight neo-grotesk (Inter / Inter Display style) for everything, self-hosted woff2 at 400/500/600. The headline is 500 weight with very tight tracking (about −0.045em).
- **Page:** white `#FEFEFE`, ink `#000`, nav ink `#3A3C40`, muted `#5E6064`.
- **Accents:** coral `#F8533F`, announcement coral `#FA6E5C`, data violet `#7A5CF0`, chip lavender `#F1EDFE→#E8E2FD` with violet text `#6A4CEB`.

## Scaling

- **Desktop:** the composition is authored in reference px of a **1514×1039** artboard: `--u = min(100cqw/1514, max(100svh/1039, .68px))`, centred.
- **Below 1024px wide or portrait:** the page re-flows into one locked screen with real px and a swipeable panel strip with dots.

## Layout (desktop, reference px)

1. **Announcement bar:** coral, 38px tall. "30% off for all new clinics." plus the underlined link "CLAIM THE DEAL NOW".
2. **Nav:** white, 68px, with a hairline bottom border.
   - **Left:** a blue-violet gradient "V" mark and "Corvana AI".
   - **Centre:** Care (current, bold) · Features · Clinics · Customers · Careers.
   - **Right:** a light-grey "Watch a Demo" pill.
3. **Headline:** two centred lines, about 72u, **"The AI Copilot Made For Calmer / Clinical Coordination"**.
4. **Subline:** about 22.4u / 31u, two lines: "From first check-in to aftercare reminders, take over routine tasks / and paperwork while giving every patient a warm welcome."
5. **Main button:** a 233×71.5u glass ring (translucent white, hairline border, soft drop shadow) around a black pill, "Start Your Trial", 22u.
6. **Heartbeat field:** behind the button, a pixel ECG trace spans the whole 1514u width.
   - **Pixels:** 6.2u squares on a 9.6u grid, coral `#F8533F` with lighter `#FB7565` baseline dots.
   - **Shape:** the baseline sits 9u below the button centre. Four heartbeats at −462, −225, +231 and +468u from centre each have a small P bump, a Q dip, a tall R spike (≈60u up), an S drop (≈47u down) and a T bump. Draw every spike as a vertical pixel staircase.
   - **Ends:** the baseline thins to sparse dots and fades toward both ends.
7. **Panel strip:** 1313.5×429.5u, radius 16, three columns 436.5 / 425.5 / 436.5u with 7.5u gaps.
   - **Patient panel:** a laughing older woman with wavy silver hair, gold hoops and a coral knit sweater, on a smooth **mint-green → pale sky-blue studio gradient**.
     - Still: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/c43c6772-ae79-45f3-a2ff-90a401f03b48.webp
     - Loop on top: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/39c69b84-0ac5-485f-ae42-3bd7d521989e.mp4` (960×960, 5s, muted, loops; first = last frame). She laughs, her shoulders shake, and her hair sways.
     - The loop is the portrait mirror-padded 47/1208 on each side to a square. Lay it at **107.78% width, left −3.89%, full height** over the 1208:1302 portrait frame so it aligns exactly. Fade it in once it is playing.
   - **Metric panel:** `#EAEAEA` with a white 339×316u card.
     - **Text:** "Check-ins Completed" with a › button, "18.7" (50u, 600) with a small "K", and a lavender chip "+21.3%" followed by "vs Prior Week".
     - **Chart:** a violet line `#7A5CF0` and a coral line `#F8533F` rise left to right. The coral end has a filled dot with a soft ring, the violet end has a ringed dot, there's a grey drop line, and a row of grey tick marks runs along the bottom.
   - **Peony panel:** a macro of ruffled coral peony petals filling the whole panel: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b6730025-6d74-465e-8978-f9909c47095a.webp.
     - **Trust card:** a frosted 292×241u card, "Patient Trust Rating", "98%" (44.5u, 400), a symmetric violet bar-wave meter and "Wonderful".
     - **Avatars card:** a white 66.5u card below it, with three overlapping rounded-square avatars, "62K+" and "Clinicians Onboarded".

## Motion

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline behind an `entry-pending` class, with a failsafe.
  - The bar text, the logo, the nav links (55ms stagger) and the demo pill rise in.
  - Each headline line wipes up out of a clip mask, then the subline.
  - The glass ring fades in and the black button rises.
  - The metric card and the right stack rise. The chart ticks fade, the two lines draw in with stroke-dashoffset, then the dots pop, and the bar-wave opens from the centre.
- **Heartbeat trace:** loops forever. Each pixel has `--t` = its x-fraction, and a 3.2s linear animation delayed by `--t`. A bright head sweeps left → right like a monitor, and pixels settle to 58% opacity behind it.
- **Hover:** the black button lifts 1px with a deeper shadow, and the › button gets a grey disc.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance, no sweep, no video.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- **Above the strip:** the coral bar, the nav, the two-line headline, the subline and the glass-ringed black button. The heartbeat line runs edge to edge through the button row, with four spikes and a moving bright trace.
- **Panel strip:** the woman laughs in motion on the mint-to-sky gradient, the chart has coral and violet lines, and the peony panel holds the trust card and the avatars card.
- **Content:** no real company names anywhere.

# Prompt: Skyprompt hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for an online course on AI image generation** for a fictional school, **Skyprompt** ("Prompt-to-Pixel Art, No Cost!"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. It's bright, playful and airy: a floating grassy island with a waterfall hangs in a clear blue sky above a bank of clouds, and a fan of four art cards rests on the island.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the whole scene is ONE background image, a 1440×900 composition: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/dc4ac5c7-4eee-48ab-814c-cbba3c9fd1b7.jpg`.
  - **Sky:** a clear blue gradient, deeper at the top (#3195e0 → #49a9f3).
  - **Island:** one small floating island, centred, its grassy top at about y = 560, with a waterfall falling from its underside into the clouds.
  - **Clouds:** fluffy clouds along the bottom edge and the lower corners.
- **Motion:** the scene moves only through a looping video of that same plate: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/81764d30-8120-4ab5-8491-4dd852b82496.mp4` (1280×720, 5s, muted, loops; first frame = last frame).
  - It shows the waterfall flowing, small yellow butterflies fluttering across the sky, a larger butterfly passing, the clouds drifting and the grass swaying. The island itself never moves.
  - The video was rendered 16:9 from the plate mirror-extended 96/1728 on each side. Lay it over the plate at **111.11% of the frame width, left −5.556%**, so its middle sits exactly on the plate.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** everything sits in one **1440×900 frame** sized by `--u = max(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)`. The frame covers the viewport, centred horizontally and anchored to the top, and every element below is placed in frame units.
- **Nav:** pinned to the viewport edges with its own fit unit, `--n = clamp(.62px, min(100vw/1440, 100vh/900), 1.6px)`.

## Type and colour

- **Headline:** DM Serif Display 400, white, with a 1.1u white text-stroke for weight.
- **Everything else:** Poppins 400/600/700. Self-host the latin woff2 files.
- **Labels:** Poppins **700**, letter-spacing −.015 to −.02em, dark ink `#161c08`, set on a **rough yellow highlighter swipe**: an SVG brush shape with jagged edges, filled `#f6f03b`, stretched behind the text, plus a soft `drop-shadow(0 0 1.5u rgba(246,240,59,.75))` paint bleed. Never use clean boxes.

## Layout (1440×900 frame coordinates)

- **Nav:**
  - **Logo:** a white six-petal flower, 44×44 at (118, 22).
  - **Links:** Story · Study Plan · Showcase · Classroom · Q&A, white, 17px, centred at y = 44, 35.5px apart.
  - **X button:** a 50px translucent white circle, 283 from the right.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Reelmark hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a short-form video creator marketplace**, **Reelmark** ("Captivate Crowds with Snackable Reels"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is soft mint studio: a warm off-white page `#F5F8EF`, deep forest-green accents `#08482D`, a mint badge `#DAE7C7`, a big bold black headline, and an arched row of seven tall video cards playing bright sage-green product clips, with hand-drawn green notes and arrows.

## Frame

- **Frame:** one **1440×1080** frame, contained and centred: `--u = min(100vw/1440, 100vh/1080)`. Every element is placed in frame units.

## Type

- **Headline:** **Inter Tight 700**, 88u on a 92u line, tracking −0.035em (−0.022em on line 2), ink `#101410`.
- **UI:** **Inter** 400/500. The subline is `#5E5E61`.
- **Notes:** **Caveat 600** for the hand-drawn notes, in forest green.

## Layout (1440×1080)

- **Top bar:**
  - **Logo:** a green leaf mark with "Reelmark", at (37, 36).
  - **Nav:** Brands · Creators · Pricing · Use Cases · Contact, Inter 16.4u, starting at x = 505 with a 31u gap.
  - **Buttons:** a white "Log in" pill, 92×40 at (1211, 29), and a forest-green "Sign up" pill, 97×40 at (1304, 29).
- **Badge:** a mint pill, 292×37 at (575, 115): "Trusted by 120,000+ indie makers", Inter 500 16.6u in green.
- **Headline:** centred, top 176: **"Captivate Crowds / with Snackable Reels"**.
- **Subline:** centred, top 394, 20.8u / 32u, three lines: "Grow your brand with short, snappy product clips by / our handpicked video makers. Our crew is ready to / lift your next launch higher."
- **Notes:**
  - a "//" doodle at (263, 377)
  - a handwritten "Be seen / with clips" rotated 16° at (1212, 310), with a long curving arrow down to the cards
  - "Zero cost" rotated 24° at (521, 937), with a small arrow pointing to the button
  - the doodle strokes draw themselves in
  - the "Be seen" arrow starts **below** the note (it never crosses the words) and curls down to the cards
- **Card row: a curved video carousel.** Ten tall cards scroll continuously **right → left** (about 50u per second, looping seamlessly). The row is draggable with the pointer or touch: it follows the drag 1:1, coasts with momentum after release (velocity decays about 95% per second), then the slow auto-scroll carries on. The cursor is grab / grabbing.
  - **Curve:** each card's geometry comes from its x position relative to the centre, like the inside of a cylinder.
    - Normalised distance d = |x − 720| / 706.
    - Width = (170 + 48·d²)u. Cards sit on an even 196u pitch, then each centre is pushed outward: x = 720 + t·(1 + 0.083·(t/706)²), where t is the unpushed offset from the centre. This keeps about a 26u gap even at the edges.
    - Each vertical edge's height = (280 + 92·q^2.6)u, where q is that edge's own normalised distance.
    - The vertical centre sits at (687 − 12·d²)u.
  - **Result:** centre cards are upright 170×280 rectangles, and cards near the screen edges grow to about 370u tall with their outer edge taller than the inner edge.
  - **Drawing:** each card is a rounded quad (`clip-path: path()`, 15u corners) recomputed every frame.
  - **Details:** no drop shadow, a small frosted round play icon at each card's bottom-left, and cards clipped by the frame edges.
- **Button:** a forest-green "Make a Reel" pill (172×58) inside a dashed green outline ring (190×74) at (626, 901).

## Card media (one video for all ten)

- **Grid:** all card clips live in ONE 16:9 **5×2 grid** (10 tiles of 384×540, edge to edge):
  - **Still poster:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b7ebb74a-8c8a-4f7e-8f80-55e2d74ecd05.webp`
  - **Loop:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/04fd3d5f-99d7-476e-98a4-46c08518ffb3.mp4` (1280×720, 5s, muted, loops)
- **Tiles** (row-major) are the sneaker, skincare splash, latte pour, headphones, plant shop, florist bouquet, pottery wheel, serum splash, latte top-down and headphones on a stand. Each tile animates on its own.
- **Each card:** shows its own tile, cover-fitted. Inside the clipped card, place a `<video>` and a poster layer sized 5 × tile width by 2 × tile height, offset to that tile, where the tile height is max(card height, card width / 0.7111).
- **Sync:** every card uses the same src, so it downloads once. Keep all ten on the same timestamp, and fade each in when its first frame is ready.
- **Clock:** drive the carousel from a long-running Web Animations clock (`document.documentElement.animate(…, {duration: 1e9})`) so the scroll is time-based.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** a one-time Web Animations sequence.
  - The nav drops in, the badge pops, each headline line rises out of a blur, then the subline.
  - The card row rises in, the button scales in, the doodle strokes draw, and the notes fade in.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Phones (≤ 820px)

- **Top:** the logo and a Sign up pill.
- **Copy:** stacked and centred: the badge, the headline (clamp 38–56px) and the subline.
- **Cards:** the same auto-scrolling, draggable curved carousel, scaled to the screen width (640-unit scale), in a 250px-tall band.
- **Bottom:** the button and the "Zero cost" note.

## Acceptance check (1440×1080)

- The headline sits centred above the arched card row, matching the coordinates above.
- The card row keeps drifting left and can be flung by dragging.
- Each card plays a different clip in motion, and the edge cards are taller and lean like the inside of a cylinder.
- **Content:** no real brand logos.

# Prompt: Gridwork Co create-account hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **create-account onboarding hero** for a fictional freelance marketplace, **Gridwork Co**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is fresh and botanical: a large photo card of a young woman tending plants in a bright glass greenhouse on the left, and a clean off-white form on the right asking "What tools do you use?", with sage and forest-green accents.

## Media

- **Photo:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/61db05ee-e08b-47b7-8ab6-541c5c510237.jpg` (1356×1528). A woman with dark hair in a low bun, a cream knit sweater and an olive apron, working with leafy plants in a sunlit greenhouse with hanging plants.
- **Motion:** a muted 10s loop of the same shot plays over the photo with identical cover rules: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/221f7a06-5ecc-40b6-9ece-26f1f982db64.mp4` (1020×1150).
  - The camera dollies in and orbits around her until she faces the lens, while her hands lift and part the leaves and the hanging plants sway. The clip plays forward then reversed, so it loops without a jump.
  - Fade it in (0.8s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Rule:** nothing in the photo is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.

## Scale

- **Units:** every size is in reference pixels of a 1447×1087 artboard, multiplied by `--u = clamp(.7px, min(100vw/1447, 100vh/1087), 2.4px)`.
- **Grid:** the shell fills the viewport. Columns are `minmax(0,1fr)` for the photo and `max(508.7u, 45%)` for the form. Padding is 11.5u top, 15.7u bottom and 15.6u left, so the photo card keeps an even margin to the edges.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** **Inter** 400/500/600/700 everywhere.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#FDFEFD`
  - ink `#101A20`; secondary text `#6E767C`, `#8A9196`
  - lines `#DCE0DD`
  - forest green `#1F4D37` (wordmark, log-in link) and `#1D4A35` (selected border and check)
  - button `#20513A`, hover `#2A6247`
  - sage tint `#ECF2EC` for selected cards

## Photo card (left)

- **Shape:** fills the left column. Top-left corner square; the other corners have a 24u radius. Photo `object-fit:cover`, position 50% 22%.
- **Tile pattern** in the top-left corner, on a 61u grid (4×4 cells):
  - six frosted tiles (61u, radius 15u, `rgba(255,255,255,.5)` with an 8u blur) at column/row (2,0), (3,1), (0,2), (2,2), (1,3) and (3,3)
  - page-coloured cut-outs: cell (0,0) and the rounded notches along the card edge, so the pattern reads as squares punched out of the corner
- **Bottom glass:** a 360u band with a 22u backdrop blur and a forest tint gradient (0 → .30 → .22), masked in from transparent.
- **Testimonial:** white, 40u side padding.
  - Quote: Inter 500, 31.35u on 45.5u, max 772u wide: "I landed multiple paid projects within a couple of days–way more traction than I ever got elsewhere. Definitely my go-to freelance platform now!"
  - Name "Sofia Hernández" (600, 20.5u) and role "Garden Designer, Portland, OR" (500, 16.25u).
  - Two 59u round outline arrow buttons (white 1.5u circle and arrow) at the bottom right, 31u apart.

## Form (right)

- **Column:** 432u wide, centred vertically and horizontally.
- **Wordmark:** a two-leaf mark (dark and mid forest green, with a thin pale vein) and "Gridwork Co" in Inter 600, 24u, forest green.
- **Heading:** "What tools do you use?" in Inter 700, 26u, tracking −.65u, 50.5u below the wordmark. Below it, "We’ll connect you with the best jobs." (17.15u, grey).
- **Tool grid:** 2×3, 34u below the subline, gaps 19u × 18u. Each card is 130.5u tall, radius 11u, with a 1u inset line. Contents:
  - a 41u app icon tile, the tool name (600, 16.75u) and the domain (400, 16.75u, grey) with an external-link icon
  - a 20u round checkbox at the top right
- **The six tools use their real app icons:**
  - **Figma:** the five-colour mark on dark `#1E1E1E`
  - **Framer:** the white glyph on black
  - **Adobe XD:** pink `#FF61F6` "Xd" on plum `#470137`
  - **Webflow:** the white W on blue `#146EF5`

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Lumora "Cadet Skyranger" interactive 3D hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **interactive character hero** for a fictional 3D studio, **Lumora**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a cinematic space poster: a glossy Pixar-quality 3D cartoon boy cadet in a chunky white, orange and teal space suit rises from the bottom of the screen in front of a glowing orange planet horizon in deep navy space. A huge glowing italic headline floats above him.

The star of the page is the interaction:
- **Head follows the cursor:** his head and eyes turn to follow the mouse, left to right.
- **Helmet:** clicking the red **PUSH ME** button on his chest closes a glass bubble helmet over his head.
- **Cursor:** a ring cursor with a dot replaces the pointer.

## Media

- **Plate:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/a194141a-44ba-44bb-8372-e6720af994ca.jpg` (1920×1080). The cadet looks straight ahead: messy auburn hair, freckles, big hazel eyes, a white suit with orange shoulders and a teal chest panel, and a collar ring around his neck. Behind him is a curved orange-gold planet horizon under deep navy space.
- **Head-turn clip:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e1b48476-24ab-456a-bb12-13e63bc60973.mp4` (580×600, 5.04s, 24fps, muted, a keyframe every 4 frames for fast seeking).
  - It's a crop of the same scene around his head: frame 0 looks toward the left of the screen, the last frame toward the right, and his head turns at an even speed in between.
  - It is **never played**: the cursor scrubs it.
- **Helmet:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e8c78660-4497-41b9-82ae-a4738a5edd11.jpg` (960×958). A clear glass bubble dome with white and soft-blue reflections on pure black, blended with `mix-blend-mode: screen` so only the glass shows.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn in code. The head moves only through the clip, and the helmet is the image.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** one **1440×810 (16:9) frame** that covers the viewport: `--u = max(100vw/1440, 100vh/810)`, centred with `left: calc(50% - 720u)` and `top: calc(50% - 405u)`. Don't use a transform, so fixed-position elements still pin to the screen on phones.
- **Placement:** every element below is in frame units. The plate fills the frame.

## Type and colour

- **Headline:** **Archivo** Black Italic (variable, wdth 94%, weight 900), 100u, tracking −.02em, white, with a three-layer glow: white 14u, pale blue 34u, blue 70u.
- **Sans:** **Urbanist** 600/700 for everything else.
- **Colours:** text white; muted text `#CDD2E6`; page `#02040D`.

## Layout (1440×810 frame)

- **Logo:** a 35u round gradient disc (cyan → blue → violet → pink, conic) and "Lumora" (Urbanist 600, 29.5u), at (55, 54).
- **Menu:** three 25u white bars at the top right, at (1358, 55).
- **Copy block**, centred, top 122:
  - eyebrow "CADET", Urbanist 700, 18u, tracking .46em, muted
  - headline "SKYRANGER" (cap box about 402–1042 × 166–236)
  - subtitle "Past the Stars and Further", Urbanist 600, 23u, muted, 9u below
- **Captions:** "3D Interaction" bottom-left at (55, 745) and "@studio.design" bottom-right, Urbanist 700, 12.2u.
- **Head clip:** placed at (510, 255), 435×450, `object-fit: fill`. It has a soft radial mask (`ellipse 50% 50% at 50% 46%`, solid to 72%, clear at 99%) so its edges melt into the plate.
  - It starts hidden and fades in (0.6s) on its first seek.
- **Helmet:** 360×360 at (533, 288), hidden at first. A bottom mask (solid to 76%, clear at 92%) tucks it behind the collar ring.
- **PUSH ME button:** a real `<button>` laid exactly over the printed one on his chest. It's a 75u circle at (675, 720) with a glossy red radial gradient, a dark 4u ring plus a faint white outer ring, and "PUSH / ME" in Urbanist 700 at 16.5u.

## Interaction

- **Loading the clip:** fetch the whole clip as a blob and use an object URL as its source, so every seek is instant. Streamed seeks wait on the network and lag. Fall back to the URL if the fetch fails.
- **Head follow:**
  - Map the pointer's x across the frame (14% to 86%) to the clip time 0 → end.
  - Each animation frame, ease the shown time toward the target (×0.14) and set `currentTime` whenever it's not already seeking.
  - After 3.5s without movement, the gaze drifts slowly side to side on its own (a sine around the middle, ±32% of the clip).
- **Cursor:**
  - On fine pointers, hide the system cursor over the stage.
  - A 7px white dot sits exactly on the pointer, and a 44px ring (1.5px white border) eases after it (×0.55 per frame).
- **Helmet:**
  - Clicking PUSH ME presses it (scale .88 and back, 320ms) and toggles the dome.
  - The dome drops from −70u above with a slight overshoot and fades in over 720ms; it reverses to remove it.
  - While on, the button glows red and has `aria-pressed="true"`.
- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline, about 1.8s.
  - The logo and menu drop in, then the eyebrow's tracking tightens from .9em.
  - The headline rises out of a 14px blur, then the subtitle and captions follow.
  - The button pops in last.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no head clip; the plate stays.

## Phones (≤ 820px)

- **Background:** the frame still covers the screen, so the cadet fills the lower part.
- **Header:** the logo and menu are pinned to the top corners.
- **Copy:** centred near the top: a 40–64px headline, 14px eyebrow and 16px subtitle.
- **Captions:** pinned to the bottom corners.

## Acceptance check (1440×810)

- The cadet sits centred in front of the glowing orange horizon, with the glowing "SKYRANGER" headline above him.
- Moving the mouse from the far left to the far right turns his head and eyes smoothly from left to right, with no seam around the head.
- Clicking PUSH ME drops a clear glass helmet over his head, and clicking again lifts it off.
- **Content:** no real brands, logos or existing characters.

The look is warm and cinematic: a full-bleed upward view between golden glass skyscrapers at sunset fills the page. A big white headline sits over the photo on the left, and a clean white log-in card with amber accents fills the right side.

## Media

# Prompt: Lauberhorn Ridge trail dashboard hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **hiking trail guide dashboard hero** for a fictional alpine trail, **Lauberhorn Ridge** (above Interlaken, Switzerland), seen by a signed-in hiker, **Mira Holt**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a bright autumn travel app: a full-bleed photo of a golden larch valley with a turquoise lake under snowy peaks, and soft cream glass widgets floating over it.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the whole background is ONE 16:10 photo (1728×1080), stretched to the frame: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4e84f7cd-8250-48e6-8dfa-746b13b73bfb.jpg`.
  - Golden larch forest on both slopes, a turquoise glacial lake winding into the valley, snow-capped peaks and a clear blue sky at the top.
- **Motion:** a muted looping drone shot of the same valley plays over it: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/48d4c209-86b6-4b1c-b972-4f57e3dafe89.mp4` (1280×720, 10s, loops seamlessly because it plays forward then reversed). The camera glides forward over the larches toward the lake, with a slow push-in and slight parallax.
  - The video was rendered 16:9 from the plate mirror-padded 96/1728 on each side. Lay it at **111.11% width, left −5.556%** so its middle sits exactly on the plate.
  - Fade it in (0.8s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** one **1440×900 frame** that covers the viewport: `--u = max(100vw/1440, 100vh/900)`, centred. Every element below is placed in frame units.

## Type and colour

- **Sans:** **Inter Tight** 300/400. The trail title is Inter Tight 300.
- **Mono:** **JetBrains Mono** 500, uppercase, tracking .06em, for labels, chips, tabs and values. Card labels start with a tight "::" prefix.
- **Colours:**
  - card cream glass `rgba(244,240,233,.94)` with a 14px backdrop blur
  - inner panels `#EAE6DE`
  - ink `#2E2D2A`
  - amber `#F6B733` and light amber `#FBD06A`
  - orange pin `#F59E0B`, violet pin `#7C6CF2`
- **Shadows:** no drop shadows on cards or the photo. Only a faint text shadow on the white title and breadcrumb.

## Layout (1440×900 frame)

- **Logo tile:** 41×38 cream tile at (15, 14), radius 12, with a six-spoke asterisk glyph.
- **User pill:** at (62, 14), 38 tall, radius 12: "::", then "Mira Holt" (18px) and a small orange ring (status dot).
- **Breadcrumb:** white mono at 12.6px, not uppercase, at (15, 73): "Back to Explore  Switzerland / Interlaken / Jungfrau Region /".
- **Title:** "Lauberhorn Ridge", white, Inter Tight 300, 96px, tracking −.045em, at (20, 86).
- **Chips:** at (15, 198), 32 tall, peach `rgba(248,232,205,.92)`, radius 9, 14px mono:
  - "4.7 (198 REVIEWS)" with an orange star disc
  - "ALPINE LARCH FORESTS" with an orange mountain glyph
- **Search card:** 359×137 at (15, 462).
  - "Hey, Mira!" at 25px.
  - "Interlaken, Switzerland ˄" at 14.5px.
  - A 37-tall panel field: "SEARCH BY ANYTHING" with a magnifier at the right.
- **Points of interest card:** 358×215 at (15, 612).
  - Label "::POINTS OF INTEREST".
  - A topographic map fills it: 16 thin wavy contour lines `#c9c5bc`, and a dark winding route that climbs to a sharp peak near the right.
  - A violet pin with a white mountain glyph marks the start; an orange pin marks the summit.
- **Photo card:** 336×215 at (383, 612), radius 16, cover-filled with a hiker in an orange jacket and backpack looking over the larch valley and lake: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/8097efdf-745f-4a23-8b33-0bed6ee16bc7.jpg` (position 72% 50%).
  - Bottom-left: a 38px white play button, then a light amber chip "211 Photos" (sans 14px) with a photo icon.
- **Altitude card:** 387×215 at (728, 612).
  - Label "::ALTITUDE". Top right: "TOTAL GAIN" with two small legend dots, "● HIKE" (amber) and "● DESCENT" (grey).
  - A line chart with a baseline:
    - the hiked part is a thick dark line that rises steeply then levels out
    - the rest is a grey dotted line that slopes down, with amber dots at waypoints
    - small mono axis labels: "0 km", "1,25 km", "2,800 m"
  - A panel tab bar at the bottom: "SLOPES", "ALTITUDE" (active, light amber with a mountain glyph), "SEASONS" (snowflake) and "TYPES". Tabs switch on click.
- **Weather card:** 303×380 at (1126, 12). Label "::WEATHER".
  - **Gauge panel**, 242 tall:
    - a centred "ENTIRE TRAIL" pill
    - a thick semicircle arc with a gradient from `#E7E1D3` through `#F8C44C` to `#F6B12A`, white knobs at both ends, and a thin white progress arc inside it
    - a big "19°" (74px) in the middle
    - "-3°" left, "Sunny" centre, ". 20°" right
  - **Two tiles:** "WIND" (orange disc) "14 km/h" and "SUNSET" (light amber disc) "17:52", values in mono 18.5px.
- **Trail info card:** 303×425 at (1126, 402). Label "::TRAIL INFO". Three 118-tall stacked panels, each with an amber-tint icon square, a big value and a caption:
  - "6.5 km", DISTANCE
  - "2.5-3 hr", DURATION
  - "350 m", ELEVATION GAIN

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline, about 2.8s.
  - The logo and user pill drop in; the breadcrumb fades.
  - The title rises out of a 10px blur; the chips follow.
  - The weather and trail info cards slide in from the right, staggered.
  - The bottom cards rise up in turn (search, points of interest, photo, altitude).
  - The gauge's white progress arc draws; the map route and the hiked chart line draw on.
  - The temperature counts up from 0° to 19°.
- **Hover:** the play button grows to 1.08.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Phones (≤ 820px)

- **Hero:** the photo and video fill the top 62% of the screen.
- **Header:** the logo and user pill share the first row, then the breadcrumb, a 46–64px title and the chips wrapped over the photo.
- **Cards:** below, full width and stacked: search, points of interest, photo, altitude, weather and trail info.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- Every widget sits at the coordinates above over the golden larch valley.
- The drone glide visibly moves the camera and loops without a jump.
- **Content:** no real brands, logos or people.

Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Particle Self"** in the **Scroll-Driven 3D** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `particle-self`
- **Category:** Scroll-Driven 3D (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/oraciteslArea.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261022_044718_d7559ffb-718c-4fc8-a360-4e025c44cca7.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Halden Stories interactive map hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **interactive storytelling map hero** for a fictional climate publication, **Halden Stories** ("Discover stories across North America"). Use plain HTML, CSS, inline SVG and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a light "field notes" atlas: a thin ink-line vector map of North America on warm off-white paper, small terracotta dots, monospace labels and a bold sans headline. Hovering a region fills it with a moving photo, and clicking opens a horizontal, draggable slider of coloured story cards.

## Media

- **Landscape grid photo:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/1571669e-4604-4c0d-9e0d-5e50b819d55d.jpg` (2336×1744). One image holding a 3×2 grid of six landscape photos separated by white gutters. The cell edges are columns 0–766, 786–1551, 1571–2336 and rows 0–862, 880–1744.
  - **Top row:** a California reservoir with a dam; Midwest crop circles from the air; a solar farm in pine forest by a river.
  - **Bottom row:** offshore wind turbines and a lighthouse at sunrise; a hydro dam in autumn boreal forest in Québec; a spare cell (wind turbines over forest, unused).
- **Grid video:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/efc53bc3-598a-4b28-b2a1-e72355301bac.mp4` (1664×1244, 4s, muted, loops seamlessly). The same grid with motion inside every cell: clouds and reflections, wheat, glints across the panels, turbines spinning, water pouring through the dam.
  - The last second crossfades into the first, so it loops without a jump and never plays in reverse.
  - Its cells sit at columns 0–545, 558–1104, 1117–1663 and rows 0–615, 626–1243.
- **People:** one photo per story, each a 3:2 documentary portrait in plain workwear (no logos):
  - Midwest: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/a72ef465-56f3-46e7-b441-8628db42c855.jpg`
  - Canada: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/39c763e2-0cef-4ad2-ae51-fa174d35220d.jpg`
  - West: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/91ef8d93-34e6-4167-93f5-db69e2be5c22.jpg`
  - South: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b28bb368-0471-49a1-bb89-82fbd7898009.jpg`
  - Northeast: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/eb40a5b6-4553-4d6a-8681-5dc064fbfbc4.jpg`
- **How photos are drawn:** one hidden `<video>` (not `display:none`) plays the grid. Every photo on the page is a `<canvas>` that draws its cell from that video each frame with cover-crop maths. Use the still grid image until the video has data.
- **Rule:** nothing in the photos is drawn or animated in code. All motion inside them comes from the video.

## The map (real vector geography, inline SVG)

- **Source data:** generate the paths at build time from public data, not by tracing:
  - us-atlas `states-10m` (US states)
  - world-atlas `countries-10m` (Canada)
  - Natural Earth 50m lakes (Great Lakes, Winnipeg, Great Slave, Great Bear, Athabasca, Reindeer, Nipigon, Mistassini, Smallwood, Great Salt Lake and others)
- **Projection:** Lambert conformal conic (standard parallels 29.5° and 45.5°, central meridian 106°W). It's fitted by least squares to a 1440×810 frame so that, for example:
  - the Washington/BC coast sits at about (539, 343)
  - San Diego at (539, 600)
  - the tip of Florida at (1009, 733)
  - eastern Maine at (1107, 402)
- **Lines:** simplify every path to about 0.35px and drop islands smaller than 1.6px.
- **What is drawn:** 1.4px ink lines (`#1C1A17`, round joins, `vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke`):
  - Canada's coast, including the Arctic islands and Hudson Bay
  - the US outline (lower 48 plus the Alaska coast)
  - the borders between the four US Census regions: **West, Midwest, South, Northeast**. Merge states by dropping any arc shared by two states of the same region.
  - the lake shores
- **Cleanups:**
  - Drop the duplicate Canada/US border lines, and the straight Alaska–Yukon line.
  - Mask the country lines out of the lakes (a black-filled, 3.2px-stroked lake mask).
- **Clip shapes:** each region (and Canada) also exists as a clip path (`clipPathUnits="objectBoundingBox"`, scaled 1/1440 × 1/810), so an HTML layer can be clipped to the exact shape.
- **Entrance:** the lines draw themselves (`pathLength="1"`, stroke-dashoffset 1 → 0 over 1.7s, staggered).

## Frame and scaling

- **Frame:** one **1440×810 (16:9)** frame, scaled to fit the viewport and centred.
- **Overflow:** the map and story layer bleed past the frame to the screen edges, so there are never bands.

## Type and colour

- **Colours:** paper `#F6F3EA`, ink `#1C1A17`, secondary text `#3B3731`, terracotta `#C35933`.
- **Headline:** **Source Sans 3** 700, 54px on a 50px line, tracking −.022em. Card body text: Source Sans 3 400.
- **Mono:** **IBM Plex Mono** 400/500/600 for the eyebrow, paragraph, coordinates, zone list, card labels and city names.

## Map view (1440×810)

- **Intro block** at (60, 219):
  - eyebrow "HALDEN STORIES" (11px, tracking .24em)
  - headline "Discover **stories** / across North / America", with "stories" in terracotta
  - a four-line mono paragraph at 13.2px on a 24px line: "Five regions, five people cutting / carbon where they live and work. / Hover a zone to look closer, then / open the story behind it."
- **Coordinates:** top right, two mono lines at 10.2px: the active zone's lat/long, then a fixed "48° 21' 36" N, 100° 27' 12" W".
- **Zone list:** right side. "CHOOSE ZONE" at y = 443, then a right-aligned mono list at 25px on a 45px line: Midwest, Canada, West, South, Northeast. The active zone is terracotta.
  - Beside the list, a 230px vertical ruler with fine ticks. A terracotta marker slides along it to the active name.
- **Dots** (16px terracotta, with a pulsing soft halo):
  - Canada (668, 238), West (599, 492), Midwest (808, 482), South (814, 626), Northeast (1022, 463).
- **Active zone** (Midwest by default):
  - **Photo fill:** its photo fills the region shape, fading in over 650ms. The others fade out over 450ms.
  - **Ring:** its dot becomes a 62px off-white disc with a plus. Around it, "DISCOVER STORIES · DISCOVER STORIES ·" runs on a 45px-radius circle (`textLength` fitted to the circumference) and spins every 14s. The ring pops in with an expo ease.
- **Interaction:**
  - **Hover:** hovering a region, a dot or a list name activates that zone.
  - **Click:** clicking any of them opens its story.

## Story view

- **Transition** (1.25s, quintic in-out):
  - The map slides 520px left.
  - A story layer slides in from the right and stops beside a 72px paper strip, which shows a slice of the map lines and a "‹ Back" button.
- **Slider:** five stories in a row. Each story is a full-height **landscape photo panel** (0.74 × height) followed by a **colour card** (0.69 × height).
  - **Card contents:**
    - a "01 —— 05" counter with a progress line
    - the person photo inset at the top
    - "FIGHTING CLIMATE CHANGE", then the city in Plex Mono 600 at 42px, then a two-line body
    - the region's own outline faintly in the bottom right
    - a spinning "Discover stories" badge with a plus
  - **Card colours:**
    - Midwest (Des Moines): cobalt `#2F55D4`
    - Canada (Québec): ink `#23201C`
    - West (Sacramento): terracotta `#C35933`
    - South (Austin): forest `#1F4A35`
    - Northeast (Portland): mustard `#D99A2B` with ink text
  - **Entrance:** the card's photo wipes up while scaling down from 1.25, and its text rises in a stagger.
- **Dragging:**
  - Drag the track with the pointer. It rubber-bands at the ends, has momentum, and snaps to the nearest story with an expo ease over 900ms.
  - Photos parallax slightly inside their panels.
  - On fine pointers, the cursor over the track becomes an 80px cream disc reading "‹ DRAG ›", which shrinks while pressed.
  - Arrow keys move between stories. Esc or "‹ Back" returns to the map.
- **Timing:** all motion runs on the page's own clock (a long Web Animation's currentTime), so the scene can be recorded frame by frame.

## Phones and portrait tablets

- **Layout:** no frame scaling.
- **Intro:** at the top, over a paper fade.
- **Map:** scaled to fit the middle.
- **Zones:** a row of pill chips at the bottom that scrolls to the active one.
- **Stories:** full width, with the photo at the top 42% and the card below.

## Acceptance check (1440×810)

- The map lines match real geography and draw in on load.
- Hovering West, then South, fills each region with its moving photo, and the ring, list highlight, ruler marker and coordinates follow.
- Clicking South slides into the Austin story. Dragging left snaps to Portland, and Back returns to the map.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

# Prompt: ZENTRADE FAQ page

Build a single-file **FAQ page for a fictional online trading platform, ZENTRADE**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is dark and premium: a near-black page with a soft green glow and stepped green light bars at the top, frosted-glass navigation, a big bold headline, a glass search bar, four pill-shaped category cards and a smooth one-at-a-time accordion.

## Scale

- **Units:** every desktop size is in reference pixels of a 1778px-wide page, multiplied by `--u = 100vw / 1778` (capped at 2200px wide).
- **Tablet (768–1199px):** a fixed `--u = .82px` with a reflowed layout.
- **Phone (under 768px):** a fixed `--u = .8px` with one column.
- **Content column:** 1224u, centred.

## Type and colour

- **Figtree:** 800 for the headline, 400/500/600 for the UI and body.
- **Lexend 300:** the search field only.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#090909`
  - lime `#83F34D` with dark lime text `#0B2400`
  - cards `#1B1B1B`, icon rings `#232323`
  - accordion rows `#131313`
  - rules `#2F2F2F`
  - muted text white at 82%

## Background (CSS only, static)

- **Glow:** a central radial green glow (740u × 950u, centred 92u from the top) that fades from `#1D2E13` to the page colour.
- **Light bars:** a 655u-tall top layer with five stepped vertical light bars on each side. Each fades from green (`#2A4B1B` → `#1D2F14`) to transparent, and the bars step down in height towards the centre (430, 360, 288, 216 and 156u) and are about 80–98u wide.
- **Top spill:** a faint green light spill along the top edge.

## Navigation (58u tall, 22u from the top)

- **Left:**
  - an angled white "Z" mark (51 × 26u) drawn as one SVG path: a top bar, a diagonal and a bottom bar, with slanted ends
  - "ZENTRADE" in Figtree 500 at 26.4u
- **Centre:** a frosted-glass pill (54u tall, radius 13u, 18u blur, white border at 14%) with "About Us · Accounts · Partnerships · FAQs" at 17u. Links glow faint lime on hover.
- **Right:**
  - a glass language selector (138 × 47u): a round US flag, "English" and a chevron
  - a 101u outline "Login" button with a lime border
  - a 142u lime "Trade Now" button with dark text
  - buttons are 58u tall with a 12u radius

## Hero (centred, 177u below the nav)

- **Tag:** a pill "FAQ" (97 × 52u) of green-tinted glass with a pale green 1.3u border.
- **Headline:** "Frequently Asked Questions", Figtree 800, 62.8u on a 75u line.
- **Lede:** two lines at 17u on a 28u line: "Find answers to the most common questions about ZENTRADE’s platforms, / accounts, deposits, trading conditions, and more."
- **Button:** a white "Join Our Community" button (221 × 50u, radius 11u).

## FAQ area (1224u column)

- **Search:** a glass bar 79u below the hero (74u tall, fully rounded, white at 16% with a 24u blur). A magnifier icon, then "Search for your queries" in Lexend 300.
  - **Focus:** a lime border and a soft lime ring.
  - **Filtering:** typing filters the questions by question and answer text. "No questions match your search." appears when nothing matches.
- **Categories:** a 2×2 grid, 59u below the search, with 23u × 25u gaps.
  - **Each card:** fully rounded, 129u tall, `#1B1B1B`, with a 99u round icon disc holding a white glyph:
    - money bag
    - candlesticks
    - target
    - trending-up arrow
  - **Card text:** title (Figtree 500, 23.2u) and "62 Articles" (16.6u, muted).
  - **Titles:** About Zen Trade · Trading Rules & Guidelines · Zen Trade Challenge Insight · Zen Trade Features.
  - **Hover:** the border tints lime.
- **Accordion:** 58u below the cards. Five rows, 22u apart.

# Prompt: Vantix footer ("Cobalt Flare")

Build a single-file **website footer** for a fictional creative agency, **Vantix**. Use plain HTML, CSS, inline SVG and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a deep-navy footer under a glowing electric cobalt and cyan aurora band. A thin blue arc runs through a glowing glass ring, and a big vertical cyan wordmark stands between two hairline dividers, with link columns, a "Book a call" call to action and social icons.

## Media

- **Glow plate:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4a917d4c-123f-4b68-8125-b201961b7791.jpg` (2240×843). A smooth cobalt-to-cyan light field across the top that fades into dark navy.
- **Motion:** a muted 4s loop over the plate: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/a8f60da5-538f-403a-a812-6be0f098e319.mp4` (1600×600).
  - The aurora ribbons flow, ripple and curl across the band while the light drifts sideways.
  - The last second crossfades into the first, so it loops without a jump and never plays in reverse.
  - It fades in (0.9s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Rule:** nothing in the glow is drawn or animated in code. Only the UI animates.

## Scale

- **Units:** desktop is a 1326 × 1186 reference composition, with 1 unit = `--u = min(100cqw/1326, clamp(1px, 100cqw/2200, 1.16px), 100vh/1186)`. The footer always fits one screen; type keeps readable floors.
- **Framing:** content sits in a centred 1326u frame (offset `--x0`). The glow, arc and dashed rule stay full-bleed.

## Colours and type

- **Colours:**
  - page `#00071A`
  - text white; links `#AFCAF3`; copyright `#B3CCEF`
  - accent cyan `#2EF0FD`
  - dividers and the dashed rule `#2A74E8` at about 40%
- **Sky:** above the glow image (on tall screens) the background is a horizontal gradient taken from the plate's top row: `#2A70F9 → #0C40D2 → #126FF3 → #57E3FC → #64E4FC`.
- **Font:** Inter Display 300/400/500.

## Layout (reference units)

- **Glow box:** the top 558u, `preserveAspectRatio="none"` across the full width. The plate and the video share it, and both are masked so their bottom 18% fades into the page.
- **Arc:** a thin arc (1.6px, gradient `#2A6DFC → #3FD0FF`) sweeps from (0, 143) down through about (816, 386) and up to (1326, 334).
- **Ring:** r = 78 at (780.7, 351.5). A glass disc with a dark inner radial fill and a 2.4px rim graded from blue at the bottom-left to bright cyan `#8AF0FF` at the top-right. A soft 5px blurred copy of the rim sits under it as a glow.
- **Wordmark:** "Vantix", bold geometric sans (Plus Jakarta Sans 700), drawn as one vector path, reading bottom to top.
  - Its cap height is 88.5u, its baseline is at x = 667.5u, and its bottom is aligned at y = 901.7u.
  - It's filled with a vertical gradient `#1DB6FC → #44F4FD → #19DAFD`.
  - The two vertical hairlines at x = 473 and 762 fade in from the top.
- **Left:**
  - "Elevate your brand with / us and experience the / difference." (500, 29u) at (72, 589)
  - a 76u cyan ring with a cyan ↗ arrow, then "Book a call" (30u, cyan, underlined) at (73, 741)
- **Right:** "Important" (Services, Portfolio, Pricing, About, Reviews) at x = 859 and "Legal" (Terms & conditions, Privacy policy, Contact us) at x = 1078. Headings are 28u/500; links are 21.6u/300 on a 58.75u row.
- **Bottom:**
  - a full-width dashed rule at y = 964
  - "Follow us" at (72, 1025)
  - five 45u round icons (X, Instagram, LinkedIn, Dribbble, Behance): dark blue glass with a thin blue ring and cyan glyphs
  - "Copyright © 2024 - All rights reserved" (15u, light) aligned right at y = 1099

## Motion

- **Entrance:** one CSS sequence with backwards fill, about 1.6s.
  - The wordmark wipes up out of a clip.
  - The headline rises out of a clip.
  - The two link columns and the CTA rise in turn.
  - The social row and the copyright fade in.
- **Hover:**
  - the CTA ring fills faint cyan and its arrow turns 45°, while the underline retracts
  - links turn cyan
  - icons lift 3u
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Tablet and phone (below 960px, portrait or touch)

- **One-screen grid:** the glow band on top takes the spare height, with the plate cropped to its bottom.
- **Wordmark:** horizontal and full width, rising out of the glow, with a rule just under it.
- **Main block:** headline and CTA, then the link columns. On phones they stack below the headline.
- **Bottom:** the social row, then the copyright.

## Acceptance check (1440×1152)

- The aurora visibly flows behind the arc and ring.
- The cyan "Vantix" stands vertically between the hairlines.
- Every accent (CTA, icons, wordmark) is cyan; there are no drop shadows.
- **Content:** no real brands except the generic social glyphs.

# Prompt: Capabilities — amber "Clarity across every layer" section

Build a single-file **capabilities section** for an infrastructure-monitoring product. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is near-black and technical: a mono context strip, a big tight headline with one glowing amber word, and three glass cards, each with a glowing amber holographic wireframe object.

## Scale

- **Units:** measured on an 826×552 artboard. Every length is N × `--u`, where `--u` is the largest uniform "contain" scale, but never under 1px per artboard pixel on narrow, short screens.
- **Spare space:** goes into flexible gaps or taller cards, never letterbox bands.

## Type and colour

- **Page:** `#050505`, with two faint vertical hairline guides at the thirds (white at 3%).
- **Fonts:** **Geist** (variable) for text, **JetBrains Mono** for the top strip.
- **Strip:** 7.2u mono caps, tracking .275em, white at 44%. Left, "01" with a short rule after it; centre "// Capabilities"; right "Full Visibility".
- **Headline:** "Clarity across every layer". Geist at about weight 473, 47.3u, tracking −.05em. "Clarity" is filled with an amber gradient (`#FFC24A` → `#E9931E` → `#A85A0C`).
- **Lede:** "A unified view of your infrastructure. Detect patterns, anticipate issues, and optimize performance before problems arise.", 13.4u at about weight 290, white at 64%.

## Cards

- **Grid:** three columns 16u apart, each card at least 273u tall, radius 4u.
- **Glass:** fill white at 2.1%, a 1u hairline border (slightly brighter on top), a 14px backdrop blur, and a soft amber radial glow (`rgba(190,112,22,.2)` fading out over 135u).
- **Stage** (170u, top of the card) holds the icon. Each icon is an image of a glowing amber wireframe object on pure black, shown with `mix-blend-mode:screen` and a soft radial mask, so only the glow shows:
  1. **Real-Time Signals:** concentric radar rings around a glowing orb, with a small dot on the outer ring.
  2. **Actionable Insights:** thin glowing bar-chart cylinders beside two overlapping wireframe spheres, with three short dashes above.
  3. **Automated Reporting:** a stack of translucent glowing document sheets with text lines.
- **Body:** a 15u title (white at 96%) and two lines at 10.5u (white at 58%):
  1. "Stay ahead with live system data and continuous performance tracking across all nodes."
  2. "Turn complex data into clear decisions with instant, intelligent analysis."
  3. "Generate structured reports that reveal system health at a glance."

## Motion

- **Entrance:** one master Web Animations timeline with backwards fill, run once.
  - The strip items rise, and the rule after "01" draws.
  - The headline rises inside a fixed mask, and "Clarity" fades up.
  - The lede settles.
  - The cards rise in reading order. Each icon performs once: the radar pops in from 72%, the chart wipes up, and the report sheets wipe in from the left.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance.

## Tablet and phone

- **Tablet:** cards become stacked horizontal panels with the icon on the left.
- **Phone:** stacked cards; the top strip keeps one line.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The amber "Clarity" headline sits over three dark glass cards with glowing amber holographic icons.
- There are no visible black squares behind the icons.
- No brands.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Rovin "Chrome Orbit" footer

Build a single-file, one-screen **footer for a fictional travel-money app, Rovin**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is near-black with a huge glossy chrome sphere of stacked rings lit with ice-blue rim light. The sphere fills the lower right. Above it is a giant two-tone headline, footer link columns sit on the left, and three small frosted-glass feature cards float over the sphere.

## Media

- **Art:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/6e8f5228-3a76-453d-a3de-610a8f8cfc09.webp` (1596×986). A black chrome, ribbed sphere seen from below-left, with electric blue light along its ridges, on black. It fills the whole frame and is anchored bottom right.

## Scale

- **Frame:** one 1596×986 frame, with `--u = min(100vw / 1596, 100vh / 986)`.
- **Tablet and portrait (under 1024px):** a stacked layout with the art behind.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts:**
  - **Golos Text** (400–900): the headline
  - **Reddit Sans** 400/600: the UI
- **Colours:**
  - page `#111`
  - body text `rgb(212,212,212)`
  - card text `rgb(214,226,246)`
  - card fill `rgba(20,30,52,.62)`, with borders `#3A5EA8` and `#2F4F8F`
  - badge `rgba(28,44,78,.7)`

## Layout (1596 frame)

- **Headline:** "Your Passport to see / the World", centred at the top, about 104u.
  - Line 1 is a white-to-pale-blue gradient.
  - Line 2 is a muted slate-blue gradient.
- **Link columns** (left, about 40% down):
  - "Legal": Privacy Policy, Terms of Service
  - "Our Address": 14 Quay Street, Leith / EH6 6LX, UK
  - "Rovin": Travel Cards, Global Wallets
- **Certification:** below the columns, "We are certified by:" and "The Payment Card Industry / Data Security Standard". Under it, a glass badge with a blue shield icon and "SECURE / CERTIFIED".
- **Feature cards** (over the sphere's right flank): three small glass cards with an icon and two lines each, slightly rotated and offset like a loose stack:
  - "Global Physical and / Virtual Cards" (card icon)
  - "Local and / International payment" (arrow icon)
  - "Travel and Lifestyle / friendly features" (check icon)

## Motion

- **Entrance:** a one-time sequence of about 1.8s:
  - the headline unveils with a clip-and-rise
  - the link columns settle in from below
  - the three cards arrive with a small tilt in a stagger
  - the trust badge reveals last
- **Hover:**
  - Links brighten.
  - Cards lift and straighten slightly, and their border brightens.
  - The badge border glows blue.
- **Reduced motion:** static.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The chrome sphere glows blue in the lower right under the giant two-tone headline.
- The links and badge read cleanly on the left, and the three glass cards float over the sphere without covering the headline.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Synthora AI hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for an AI solutions company**, **Synthora**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a black page with a futuristic rounded display font, a centred headline, and a blazing molten-orange solar ring rising from the bottom edge.

## Media

- **Glow plate:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/7e2a7695-c32b-4179-9c90-cae865819272.jpg` (1663×940). A pure-black field with a burning ring arching up from the bottom centre: a white-gold edge, fiery orange plasma with crackling filaments, a dark interior, drifting embers and thin vertical orange light streaks. The top half is pure black.
- **Motion:** a muted 4s loop of the same ring, laid over the plate with identical sizing: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/6ad9485f-ab40-444b-bd3c-40dcb9bd0e2f.mp4`.
  - The flares lick around the ring, embers rise, and the camera pushes in slowly.
  - The last second crossfades into the first, so it never plays in reverse.
  - Fade it in (0.8s) once its first frame is ready.
- **Rule:** nothing in the glow is drawn or animated in code.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** **Anta** (rounded futuristic display) for everything, weight 400.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#000`, text white, button text `#030103`
  - badge glass `rgba(220,110,40,.16)`, Watch Demo glass `rgba(255,150,70,.2)`
  - sun icon `#FAD53E`
  - a floor gradient under the glow, from `rgb(255,150,40)` at the bottom through deep ember to black

## Layout

- **Units:** a reference stage of 894×541 scaled by `--p = min(100vw/894, 100svh/541)`. The glow is pinned to the bottom (906×515p), the nav is pinned to the top, and the content floats in the middle.
- **Nav:** a round white logo mark with a four-point sparkle cut-out, then "Synthora" at 23.8p. Centre links: Start · Features · Resources · Help · Pricing (10.7p). Right: "Log in" with a user icon.
- **Badge:** an ember-glass pill holding a white "New" chip, "Simple Pricing" and a small yellow sun.
- **Headline:** "Empowering businesses with / practical AI solutions" at 38p on a 47p line.
- **Subline:** "We help teams design, develop and launch intelligent products with reliable infrastructure / and real-world impact." at 10.7p.
- **Buttons:**
  - a white "Start Free" pill
  - an ember-glass "Watch Demo" pill with a play icon
  - Hover: Start Free gets an orange glow, and Watch Demo's glass deepens.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations sequence, about 1.9s.
  - The logo, links and login fade in.
  - The badge opens from its centre.
  - The headline wipes up out of a clip.
  - The subline, then each button rises.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Phones and tablets

- **Fluid layout:** a top bar with the logo and a round glass burger that opens a dark ember glass dropdown menu.
- **Content:** centred, with type set by clamp().
- **Glow:** scaled up and anchored to the bottom.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The black page has the centred white headline.
- The burning orange ring rises from the bottom edge, and its flames and embers visibly move.
- **Content:** no real brands.

# Prompt: Shipcraft CTA and footer

Build a single-file **closing CTA plus footer section** for a fictional app builder, **Shipcraft**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is near-black and warm:
- a tilted 3D editor panel glowing amber on the right
- a glossy amber-glass CTA button
- a four-part footer
- two white marble sculpture hands reaching toward each other, lit with an amber rim light
- a giant thin amber-brown "Shipcraft" wordmark sinking off the bottom edge

## Media (transparent PNGs)

- **Editor panel:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/5bc1d856-0342-40d4-b7ca-c490ac20624a.png` (912×700). A perspective-tilted dark glass editor with a "Widget Tree" column, where "Home Screen" is selected in amber, and a "Code" column with amber, peach, lilac and teal syntax. It has a glowing amber top edge and fades out at the bottom and left.
- **Left hand:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4c029f38-d0a0-46d1-9ebc-3edcdaa11fc1.png` (582×290).
- **Right hand:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/7eba3f06-a99e-44b8-bd46-7ccfaf6b2363.png` (558×328).
- **Hands:** both are polished white Carrara marble with grey veins and a warm amber rim light, reaching in from the left and right edges.
- **Motion:** no video. Only the UI animates.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** Google Sans Flex (variable) for everything.
- **Colours:**
  - background `#0D0D0D`, headline white
  - text greys `#ADADAD`, `#7D7D7D` and `#717171`
  - amber accent `#F0A24C`, social icons `#E0A165`
  - wordmark `#5A3418`
- **Pill:** a dark `#1D1510` pill with an amber hairline and a sparkle icon.
- **Buttons:** glossy amber-glass. The CTA goes from a `#2C241D` to `#7A5832` gradient, with lit white and amber rims and a soft amber halo. The newsletter key has a warm metal gradient.

## Layout (787×753 reference artboard at 900px and wider; `--u` = container width / 787)

- **CTA band:**
  - pill "Ship Your Idea", then "Your next app / starts now."
  - "Describe it, shape it in the canvas or code, ship it to the App Store, Play Store, or web. No install, no credit card."
  - "Get started now"
  - the editor panel bleeding off the top-right
- **Footer:**
  - **Brand:** an original amber sail mark and "shipcraft", the blurb "Shipcraft keeps every surface in sync, / so you never rebuild from scratch.", and LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube outline icons.
  - **Columns:** Product (Preview, Features, How it works, Developers), Resources (Blog, Documentation, Videos, Community), Company (Contact, Privacy, Terms of Service).
  - **Newsletter:** "Subscribe to our newsletter", a glass email field with placeholder "jane@shipcraft.example" and an arrow key, and "Unsubscribe anytime".
  - **Bottom:** "©2026 / Shipcraft / Build a real app, fast." centred between the reaching hands, with the giant "Shipcraft" wordmark at the bottom.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** a CSS sequence.
  - The pill fades, then the headline lines rise.
  - The paragraph, button and editor (scale/tilt in) follow, then the footer columns.
- **Reduced motion:** none.

## Narrower screens

- **Below 900px:** a single column with the editor under the CTA.
- **Footer columns:** wrap.
- **Hands and wordmark:** scale to the bottom of the section.

## Acceptance check (1440×1440)

- The amber-lit editor panel tilts on the right of the headline.
- The marble hands reach toward each other over "©2026 Shipcraft".
- The amber-brown "Shipcraft" wordmark sits at the bottom.
- **Content:** no real brands; the placeholder email is a .example address.

items.title: Mindora Hero
items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Mindora mental-health hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **hero for a fictional AI mental-health app, Mindora**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is "forest quiet": a pale sage page washed with soft sunlit fern shadows, a calm serif headline, a dark moss pill button, and three frosted-glass health cards that each hold a photo of a person resting in a sunlit forest.

## Media

- **Background:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/91ff1b55-9dec-43eb-8da7-329815e2f52a.webp`. A pale sage wash with blurred fern fronds and dappled light at the left and right edges, and an empty, soft centre for the copy. It covers the whole page.
- **Card photos** (1214×1295 each, cover-fitted):
  - Sleep: a woman with closed eyes, resting in warm forest light. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/765542c8-b963-46be-9449-d9c5536889c1.webp`
  - Biomarkers: a man in an olive tee among ferns. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/ccb0662a-dc37-4d0f-9120-244a0e16cd7b.webp`
  - HRV: a woman with her head tilted back, eyes closed, breathing in sunlight. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/dd81f02a-0640-48db-9d47-868c0810b4cd.webp`
- **Fallback:** keep a soft green gradient behind each photo until it loads.

## Scale

- **Units:** every desktop size is in reference pixels of a 1440px frame, multiplied by `--u = max(min(100cqw / 1440, 100svh / 1032), 100cqw / 1440 × .72)`, so the hero always fits one screen.
- **Tablet and portrait:** under 900px wide, or any portrait ratio, the cards reflow into a scrollable row.
- **Phone:** under 560px, `--u` is 1px and the cards stack in one column.

## Type and colour

- **Fonts:**
  - **Brygada 1918:** the headline
  - **Poppins:** body and UI
  - **Urbanist:** the card numbers and labels
- **Colours:**
  - ink `#28311F`
  - button `#2C3A22`
  - page `#EEF0E4`
  - bars: a pale green gradient `#A9D18E`

## Layout (1440 frame)

- **Nav:**
  - Left: a small sun mark (a circle with eight short rays, drawn in SVG) and "Mindora".
  - Centre: "Home · About Us · Benefit · Community".
  - Right: a dark moss "Contact Us ↗" pill.
- **Headline:** "Smarter Mental Health, / Powered by AI", centred, Brygada 1918 at about 52u.
- **Sub:** two lines in Poppins: "Get instant mental health insights, personalized advice, and / virtual care, anytime, anywhere."
- **Button:** a dark pill, "Get Started Today ↗".
- **Cards:** three cards along the bottom, about 330 × 360u with a 24u radius and 34u gaps. Each card is a frosted-glass frame (blur, a faint green tint and a thin white inner border) around its photo.
  - **Sleep:** "Sleep", seven thin white percentage bars with day letters (64, 74, 57, 78, 68, 56, 65%), and the note "Your HRV was within the typical range (35 – 40)".
  - **Biomarkers:** a glass chip reading "10.8 g/dl", "BORDERLINE LOW", "Ferritin · Blood Iron".
  - **HRV:** a translucent white area chart (37, 36, 29, 35, 27, 45, 40) with day letters and the same range note.
  - **HRV photo crop:** anchor it at 50% 8% so the head is never cropped.

## Motion

- **Entrance:** a one-time Web Animations sequence of about 1.6s. It runs once the fonts are ready, with a failsafe.
  - The nav fades down.
  - The headline lines rise and unblur.
  - The sub, then the button.
  - The three cards rise in a 120ms stagger.
  - The sleep bars grow from zero, and the HRV line draws in.
- **Hover:**
  - Cards lift 4u and the glass brightens slightly.
  - Buttons lift 1px and the arrow nudges.
- **Reduced motion:** everything is static.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The serif headline sits centred in the soft fern-shadow light.
- Three glass cards with forest portraits sit along the bottom with even side margins, and no faces are cropped.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

items.title: TOKA
items.prompt_text:
Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"TOKA"** in the **Creative Studio** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `toka-hero`
- **Category:** Creative Studio (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/toka-hero.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261023_011743_129b8f4d-d2ed-4a71-b9a7-8fa026ca8d8c.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#F8F7F4`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#EFECE6`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#141413`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(20,20,19,0.10)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"TOKA"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/toka-hero.mp4) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"TOKA"** (Creative Studio) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.
3. **Interactive Bento / Feature Architecture:**
   - 3-to-4 interactive cards or live calculator/filter controls depending on the archetype of **"TOKA"**.
   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).
