items.title: Maya Lind Profile
items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Maya Lind profile page (bento)

Build a single-file **personal profile page for a product designer** with a short intro and a bento grid of live cards. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is calm and editorial: warm light grey, off-white rounded cards with hairline borders and soft shadows, tight neo-grotesk type, and one orange accent. Every card has a small piece of quiet, real UI motion.

## Fit: never cropped

- **Stage:** the whole page is drawn on one **1440×960** stage. It's scaled with `transform: scale(min(100vw/1440, 100vh/960))` and centred in a fixed full-window viewport. The intro and the complete grid are always fully visible, with even margins, on any desktop window.
- **Narrow screens (≤820px):** the stage becomes a normal column (intro, then the cards stacked full width) and the page scrolls.

## Media

All photos are generated and contain no logos.

- **Avatar (440×440):** a woman with dark tied-back hair in a black jacket, on a flat orange backdrop. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/60582a62-dbab-4bc1-9169-07db0fcb51b1.jpg`
- **Album cover (500×500):** a single pink gerbera on a soft pink ground. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/ed0c3ef0-5a75-4933-9f3c-6afbea39e2ec.jpg`
- **Book (503×700):** a red hardcover, "THE PATIENT BUILDER / ADA MARSH", on white. It's shown with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` so the white drops out on the card. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b820bd2c-7312-4ac3-8162-76f6d97d4de4.jpg`
- **Football photo (960×645):** a coach kneeling with a ball among kids in red kits on a pitch. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/9f4e5ca0-844d-4c0a-8665-5cc5024e3281.jpg`
- **Map (960×645):** a very light grey street map of Lisbon with the estuary. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4f3be2d6-3848-493b-b3d7-5880dac21a63.jpg`

## Type and colour

- **Type:** Inter (variable, self-hosted).
  - Headline 39.5px / 46px, weight 520, tracking −0.021em.
  - Bio 20.5px / 31px.
  - Card titles 15.5–29px; chips 12.5px.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#EEECE8`, cards `#F5F3EF`, hairlines black at 7%
  - ink `#1E1C1A`, secondary `#77736E`, muted `#A7A39D`
  - chips `#E9E6E1`, orange `#EE6A1F`, green `#3BC45E`, dark segment `#2A2624`

## Layout (stage pixels)

- **Avatar:** 145px square at (136, 82), radius 11.
- **Headline** at (321, 92), 900px wide: "Hi I’m Maya Lind — I’m a Product Designer at / Fieldnote." followed by " Previously at Orbit." in the muted colour.
- **Bio** at (321, 203), 790px wide, two lines: "I am a seasoned product designer with 5 years of experience specializing in / crafting creative tools solutions and empowering creatives."
- **Voice-note pill** at (321, 287), 495×53, fully rounded, a white-ish fill with a hairline border:
  - a 29px orange round play/pause button
  - 78 waveform bars, 2px wide, with seeded heights and two loud bursts
  - a timer, right-aligned
- **"Available for Work" pill** at (841, 287), 174×53: a green dot with a pulsing halo.
- **Grid:** cards with radius 14, gaps of 17px, outer margins of 76px.
  - **Row 1** (top 390, height 258): Experience 370px · What I’m listening 513px · What I’m reading 371px.
  - **Row 2** (top 665, height 242): Map 370px · Photo 330px · How I work 554px.
- **Chips:** each card has a small rounded label at its top left (line icon plus text): "Experience", "What I’m listening", "What I’m reading", "Map", "How I work".

## Cards

- **Experience:** a vertical timeline with a 1.5px dark line, 8.5px dots, a title at 15.5px and the years in muted grey.
  - Items: Studio Kettle & Co (2020 – 2023), Product Designer (2020 – 2023), Freelance (2023), Orbit — Design Lead (2018 – 2020), Fieldnote — Product Designer (2023 – now), Speaker, Form Conf (2024).
  - The list is doubled and drifts upward at 9px/s, inside a top/bottom fade mask, as a seamless loop.
- **What I’m listening:**
  - Album 165×173 on the left.
  - "SLOW BLOOM" at 18px weight 500 and "Juno Vale" in muted grey.
  - A 243px progress bar (3.5px) with a dark fill and an mm:ss time that advances from 00:34 through a 3:12 track.
  - Prev / play-pause / next and a volume icon; play-pause toggles.
- **What I’m reading:** "The Patient Builder" at 25.5px / 35px, "Ada Marsh" in muted grey, and the book at the right, tilted 5° and bleeding to the bottom edge.
- **Map:** the map fills the card with an 11px inset, radius 9. "Lisbon" sits centred at 27px in grey, with a small "Lisbon" label at the bottom left.
- **Photo:** the football photo inset 11px, with a white pill at the bottom left reading "I love teaching football" with a small orange ball icon.
- **How I work:** a title at 29px, a body at 15px, and a 40px segmented control (Step 01–04) with a dark sliding pill.
  - Steps:
    1. **"01 Discovery Call":** We will make a 30 minutes free consultation so that I can get to learn about your specific needs and come up with a plan.
    2. **"02 Strategy & Scope":** Together we turn what we learned into goals, a clear scope and a timeline, so everyone knows what success looks like.
    3. **"03 Design Sprint":** I explore, prototype and test in focused weekly cycles, sharing progress often so feedback lands early.
    4. **"04 Handoff & Support":** You get polished files, specs and a walkthrough for your team, plus a month of support after launch.
  - It auto-advances every 1.9s, with a 0.42s cubic ease. The pill slides, the outgoing text rises out and the incoming text rises in. Clicking a step holds it for 6s.

## Motion: one clock

- **Clock:** all motion reads one clock, the `currentTime` of a long Web Animation on a hidden element, inside a single `requestAnimationFrame` loop. A frame-by-frame recorder that pauses and seeks Web Animations therefore captures it exactly.
- **Entrance:** each block rises 14px and fades in over 0.7s with a cubic ease, staggered 80ms in DOM order.
- **Voice note:** it starts at 1.3s and plays for 32s.
  - The button shows pause, and the timer counts from 0:00.
  - Bars left of the playhead turn dark, and bars near the playhead gently bounce (scaleY up to +55%).
  - The button toggles play and pause.
- **Available dot:** a halo scales from 1 to 2.4 and fades out every 1.8s.
- **Cards:** on hover they lift 3px with a deeper shadow.
- **Reduced motion:** everything is shown settled and static.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The intro and all six cards are fully visible, with even margins; nothing is cropped.
- Within 6.5 seconds:
  - the page rises in
  - the voice note plays with a moving playhead
  - the song time ticks
  - the experience list drifts
  - How I work changes from 01 to 02 to 03
- **Content:** no real brands, people or logos.

sections.title: Maya Lind Profile — Master Specification
sections.content:
# Prompt: Maya Lind profile page (bento)

Build a single-file **personal profile page for a product designer** with a short intro and a bento grid of live cards. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is calm and editorial: warm light grey, off-white rounded cards with hairline borders and soft shadows, tight neo-grotesk type, and one orange accent. Every card has a small piece of quiet, real UI motion.

## Fit: never cropped

- **Stage:** the whole page is drawn on one **1440×960** stage. It's scaled with `transform: scale(min(100vw/1440, 100vh/960))` and centred in a fixed full-window viewport. The intro and the complete grid are always fully visible, with even margins, on any desktop window.
- **Narrow screens (≤820px):** the stage becomes a normal column (intro, then the cards stacked full width) and the page scrolls.

## Media

All photos are generated and contain no logos.

- **Avatar (440×440):** a woman with dark tied-back hair in a black jacket, on a flat orange backdrop. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/60582a62-dbab-4bc1-9169-07db0fcb51b1.jpg`
- **Album cover (500×500):** a single pink gerbera on a soft pink ground. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/ed0c3ef0-5a75-4933-9f3c-6afbea39e2ec.jpg`
- **Book (503×700):** a red hardcover, "THE PATIENT BUILDER / ADA MARSH", on white. It's shown with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` so the white drops out on the card. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b820bd2c-7312-4ac3-8162-76f6d97d4de4.jpg`
- **Football photo (960×645):** a coach kneeling with a ball among kids in red kits on a pitch. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/9f4e5ca0-844d-4c0a-8665-5cc5024e3281.jpg`
- **Map (960×645):** a very light grey street map of Lisbon with the estuary. `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4f3be2d6-3848-493b-b3d7-5880dac21a63.jpg`

## Type and colour

- **Type:** Inter (variable, self-hosted).
  - Headline 39.5px / 46px, weight 520, tracking −0.021em.
  - Bio 20.5px / 31px.
  - Card titles 15.5–29px; chips 12.5px.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#EEECE8`, cards `#F5F3EF`, hairlines black at 7%
  - ink `#1E1C1A`, secondary `#77736E`, muted `#A7A39D`
  - chips `#E9E6E1`, orange `#EE6A1F`, green `#3BC45E`, dark segment `#2A2624`

## Layout (stage pixels)

- **Avatar:** 145px square at (136, 82), radius 11.
- **Headline** at (321, 92), 900px wide: "Hi I’m Maya Lind — I’m a Product Designer at / Fieldnote." followed by " Previously at Orbit." in the muted colour.
- **Bio** at (321, 203), 790px wide, two lines: "I am a seasoned product designer with 5 years of experience specializing in / crafting creative tools solutions and empowering creatives."
- **Voice-note pill** at (321, 287), 495×53, fully rounded, a white-ish fill with a hairline border:
  - a 29px orange round play/pause button
  - 78 waveform bars, 2px wide, with seeded heights and two loud bursts
  - a timer, right-aligned
- **"Available for Work" pill** at (841, 287), 174×53: a green dot with a pulsing halo.
- **Grid:** cards with radius 14, gaps of 17px, outer margins of 76px.
  - **Row 1** (top 390, height 258): Experience 370px · What I’m listening 513px · What I’m reading 371px.
  - **Row 2** (top 665, height 242): Map 370px · Photo 330px · How I work 554px.
- **Chips:** each card has a small rounded label at its top left (line icon plus text): "Experience", "What I’m listening", "What I’m reading", "Map", "How I work".

## Cards

- **Experience:** a vertical timeline with a 1.5px dark line, 8.5px dots, a title at 15.5px and the years in muted grey.
  - Items: Studio Kettle & Co (2020 – 2023), Product Designer (2020 – 2023), Freelance (2023), Orbit — Design Lead (2018 – 2020), Fieldnote — Product Designer (2023 – now), Speaker, Form Conf (2024).
  - The list is doubled and drifts upward at 9px/s, inside a top/bottom fade mask, as a seamless loop.
- **What I’m listening:**
  - Album 165×173 on the left.
  - "SLOW BLOOM" at 18px weight 500 and "Juno Vale" in muted grey.
  - A 243px progress bar (3.5px) with a dark fill and an mm:ss time that advances from 00:34 through a 3:12 track.
  - Prev / play-pause / next and a volume icon; play-pause toggles.
- **What I’m reading:** "The Patient Builder" at 25.5px / 35px, "Ada Marsh" in muted grey, and the book at the right, tilted 5° and bleeding to the bottom edge.
- **Map:** the map fills the card with an 11px inset, radius 9. "Lisbon" sits centred at 27px in grey, with a small "Lisbon" label at the bottom left.
- **Photo:** the football photo inset 11px, with a white pill at the bottom left reading "I love teaching football" with a small orange ball icon.
- **How I work:** a title at 29px, a body at 15px, and a 40px segmented control (Step 01–04) with a dark sliding pill.
  - Steps:
    1. **"01 Discovery Call":** We will make a 30 minutes free consultation so that I can get to learn about your specific needs and come up with a plan.
    2. **"02 Strategy & Scope":** Together we turn what we learned into goals, a clear scope and a timeline, so everyone knows what success looks like.
    3. **"03 Design Sprint":** I explore, prototype and test in focused weekly cycles, sharing progress often so feedback lands early.
    4. **"04 Handoff & Support":** You get polished files, specs and a walkthrough for your team, plus a month of support after launch.
  - It auto-advances every 1.9s, with a 0.42s cubic ease. The pill slides, the outgoing text rises out and the incoming text rises in. Clicking a step holds it for 6s.

## Motion: one clock

- **Clock:** all motion reads one clock, the `currentTime` of a long Web Animation on a hidden element, inside a single `requestAnimationFrame` loop. A frame-by-frame recorder that pauses and seeks Web Animations therefore captures it exactly.
- **Entrance:** each block rises 14px and fades in over 0.7s with a cubic ease, staggered 80ms in DOM order.
- **Voice note:** it starts at 1.3s and plays for 32s.
  - The button shows pause, and the timer counts from 0:00.
  - Bars left of the playhead turn dark, and bars near the playhead gently bounce (scaleY up to +55%).
  - The button toggles play and pause.
- **Available dot:** a halo scales from 1 to 2.4 and fades out every 1.8s.
- **Cards:** on hover they lift 3px with a deeper shadow.
- **Reduced motion:** everything is shown settled and static.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The intro and all six cards are fully visible, with even margins; nothing is cropped.
- Within 6.5 seconds:
  - the page rises in
  - the voice note plays with a moving playhead
  - the song time ticks
  - the experience list drifts
  - How I work changes from 01 to 02 to 03
- **Content:** no real brands, people or logos.

items.prompt_text:
Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Lumora"** in the **3D** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `lumora`
- **Category:** 3D (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/arctis-3d-blob-rings-hero.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261018_201830_4ea429db-173a-4412-ac17-1f4f94241044.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"Lumora"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/arctis-3d-blob-rings-hero.mp4) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"Lumora"** (3D) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.
3. **Interactive Bento / Feature Architecture:**
   - 3-to-4 interactive cards or live calculator/filter controls depending on the archetype of **"Lumora"**.
   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).

items.title: Vela Terms Hero
items.prompt_text: # Prompt: Vela "in your terms" hero Build a single-file, one-screen hero for a fictional privacy app, **vela**: a secure messaging app, crypto wallet and Web3 browser. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is soft and warm: a grainy pastel gradient panel and a huge tight grotesk headline. The first word cycles through four verbs, each with its own glossy 3D icon, and the panel's colour changes with every word. A cream stats strip with a curved notch sits underneath. ## Media Four glossy 3D icons, each a 320×320 webp with transparency, in a soft inflated candy material. The files are orange, but the page shows each icon in its own word's hue (see **Icon tint** below). | Word | Icon | File | |---|---|---| | Message | rounded chat bubble with three embossed dots | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/83de7c35-dd91-4e56-bfb8-0ffafc83d0e0.webp` | | Browse | four-pointed sparkle star with two small orbiting spheres | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4d952211-0474-48cc-af48-58f68b3b7525.webp` | | Transact | two curved arrows cycling around a $ coin | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e2e91fca-5b3f-4e0e-a437-8a581592e407.webp` | | Build web | a globe of rounded hexagon-like cells with meridian grooves | `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/6b32bb47-4ad6-4938-a637-c997b373c68b.webp` | ## Scale and type - **Unit:** every size is in px of a 1440×960 frame, multiplied by `--u = min(100vw/1440, 100vh/960)`. The page fills the viewport. - **Font:** **Inter Tight** (variable, self-hosted latin), 500 for the headline, numbers and lead, and 400/500 for UI. - **Colours:** - ink `#0D0D0C` - secondary text at 56% ink, the scroll hint at 42% - strip and page cream `#FBF6EF` ## Layout (1440×960) - **Hero panel:** the top 75% of the screen. - It's made of four stacked gradient layers, one per word. Each layer has a vertical base gradient, a large radial glow at about 86% / 76% (bottom right), and a softer radial glow at about 32% / 105% (bottom left). - **Message**, lemon cream: base `#F2ECDF` → `#F4EBC6`, glow `rgb(246,222,104)`. - **Browse**, peach and apricot: base `#F8DCC7` → `#F9CBA9`, glow `rgb(249,150,84)`. - **Transact**, warm sage mint: base `#E9EBE0` → `#DFE9D4`, glow `rgb(150,206,150)`. - **Build web**, rose lilac: base `#F0E4E6` → `#ECD6E2`, glow `rgb(222,150,200)`. - A fine SVG fractal-noise grain sits on top at 18% opacity with `mix-blend-mode: multiply`. - **Nav:** 80u tall, with a hairline under it. - **Left:** a 13u black dot and "vela", 600 weight at 25u. - **Right:** "Products / Company / Docs", each with a small chevron (17u, 42u gaps), then an outlined "Join Vela" button (48u tall, 7u radius, 1.4px border). The button fills black on hover. - **Headline:** - **Position:** left 112u, top 190u. - **Size:** 172u on a 0.86 line height, tracking −0.032em. - **Line 1:** the cycling slot, an icon at 1em square followed by the word. - **Line 2:** "in your terms", which never changes. - **Row:** at top 578u. - Two outlined store buttons, 58u tall: "App Store" with a fruit glyph and "Google Play" with a play-triangle glyph. Use neutral line icons, not official badges. - Beside them, a 2-line caption at 18.5u: "Vela is a secure messaging app, crypto wallet, and / Web3 browser built with state of the art technology." - **Stats strip:** the bottom 25% of the screen, in cream. - **Notch:** its top edge rises over the right side in a smooth S-curve. The SVG path is `M0 62 H1062 C1092 62 1098 54 1116 34 C1138 9 1146 1 1178 1 H1440 V62 Z` in a 1440×62 box, stretched to the width. - **Scroll hint:** "↓ Scroll to learn more" at 15u sits on the raised part. - **Content:** - "Nothing great is / made alone" at 29u, 500 weight - three stats at 54u: **11.5M+** "Active accounts", **$0.0002** "Average cost per transaction", **80+** "Dapps integrations", with labels at 16.5u - a thin line-art sprout (two leaves on a stem, a little ground line) on the far right ## Icon tint (in code) Each icon takes the hue of its word's panel, so the icon and background read as one colour family: - **Wrapper:** each icon sits in a 1.02em square wrapper with `isolation: isolate`. - **Base:** the `` is turned grey with `filter: grayscale(1) brightness(1.1) contrast(1.08)`. - **Tint layer:** a colour layer sits on top, `background: var(--tint)` with `mix-blend-mode: color`, clipped to the icon's own shape with `mask: url() center/contain no-repeat`. The grey icon's shading and speculars survive, and only the hue and saturation change. - **Tints:** Message `#E9C22E` (yellow), Browse `#F2772F` (orange), Transact `#3FB874` (green), Build web `#C564C4` (rose violet). - **Motion:** the transforms (bob, pop-in) go on the wrapper. ## Motion (one clock) - **Clock:** everything reads one clock, a long Web Animation's `currentTime`, so a frame-by-frame recorder can seek it. - **Slots:** each word has a 1.75 s slot, in the order Message → Browse → Transact → Build web, looping. - **Enter, over 0.5 s:** opacity 0→1, rising from +0.32em, blur 10px→0, scale 0.96→1, ease-out cubic. The icon follows 60 ms later, scaling 0.7→1 and untwisting from −14°. - **Leave, the last 0.42 s:** fade out while drifting up 0.16em and blurring to 8px, ease-in cubic. - **Panel colour:** crossfades over a 0.77 s window that straddles each word change, so it passes through a soft muted mix as in the reference. - **Idle motion:** the icon floats gently (±0.028em, ±3°). The gradient layers drift slowly (±2.2% / ±1.6% at scale 1.08), so nothing is ever frozen. - **App Store:** while "Build web" holds, the App Store button fills to black with white text and then releases. - **Live first word:** Message also fades in on load. - **Reduced motion:** a still "Browse" state. - **Hidden tab:** the clock pauses. ## Phones (≤ 760px) - The panel flows in normal order. - The headline is at `clamp(52px, 15.5vw, 88px)`. - The store buttons wrap, and the caption sits under them. - The strip's stats wrap into two columns with the sprout on the right. - No sideways scroll. ## Acceptance check (1440×960) - "Browse in your terms" sits on a warm peach panel with the glossy star tinted orange; each icon always matches its panel's hue. - Every 1.75 s the word blurs up and out, and the next rises in with its own icon while the panel shifts to lemon, sage or rose. - The App Store button flashes black during "Build web". - **Content:** no real brands or logos.

items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Verra Events hero

Build a single-file **community-platform hero** for a fictional creator platform, **Verra**, in plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS with no framework, no build step and no media files. A black page holds a rounded dark frame. Inside it, a huge glowing vortex ring of fine red, pink and orange fins is drawn live on a canvas, cropped by the top of the frame. Below it sit a giant gradient word with a typing caret, a two-line subline and a white button. The ring turns slowly and the word types itself through a short list.

## Frame and scale

- **Page:** `#000`. The frame is inset 5vw left and right and 7.2vh top and bottom, with radius 14u, a 1px border at white 9%, and overflow hidden.
- **Unit:** `u = min(frameWidth / 1052, frameHeight / 754)`, written to `--u`. On phones (under 768px) `u = frameWidth / 600` and the frame is inset 10px.
- **Font:** Inter (variable, 400 to 600), self-hosted latin woff2.

## Nav (24u from the top, 26u and 24u side insets)

- **Left:** a small two-chevron logo (an outlined diamond over an open V, 1.7px white stroke) and "Verra" at 17.5u, weight 500.
- **Right:**
  - a frosted pill (29u tall, radius 8u, background `rgba(150,150,150,.38)`, 14px blur) holding "Explore", "Circles" and "People" at 14u;
  - a 4u gap;
  - a white "Connect" button (29u, radius 8u, dark text, weight 500) that lifts 1px on hover.
- **Phones:** the pill hides.

## The ring (canvas, redrawn every frame)

- **Geometry:**
  - centre (frameWidth/2 + 34u, −212u), so it sits above the frame and only the lower arc shows;
  - inner radius 435u, outer radius 652u;
  - vertical scale 1.03 (plus up to ±3.5% from pointer tilt).
- **Strands:** 196 of them, each sampled at 41 points from the inner rim to the outer rim, with q = 0 → 1 and r = ri + (ro − ri)·q.
  - **Angle:** θ = uᵢ + k·(1 − q)^4.2 + 0.05·k·q² + 0.02·sin(πq)·sin(3uᵢ + 0.4t), where uᵢ = 2πi/196 + spin.
  - **Result:** each strand curls tangentially along the inner rim and then runs almost radially to the outer rim, like a turbine fin.
  - **Motion:** spin = 0.06·t rad/s (a seamless rotation), and k = 0.42·(1 + 0.12·sin 0.55t) gently breathes the curl.
- **Fins:**
  - Each strand is a filled ribbon around its centreline. Its half-width is (0.15 + 3.3·s·(1 − 0.25q))·u, where s is a smoothstep of q over 0 to 0.28, so it tapers to nothing at the inner rim.
  - Draw them in angular order starting at the top of the ring (which is off-screen), so the overlap never shows a seam. Each body is opaque (`source-over`), then its leading edge, offset by the half-width, is stroked 1.45u wide in `lighter` mode. The next body covers part of that edge, which gives the layered-fin depth.
- **Colour (radial gradients from ri to ro, so colour follows radius):**
  - body: `#b01e50` → `#9c1236` (12%) → `#860c18` (40%) → `#9c1a0a` (70%) → `#c63c0e` (90%) → `#e85a18`.
  - edge: pink `rgba(255,130,185,.85)` → `rgba(255,84,138,.95)` (8%) → `rgba(255,56,80,.95)` (28%) → `rgba(255,58,44,.95)` (55%) → `rgba(255,92,36)` (80%) → `rgba(255,122,44)` (94%) → `rgba(255,150,70)`.
- **Light:**
  - a deep-red ambient fill in the annulus (`rgba(170,14,50,.35)` → `rgba(120,8,14,.45)` → `rgba(170,40,6,.4)`);
  - an orange halo from ro − 16u to ro + 70u (peak 0.42);
  - a faint pink inner halo (0.09);
  - a thin orange outer-rim line (1.6u).
- **Bloom:** draw every edge again on an offscreen canvas at 0.32× size (5.3u wide, alpha 0.7), plus a 9u orange outer-rim ring and a 5u pink inner-rim ring. Composite it onto the main canvas in `lighter` mode with an 8u blur.
- **Performance:** device pixel ratio is capped at 2. The loop pauses while the tab is hidden. Reduced motion draws one still frame.
- **Pointer:** the ring centre eases up to 14u × 10u toward the pointer (lerp 0.05).

## Headline group (cap top about 447u from the frame top, centred)

- **Word:** at 176u, weight 600, tracking −0.03em, filled with `linear-gradient(12deg, #fffaf6 28%, #ffe6d6 46%, #ffbc98 66%, #ff8f62 88%, #ff7a4c)`. The result is white at the lower left and peach-orange at the top right.
- **Caret:** a 1.6u × 124u bar in `#ffb48c`, 7u to the right of the word.
- **Typewriter:**
  - The words are Events, then Circles, then Creators, looping.
  - Each word holds for 2.6s with the caret blinking every 0.55s. It deletes at 70ms per letter, pauses 0.25s empty, types the next word at 100ms per letter, then pauses 0.15s.
  - Everything is a pure function of time.
- **Subline:** "Verra provides a space for creators to build / communities from zero to millions.", 26u below the word, 18u on a 24u line, white at 92%.
- **Button:** "Get started now", 19u below the subline. It's white, 41u tall with 17u side padding, radius 10u, 15u text at weight 500. On hover it lifts 2px and gains a soft orange glow.
- **Phones:**
  - the word is min(176u, 22vw);
  - the subline is 15px on a 21px line;
  - the whole ring and text block is centred vertically by shifting both the ring centre and the text down by half the leftover height.

## Timing and recording

- **Clock:** the ring and the typewriter read one clock, `performance.now()`.
- **`?rec=1`:** time comes instead from a paused Web Animation, a 100s linear `translateX(0 → 100000px)` on a hidden 1px element. A frame-by-frame recorder can seek it to get exact frames.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- **Look:** a crisp, glowing red-pink-orange fin vortex arcs across the top with a pure-black hole.
- **Text:** "Events" sits under the arc in a cream-to-orange gradient with a blinking caret.
- **Motion:** the ring turns slowly and seamlessly. After about 2.6s the word deletes and types "Circles".
- **Performance:** 60fps on a laptop.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

items.title: AXON
items.prompt_text:
# AXON — Motion research hub: recreation brief

Build a single full-screen dark page: a GPU particle cloud shaped like a sculpted logo form fills the viewport, stirred by the cursor through a fluid simulation, with a thin monospace UI layer on top (brand, tag chips, a scrollable column of video cards on the left, a text column on the right, a round counter top-right). Pure black background. No scrolling of the page itself.

## 1. Media

| Use | URL | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Card 1 video | https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/oraciteslArea.mp4 | "Lattices / zone" |
| Card 2 video | https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/facet-glass-hero.mp4 | "Prism / shell" |
| Card 3 video | https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/stellarmind-hero.mp4 | "Nebular / loop" |
| Card 4 video | https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/thedropthroughArea.mp4 | "Fall / forward" |
| Particle sprite matcap | 64×64 PNG, a soft grey sphere shading (a generic matcap). Any soft spherical matcap works; embed as a data URI. | Sampled per point sprite |
| three.js | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.150.1/build/three.min.js | UMD build, global `THREE` |

All videos: `autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="metadata"`, `object-fit: cover`.

## 2. Fonts

System monospace stack, no web font: `"SF Mono", "Menlo", "Consolas", "Liberation Mono", monospace`. All UI text is uppercase, 13 px, line-height 1.35, letter-spacing 0.02em.

## 3. Head and tokens

- `<title>AXON..</title>`
- `<meta name="description" content="AXON is a motion research studio: an open logbook of real-time rendering studies in particles, fluids and signed surfaces.">`
- Viewport meta, charset UTF-8.

```
--accent: #aa88ff   (headings, chip highlight)
--text:   #dddddd
--muted:  #8a8a8a
--chip:   #1c1c1c
--line:   #2a2a2a
body background #000, html/body height 100%, overflow hidden
```

## 4. Layers

1. `canvas#bg` fixed, full viewport, z-index 0. WebGL renderer, pixel ratio min(devicePixelRatio, 2), clear colour black.
2. `.ui` fixed inset 0, z-index 1, `pointer-events: none` (links and the card list re-enable pointer events). Text blocks use `mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter` so they glow over the particles; the video cards do not blend.

## 5. UI DOM, in order, desktop measurements

**Brand** `.brand` absolute top 24 left 24, flex row gap 14.
- A 40×40 SVG mark: 18.5 px radius circle stroke white 1.6, plus a white 8-point star polygon inside.
- Name "AXON" 20 px white; subtitle "Motion research" 11 px muted, margin-top 2.

**Counter** `.counter` absolute top 24 right 24: 44×44 circle, 1 px `--line` border, background #0a0a0a, text "07" 14 px white centred.

**Tags** `.tags` absolute top 120 left 24 width 320, flex wrap gap 6. Chips: background `--chip`, padding 5px 9px, 11 px, colour #cfcfcf. First chip "All" is active: background #e6e6e6, colour #000. Chips in order: All, Light, Physics, Fluids, Grid, Audio, Volumes, Particles, Capture, Render.

**Card list** `.list` absolute top 250 left 24 bottom 0 width 320, vertical scroll, scrollbar hidden. Each `.card`: padding 18px 0, 1 px top border `--line`.
- `.thumb` height 160, radius 2, background #0a0a0a, overflow hidden, video cover-fitted.
- `.meta` flex space-between gap 16, margin-top 10, 12 px. Left column white, right column muted and right-aligned; both two lines (`white-space: pre-line`).
- Cards: Lattices / zone · Ambient light / study — Prism / shell · Dispersion hero / render — Nebular / loop · Procedural hero / sequence — Fall / forward · Dolly track / study.

**Text column** `.about` absolute right 90, top 50% translateY(-50%), width 380. Blocks separated by 2.2em. Headings `h2` 13 px accent colour, margin-bottom 1em. Paragraphs justified, margin-bottom 1em. Lists `list-style: inside`. Links block-level, underlined, margin 4px 0, hover opacity .7 over 300 ms.

```
[info]
Studies are published as they are built and may not run on every device.

[aims]
An open logbook of real-time rendering research: surfaces, fluids, fields, and the little tools we build to shape them.
It is here to keep the work in view and to give each new project a place to grow.

[exploring]
• Signed surfaces  • Cursor turbulence  • Compute passes  • Type in 3D space

[connect]
Index -> AXON              (href "#")
Mail -> hello@axonlab.dev  (mailto)
```

## 6. Responsive

- ≤1100 px: text column right 24, width 320.
- ≤760 px: hide `.list` and `.tags`; text column becomes left 24 / right 24 / bottom 24, no transform, paragraphs left-aligned.

## 7. Particle system (the hero)

**Scene.** Perspective camera FOV 30, near 0.1, far 1000, base position (-1.17, 0, 6) looking at the origin. A group holds the points at position (0.343, 0.16, -1), rotation in degrees (-28.4, 390, 4.92), scale (5, 5, 6).

**Gaze camera.** Each frame the target position is base + (mouse.x mapped 0..width → -1..1) × (-1) on x and (mouse.y mapped 0..height → -1..1) × 2 on y; the camera lerps to it at 0.05 and looks at the origin.

**Count.** 262,144 points on desktop (512×512 position texture), 16,384 on mobile. Each point has a `random` vec4 attribute in 0..1 and looks up its position from a float RGBA texture using `position.xy` as UV.

**Simulation (ping-pong float render target, one fullscreen pass per frame).** Inputs: current position texture, origin texture (initial random positions uniform in [-1,1]³), random attribs, `time` (s), `HZ` (= dt × 60), fluid velocity texture, fluid density texture, projection matrix (camera projection × inverse camera world), model matrix (group world), normal matrix (camera world). Per particle:

```
if (length(pos) > 0.7) pos /= 2.0;
pos += curlNoise(pos * 0.1 + time * 0.05) * 1.0 * 0.0002 * HZ;        // uCurlNoiseScale 1, uCurlTimeScale 0.5, uCurlNoiseSpeed 1
vec3 gradient = sdfNormal(pos);   // central differences, step 0.001
float sdf = sdfShape(pos);
pos += cross(normalize(pos), normalize(gradient)) * 0.0005;           // swirl along the surface
pos += -gradient * sdf * 0.5;                                          // pull onto the surface

Pure black background. No scrolling of the page itself.

## 1. Media

| Use | URL | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Card 1 video | https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/oraciteslArea.mp4 | "Lattices / zone" |

| Card 3 video | https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/stellarmind-hero.mp4 | "Nebular / loop" |
| Card 4 video | https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/thedropthroughArea.mp4 | "Fall / forward" |
| Particle sprite matcap | 64×64 PNG, a soft grey sphere shading (a generic matcap). Any soft spherical matcap works; embed as a data URI. | Sampled per point sprite |
| three.js | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.150.1/build/three.min.js | UMD build, global `THREE` |

All videos: `autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="metadata"`, `object-fit: cover`.

## 2. Fonts

System monospace stack, no web font: `"SF Mono", "Menlo", "Consolas", "Liberation Mono", monospace`. All UI text is uppercase, 13 px, line-height 1.35, letter-spacing 0.02em.

## 3. Head and tokens

- `<title>AXON..</title>`
- `<meta name="description" content="AXON is a motion research studio: an open logbook of real-time rendering studies in particles, fluids and signed surfaces.">`
- Viewport meta, charset UTF-8.

```
--accent: #aa88ff   (headings, chip highlight)
--text:   #dddddd
--muted:  #8a8a8a
--chip:   #1c1c1c
--line:   #2a2a2a
body background #000, html/body height 100%, overflow hidden
```

## 4. Layers

1. `canvas#bg` fixed, full viewport, z-index 0. WebGL renderer, pixel ratio min(devicePixelRatio, 2), clear colour black.
2. `.ui` fixed inset 0, z-index 1, `pointer-events: none` (links and the card list re-enable pointer events). Text blocks use `mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter` so they glow over the particles; the video cards do not blend.

## 5. UI DOM, in order, desktop measurements

**Brand** `.brand` absolute top 24 left 24, flex row gap 14.
- A 40×40 SVG mark: 18.5 px radius circle stroke white 1.6, plus a white 8-point star polygon inside.
- Name "AXON" 20 px white; subtitle "Motion research" 11 px muted, margin-top 2.

**Counter** `.counter` absolute top 24 right 24: 44×44 circle, 1 px `--line` border, background #0a0a0a, text "07" 14 px white centred.

**Tags** `.tags` absolute top 120 left 24 width 320, flex wrap gap 6. Chips: background `--chip`, padding 5px 9px, 11 px, colour #cfcfcf. First chip "All" is active: background #e6e6e6, colour #000. Chips in order: All, Light, Physics, Fluids, Grid, Audio, Volumes, Particles, Capture, Render.

**Card list** `.list` absolute top 250 left 24 bottom 0 width 320, vertical scroll, scrollbar hidden. Each `.card`: padding 18px 0, 1 px top border `--line`.
- `.thumb` height 160, radius 2, background #0a0a0a, overflow hidden, video cover-fitted.
- `.meta` flex space-between gap 16, margin-top 10, 12 px. Left column white, right column muted and right-aligned; both two lines (`white-space: pre-line`).
- Cards: Lattices / zone · Ambient light / study — Prism / shell · Dispersion hero / render — Nebular / loop · Procedural hero / sequence — Fall / forward · Dolly track / study.

**Text column** `.about` absolute right 90, top 50% translateY(-50%), width 380. Blocks separated by 2.2em. Headings `h2` 13 px accent colour, margin-bottom 1em. Paragraphs justified, margin-bottom 1em. Lists `list-style: inside`. Links block-level, underlined, margin 4px 0, hover opacity .7 over 300 ms.

```
[info]
Studies are published as they are built and may not run on every device.

[aims]
An open logbook of real-time rendering research: surfaces, fluids, fields, and the little tools we build to shape them.
It is here to keep the work in view and to give each new project a place to grow.

[exploring]
• Signed surfaces  • Cursor turbulence  • Compute passes  • Type in 3D space

[connect]
Index -> AXON              (href "#")
Mail -> hello@axonlab.dev  (mailto)
```

items.title: Facet Glass
items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Facet "Designed in glass" hero

Build a one-screen **WebGL hero for a fictional real-time material studio, Facet**. The page is a dark website shattered into **thick smoked-glass shards** floating on black. The content is printed on the shards. The whole slab tilts toward the cursor, the shard under the pointer lifts and tips, and "Read paper →" shatters the page to reveal a second view. Use plain HTML, CSS and JS with three.js 0.169.0 from jsDelivr (import map, plus `RoomEnvironment` from the addons). No build step and no images: all content is drawn in code. Font: Inter (variable woff2, 400–600).

## Scene and scale

- **Background:** #050507.
- **Camera:** perspective, fov 30°, placed so that 1 world unit = 1 CSS px at z = 0.
- **Renderer:** ACES filmic tone mapping, DPR capped at 2.
- **Environment:** PMREM RoomEnvironment, `environmentIntensity` .42, plus a soft white-blue key light from the top-left.
- **Page block:** centred, with side margins of 5.5 % of the width and top/bottom margins of 8.5 % of the height (16 px on phones).
  - The block is a **nav slab** (10.8 % of the block height) above a **14 px gap** and a **shard panel** (the rest).
  - Layout scale: S = blockWidth / 1730.

## The glass

- **Construction:** every piece is an `ExtrudeGeometry` of a rounded polygon.
  - Corner radius 20·S, depth 13·S, bevel 2.6·S with 3 segments.
  - The outline is inset by half the gap, so pieces sit 14·S apart.
- **Material:** MeshPhysicalMaterial.
  - color #17171b, roughness .36, clearcoat .7, clearcoatRoughness .12, specularIntensity .7.
  - Iridescence .55 (IOR 1.3, thickness 250–650 nm), rising to 1.0 together with envMapIntensity 1 → 1.9 while a piece is hovered.
  - The result: dark charcoal faces, soft studio gradients, thin bright rims, and a green/violet sheen when a piece tips toward the light.
- **Cursor glow:** a soft lavender emission injected into the glass shader via `onBeforeCompile`: `vec3(.42,.37,.62) · .16 · exp(−1.6·(d/300S)²)` around the pointer's world position. It fades in and out with the pointer.

## The cut pattern (live)

- **Cells:** five cells measured from the reference, in panel-normalised coordinates (x right, y down).
  - Edge points: top .22, .515, .84; bottom .34, .865.
  - Inner junctions: J0 (.385,.72), J1 (.48,.62), J2 (.716,.49).
  - A = TL·tAB·J0·bAD·BL (hero), B = tAB·tBC·J1·J0, C = tBC·tCE·J2·J1, D = J0·J1·J2·bDE·bAD, E = tCE·TR·BR·bDE·J2.
- **Drift:** every point drifts on its own slow sine (x ±.03; junctions also y ±.05; periods ≈10–20 s).
- **Cursor push:** points within .6 of the pointer are pushed away by up to .05, so the cell under the cursor grows.
- **Rebuild:** geometry is rebuilt about 45×/s.
- **Portrait screens:** the pattern is transposed so the hero cell sits on top.

## Content printed on the glass

- **Page image:** one canvas (DPR ≥1.5) of the whole panel. Each cell carries a `ShapeGeometry` of its own outline just above its top face, with UVs mapped to its original page position. A lifted or flying shard takes its slice of the text with it, and the seams read like refraction.
- **Panel content:**
  - Eyebrow "REAL-TIME MATERIAL STUDIO": 11·S px, tracking .2em, 38 % white, at 13.5 % of the height.
  - Headline "Designed / in glass.": Inter 500, size min(7.8 % of panel width, 20 % of height), tracking −.045em, leading .97, a #dcdce0→#bdbdc3 vertical gradient.
  - Two-line sub "Author dispersion, transmission, and refraction in the browser. Live / previews, real materials.": 55 % white.
  - "Open studio" light pill (116×40·S, radius 6). It **turns green #36d67e on hover**.
  - "Read paper →" link (underlines on hover).
  - "© Facet Lab" bottom-left and "KHR_materials_dispersion" bottom-right, 11·S px at 34 % white.
- **Nav slab:** square mark + "Facet", links "Studio · Materials · Pricing" (60 % white, brighten on hover), "Sign in" right.
- **Text layer:** a transparent DOM copy of all text is mapped onto the tilted panel with a homography (`matrix3d` from the panel's four projected corners). Text is selectable (blue selection box) and buttons and links are real hit areas.

## Interaction

- **Global tilt:** the block rotates as if pressed at the pointer: rotateY = x·7° − 1.2°, rotateX = −y·5.5° + .8°. It is smoothed with a 0.3 s exponential and eases back when the pointer leaves the window.
- **Hover:** a raycast picks the piece under the pointer (cells and nav). It springs (k 170, c 19) up 50·S toward the camera (nav 32·S) and tips up to ±.24 rad, with the edge nearest the pointer dipping away. Neighbours stay put.
- **Shatter (click "Read paper →"):**
  - Every piece, nav first, flies off in 0.72 s with ease-in cubic, with a small stagger per piece.
  - Each piece gets an outward and downward velocity plus 420–800·S toward the camera, gravity, and 2.0–3.6 rad of tumble about a random axis. The printed text rides along.
  - From 0.28 s the definitions view fades in on black over 0.4 s. Its type scales with viewport width, measured from the reference:
    - The column starts at 32.4 % W and is 33.9 % W wide. The title baseline sits at 35.9 % H.
    - Title "Real-time glass, in five terms.": Inter 650, 1.36 vw, tracking −.022em, white.
    - Five paragraphs (Iridescence, Index of refraction, Dispersion, Transmission, Roughness): .73 vw on a 1.72 line height, 60 % white, with the bold term in white + an em dash. Gaps are 1.05 vw.
  - The **"← Back" sliver** is a thin dark smoked-glass shard, the same material as the cells with iridescence .35 and no cursor glow.
    - Outline: viewport fractions (.147,.243) (.252,.169) (.287,.277) (.151,.258), with rounded corners, an 11·k extrusion and a bright bevel (k = W/1918).
    - It leans in 3D: rotateY −.16 (left end further away) and rotateX .08. It has a slow idle wobble (±.03–.04 rad at ≈1 Hz) and tips up to .14 rad toward the pointer on hover.
    - "← Back" is .66 vw Inter 500, white, centred at (.219 W, .238 H). It turns lavender #b9abff on hover.
    - It grows in from .3 s after the click and shrinks away on Back.
- **Back:** the definitions fade out in 0.25 s and the sliver shrinks away. The pieces fly back along the same paths in 0.72 s with ease-out-back (a slight overshoot), nav first, then a 30 ms stagger.
- **Load:** the page enters with the same fly-in.
- **Reduced motion / no WebGL:** a static styled HTML version.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The dark glass shards and nav slab look thick, with bright hairline rims and black gaps. The headline is printed across the cuts.
- Moving the mouse tilts the whole slab, and the hovered shard lifts, tips, gains a sheen and glows lavender under the cursor.
- The cut lines slowly breathe.
- "Read paper →" shatters everything, with the text flying on the shards, into the five-terms view. "← Back" reassembles it.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Loops Virtual Store"** in the **3D Store** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `loops-virtual-store`
- **Category:** 3D Store (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/loops-virtual-store.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261024_010948_048422f0-152e-4f66-8f6e-88dd6aca7d9d.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)

ANIMATION ENGINE (requestAnimationFrame, NOT CSS marquee):
Constant SPEED = 0.8 px per frame (auto-scroll left)
Transform: translate3d(offsetPx, 0, 0)
Seamless wrap:
halfWidth = track.scrollWidth / 2
if offset <= -halfWidth → offset += halfWidth
if offset > 0 → offset -= halfWidth

DRAG / POINTER INTERACTION:
onPointerDown: set dragging true, velocity=0, capture pointer, store startX + startOffset, cursor-grabbing
onPointerMove while dragging:
  velocity = (dx / dt) * 16   // normalize ~60fps
  offset = dragStartOffset + (clientX - dragStartX)
onPointerUp / onPointerCancel: dragging=false, release grabbing cursor
While NOT dragging:
  if |velocity| > 0.1: offset += velocity; velocity *= 0.95 (momentum decay)
  else: velocity=0; offset -= SPEED (resume auto-scroll)
This yields: continuous left crawl → grab/drag → inertial coast → resume crawl

# Prompt: Orvante branding-agency page (three sections)

Build a single-file, three-section landing page for a fictional branding agency, **Orvante**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a strict monochrome editorial layout. A light grey hero with a large black-and-white photo of an Asian man seen from behind is followed by a black manifesto section whose words fill from grey to white, then a bordered "Trusted by" panel with stat cards.

## Media (exact URLs, all on Higgsfield CloudFront)

- **Hero photo:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/7dc8b8f3-4ccb-4599-8ce4-7f7c7881bad9.webp. A black-and-white studio photo of an East Asian man seen from behind, head turned slightly to his right, in a dark technical jacket, on a flat #dadada background.
- **230+ card photo:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/a9d3641f-d629-46e5-8d2d-5f75386b803d.webp. A young man in a black cap, low-key, dark background.
- **Q Industrial card:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/9340eb08-877d-4d08-91fb-b70754541d98.webp. An abstract motion-blurred monochrome fashion shot with a sharp white angular shape.
- **Portrait card:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/addecc7d-666f-4342-8290-ed7f7cbbffd6.webp. A side profile in a white t-shirt on a blue-grey gradient.
- **Avatars:** eight round black-and-white headshots, 240 × 240.
  - Avatar 1: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/300f41b1-3de5-4153-afde-06e15e753ad0.webp
  - Avatar 2: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/bfff4cdf-4fda-4491-ada6-62f3b6236492.webp
  - Avatar 3: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/943b121e-fe72-479f-93ae-aa8cd1650f69.webp
  - Avatar 4: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/c673306f-2b81-4c3d-a7d2-3df61d481abb.webp
  - Avatar 5: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/2e4fcf11-d0fc-4f31-8f7a-dfe751777141.webp
  - Avatar 6: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/ab458fcd-4c2c-426f-8213-21cc3c7274be.webp
  - Avatar 7: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/c1fcd833-5ac9-41e9-9352-fead7e64fa24.webp
  - Avatar 8: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/4c2b3307-e555-4633-949c-efd3b7e09d82.webp

Both are self-hosted latin woff2 (Google Fonts: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@100..900&family=Archivo:wdth,wght@62..125,100..900&display=swap).

## Scale

- **Units:** everything is drawn on a 1440-px artboard. `u = min(100vw / 1440, 1.333px)`, and every size below is in u.

  - hero paper #dadada, ink #111
  - lower sections pure black #000
  - text #f4f4f4
  - statement grey #6f6f6f filling to #f4f4f4
  - hairlines white at 14–28 %
- **"PURE DESIGN":** Archivo at width 104 %, weight 640, 90u, line-height 0.86, tracking −0.06em.
- **UI:** Inter Tight, 13–15u, weight 500.

## Hero (1440 × 938u)

- **Photo:** placed at left 338u, top −86u, 764 × 1024u, object-fit cover. The left and right edges are masked to transparent over 6 %, so it melts into the paper. The man's head top sits about 85u from the top, and his back is cut off by the hero's bottom edge.
- **Nav:** at (57, 61). A white segmented pill, 48u tall, with Home (active, on a black sliding pill), Studio, Works and Blog. The black pill slides to the hovered link.
- **Top right:**
  - date "Sunday / 17.06 – 27 June 2026" at (1038, 70)
  - a black "Contact Us ↗" button, 144 × 46u, at (1237, 63)
- **Title:** "PURE / DESIGN" at (57, 246), with "(’25)" at (339, 272).
- **About:** "● (ABOUT)" at y 458, then two lines of 14u copy, "Building stunning website that every brand deserves to be seen.", then a black "Book A Call ↗" button at y 584.
- **Stats frame:** at (57, 693), 341 × 208u, light grey #cdcdcd.
  - A dark card: "400+ / Trusted Partner", six tiny fictional partner marks (Halcyon, Ostra, Fenwick, Monolo, Kitefly, Arbor, each with a simple glyph), and a white "Book a call ↗" bar.
  - A photo card (cap photo) with "Studio Feed · 05/06" and a hairline at the top, and "230+ / Projects successfully launched worldwide" bottom right.
- **Right column:**
  - a frosted "True Growth" pill with a black check disc at (1216, 258)
  - "We’re available / ● for you", right-aligned, at y 442
  - "Out Now / Q Industrial / [2025]" with a 196u-tall image card (Q Industrial image, scaled 1.55 from 62 % 45 %), a frosted round arrow button and a progress line (white at 35 % with a white fill)
- **Brand plate:** a dark glass plate over the man's back at (532, 444), 364 × 73u, with a two-part triangular mark, "ORVANTE" in wide Archivo 25u, and a two-line menu icon.
- **Logos:** a row of fictional white wordmarks, "Lumon · Paperfold · Northwind", at y 864 across the jacket.

## Bar and statement

- **Bar:** black, 111u, with a bottom hairline. "EST 2019" on the left (the year in grey), "SCROLL DOWN" with a white round arrow in the middle, and "LIVE IN DETAILS" (grey) on the right. Wide Archivo, 14u.
- **Statement:** centred, 830u wide, 52u, line-height 1.33, tracking −0.028em, five lines: "We believe the strongest brands are / built through strategy, not just / aesthetics. Every campaign is designed / to capture attention, inspire action, and / create lasting business growth."
  - Every word is its own span. As the section scrolls through the viewport, the words fill from grey #6f6f6f to white in reading order, with a 3-word soft edge.
- **Sub-line:** two lines, 23u, 150u below: "Performance-driven marketing, from / strategy to execution. *Built for growing brands.*" (the last sentence in grey).

## Trust panel

- **Panel:** 1302 × 429u, centred, with a 1px border (white at 28 %) and a 14u radius.
- **Left:** "Trusted by / Hundreds of / Growing / Businesses", 55u, weight 500, plus a three-line 14.5u paragraph. Two frosted glass icon tiles (88u, 12u radius, backdrop blur) overlap the heading: an asterisk tile top right of line 1, and a four-dot tile over "Businesses".
- **Cards:** 326u tall, 8u radius.
  - Avatar card, light grey #d6d6d6, 293u: eight round 48u avatars in a 4 × 2 grid, "56M+" at 43u and "Global Collaborations".
  - Awards card, #262626, 298u: "10+ / Industry Awards", an SVG laurel badge "BEST GROWTH PARTNER 2026" and a two-line note.
  - Portrait card, 200u, cut off by the panel's right edge.

## Motion

- **Load (Web Animations):**
  - The title lines rise out of their masks, 1 s, staggered 110 ms.
  - The photo rises 40px, un-blurs and fades in over 1.3 s.
  - The nav drops in.
  - Every other hero element rises 14px and fades in, staggered 55 ms.
  - The Q Industrial progress line draws in.
  - "400+" and "230+" count up over 1.4 s.
- **Scroll:**
  - The hero photo drifts at 0.12× scroll.
  - The statement fills grey → white.
  - When the trust panel enters, "56M+" and "10+" count up and the avatars pop in (scale 0.4 → 1, staggered).
- **Hover:**
  - Nav pill slide.
  - Buttons lift 1px.
  - Trust cards lift 6u.
  - The Q Industrial image zooms and its arrow rotates 45°.
- **Recorder (?rec=1):** the whole page is captured in one frame, so the scroll-driven parts run on time instead.
  - Statement fill: 1.3–4.2 s.
  - Trust counters and avatars: 3.5–5.2 s.
  - Awards card lift: 5.3 s.
  - The photo drifts slowly throughout.
- **Reduced motion:** no transitions; everything is shown filled and counted.

## Phone (≤ 760px)

- **Unit:** `u = 100vw / 390`.
- **Layout:** one column.
  - The nav pill is on the left and "Contact Us" becomes a 40u square arrow button.
  - The title, (ABOUT) copy and Book A Call come next, then the full-width photo (470u) with the brand plate and logos over it.
  - Then True Growth, the stats frame (two columns) and Out Now.
- **Statement:** 28u.
- **Trust panel:** stacks its heading, paragraph and cards, and the second glass tile is hidden.
- **Overflow:** no sideways scroll.

## Acceptance check (1440 wide)

- **Hero:** the hero matches the reference layout, with the man centred and the ORVANTE plate on his back.
- **Statement:** the words fill to white as you scroll.
- **Trust panel:** the counters and avatars animate in when it appears.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

# Prompt: "offline" power-button footer

Build a single-file **website footer** for a fictional digital-wellbeing product, **offline** ("Everything you need to know before you finally log off"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The footer is one full-bleed cinematic scene: a small beige vintage all-in-one computer (generic, no brand logo) on a grassy hill under a blue sky. The wordmark's "o" is a power button. items.title: Feathers Atlas
items.prompt_text:
Build a single standalone index.html (inline <style> and one inline <script type="module">, no build step, no local assets) containing one 100vh hero section: an interactive 3D bird field guide called "Feather Atlas". Two birds only: Hoopoe and Kingfisher. Do not download any asset; load everything from the URLs given below.

=== ASSETS (use exactly these URLs) ===
CDN base: https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/
Kingfisher image (transparent PNG): {CDN}hf_20261004_073256_f9e3e60d-acdc-4925-b393-c4ce14b28711.png
Kingfisher 3D model (GLB):          {CDN}hf_20261004_073345_12721630-c589-442f-8884-e4a445cd8980.glb
Hoopoe image (transparent PNG):     {CDN}hf_20261004_073256_21ed095c-d038-4ab5-87b7-b44e527ec449.png
Hoopoe 3D model (GLB):              {CDN}hf_20261004_073347_06b339a7-70bc-4ecd-9e72-1a4143264da9.glb
There is no video on the page.

=== LIBRARIES ===
Import map: "three" -> https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js and "three/addons/" -> https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/
Use GLTFLoader, DRACOLoader (decoder path https://www.gstatic.com/draco/versioned/decoders/1.5.7/), MeshoptDecoder and RoomEnvironment from three/addons. Do not use OrbitControls.

=== FONTS (Google Fonts) ===
Display: "Newsreader" (opsz 6..72; weights 400, 500; italic 400). Body/UI: "Nunito Sans" (opsz 6..12; weights 400, 600, 700).
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400;0,6..72,500;1,6..72,400&family=Nunito+Sans:opsz,wght@6..12,400;6..12,600;6..12,700&display=swap
Fallbacks: serif -> "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif; sans -> "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif.

=== COLOR TOKENS (CSS custom properties on :root) ===
Day:  --bg #f6f1e7; --panel #fbf8f1; --line #e7e0d1; --ink #1b1a17; --muted #6d685d; --sage #4d5a3d; --sage-ink #ffffff; --sage-tint #e9ebdc; --chip #efeadd; --shadow 60,48,28 (rgb triplet)
Dusk (on .hero[data-light="dusk"]): --bg #14170f; --panel #1b1f15; --line #2d3324; --ink #f2ecdf; --muted #a8a392; --sage #a9b98a; --sage-ink #14170f; --sage-tint #283020; --chip #262b1d; --shadow 0,0,0
Easing: --ease cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.24,1). Body: overflow hidden, antialiased, background var(--bg). Focus ring: 2px solid var(--sage), offset 2px.
Icons: all inline SVG line icons via <symbol>/<use>, 24x24 viewBox, fill none, stroke currentColor, stroke-width 1.5, round caps and joins, default 20px. No icon library, no emoji.

=== DESKTOP LAYOUT (>1100px) ===
.hero: position relative; height 100vh then 100dvh; overflow hidden; CSS grid with columns 196px | minmax(0,1fr) | clamp(300px,27vw,356px); background and color transition .6s.
A single <canvas id="gl"> is absolutely positioned over the whole hero (inset 0, z-index 5, pointer-events none) so the bird is never clipped by any panel and renders on top of tabs, sidebar and detail panel when zoomed or rotated.

1) Left sidebar (aside): flex column, padding 22px 12px 18px 24px, border-right 1px var(--line).
 - Brand "Feather Atlas": Newsreader 26px, letter-spacing -.01em.
 - Nav list (margin 20px 0 12px, gap 2px). Each item is a button: flex, gap 16px, padding 7px 10px, radius 10px, 14.5px text, hover background var(--chip). Sub-label in <small> 12px muted, margin-top 3px. Items in order: Home (house icon); Featured (star icon, aria-current="page", background var(--sage-tint)); Songbirds "34 species"; Kingfishers "8 species"; Owls "11 species" (owl icon); Hummingbirds "15 species"; Raptors "12 species"; Waders "9 species" (wading-bird icon). Other items use simple line bird icons.
 - Featured card pinned to the bottom (margin-top auto): background var(--sage-tint), radius 10px, padding 14px 14px 16px. Eyebrow "FEATURED SPECIES" (9.5px, letter-spacing .22em, uppercase, muted, weight 600); the active bird's PNG (92x76, object-fit contain, centered); title in Newsreader 18px; text 12px muted line-height 1.4; underlined link "Learn more" with a small right arrow icon.

2) Centre column (section.main): grid rows auto / minmax(0,1fr); padding 48px 18px 14px 26px.
 - Tabs row (role="tablist", flex, gap 10px), two tab buttons in order Hoopoe, Kingfisher. Each tab: 130px wide, padding 8px 8px 11px, grid centered, background var(--panel), 1px border var(--line), radius 8px, hover translateY(-2px). Contents: bird PNG 58x52 contain; name in Newsreader 15.5px; Latin name in Newsreader italic 12.5px muted. Selected tab: background var(--sage-tint), border color-mix(in srgb, var(--sage) 45%, transparent). Arrow Left/Right move between tabs.
 - Stage (div#stage, tabindex 0): position relative, fills the remaining height, touch-action none, cursor grab (grabbing while dragging), user-select none. Children:
   a) Ground shadow: absolute, left 50%, bottom 15%, width min(62%,460px), height 44px, radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(var(--shadow),.22), transparent). While a tab switch is in progress it fades to opacity 0 and scaleX(.4).
   b) Loader: centered 30px ring (1.5px border var(--line), top color var(--sage), 1s linear spin) with text "Preparing the specimen…" 12.5px muted; fades in/out.
   c) Fallback: if a GLB fails to load, show that bird's PNG centered in the stage.
   d) Hint, top-right: hand icon + "Drag to turn · scroll to zoom", 11.5px muted; fades out permanently after the first interaction.
   e) Icon rail, absolute left 0, vertically centered, z-index 6, grid gap 9px: four 38px circular buttons (background var(--panel), 1px border var(--line), 17px icon, hover border sage, active scale .92; "on" state = background var(--sage), icon var(--sage-ink)). Order: Zoom in (magnifier with plus; "on" whenever zoom >= 1), Zoom out (plain magnifier; "on" when zoom < 1), Expand (four corner brackets), Light (sun).
   f) Turn pill, absolute bottom 46px, centered, z-index 6: pill with background var(--panel), 1px border, radius 999px, padding 3px 6px, 13px text; three buttons: counter-clockwise arrow, the label "360°", clockwise arrow.
   g) Caption, absolute bottom 0, centered: Newsreader italic, clamp(16px,1.55vw,20px), shows the active bird's caption.

3) Right column (section.info): grid rows auto / minmax(0,1fr), gap 16px, padding 13px 26px 14px 0.
 - Top row: search field (flex 1, height 32px, background var(--panel), 1px border, radius 8px, 15px magnifier icon, placeholder "Search species, habitats, or regions…" at 11.5px), bell icon button (32px), account button showing a 24px ink-filled circle with a user icon.
 - Detail card: background var(--panel), 1px border var(--line), radius 6px, padding 22px 20px 16px, overflow-y auto (thin scrollbar). Inside, an <article aria-live="polite"> as a flex column containing in order:
   eyebrow with the family name (uppercase, same eyebrow style);
   h1 bird name: Newsreader 500, clamp(40px,4.2vw,54px), line-height 1, letter-spacing -.025em, margin-top 8px;
   three tag pills (11.5px, padding 6px 13px, radius 999px, background var(--chip)), margin-top 16px;
   description paragraph 13.5px, line-height 1.55, text-wrap pretty;
   h2 "Key Traits": Newsreader 400, 21px, with a 1px top border and 14px padding-top;
   four trait rows, each a grid 22px | 88px | 1fr, gap 16px, 13px text: icon, muted label, value;
   h2 "Habitat" (same style) and a row with a reed icon + habitat sentence;

=== BIRD DATA ===

 Description: "Unmistakable in cinnamon, black and white, the hoopoe walks open ground probing for grubs with its long curved bill. It lifts its crest into a fan when it lands or takes fright, and flies on broad wings with a loose, butterfly-like beat."
 Traits: Length 25–29 cm (ruler icon); Wingspan 44–48 cm (wing icon); Diet "Insects, larvae and grubs" (fish icon); Range "Europe, Asia and Africa" (globe icon)
 Habitat: "Orchards, vineyards and dry grassland."
 Caption: "A crown raised, and the orchard takes notice."
 Close-up text: "Every crest feather ends in a black tip, so the raised fan reads like a row of signal flags." Lens position: 62% 22%
 Featured card: title "A crown of cinnamon." text "Bold bars on broad wings. A call you hear before you see it."
Kingfisher (selected by default) — Latin: Alcedo atthis — family: ALCEDINIDAE — tags: River bird, Diver, Iridescent
 Description: "A small, spectacular bird of rivers and lakes, the kingfisher is renowned for its dazzling plumage and astonishing hunting dives. A master of stealth and speed, it links healthy waterways with extraordinary beauty."

Key DirectionalLight color #fff4e2 intensity 1.6 at (2.5, 4, 5); rim DirectionalLight #bfd8ff intensity 0.5 at (-4, 2, -3).

items.prompt_text:
Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"FinSmith"** in the **Motion Design** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `finsmith`
- **Category:** Motion Design (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/finsmith-fish-3d.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261013_171303_9d57c549-4216-480b-bd2f-b9d68d6dc9f0.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#FF5656`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"FinSmith"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/finsmith-fish-3d.mp4) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"FinSmith"** (Motion Design) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.
3. **Interactive Bento / Feature Architecture:**
   - 3-to-4 interactive cards or live calculator/filter controls depending on the archetype of **"FinSmith"**.
   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `finsmith`
- **Category:** Motion Design (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/finsmith-fish-3d.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261013_171303_9d57c549-4216-480b-bd2f-b9d68d6dc9f0.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#FF5656`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"FinSmith"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/designs/finsmith-fish-3d.mp4) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"FinSmith"** (Motion Design) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.
3. **Interactive Bento / Feature Architecture:**
   - 3-to-4 interactive cards or live calculator/filter controls depending on the archetype of **"FinSmith"**.
   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).

# Prompt: Oda Nobunaga, "Unifiers of Japan" hero and bio

Build a single-file **two-section page** about the warlord Oda Nobunaga. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step.

- **Section 1:** a full-bleed signal-red hero in a flat vector illustration style. A giant two-line title sits behind the lord, and a kanji line sits above it.
- **Scroll beat:** as you scroll the first ~70 % of a screen, samurai armour builds onto the lord piece by piece while the camera pushes in on his face. Red cherry petals fall over everything.
- **Section 2:** a cream bio panel with the clan crest, six stats and a centred statement card.

## Media (all URLs used)

| Asset | URL | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Lord in kimono (base layer) | https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/5b4e0901-a420-4d48-a2f8-0983ac5e1811.webp | 2048×2048 with alpha; covers the whole stage |
| Armour: side flaps | https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/df3f02d3-42b8-4d75-a592-363d4f9e97b3.webp | Placed at left 26.172 %, top 37.598 %, width 47.412 %, height 22.607 % of the stage |
| Armour: chest plate | https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/f1d71bb6-a9c7-4956-ad93-7de36b6bdee3.webp | 31.299 % / 55.713 % / 37.549 % / 44.287 % |
| Armour: demon mask | https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/fe02860a-fb96-4451-b0cb-55156e3573d2.webp | 38.672 % / 37.598 % / 22.803 % / 21.924 % |
| Armour: helmet | https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/7229bca2-f88f-43c1-914b-37bf5e6321c3.webp | 27.734 % / 4.932 % / 44.531 % / 32.666 % |
| Armour: crescent horns | https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e71cba83-443b-4d04-9959-f64286de1604.webp | 29.834 % / 5.127 % / 40.332 % / 26.172 % |
| Falling petals loop | https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/2c1e0be2-077e-464f-9797-ff6ee91769ac.mp4 | 720×720, 5 s, red petals on chroma green; load with `crossorigin="anonymous"` |
| Clan crest (five-lobed mokko) | https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/857c3bc4-0da2-4095-8d2c-64274974833b.webp | Red, alpha |
| Fan / pine icon | https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/425a6870-25c3-4155-a076-e2146f3587db.webp | Red, alpha |

The five armour pieces were cut from one drawing that lines up exactly with the base layer. Stack them over the base in this order: flaps, chest, mask, helmet, horns.

### Fonts

Self-host them; the single file embeds them as base64 woff2.

| Font | Use | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Anton | Title | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton |
| Mochiy Pop One | Kanji | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Mochiy+Pop+One&text=織田信長 (subset to those 4 characters) |
| Archivo variable (width 62–125, weight 100–900) | Everything else | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wdth,wght@62..125,100..900 |

## Palette and scale

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| Red | `#E40038` |
| Cream | `#FAF3E9` |
| Ink | `#201408` |

- **Scale unit:** `--u = 100vw / 1507`, so the page is designed on a 1507px frame. `--side = 121u`.
- **Paper grain:** an SVG fractal-noise overlay at 16 % opacity in multiply blend sits on both sections.

## Section 1: hero (height 1440u, red, `overflow:hidden`)

- **Nav:** 84u tall with a 1px cream (50 %) bottom rule. Three centred items, MENU, ABOUT and STUDIO: Archivo 30u, weight 900, width 84 %, uppercase.
- **Frame:** two vertical 1px cream (50 %) rules at `--side` from each edge, starting under the nav.
- **Side labels:** small rotated labels (11u, 800, uppercase, +.08em tracking) centred in each side gutter.
  - **Left**, rotated -90°: "01 / 05" at 225u, "ODA NOBUNAGA" at 560u, "UNIFICATION OF JAPAN" at 1010u, "01 / 05" at 1330u.
  - **Right**, rotated 90°: the same labels, with the two middle ones swapped.
- **Kanji:** "織田信長" in Mochiy Pop One 56u, centred, at top 158u.
- **Title:** two Anton lines in cream, each stretched to fill its box exactly. Measure Anton's cap height on a canvas, set the font size so the caps fill the box height, and use SVG `textLength` + `lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"` for the width.
  - "ODA": 392u × 258u, top 252u.
  - "NOBUNAGA": 1120u × 266u, top 526u.
- **Stage:** 1386u square, centred, top 54u, above the title. It holds the base webp and the five armour pieces, each absolutely placed by the percentages above.
- **Petals:** a 1507u square WebGL canvas over everything. Each frame it draws the petals video, with alpha keyed from redness: `a = smoothstep(.12,.75, r - g*.5)`, green clamped to blue, premultiplied. That leaves clean red petals with no green fringe.

## The suit-up (scroll-driven)

- **Progress:** `p = clamp((scrollY - 0.06·vh) / (0.62·vh))`, smoothed by 20 % per frame.
- **Camera:** the inner layer scales `1 + 0.3·easeInOutCubic(p)` and moves up `-4 %·easeInOutCubic(p)`, so it pushes in on his face.
- **Pieces:** each one grows from an anchor inside the 2048px drawing. Before its window it is invisible; inside the window it snaps to full opacity in the first ~7 %, then scales from (sx, sy) up to (1, 1).

| Piece | Anchor (x, y) | Window of p | Start scale (sx, sy) | Ease |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mask | 1024, 960 | .16–.46 | .72, .72 | easeOutCubic |
| Helmet | 1024, 600 | .22–.54 | .12, .30 | backOut 1.25 |
| Flaps | 1024, 770 | .30–.60 | .25, .65 | easeOutCubic |
| Horns | 1024, 640 | .40–.70 | .12, .10 | backOut 1.4 |
| Chest | 1024, 1185 | .34–.74 | .55, 0 | easeOutCubic |

The mask closes over his face, the helmet grows out of his forehead, the flaps open out, the horns shoot up, and the chest plate drops down from his neck. Scrolling back up takes everything off in reverse.

## Load reveal (Web Animations)

| Element | Animation | Duration | Delay |
|---|---|---|---|
| Title lines | Rise out of their masks (translateY 102 % → 0) | 1.1s | 150 / 290ms |
| Kanji | Rises 16u while fading in | — | 60ms |
| Nav and side labels | Fade in | 0.7s | 120ms + 25ms each |
| Stage | Rises 6 % | 1.3s | — |

All of them use `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`.

## Section 2: biodata and introduction (cream)

- **Rules:** the same two vertical side rules, in red at 55 %.
- **Biodata row:** 324u tall, with a red rule underneath. Side labels: "BIODATA" on the left, "02 / 05" on the right.
  - **Left block** (at 200u, 290u wide): the label "[ CREST OF THE ODA CLAN ]" (10.5u, 700, uppercase), with the crest under it at 232u wide.
  - **Right side:** a 2 × 3 stat grid from 560u to 150u from the right. Each stat is a tiny label above a value in Archivo 31u, weight 900, width 90 %, uppercase:

| Label | Value |
|---|---|
| POSITION | ODA CLAN LEADER |
| CONTROL | 1/3 OF JAPAN |
| TIMELINE | 1534 — 1582 |
| POWER | 22 YRS IN POWER |
| CAPITAL | AZUCHI CASTLE |
| LEGACY | MILITARY INNOVATION |

- **Introduction card:** 134u side margins, a 1px red (70 %) border, and a 30u circle on each corner with its centre on the corner point.
  - The fan icon (118u) sits centred at the top.
  - The statement is in Archivo 50u, weight 900, width 96 %, line height 1, uppercase, one line per row:
    > ODA NOBUNAGA IS KNOWN AS THE / FIRST GREAT UNIFIER OF JAPAN - / A DAIMYŌ WHO OVERTHREW THE / ASHIKAGA SHOGUNATE AND ENDED / YEARS OF FEUDAL WARS IN JAPAN
  - Under it, a 19u paragraph, 500 wide max: "Accounts describe him as tall, lean and lightly bearded. His ambition made him ruthless, yet he was a clear-eyed realist, respected for making the hard calls."
  - Side labels: "03 / 05", "ODA NOBUNAGA", "INTRODUCTION".

## Mobile (≤ 767px)

- `--u = 100vw / 1300` and `--side = 22px`.
- **Hero:** height `max(100svh, 178vw)`. The nav is 56px tall; the kanji sits at 86px and the title starts at 130px. The stage becomes 150vw square, anchored to the bottom centre.
- **Bio:** the crest and stats stack, with the stats in two columns.
- **Card:** the statement drops to `min(4vw, 22px)`.

## Reduced motion

Skip the reveal, show the full armour (p = 1) and pause the petals.
