items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Nova Agent, light 3D robot landing page

Build a single-file **three-section landing page** for a fictional on-chain AI agent product, **NOVA AGENT** ("Thinking Machines"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, plus **three.js 0.160.0** as an ES module through an import map. There is no framework and no build step.

The page is warm paper-white with thin dark grid lines. A cute boxy white-ceramic robot is built entirely in three.js and stays fixed on a full-screen canvas behind the content:
- **Intro:** the robot stands on a charcoal pedestal with its head tilted.
- **Product:** the camera glides in to a close-up of the head.
- **Reviews:** the face screen swaps its two glowing eyes for a quote mark.

## Assets (all external URLs used)

- **three.js core:** https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js
- **three.js addons** (import map prefix `three/addons/` → https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/):
  - RoundedBoxGeometry: https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js
  - RoomEnvironment: https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js
- **Fonts** (latin woff2; embed them as base64 `@font-face` in the single file):
  - IBM Plex Mono 300: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ibmplexmono/v20/-F6qfjptAgt5VM-kVkqdyU8n3oQIwlBFgsAXHNk.woff2
  - IBM Plex Mono 400: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ibmplexmono/v20/-F63fjptAgt5VM-kVkqdyU8n1i8q131nj-o.woff2
  - IBM Plex Mono 500: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ibmplexmono/v20/-F6qfjptAgt5VM-kVkqdyU8n3twJwlBFgsAXHNk.woff2
  - Schibsted Grotesk 400/500 (variable): https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/schibstedgrotesk/v7/Jqz55SSPQuCQF3t8uOwiUL-taUTtap9GayojdSFO.woff2

There are no images or videos. The robot, the gradient ring texture and the face screen are all generated in code. The only other image is the small testimonial avatar, an inline SVG (a figure in front of a brick wall).

## Palette and type

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| Background | `#efece6` |
| Text | `#141414` |
| Dim text | `rgba(20,20,20,.5)` |
| Grid lines | `rgba(20,20,20,.09)` |
| Brand gradient | `conic-gradient(from 200deg, #ffb347, #ff8a3d 18%, #ff5a5f 34%, #ff3d8b 50%, #ff5a5f 66%, #ff8a3d 82%, #ffb347)` |

- **Sans:** Schibsted Grotesk.
- **Mono:** IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, letter-spacing .04–.06em, used for all small labels.

## Fixed chrome

- **Grid:** three 1px vertical guides at 17 %, 50 % and 83 % of the width (`--col: 17%`).
- **Top bar:** 30px tall, mono 11px.
  - Text: "**New:** Nova Agent V1 Is Here - The Home for On-chain AI Agents ↗", with a × at the right.
  - It slides up out of view (0.5s, `cubic-bezier(.6,0,.2,1)`) once the page scrolls past 40px, or when × is clicked.
- **Nav:** 52px tall, below the top bar (moves to top 0 when scrolled). Paper at 86 % with an 8px backdrop blur and a bottom hairline. Its grid columns are `17% 1fr 12% 17%`:
  - **Logo:** a 27px rounded-square outline (a C-shape) stroked with the orange→pink gradient, with two dark dots for eyes, then "NOVA AGENT" at 18px.
  - **Menu (mono 11px):** Solutions▾, Pricing, Learn▾, $NOVA▾, Community▾, Contact us.
  - **Pad cell:** "Nova Pad ↗", with hairlines on both sides.
  - **Button:** "•• LAUNCH NOVA", a 30px outlined mono button. A gradient border shows only along part of its top edge and down its left edge, cut with a clip-path.
- **Right rail:** fixed, vertically centred, 270px tall.
  - A column of 14 tiny dots.

Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Tide Footer"** in the **Footer** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `tide-engraving-footer`
- **Category:** Footer (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/tide-engraving-footer.mp4
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261028_001408_312cbed5-29f8-4ac2-a1cb-1df027bc55e1.png&w=1280&q=85
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"Tide Footer"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/tide-engraving-footer.mp4) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"Tide Footer"** (Footer) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.
3. **Interactive Bento / Feature Architecture:**
   - 3-to-4 interactive cards or live calculator/filter controls depending on the archetype of **"Tide Footer"**.
   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).

items.title: Wild Pil
items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Wild pill hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **travel hero for a fictional rental brand, Wild**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS with no framework and no build step.

The page opens on white with the word **WILD** and a hairline between the I and the L. That line opens into a slit, then a circle, then a wide stadium-shaped pill that pushes "WI" and "LD" apart. The pill shows a looping video of a floating island with a waterfall over sunset clouds. As the pill opens, a soft paper background with flowing white lines fades in, the nav drops in from the top and the footer bar rises from the bottom.

## Media

- **Scene video:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/175fbbcd-e50a-480c-bab2-ca16d4678322.mp4
  - 1280×720, 60 fps, 4.25 s, muted.
  - It loops seamlessly with a hard loop: no crossfade, no reverse.
  - The island sits centred with sky above and clouds below. The waterfall pours, clouds drift, birds glide and the small islands bob.
- **Poster (first frame):** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/726b168c-da47-4682-a255-cc3e02f89bae.jpg
- **Display:** the video sits inside the pill at full pill height, centred horizontally, at least 4.2 em wide, so it cover-crops at every pill width. The focal point is the top of the scene: `object-fit: cover; object-position: center top` (the poster too). It is always fully opaque; only the pill's own width and clip reveal it.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** Inter (variable, 400–800), self-hosted.
- **Word:** "WILD" in weight 800, tracking −0.045 em, line-height 0.8.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#ffffff` at the start, then paper `#f2f2f1`
  - ink `#1d1d1d`, secondary text `#3a3a3a`
  - rule `#a9a9a6`
  - button `#1b1b1b` with white text

## Scale

- **Unit:** one type unit, `--fs = min(19.6vh, 13.2vw)` on desktop, which is the font size of the word. Everything in the hero is sized from it.
- **Phone (≤ 720 px):** the word stacks, with "WI" over the pill over "LD". See *Phone* below.

## Layout

- **Hero:** centred 43 % from the top. The row is `WI · pill · LD` in a flex row, with the gap animating between the parts.
- **Pill:**
  - height 1.81 em, fully rounded, overflow hidden, placeholder fill `#d8d3cf`
  - final width 3.62 em on desktop, about a 2:1 stadium
  - a tiny white line icon near each end, at about 85 % opacity: a breeze icon on the left, a speaker icon on the right that toggles its sound waves
- **Background:** a paper layer with about 15 long white strokes sweeping up and to the right as soft S-curves (stroke 1.2–3.9 px, opacity 0.55–0.85), drawn in an SVG stretched to the viewport.
- **Nav (top):**
  - left links "Home · Features · Templates · Contact Us", right links "Instagram · Facebook" as plain text (no logos)
  - size max(12 px, 0.072 em), weight 450
  - padding 0.14 em top, 0.27 em sides
- **Footer (bottom):** a row aligned to the bottom.
  - Left: a paragraph 1.42 em wide, size 0.066 em, line-height 1.45, with a drop-cap "E" (2.35× size, weight 650): "Embark on a wild ride around the world with our travel rental service. Discover breathtaking landscapes and hidden gems on your unforgettable journey."
  - Middle: a 1 px rule filling the space.
  - Right: a black pill button "Let's Get Wild".

## Motion: the reveal

One Web Animations timeline, 2.1 s, starting once fonts are ready.

- **Pill width** (fs = word size):
  - 0.012 fs (a hairline) at 0 %, held to 14 %
  - 0.16 fs (a slit) at 30 %
  - 1.81 fs (a circle) at 58 %
  - the final width at 100 %
  - easings: `(.5,0,.3,1)`, `(.45,0,.3,1)`, `(.4,0,.2,1)`
- **Pill clip:** grows vertically from `inset(50% 0)` to `inset(0)` over 0–14 %, so the hairline draws from the middle out.
- **Hairline:** a grey overlay (`#b9b9b9`) on the pill shows the line as grey, then fades out between 14 % and 30 % as the image appears. This fade is on the overlay, never on the video.
- **Word gap:** 0.026 em until 14 %, 0.05 em at 58 %, then 0.085 em. "WI" and "LD" are pushed outward by the opening pill.
- **Background:** the paper and lines fade in between 45 % and 78 %.
- **Nav:** slides down from −140 % between 50 % and 86 %, with easing `(.2,.8,.2,1)`.
- **Footer:** rises from +160 % between 52 % and 90 %.
- **Rule:** draws from the centre (scaleX 0 → 1) between 40 % and 95 %.
- **Icons:** fade in after 80 %.

## Interaction

- **"Let's Get Wild":** replays the reveal. It plays the same timeline in reverse, collapsing the pill back to the hairline with everything leaving, then opens it again.
- **Resize:** finishes any running animation and resets the pill width.
- **Speaker icon:** toggles its waves. The clip is silent.
- **Reduced motion:** shows the final state with the video paused on the poster.

## Recording mode (`?rec=1`)

- The reveal plays at 0 s and the reverse collapse starts at 4.9 s, matching the reference loop.
- `window.__recVideo(t)` returns `(t mod duration) + 1/120`, so a frame-by-frame recorder seeks the clip to a fresh frame every step.

## Phone (≤ 720 px)

- **Type:** `--fs = min(34vw, 16.5vh)`, side margin 20 px.
- **Hero:** the hero column is centred 47 % from the top: "WI", then the pill, then "LD", with gaps of 0.03 → 0.1 em.
- **Pill:** full width (`100vw − 40px`), with a final height of width ÷ 1.85.
  - It opens **vertically**: a horizontal grey hairline draws from the centre outwards (clip `inset(0 50%)` → 0), then grows 1.5 px → 10 % → 55 % → 100 % of its height on the same 2.1 s curve.
  - The halves are pushed apart vertically.
  - The video inside is full pill width and the final pill height, centred vertically, anchored top.
- **Nav:** the four links only, at 12.5 px.
- **Footer:** the paragraph at full width (13 px / 1.5), then a row with the rule and a 38 px black button. Even 20 px margins.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The hairline draws between I and L, opens into a slit, a circle, then a wide pill, while the halves glide apart. The nav drops in, the footer rises and the rule draws.
- The island video keeps moving inside the pill and loops with no jump.
- "Let's Get Wild" collapses the hero to the line and reopens it.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.

items.title: Tana Elephant
items.prompt_text:
# Prompt: Tana Camps "Elephant" editorial sections

Build three stacked sections of a fictional safari brand's species page, **Tana Camps Expeditions**, in plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS with no framework and no build step. The look is a quiet nature magazine: warm cream paper, deep brown-plum Didone capitals, small rust caps labels, documentary photography. The motion is slow and letter-by-letter: the hero title rises in behind the elephant, the hero photo melts into the paper as you scroll, and each section's type climbs in one letter at a time.

## Media (Higgsfield CloudFront)

- **Hero photo** (2400×1357, ratio 2688:1520): an African bush elephant with long tusks walking through golden savanna grass, soft cloudy sky in the top third. https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/934f4b51-d05b-4498-9c4a-8262f044da66.jpg
- **Elephant cut-out** (transparent WebP of the same elephant, cropped to its bounding box): https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/5d850aba-1a5b-44eb-bd6c-cd9f87845be7.webp. In the photo's own frame it sits at left 26.19%, top 30.99%, width 46.5%.
- **Round pill photos** (square):
  - savanna with a small elephant under acacias: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/a6ea3433-41c4-46b8-aac3-faefa9ad7558.jpg
  - mother and calf silhouetted at sunset: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/9152c213-6763-4147-83f3-b985e6c65a00.jpg
- **Tall portrait** (2:3): an elephant's head in profile with one long tusk on green foliage. https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e665edf0-2b16-4b17-ada1-0b928af1dbfa.jpg

## Type and colour

- **Display:** Bodoni Moda (variable), weight 500, optical size pinned to 11 so the hairlines stay sturdy. All display text is uppercase.
- **Labels and body:** Inter. Labels are 600, 10.5px, tracking .2em, uppercase.
- **Colours:** paper `#ECE3D1`, darker paper `#E6DCC8`, ink `#43282A`, body text ink at 72%, rust `#A86438`, hairlines ink at 16%.
- **Grain:** a fixed SVG fractal-noise layer over everything, multiply blend, 38% opacity.

## 1 · Hero (full viewport)

- **Stage:** a box with the photo's ratio (2688:1520) that covers the viewport (`width: max(100vw, 100svh × 1.7684)`), centred, with `container-type: inline-size`. Inside it, three layers:
  1. the photo (object-fit cover)
  2. the title block
  3. the elephant cut-out, so the elephant's back overlaps the lower part of the letters "PH"
- **Title block:** top 19.2% of the stage, centred.
  - Eyebrow "LOXODONTA AFRICANA" (label style, 0.66cqw).
  - "ELEPHANT" at 9.6cqw, line height .8, tracking .01em.
- **Nav (over the photo):**
  - Left: a two-line menu icon + "MENU".
  - Centre: "Tana Camps" in Bodoni Moda 19px over "EXPEDITIONS" (7.5px, tracking .32em).
  - Right: a search icon + "SEARCH".
- **Map pill:** bottom centre, a cream pill "SEE ON MAP" with a round pin icon and an arrow.
- **Load sequence:**
  - The photo settles from scale 1.06 to 1 over 2.2s.
  - The eyebrow and nav fade down into place.
  - The letters of ELEPHANT rise .18em out of a 10px blur, 95ms apart, left to right.
  - The pill rises in last, at about 1.05s.
- **Scroll (hero melts into the paper):**
  - The stage drifts down at .32× the scroll.
  - A paper-coloured gradient at the bottom grows from 34% to 100% of the hero height and to full opacity by about 60% of a viewport scrolled.
  - Photo and cut-out blur up to 6px. The pill sits under the gradient and disappears with the photo.

## 2 · Statement (full viewport, centred)

- **Label:** rust "ELEPHANTS IN AFRICA".
- **Statement:** three lines of uppercase Bodoni at clamp(40px, 7.2vw, 132px), line height 1.06: "THE ● LARGEST / LAND ANIMAL ● ON / THE PLANET".
  - Each ● is a 0.86em round photo pill sitting inline.
- **Emblem:** below, a 66px rust line emblem: a double ring with an elephant head.
- **Reveal (when 35% visible):**
  - Every letter rises from .55em below with a 4° tilt, 26ms apart in reading order.
  - The pills spring in from scale 0, with an overshoot, while their photo zooms from 1.5 to 1.
  - The emblem turns in from −90° and scale .6.

## 3 · Quick facts (full viewport)

# Prompt: Distill, "Built for people. Read by machines." comparison section Give me the superdetailed exact prompt to recreate this page exactly as it is, including the correct asset URL, all elements, animations, and fonts. This is that prompt. ## What it is Build a full-viewport **comparison hero** for a fictional AI-readability product called Distill. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript in one file, with no framework and no libraries. - **Top:** a nav bar and a two-column hero. On the left, a serif headline, "Built for people. / *Read by machines.*". On the right, a paragraph and an orange pill button. - **Below:** a **conveyor belt** of rounded website cards, real mini web pages of a fictional materials company called Kessler built in HTML/CSS, drifts continuously to the left. - **The scanner:** at the horizontal centre of the screen stands a glowing orange vertical **scanner line**. - **Right of the line:** the cards look like a real website. - **At the line:** each card **dissolves into a dense cloud of orange pixel particles**. - **Left of the line:** the exact same card area shows **that page's plain HTML source**, the token-light version an AI agent receives, printed in small grey monospace. It fades out towards the left edge of the screen. - **The counter:** a floating counter on top of the line labelled "Token reduction" counts down the tokens removed from the card currently crossing ("−48,193") with its percentage ("91% less"). - **Interaction:** hovering the belt slows it; dragging scrubs it with inertia. Dragging a card back to the right rebuilds it from its code, pixel by pixel. Everything, including the particle dissolve, is real code, with no video. The cards are DOM, the code is real text, and the dissolve is a 2D canvas drawn every frame in sync with the card positions. ## Media: every asset URL Six photographs (WebP, about 650 × 655 px), used as backgrounds inside the Kessler cards. It starts at `W/2 − 0.62·cw`, so the first card is already about 12 % past the line on load. - **Card position:** with `span = cw + gap` and `period = span × 6`, card i sits at `x = mod(off + i·span + span, period) − span`. Cards wrap invisibly off the left edge back to the far right. ### Speed - **Auto speed:** `−0.075 × innerWidth` px per second, leftwards (about 108 px/s at 1440). It is 0 with reduced motion. - **Hover:** entering the belt eases a `hover` value to 1 (rate 4/s); leaving eases it back to 0. The target speed is `auto × (1 − 0.65·hover)`, so the belt slows to 35 % under the cursor. - **Easing:** when not dragging, `vel` eases towards the target at `1 − e^(−2.2·dt)`, then `off += vel·dt`. - **Drag:** - `pointerdown` on the belt captures the pointer. - Each `pointermove` adds dx straight to `off` and estimates velocity: `dx / max(8ms, Δt) × 1000 × .8 + previous × .2`. - On release, that velocity carries as inertia and then eases back to the auto speed, so a flick right reverses the belt for a moment. - **Wheel:** horizontal wheel input (when `|deltaX| > |deltaY|`) adds `−deltaX × 6` to the velocity. ### Per card, every frame - `cut = clamp(Lx − x, 0, cw)` is how many pixels of the card are already past the scanner. - **Card:** - `transform: translate3d(x, 0, 0)`. - `clip-path: inset(0 0 0 cut px round 0 1.6vw 1.6vw 0)` when cut > 0. The left side of a crossing card is a hard straight edge at the line. - A CSS mask `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent cut px, #000 cut+26 px)`, so the card softens into the particles over its first 26px. - **Code block:** the same transform, `clip-path: inset(0 (cw − cut)px 0 0)`, and `visibility: hidden` while cut = 0. The code is revealed exactly where the card has been removed, as if printed by the scanner. ### The counter - It follows the card currently crossing (0 < cut < cw), with progress `cut / cw`. - Its target is `round((original − distilled) × progress)`. - The shown number eases towards the target at `dt × 14`. When the crossing card changes, it snaps and the percent label updates to `round(saved / original × 100)% less`. - Numbers use the en-US thousands format with a leading "−". ## The dissolve (canvas `drawFx`, for each card where cut > 0 and the card's right edge is still past the line) ### 1. Haze - A horizontal linear gradient from `Lx` to `Lx + 150`, going from `rgba(255,96,40,.42)` to transparent. - It fills a rect from the line, over the card's height, `min(150, x + cw − Lx)` px wide. - The width must never be negative; that is why it is only drawn while the card's right edge is past the line. ### 2. Dithered particles fixed to the card surface - **Grid:** the card is divided into a **3px grid in card-local coordinates**, so the dots travel with the card. Only columns from the cut to `R = 0.3·cw` past the line are walked. - **Probability:** for each column at screen x `sx = x + gx·3`, with distance `d = sx − Lx`, the lighting probability is `p = (1 − d/R)^1.7`. It is almost solid at the line and thins to nothing 30 % of a card width away. - **Rows:** rows run from −5 to `rows + 5`, so a few dots spill above and below the card. - Inside the card, a cell lights when `hash(gx, row, cardIndex) < p × 0.92`. - Outside the card, `p × .16`, fading out over 5 rows. - **Hash:** a 32-bit integer hash. `h = (a·374761393 + b·668265263 + c·2147483647) | 0`, then `h = (h ^ (h >>> 13)) · 1274126177 | 0`, then `((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 2³²`. - **Twinkle:** cells are skipped when `hash(gx, row, floor(t × 9) + 97) < .22`. About a fifth of the dots blink, changing 9 times per second. - **Colour:** from the palette `#FF4A12, #FF5A1F, #FF6B2C, #FF8A3D, #FFB06A, #FFD9B5, #FFF3E6`, chosen by a second hash `h2 = hash(row, gx, cardIndex + 31)`. - Within 10px of the line, use the three palest colours (index 4 + floor(h2 × 3)). The edge reads white-hot. - Elsewhere, use index `floor(h2² × 7)`, mostly deep oranges. - **Size:** `1.1 + h2 × 1.7` px squares. - **Jitter:** up to ±0.8px in x and y from the hashes, so the grid doesn't read as a grid. ### 3. Free sparks - **Spawning:** each frame, up to 3 sparks (70 % chance each) spawn within 30px right of the line, anywhere from 10px above to 10px below the card. - **Movement:** velocity x is −30…+40 px/s plus 60 % of the belt velocity; velocity y is ±25 px/s. - **Look:** size .8–2.6px, random palette colour. - **Life:** .3–1.1s. Alpha is `min(1, life × 2.2)`. - Sparks drift off the line and over the code side like embers. ## Responsive (≤ 767px) - **Card variables:** `--cw: 84vw; --ch: 54vw; --gap: 7vw; --top: 54svh`, or `58svh` when the height is ≤ 700px. - **Nav:** the links, "Sign in" and "Start a free trial" are hidden; only the logo and the orange "Book a demo" pill (30px, 0 13px, 12px text) remain. Side padding is 16px. - **Hero:** stacks to one column with 14px gaps and padding 18px 20px 0. Headline 34px, paragraph 14px, no max width, button 14px below. - **Code mask:** the fade extends to 30vw. - All card internals scale automatically through cqw. ## Reduced motion - Auto speed is 0, so the belt stands still with one card mid-crossing. - The particles stop twinkling and jittering, and no sparks spawn. - Dragging still works, so the comparison can be scrubbed by hand. ## Acceptance checklist - At 1440 × 810 the headline block sits top-left and the paragraph with the orange pill sits top-right. - The belt's cards are about 662 × 421px with about 68px gaps, the orange scanner stands at exactly x = 720, and the "Token reduction" pill rides above it. - A dark card crossing the line shows a dense, flickering orange pixel cloud fading out about 200px into the card, with the card's left edge cut straight at the line. - Immediately left of the line, that card's HTML and its three comment lines appear in 10px grey mono. They fade out towards the screen's left edge. - The counter rises (in magnitude) smoothly while a card crosses, and jumps to the next card's percentage when a new card starts crossing. - Dragging right rebuilds the card from its code; letting go resumes the leftward drift.

It starts at `W/2 − 0.62·cw`, so the first card is already about 12 % past the line on load. - **Card position:** with `span = cw + gap` and `period = span × 6`, card i sits at `x = mod(off + i·span + span, period) − span`. Cards wrap invisibly off the left edge back to the far right. ### Speed - **Auto speed:** `−0.075 × innerWidth` px per second, leftwards (about 108 px/s at 1440). It is 0 with reduced motion. - **Hover:** entering the belt eases a `hover` value to 1 (rate 4/s); leaving eases it back to 0. The target speed is `auto × (1 − 0.65·hover)`, so the belt slows to 35 % under the cursor. - **Easing:** when not dragging, `vel` eases towards the target at `1 − e^(−2.2·dt)`, then `off += vel·dt`. - **Drag:** - `pointerdown` on the belt captures the pointer. - Each `pointermove` adds dx straight to `off` and estimates velocity: `dx / max(8ms, Δt) × 1000 × .8 + previous × .2`. - On release, that velocity carries as inertia and then eases back to the auto speed, so a flick right reverses the belt for a moment. - **Wheel:** horizontal wheel input (when `|deltaX| > |deltaY|`) adds `−deltaX × 6` to the velocity. ### Per card, every frame - `cut = clamp(Lx − x, 0, cw)` is how many pixels of the card are already past the scanner. - **Card:** - `transform: translate3d(x, 0, 0)`. - `clip-path: inset(0 0 0 cut px round 0 1.6vw 1.6vw 0)` when cut > 0. The left side of a crossing card is a hard straight edge at the line. - A CSS mask `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent cut px, #000 cut+26 px)`, so the card softens into the particles over its first 26px. - **Code block:** the same transform, `clip-path: inset(0 (cw − cut)px 0 0)`, and `visibility: hidden` while cut = 0. The code is revealed exactly where the card has been removed, as if printed by the scanner. ### The counter - It follows the card currently crossing (0 < cut < cw), with progress `cut / cw`. - Its target is `round((original − distilled) × progress)`. - The shown number eases towards the target at `dt × 14`. When the crossing card changes, it snaps and the percent label updates to `round(saved / original × 100)% less`. - Numbers use the en-US thousands format with a leading "−". ## The dissolve (canvas `drawFx`, for each card where cut > 0 and the card's right edge is still past the line) ### 1. Haze - A horizontal linear gradient from `Lx` to `Lx + 150`, going from `rgba(255,96,40,.42)` to transparent. - It fills a rect from the line, over the card's height, `min(150, x + cw − Lx)` px wide. - The width must never be negative; that is why it is only drawn while the card's right edge is past the line. ### 2. Dithered particles fixed to the card surface - **Grid:** the card is divided into a **3px grid in card-local coordinates**, so the dots travel with the card. Only columns from the cut to `R = 0.3·cw` past the line are walked. - **Probability:** for each column at screen x `sx = x + gx·3`, with distance `d = sx − Lx`, the lighting probability is `p = (1 − d/R)^1.7`. It is almost solid at the line and thins to nothing 30 % of a card width away. - **Rows:** rows run from −5 to `rows + 5`, so a few dots spill above and below the card. - Inside the card, a cell lights when `hash(gx, row, cardIndex) < p × 0.92`. - Outside the card, `p × .16`, fading out over 5 rows. - **Hash:** a 32-bit integer hash. `h = (a·374761393 + b·668265263 + c·2147483647) | 0`, then `h = (h ^ (h >>> 13)) · 1274126177 | 0`, then `((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 2³²`. - **Twinkle:** cells are skipped when `hash(gx, row, floor(t × 9) + 97) < .22`. About a fifth of the dots blink, changing 9 times per second. - **Colour:** from the palette `#FF4A12, #FF5A1F, #FF6B2C, #FF8A3D, #FFB06A, #FFD9B5, #FFF3E6`, chosen by a second hash `h2 = hash(row, gx, cardIndex + 31)`. - Within 10px of the line, use the three palest colours (index 4 + floor(h2 × 3)). The edge reads white-hot. - Elsewhere, use index `floor(h2² × 7)`, mostly deep oranges. - **Size:** `1.1 + h2 × 1.7` px squares. - **Jitter:** up to ±0.8px in x and y from the hashes, so the grid doesn't read as a grid. ### 3. Free sparks - **Spawning:** each frame, up to 3 sparks (70 % chance each) spawn within 30px right of the line, anywhere from 10px above to 10px below the card. - **Movement:** velocity x is −30…+40 px/s plus 60 % of the belt velocity; velocity y is ±25 px/s. - **Look:** size .8–2.6px, random palette colour. - **Life:** .3–1.1s. Alpha is `min(1, life × 2.2)`. - Sparks drift off the line and over the code side like embers. ## Responsive (≤ 767px) - **Card variables:** `--cw: 84vw; --ch: 54vw; --gap: 7vw; --top: 54svh`, or `58svh` when the height is ≤ 700px. - **Nav:** the links, "Sign in" and "Start a free trial" are hidden; only the logo and the orange "Book a demo" pill (30px, 0 13px, 12px text) remain. Side padding is 16px. - **Hero:** stacks to one column with 14px gaps and padding 18px 20px 0. Headline 34px, paragraph 14px, no max width, button 14px below. - **Code mask:** the fade extends to 30vw. - All card internals scale automatically through cqw. ## Reduced motion - Auto speed is 0, so the belt stands still with one card mid-crossing. - The particles stop twinkling and jittering, and no sparks spawn. - Dragging still works, so the comparison can be scrubbed by hand. ## Acceptance checklist - At 1440 × 810 the headline block sits top-left and the paragraph with the orange pill sits top-right. - The belt's cards are about 662 × 421px with about 68px gaps, the orange scanner stands at exactly x = 720, and the "Token reduction" pill rides above it. - A dark card crossing the line shows a dense, flickering orange pixel cloud fading out about 200px into the card, with the card's left edge cut straight at the line. - Immediately left of the line, that card's HTML and its three comment lines appear in 10px grey mono. They fade out towards the screen's left edge. - The counter rises (in magnitude) smoothly while a card crosses, and jumps to the next card's percentage when a new card starts crossing. - Dragging right rebuilds the card from its code; letting go resumes the leftward drift.

# Prompt: HOLLOWMERE, "A Night of Lanterns": Halloween descent scroll Give me the superdetailed exact prompt to recreate this page exactly as it is, including the correct asset URL, all elements, animations, and fonts. This is that prompt. ## What it is Build a single-page site for a fictional Halloween night festival called **Hollowmere**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript in one file, with no libraries. **The structure.** The page is **one continuous illustrated descent**: five full-bleed flat-vector Halloween scenes stacked vertically into a single tall picture. | # | Scene | |---|---| | 1 | A moonlit canyon of gothic houses with a castle on the moon | | 2 | An underground crypt laboratory with a glass tower of captured ghosts | | 3 | A mill chamber with a giant jack-o'-lantern-studded wheel | | 4 | A cauldron foundry pouring molten potion | | 5 | A cave mouth opening onto a moonlit lake of floating lanterns | **The joins.** Between every pair of scenes lies an illustrated band of rock strata: the ground of the scene above on top, the cave ceiling of the scene below underneath. The scenes therefore join through real drawn geology, never through gradient fades. **The art.** Every scene is drawn in one art style: angular shard-cut shapes, grainy speckled texture, glowing rim light, deep indigo, violet and electric blue with pale cyan ghost-light and warm orange jack-o'-lantern accents. A **pale cyan "ghost-light" waterfall** runs from the hero's pool down through the scenes, like the falls in an illustrated-scroll corporate site. **The motion is all code:** - The falls flow continuously as canvas streaks. - Lava streams pour. - Mist breathes and lanterns and jack-o'-lanterns flicker. - Motes, spray, bubbles and moonlight shimmer drift on small canvases. - Ghost sprites bob and shy away from the cursor, and bats flap across the skies. - The page scrolls with eased momentum. - The hero title rises letter by letter on load and drifts with parallax, and section copy rises line by line out of masks. - A warm "lantern" glow follows the cursor. ## Media: every asset URL All images are Higgsfield generation results served through the images.higgs.ai resizer. They are not re-uploaded. | Asset | URL | Notes | |---|---|---| | Scene 1, hero (canyon, moon and castle, ghost-light falls, pool, lower cascade) | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261029_023809_d6836117-c958-4680-aa43-1e1973fbc17c.png&w=2400&q=85 waterfall opening at 47–53 % | https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261029_025938_e54c50c3-9748-4d00-af68-886bef6e65e7.png&w=2400&q=85 rim, stalactites, two hanging bats), no opening | | 1024 × 688, keeps alpha | ### Using the scenes - Each scene is the `background` of an `.art` box (`center / 100% 100% no-repeat`), passed through a CSS variable `--img`. - When the URL is inside an inline `style` attribute, write it as `url('…')` in single quotes. - Every scene's top and bottom edge is dark `#110A2A`. The seam bands cover those edges completely, so no fade is ever visible. ### Using the sprite sheet Each sprite is a `
` showing a crop of the one sheet. With the sheet at 1024 × 688 and a crop of `[x, y, w, h]`: - `background-size = (1024/w × 100)% (688/h × 100)%` - `background-position = (x/(1024−w) × 100)% (y/(688−h) × 100)%` - `aspect-ratio = w / h` | Sprite | Crop [x, y, w, h] | |---|---| | ghost1: drifting, trailing tail | 39, 103, 204, 221 | | ghost2: waving | 303, 122, 152, 212 | | ghost3: curled tail | 538, 125, 208, 201 | | ghost4: tall, rising | 833, 70, 131, 280 | | bat, wings up | 41, 389, 203, 221 | | bat, wings down | 299, 389, 195, 221 | Ghosts carry `filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(170,235,255,.45))`. ## Fonts Self-host them; the single file embeds both as base64 WOFF2 (Latin subset). | Family | Use | Source | |---|---|---| | Oswald (variable, 200–700) | The hero title and subtitle | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@300..700 | | Inter (variable, 100–900) | Nav, headings, body, buttons | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600 | ## Tokens | Token | Value | |---|---| | `--night` (page and theme colour) | `#110A2A` | | `--ink` | `#F4F0FF` | | `--soft` (body copy) | `rgba(232,226,255,.78)` | | `--ember` (button hover) | `#FF9A3C` | | `--ease` | `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)` | | `--artH` (scene height) | `calc(100vw × 1520 / 2688)`, so each scene is exactly 16:9-ish and fills a 1440 × 810 screen | ## Page structure - **`
`:** fixed, `z-index 50`. - **`#scroller`:** `position: fixed; top: 0; width: 100%`, moved by `translate3d`. It holds the five `
` elements, with a `
` between each pair. There is no footer. - **`body`:** its height is set by JS to the scroller's height, so native scrolling drives everything. - **`.lamp`:** the cursor light, `position: fixed`. ### Nav - **Bar:** 64px tall, padding 0 2.2vw, grid `1fr auto 1fr`, with a top-down scrim from `rgba(17,10,42,.55)` to transparent. - **Type:** Inter 500, 12px, links in `rgba(244,240,255,.82)` turning white on hover. - **Left,** 5.6vw apart: "Our Story", "The Rites", "Visitors". - **Centre, the logo:** a 26 × 24 SVG. A solid white triangle (13,1 → 25,23 → 1,23) with a crescent-moon notch: a 3.4px night-coloured circle at (13, 15.2) overlapped by a 3px white circle at (14.4, 14.4). - **Right:** "Gallery" and "Journal" (both link to the finale), then a "Tickets" box: 1px `rgba(244,240,255,.6)` border, padding 9px 14px, 2px radius, filling white with night-coloured text on hover. - **On load:** the nav slides down from `translateY(−100%)` over 900ms with a 500ms delay. ### Scene shell - **`.scene`:** `position: relative; height: var(--artH); overflow-x: clip`. - **Stacking:** scenes have no z-index. The hero has `overflow: clip` on both axes, so its parallax never spills onto scene 2. - **`.art`:** `position: absolute; inset: top 0 left 0; width: 100vw; height: var(--artH)`. It holds a `.bg` div plus every animated layer, all positioned in **% of the illustration**, so they stay locked to the painted features at any size. ## The seams: illustrated rock bands across every join - **Element:** `
` with `position: relative; height: 0; z-index: 10; pointer-events: none`, placed between two sections. It sits above both neighbouring scenes. - **Band:** a `.band` box inside it, `position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100vw; aspect-ratio: 2688 / 1152; transform: translateY(−50%)`, so it straddles the join exactly. It holds the transparent band image (``, filling the box, `z-index 1`) and, where the falls pass through, a falls canvas behind the image (`z-index 0`). - **Size:** the drawn rock occupies about 19–80 % of the band image's height. At 1440px wide, that is roughly 185px into the bottom of the upper scene and 185px into the top of the lower scene. - **Mobile:** the band uses the lower scene's `--focus` with the same width and offset formula as `.art`, so its opening stays over the lower scene's falls. | Seam | Between | `--focus` | Falls canvas behind the opening (left / top / width / height, % of the band) | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | Hero → Our Story | 48 | 44.8 / 2 / 10.4 / 90, speed 1 | | 2 | Our Story → The Rites | 40 | 21.4 / 22 / 10.6 / 74, speed 1 | | 3 | The Rites → Plan Your Night | 66 | 60.8 / 46 / 13.6 / 50, speed 1 (below the painted pipe collar) | | 4 | Plan Your Night → Finale | 45 | none | **Seam waterfalls get a water body.** Behind each opening there is no painted water, only the dark edges of the scenes, so a seam falls canvas first fills itself with a horizontal gradient before drawing its streaks: - `rgba(80,150,255,0)` at the edges; - `rgba(90,175,255,.7)` at 18 % and 82 %; - `rgba(175,238,255,.96)` in the centre. This makes the stream opaque enough to read as one waterfall continuing from the hero's painted cascade into the crypt's painted falls. **Seam 1's canvas starts at 2 % of the band**, well above the join, so it is fully opaque across the line where the clipped hero ends. ## The five scenes, with every overlay Positions are left and top in % of the art box; widths are % of art width. `canvas.fall` boxes are left, top, width, height. Every `.glow`, `.mist` and `.moonglow` is centred on its point with `translate(−50%, −50%)` and is a 1:1 circle unless a height is given. ### 1. Hero: "HOLLOWMERE" (`#top`, focus 50) **Overlays:** - **`.moonglow`** at 50.2 / 25.6, width 21 %. It is a ring halo: a radial gradient, transparent to 62 %, then `rgba(255,226,170,.32)` at 70 % and `rgba(190,150,255,.12)` at 85 %. It breathes over 6s. - **Upper falls canvas** (ghost-light, speed 1): 47.4 / 51, 5.6 × 22. - **Mist** at 50 / 73, 22 × 9. - **Lower cascade canvas** (ghost-light, speed 1.15): 44 / 80, 12.4 × 34. It overhangs the bottom and is clipped by the hero. - **12 warm jack-o'-lantern `.glow`s:** | left / top | width | |---|---| | 4.8 / 54.4 | 4.6 | | 18.5 / 50.6 | 3.6 | | 17.5 / 69.4 | 3.8 | | 25.9 / 38.3 | 2.6 | | 31.6 / 42 | 2.4 | | 30.4 / 63 | 2.4 | | 80 / 36.7 | 3 | | 85 / 45.3 | 3 | | 93.8 / 53 | 4.6 | | 87.8 / 73 | 3.8 | | 74.5 / 61 | 2.6 | | 67.2 / 64.8 | 2.6 | - **Wisp canvas:** 70 particles. - **Sprites:** - ghost1 at 21 / 30, width 4.2 %. - ghost2 at 78 / 21, width 3.4 %. - ghost4 at 64 / 44, width 2.8 %. - ghost3 at 36 / 46, width 2.4 %. - 4 bats crossing the sky band from 8 % to 34 %. **Hero copy** sits centred at `top: artH × .085`, `z-index 6`: | Element | Text | Style | |---|---|---| | `h1` | "HOLLOWMERE", split into one span per letter | Oswald 500, `clamp(46px, 6.4vw, 124px)`, line height 1, letter-spacing `calc(var(--ls, .42em) + var(--lsx, 0em))` with left padding equal to `--ls` so it stays optically centred, `overflow: hidden`, text-shadow `0 0 40px rgba(120,90,255,.45)` | | `.sub` | "A NIGHT OF LANTERNS" | Oswald 500, `clamp(12px, 1.18vw, 22px)`, letter-spacing .62em, white, no shadow. There is **no footer**: the page ends on the finale scene. ## Copy typography | Element | Style | |---|---| | `h2` | Inter 600, `clamp(30px, 3.4vw, 60px)`, line height 1.04, letter-spacing −.025em | | `.rule` | 150 × 1px, `rgba(244,240,255,.45)`, margins 20px 0 22px, `transform-origin: left` | | `h3` | Inter 600, 15px, 22px above and 8px below (no top margin straight after the rule) | | Paragraph | Inter 400, 14px, line height 1.55, `--soft`, max 52ch, 10px between paragraphs | | `.btn` | 38px tall, padding 0 18px, white with night text, Inter 600 12.5px, 2px radius, 22px above | - **Copy blocks:** `max-width: 520px`, `z-index 6`. There are no eyebrow lines above the headings. - **Button hover:** turns ember `#FF9A3C` with `#1A0B05` text and lifts 2px. Colour transitions take .3s; the lift uses `--ease`. ## The falls renderer (`canvas.fall`) **Element styling:** - `mix-blend-mode: screen`, so the streaks add light on top of the painted falls. - A **double CSS mask**, intersected (`mask-composite: intersect`, `-webkit-mask-composite: source-in`): - horizontal: transparent → black 22 % → black 78 % → transparent; - vertical: transparent → black 12 % → black 82 % → transparent. - The streams therefore feather out at the sides, top and bottom. **Streak sprites:** pre-render 8 × 160 offscreen canvases, each a vertical gradient, two per kind. | Kind | Sprite A | Sprite B | |---|---|---| | ghost | `rgba(190,240,255,0)` → `rgba(210,248,255,.95)` at 35 % → `rgba(120,200,255,0)` | `rgba(120,190,255,0)` → `rgba(140,215,255,.8)` at 50 % → `rgba(90,150,255,0)` | | lava | `rgba(255,190,80,0)` → `rgba(255,236,150,1)` at 40 % → `rgba(255,120,30,0)` | `rgba(255,120,30,0)` → `rgba(255,150,50,.9)` at 50 % → `rgba(255,80,20,0)` | **Sizing (on load and resize):** - Read `offsetWidth` and `offsetHeight`, which ignore transforms, so the hero's load zoom does not distort it. - The pixel ratio is capped at 1.5. **Streaks per canvas:** | | ghost | lava | |---|---|---| | Count | `round(w / 2.2) × 2` | `round(w / 3) × 3` | | x | Anywhere across the width | Within the middle 50 % | | Stroke width | .8–4px | 1–3.2px | | Length | 60–280px | 30–100px | | Speed | 420–760 px/s × the canvas `data-speed` | 195–350 px/s × the canvas `data-speed` | | Opacity | .18–.73 | .18–.73 | Each streak gets a random phase and one of the two sprites (45 % / 55 %). **Each frame:** - Clear the canvas and switch to `globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'`. - For every streak, `y = ((t × v × speed + phase) mod (h + len)) − len`. - Draw the sprite at (x, y) and again one span higher, so streaks wrap seamlessly. - Ghost streaks dim towards the edges by `1 − (|x/w − .5| × 2)² × .6`. - Only canvases whose rect is within 50px of the viewport are drawn. ## Particle canvases (`canvas.dust`) **Setup:** - Each canvas is full-art, with `mix-blend-mode: screen`. - Each particle has u, v, r, phase and speed .4–1.2. - An optional box (`data-x/w/y/h`, in %) limits where the particles live. - A canvas is drawn only while it is on screen. | Kind | Behaviour | |---|---| | `wisp` (hero) | Rises at `.02 × speed` of the height per second from the canyon floor. It respawns at v .98 across x .2–.8 once v passes .35. It sways ±1.2 % and has radius .8–2.6px. Opacity fades in over the first .25 of its rise and pulses with `|sin(2t + phase)|`. Colour `rgb(190,240,255)` | | `mote` (crypt) | Drifts up very slowly (.008 × speed), wraps top to bottom, sways ±2 %, radius .6–2px, opacity .25–.75, colour `rgb(170,225,255)` | | `spray` (mill) | Lives a 1-second loop, `life = (t × speed × .8 + phase) mod 1`. It is thrown sideways by `(r − .5) × .6` of the box and falls in a parabola (`life² × .9` of the box height). Radius .7–2.3px, opacity 1 − life, colour `rgb(200,245,255)` | | `bubble` (cauldron) | `life = (t × speed × .16 + phase) mod 1`. Rises from the bottom of the box to the top, wobbling `sin(1.4t)` × 3 % of the box, with radius (2–9px) × width/1440. Drawn as a radial gradient: `rgba(255,240,180,a)` → `rgba(255,170,70,.55a)` → transparent, with a highlight offset up and left. `a = sin(life × π) × .9` | | `shimmer` (lake) | Horizontal glints 12–32px long and 1.2px tall in `rgba(255,240,205,a)`, with `a = max(0, sin(t × (1.2 + 2r) + phase)) × .8`. They spread wider further down the light pillar (spread .3 → 1) | ## CSS-animated glows | Class | Look | Animation | |---|---|---| | `.glow` (warm) | `radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255,150,60,.7), rgba(255,110,40,.22) 50%, transparent)`, `mix-blend-mode: screen` | `flicker` 2.8s `steps(1,end)` infinite: an irregular candle stutter that holds opacity at 1 → .78 → 1 → .86 → 1 → .7 → .95 → .82 | | `.glow.cold` | Cyan `rgba(150,235,255,.6)` / `rgba(110,190,255,.2)` | `breathe` 3.8s | | `.mist` | Elliptical `radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(170,235,255,.55), rgba(120,200,255,.18) 55%, transparent)` | `breathe` 4.6s | | `.moonglow` | The ring halo described above | `breathe` 6s | `breathe` keeps the element centred and scales it 1 → 1.08 → 1, with brightness 1 → 1.25 → 1, ease-in-out. ## Sprites in motion **Ghosts:** - **Placement:** each ghost is placed by `translate3d` at its % anchor in the art, centred, with drift added on top. - **Wander:** `x += sin(.35t + phase) × 1.2 %` of the art width, `y += sin(.9t + phase) × 1.4 %` of the art height. - **Sway:** rotation `sin(.7t + phase) × 6° + offsetX × .05`. - **Cursor repulsion:** within 260px of the cursor, a ghost is pushed directly away by up to `(1 − d/260)^1.5 × 90` px. The push eases at `1 − e^(−3dt)`, so ghosts glide aside and drift back. **Bats:** - **Path:** each bat flies `x: −8 % → 108 %` of the art width over 9–16s, looping, with a random offset. - **Height:** `y = y0 + sin(p × 9 + offset × 6) × (1–4) %`. - **Size:** 1.6–3.2 % of the art width, aspect 203 / 221. - **Flap:** wings-up and wings-down frames swap 8–12 times a second, toggled by a `.down` class. ## Motion system ### Smooth scroll - Each frame: `cur += (scrollY − cur) × (1 − e^(−7.5·dt))`. It snaps when within .05px. - `#scroller` gets `translate3d(0, −cur px, 0)`. - Anchor links jump instantly by native scroll, and the easing does the glide. ### Hero parallax - The hero `.art` translates `+cur × .32` px, so the illustration lags behind. - `.hero-copy` translates `+cur × .55` px. - The title's `--lsx` grows from 0 to .18em as the hero scrolls away. With `hp = clamp(cur / heroHeight, 0, 1)`, the letters spread apart as you descend. ### Load intro All Web Animations: - **Letters:** each letter rises `translateY(110%) → 0` over 1200ms, starting at 250ms, 70ms apart. - **Subtitle:** over 1600ms from 900ms: letter-spacing 1.4em → .62em, `translateY(14px) → 0`, `clip-path: inset(0 50% 0 50%) → inset(0)`. It opens from the centre outwards. - **Hero art:** `scale(1.09) → 1` over 2600ms, composited with "add" so it stacks on the parallax. - **Nav:** slides down over 900ms from 500ms. - **Easing:** `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)` throughout. ### Section reveals - **Trigger:** the first time a copy block's top passes 80 % of the viewport height. - **Lines:** each `.ln > span` rises `translateY(105%) → 0` over 1000ms, 80ms apart. - **Rule:** scales X 0 → 1 over 1100ms after 160ms. - **No opacity fades anywhere.** ### Lantern light - A fixed 520px circle, `radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255,170,90,.16), rgba(255,140,70,.06) 55%, transparent)`, `mix-blend-mode: screen`. - It follows the cursor with `1 − e^(−10·dt)` smoothing. - It shows only on fine pointers. ## Responsive (≤ 767px) - **Scene height:** `--artH: max(100vw × 1520/2688, 92svh)`, so phones get tall scenes. - **Art box:** widens to `artH × 2688/1520` and slides so each scene's `--focus` x (in %) sits at the screen centre: `left = 50vw − focus × artWidth / 100`. | Scene | Focus | |---|---| | Hero | 50 (falls) | | Story | 48 | | Rites | 40 | | Night | 66 (cauldron) | | Finale | 45 (moon) | - **Nav:** 56px tall. Only the logo (left) and Tickets (right) remain. - **Hero copy:** at `artH × .11`, title 9.6vw with `--ls: .14em`, subtitle 11px with .42em tracking at `top: artH × .305`. - **Section copy:** full width (left and right 20px, top 24 % of the scene, below the band) on a panel `linear-gradient(rgba(17,10,42,.78), rgba(17,10,42,.5))` with a 2px backdrop blur and 18px padding. `h2` is 30px, paragraphs 13.5px. - **Finale copy:** at top 26 %, with no panel. - **Seam bands:** follow the lower scene's focus, like `.art`. ## Reduced motion - Glows, mist and moonglow stop animating. - Copy is shown without the rise. - The scroll easing is instant. - Canvases draw a single still frame (t = 0), and nothing drifts. ## Acceptance checklist 1. **Load:** at 1440 × 810 the hero fills the screen. HOLLOWMERE rises letter by letter over the moon and castle, the subtitle opens from the centre, and the ghost-light falls stream into the misty pool. 2. **Cursor:** moving it near a ghost makes the ghost glide away. 3. **Descent:** scrolling glides down with momentum. The hero lags and its title spreads apart. At every join a drawn rock band (ground above, cave ceiling below) bridges the scenes, and the waterfall pours through its opening as one continuous glowing stream. No gradient fades anywhere. 4. **Copy:** "Our Story", "The Rites" and "Plan Your Night" rise line by line into the dark areas of their scenes. The mill throws spray, the cauldron pours three lava streams and bubbles, and the jack-o'-lanterns and candles flicker. 5. **Finale:** "See you at midnight." over the lantern lake, with shimmering moonlight and flickering lanterns. The page ends there.

Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript in one file, with no libraries. **The structure.** The page is **one continuous illustrated descent**: five full-bleed flat-vector Halloween scenes stacked vertically into a single tall picture. | # | Scene | |---|---| | 1 | A moonlit canyon of gothic houses with a castle on the moon | | 2 | An underground crypt laboratory with a glass tower of captured ghosts | | 3 | A mill chamber with a giant jack-o'-lantern-studded wheel | | 4 | A cauldron foundry pouring molten potion | | 5 | A cave mouth opening onto a moonlit lake of floating lanterns | **The joins.** Between every pair of scenes lies an illustrated band of rock strata: the ground of the scene above on top, the cave ceiling of the scene below underneath. The seam bands cover those edges completely, so no fade is ever visible. ### Using the sprite sheet Each sprite is a `
` showing a crop of the one sheet. With the sheet at 1024 × 688 and a crop of `[x, y, w, h]`: - `background-size = (1024/w × 100)% (688/h × 100)%` - `background-position = (x/(1024−w) × 100)% (y/(688−h) × 100)%` - `aspect-ratio = w / h` | Sprite | Crop [x, y, w, h] | |---|---| | ghost1: drifting, trailing tail | 39, 103, 204, 221 | | ghost2: waving | 303, 122, 152, 212 | | ghost3: curled tail | 538, 125, 208, 201 | | ghost4: tall, rising | 833, 70, 131, 280 | | bat, wings up | 41, 389, 203, 221 | | bat, wings down | 299, 389, 195, 221 | Ghosts carry `filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(170,235,255,.45))`. ## Fonts Self-host them; the single file embeds both as base64 WOFF2 (Latin subset). | Family | Use | Source | |---|---|---| | Oswald (variable, 200–700) | The hero title and subtitle | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@300..700 | | Inter (variable, 100–900) | Nav, headings, body, buttons | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600 | ## Tokens | Token | Value | |---|---| | `--night` (page and theme colour) | `#110A2A` | | `--ink` | `#F4F0FF` | | `--soft` (body copy) | `rgba(232,226,255,.78)` | | `--ember` (button hover) | `#FF9A3C` | | `--ease` | `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)` | | `--artH` (scene height) | `calc(100vw × 1520 / 2688)`, so each scene is exactly 16:9-ish and fills a 1440 × 810 screen | ## Page structure - **`
`:** fixed, `z-index 50`. - **`#scroller`:** `position: fixed; top: 0; width: 100%`, moved by `translate3d`. It holds the five `
` elements, with a `
` between each pair. There is no footer. - **`body`:** its height is set by JS to the scroller's height, so native scrolling drives everything. - **`.lamp`:** the cursor light, `position: fixed`. ### Nav - **Bar:** 64px tall, padding 0 2.2vw, grid `1fr auto 1fr`, with a top-down scrim from `rgba(17,10,42,.55)` to transparent. - **Type:** Inter 500, 12px, links in `rgba(244,240,255,.82)` turning white on hover. - **Left,** 5.6vw apart: "Our Story", "The Rites", "Visitors". - **Centre, the logo:** a 26 × 24 SVG. A solid white triangle (13,1 → 25,23 → 1,23) with a crescent-moon notch: a 3.4px night-coloured circle at (13, 15.2) overlapped by a 3px white circle at (14.4, 14.4). - **Right:** "Gallery" and "Journal" (both link to the finale), then a "Tickets" box: 1px `rgba(244,240,255,.6)` border, padding 9px 14px, 2px radius, filling white with night-coloured text on hover. - **On load:** the nav slides down from `translateY(−100%)` over 900ms with a 500ms delay. ### Scene shell - **`.scene`:** `position: relative; height: var(--artH); overflow-x: clip`. - **Stacking:** scenes have no z-index. The hero has `overflow: clip` on both axes, so its parallax never spills onto scene 2. - **`.art`:** `position: absolute; inset: top 0 left 0; width: 100vw; height: var(--artH)`. It holds a `.bg` div plus every animated layer, all positioned in **% of the illustration**, so they stay locked to the painted features at any size. ## The seams: illustrated rock bands across every join - **Element:** `
` with `position: relative; height: 0; z-index: 10; pointer-events: none`, placed between two sections. It sits above both neighbouring scenes. - **Band:** a `.band` box inside it, `position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100vw; aspect-ratio: 2688 / 1152; transform: translateY(−50%)`, so it straddles the join exactly. It holds the transparent band image (``, filling the box, `z-index 1`) and, where the falls pass through, a falls canvas behind the image (`z-index 0`). - **Size:** the drawn rock occupies about 19–80 % of the band image's height. At 1440px wide, that is roughly 185px into the bottom of the upper scene and 185px into the top of the lower scene. - **Mobile:** the band uses the lower scene's `--focus` with the same width and offset formula as `.art`, so its opening stays over the lower scene's falls. | Seam | Between | `--focus` | Falls canvas behind the opening (left / top / width / height, % of the band) | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | Hero → Our Story | 48 | 44.8 / 2 / 10.4 / 90, speed 1 | | 2 | Our Story → The Rites | 40 | 21.4 / 22 / 10.6 / 74, speed 1 | | 3 | The Rites → Plan Your Night | 66 | 60.8 / 46 / 13.6 / 50, speed 1 (below the painted pipe collar) | | 4 | Plan Your Night → Finale | 45 | none | **Seam waterfalls get a water body.** Behind each opening there is no painted water, only the dark edges of the scenes, so a seam falls canvas first fills itself with a horizontal gradient before drawing its streaks: - `rgba(80,150,255,0)` at the edges; - `rgba(90,175,255,.7)` at 18 % and 82 %; - `rgba(175,238,255,.96)` in the centre. This makes the stream opaque enough to read as one waterfall continuing from the hero's painted cascade into the crypt's painted falls. **Seam 1's canvas starts at 2 % of the band**, well above the join, so it is fully opaque across the line where the clipped hero ends. ## The five scenes, with every overlay Positions are left and top in % of the art box; widths are % of art width. `canvas.fall` boxes are left, top, width, height. Every `.glow`, `.mist` and `.moonglow` is centred on its point with `translate(−50%, −50%)` and is a 1:1 circle unless a height is given. ### 1. Hero: "HOLLOWMERE" (`#top`, focus 50) **Overlays:** - **`.moonglow`** at 50.2 / 25.6, width 21 %. It is a ring halo: a radial gradient, transparent to 62 %, then `rgba(255,226,170,.32)` at 70 % and `rgba(190,150,255,.12)` at 85 %. It breathes over 6s. - **Upper falls canvas** (ghost-light, speed 1): 47.4 / 51, 5.6 × 22. - **Mist** at 50 / 73, 22 × 9. - **Lower cascade canvas** (ghost-light, speed 1.15): 44 / 80, 12.4 × 34. It overhangs the bottom and is clipped by the hero. - **12 warm jack-o'-lantern `.glow`s:** | left / top | width | |---|---| | 4.8 / 54.4 | 4.6 | | 18.5 / 50.6 | 3.6 | | 17.5 / 69.4 | 3.8 | | 25.9 / 38.3 | 2.6 | | 31.6 / 42 | 2.4 | | 30.4 / 63 | 2.4 | | 80 / 36.7 | 3 | | 85 / 45.3 | 3 | | 93.8 / 53 | 4.6 | | 87.8 / 73 | 3.8 | | 74.5 / 61 | 2.6 | | 67.2 / 64.8 | 2.6 | - **Wisp canvas:** 70 particles. - **Sprites:** - ghost1 at 21 / 30, width 4.2 %. - ghost2 at 78 / 21, width 3.4 %. - ghost4 at 64 / 44, width 2.8 %. - ghost3 at 36 / 46, width 2.4 %. - 4 bats crossing the sky band from 8 % to 34 %. **Hero copy** sits centred at `top: artH × .085`, `z-index 6`: | Element | Text | Style | |---|---|---| | `h1` | "HOLLOWMERE", split into one span per letter | Oswald 500, `clamp(46px, 6.4vw, 124px)`, line height 1, letter-spacing `calc(var(--ls, .42em) + var(--lsx, 0em))` with left padding equal to `--ls` so it stays optically centred, `overflow: hidden`, text-shadow `0 0 40px rgba(120,90,255,.45)` | | `.sub` | "A NIGHT OF LANTERNS" | Oswald 500, `clamp(12px, 1.18vw, 22px)`, letter-spacing .62em, white, no shadow. Absolutely placed at `top: artH × .335` inside the hero copy (`.085 + .335` = 42 % of the art), on the dark hill **below** the moon and castle, so the title and subtitle frame the castle and nothing sits over the pale moon | ### 2. "Our Story" (`#story`, focus 48) **Overlays:** - **Falls canvas** (speed .9): 40.6 / 0, 17.2 × 90. - **Mist** at 49 / 84, 34 × 14. - **Cold `.glow`s** (cyan): | What | left / top | width | |---|---|---| | Crystal ball | 20.3 / 69.8 | 7 | | Ghost jars in the tower | 72.5 / 19 | 5 | | | 80.4 / 18.1 | 4.4 | | | 76 / 41.6 | 5.6 | | | 85 / 43.3 | 4 | | | 70.5 / 68.5 | 4.4 | | | 77.3 / 63.7 | 4.4 | | | 85.3 / 66.3 | 4 | - **Warm `.glow`s:** 7.6 / 85 (4.4), 13.2 / 87 (3.2), 92.2 / 84 (3.6). - **Mote canvas:** 50 particles. - **Sprite:** ghost4 at 30 / 22, width 2.6 %. **Copy** at left 6.5 %, top 26 %, width 31 %, below the seam band: | Element | Text | |---|---| | `h2` | "Our Story" | | Rule | | | Paragraph | "Every October the falls of Hollowmere run pale. For one night the canyon lights its lanterns, the old houses open their doors, and the ghosts come home to visit." | | Paragraph | "We have kept the night for two hundred years: a walk through the crypts, the mill and the cauldron halls, ending at the lake where the lanterns are set free." | | Button | "Read the legend" | ### 3. "The Rites" (`#rites`, focus 40) **Overlays:** - **Falls canvas** (speed 1.05): 19.5 / 0, 18 × 38. It covers only the stretch above the wheel. - **Mist** at 31 / 33, 22 × 10. - **Warm wheel-pumpkin glows,** each 4.2 wide: 12 / 34, 37.5 / 47.7, 32.3 / 52.6, 11.7 / 62.3, 39 / 78.2. - **Cold spellbook glows,** each 9 wide: 64.5 / 70.3 and 88.5 / 70.7. - **Candle glows,** each 2.4 wide: 61.4 / 75, 72.6 / 75.4, 91.5 / 75.4. - **Spray canvas:** 60 particles in the box x 20–40 %, y 30–48 %, where the falls hits the wheel. **Copy** at left 55 %, top 24 %, width 40 %: | Element | Text | |---|---| | `h2` | "The Rites" | | Rule | | | `h3` | "The Lantern Walk." | | Paragraph | "At dusk the procession leaves the castle gate and follows the ghost-light falls down into the canyon. Bring a lantern, or borrow one of ours at the gate." | | Paragraph | "Children lead, the old walk last, and nobody looks back until the bells stop." | | `h3` | "The Turning Wheel." | | Paragraph | "Below the falls the old mill turns all night. Write a wish on a paper lantern, pin it to a spoke, and let the wheel carry it round to midnight." | ### 4. "Plan Your Night" (`#night`, focus 66) **Overlays:** - **Falls canvas** (ghost, speed 1): 67.4 / 0, 11.8 × 37, pouring into the cauldron. - **Three lava canvases** (speeds .55 / .6 / .5), each 1.8 wide and 25 tall at top 66.5, at left 62.3, 69.4 and 76.5. They line up with the three painted pipes. - **Warm glows:** a wide floor glow at 70 / 93 (width 26), plus 16.8 / 78.2 (6), 27.8 / 85.3 (4) and 18 / 66.3 (8, the big amber bubble). - **Cold glow** at 73 / 33 (14) where the falls meets the cauldron. - **Bubble canvas:** 22 particles in the box x 60–84 %, y 8–36 %. **Copy** at left 6.5 %, top 25 %, width 40 %: | Element | Text | |---|---| | `h2` | "Plan Your Night" | | Rule | | | `h3` | "Gates at Six." | | Paragraph | "The gates open at 18:00 on 31 October. The walk takes about ninety minutes, and the cauldron halls stay open until three, serving spiced cider, soul cakes and hot pumpkin broth." | | `h3` | "Midnight at the Cauldron." | | Paragraph | "At the twelfth bell the great cauldron is lit and every lantern in Hollowmere is carried down to the lake. Stay for it." | ### 5. Finale (`#finale`, focus 45) **Overlays:** - **`.moonglow`** at 39.1 / 56.6, width 19. - **Shimmer canvas:** 90 particles in the box x 34–44 %, y 69–91 %, on the moon's light pillar. - **15 warm lantern glows:** | left / top | width | |---|---| | 29.9 / 76.7 | 3.4 | | 32.9 / 72.7 | 2.4 | | 45.9 / 72.7 | 2.4 | | 48.3 / 77.4 | 3.6 | | 55.4 / 81.8 | 4 | | 58.1 / 75.6 | 3.2 | | 53.9 / 72.2 | 2.2 | | 62.5 / 72.5 | 2.2 | | 69.9 / 80.9 | 4 | | 74.9 / 75.9 | 3.2 | | 73 / 72.3 | 2.2 | | 79.1 / 72.5 | 2.2 | | 24.8 / 72.1 | 2.2 | | 7.8 / 65.4 | 5 (cave jack-o'-lantern) | | 89.8 / 76.9 | 5 (cave jack-o'-lantern) | - **Sprites:** ghost2 at 66 / 26 (width 3 %), ghost1 at 27 / 38 (width 2.6 %), and 3 bats in the band 24–40 %. **Copy** is centred: `left: 50%; translateX(−50%); top: 30%; width: 60%; text-align: center`. - **`h2`:** "See you at midnight.", `clamp(34px, 4.4vw, 78px)`. - **Rule:** centred. - **Buttons:** "Get tickets" (white, links to the finale) and "Plan your visit" (ghost button: transparent with a 1px `rgba(244,240,255,.6)` border). There is **no footer**: the page ends on the finale scene. ## Copy typography | Element | Style | |---|---| | `h2` | Inter 600, `clamp(30px, 3.4vw, 60px)`, line height 1.04, letter-spacing −.025em | | `.rule` | 150 × 1px, `rgba(244,240,255,.45)`, margins 20px 0 22px, `transform-origin: left` | | `h3` | Inter 600, 15px, 22px above and 8px below (no top margin straight after the rule) | | Paragraph | Inter 400, 14px, line height 1.55, `--soft`, max 52ch, 10px between paragraphs | | `.btn` | 38px tall, padding 0 18px, white with night text, Inter 600 12.5px, 2px radius, 22px above | - **Copy blocks:** `max-width: 520px`, `z-index 6`. There are no eyebrow lines above the headings. - **Button hover:** turns ember `#FF9A3C` with `#1A0B05` text and lifts 2px. Colour transitions take .3s; the lift uses `--ease`. ## The falls renderer (`canvas.fall`) **Element styling:** - `mix-blend-mode: screen`, so the streaks add light on top of the painted falls. - A **double CSS mask**, intersected (`mask-composite: intersect`, `-webkit-mask-composite: source-in`): - horizontal: transparent → black 22 % → black 78 % → transparent; - vertical: transparent → black 12 % → black 82 % → transparent. - The streams therefore feather out at the sides, top and bottom. **Streak sprites:** pre-render 8 × 160 offscreen canvases, each a vertical gradient, two per kind. | Kind | Sprite A | Sprite B | |---|---|---| | ghost | `rgba(190,240,255,0)` → `rgba(210,248,255,.95)` at 35 % → `rgba(120,200,255,0)` | `rgba(120,190,255,0)` → `rgba(140,215,255,.8)` at 50 % → `rgba(90,150,255,0)` | | lava | `rgba(255,190,80,0)` → `rgba(255,236,150,1)` at 40 % → `rgba(255,120,30,0)` | `rgba(255,120,30,0)` → `rgba(255,150,50,.9)` at 50 % → `rgba(255,80,20,0)` | **Sizing (on load and resize):** - Read `offsetWidth` and `offsetHeight`, which ignore transforms, so the hero's load zoom does not distort it. - The pixel ratio is capped at 1.5. **Streaks per canvas:** | | ghost | lava | |---|---|---| | Count | `round(w / 2.2) × 2` | `round(w / 3) × 3` | | x | Anywhere across the width | Within the middle 50 % | | Stroke width | .8–4px | 1–3.2px | | Length | 60–280px | 30–100px | | Speed | 420–760 px/s × the canvas `data-speed` | 195–350 px/s × the canvas `data-speed` | | Opacity | .18–.73 | .18–.73 | Each streak gets a random phase and one of the two sprites (45 % / 55 %). **Each frame:** - Clear the canvas and switch to `globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'`. - For every streak, `y = ((t × v × speed + phase) mod (h + len)) − len`. - Draw the sprite at (x, y) and again one span higher, so streaks wrap seamlessly. - Ghost streaks dim towards the edges by `1 − (|x/w − .5| × 2)² × .6`. - Only canvases whose rect is within 50px of the viewport are drawn. ## Particle canvases (`canvas.dust`) **Setup:** - Each canvas is full-art, with `mix-blend-mode: screen`. - Each particle has u, v, r, phase and speed .4–1.2. - An optional box (`data-x/w/y/h`, in %) limits where the particles live. - A canvas is drawn only while it is on screen. | Kind | Behaviour | |---|---| | `wisp` (hero) | Rises at `.02 × speed` of the height per second from the canyon floor. It respawns at v .98 across x .2–.8 once v passes .35. It sways ±1.2 % and has radius .8–2.6px. Opacity fades in over the first .25 of its rise and pulses with `|sin(2t + phase)|`. Colour `rgb(190,240,255)` | | `mote` (crypt) | Drifts up very slowly (.008 × speed), wraps top to bottom, sways ±2 %, radius .6–2px, opacity .25–.75, colour `rgb(170,225,255)` | | `spray` (mill) | Lives a 1-second loop, `life = (t × speed × .8 + phase) mod 1`. It is thrown sideways by `(r − .5) × .6` of the box and falls in a parabola (`life² × .9` of the box height). Radius .7–2.3px, opacity 1 − life, colour `rgb(200,245,255)` | | `bubble` (cauldron) | `life = (t × speed × .16 + phase) mod 1`. Rises from the bottom of the box to the top, wobbling `sin(1.4t)` × 3 % of the box, with radius (2–9px) × width/1440. Drawn as a radial gradient: `rgba(255,240,180,a)` → `rgba(255,170,70,.55a)` → transparent, with a highlight offset up and left. `a = sin(life × π) × .9` | | `shimmer` (lake) | Horizontal glints 12–32px long and 1.2px tall in `rgba(255,240,205,a)`, with `a = max(0, sin(t × (1.2 + 2r) + phase)) × .8`. They spread wider further down the light pillar (spread .3 → 1) | ## CSS-animated glows | Class | Look | Animation | |---|---|---| | `.glow` (warm) | `radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255,150,60,.7), rgba(255,110,40,.22) 50%, transparent)`, `mix-blend-mode: screen` | `flicker` 2.8s `steps(1,end)` infinite: an irregular candle stutter that holds opacity at 1 → .78 → 1 → .86 → 1 → .7 → .95 → .82 | | `.glow.cold` | Cyan `rgba(150,235,255,.6)` / `rgba(110,190,255,.2)` | `breathe` 3.8s | | `.mist` | Elliptical `radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(170,235,255,.55), rgba(120,200,255,.18) 55%, transparent)` | `breathe` 4.6s | | `.moonglow` | The ring halo described above | `breathe` 6s | `breathe` keeps the element centred and scales it 1 → 1.08 → 1, with brightness 1 → 1.25 → 1, ease-in-out. ## Sprites in motion **Ghosts:** - **Placement:** each ghost is placed by `translate3d` at its % anchor in the art, centred, with drift added on top. - **Wander:** `x += sin(.35t + phase) × 1.2 %` of the art width, `y += sin(.9t + phase) × 1.4 %` of the art height. - **Sway:** rotation `sin(.7t + phase) × 6° + offsetX × .05`. - **Cursor repulsion:** within 260px of the cursor, a ghost is pushed directly away by up to `(1 − d/260)^1.5 × 90` px. The push eases at `1 − e^(−3dt)`, so ghosts glide aside and drift back. **Bats:** - **Path:** each bat flies `x: −8 % → 108 %` of the art width over 9–16s, looping, with a random offset. - **Height:** `y = y0 + sin(p × 9 + offset × 6) × (1–4) %`. - **Size:** 1.6–3.2 % of the art width, aspect 203 / 221. - **Flap:** wings-up and wings-down frames swap 8–12 times a second, toggled by a `.down` class. ## Motion system ### Smooth scroll - Each frame: `cur += (scrollY − cur) × (1 − e^(−7.5·dt))`. It snaps when within .05px. - `#scroller` gets `translate3d(0, −cur px, 0)`. - Anchor links jump instantly by native scroll, and the easing does the glide. ### Hero parallax - The hero `.art` translates `+cur × .32` px, so the illustration lags behind. - `.hero-copy` translates `+cur × .55` px. - The title's `--lsx` grows from 0 to .18em as the hero scrolls away. With `hp = clamp(cur / heroHeight, 0, 1)`, the letters spread apart as you descend. ### Load intro All Web Animations: - **Letters:** each letter rises `translateY(110%) → 0` over 1200ms, starting at 250ms, 70ms apart. - **Subtitle:** over 1600ms from 900ms: letter-spacing 1.4em → .62em, `translateY(14px) → 0`, `clip-path: inset(0 50% 0 50%) → inset(0)`. It opens from the centre outwards. - **Hero art:** `scale(1.09) → 1` over 2600ms, composited with "add" so it stacks on the parallax. - **Nav:** slides down over 900ms from 500ms. - **Easing:** `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)` throughout. ### Section reveals - **Trigger:** the first time a copy block's top passes 80 % of the viewport height. - **Lines:** each `.ln > span` rises `translateY(105%) → 0` over 1000ms, 80ms apart. - **Rule:** scales X 0 → 1 over 1100ms after 160ms. - **No opacity fades anywhere.** ### Lantern light - A fixed 520px circle, `radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255,170,90,.16), rgba(255,140,70,.06) 55%, transparent)`, `mix-blend-mode: screen`. - It follows the cursor with `1 − e^(−10·dt)` smoothing. - It shows only on fine pointers. ## Responsive (≤ 767px) - **Scene height:** `--artH: max(100vw × 1520/2688, 92svh)`, so phones get tall scenes. - **Art box:** widens to `artH × 2688/1520` and slides so each scene's `--focus` x (in %) sits at the screen centre: `left = 50vw − focus × artWidth / 100`. | Scene | Focus | |---|---| | Hero | 50 (falls) | | Story | 48 | | Rites | 40 | | Night | 66 (cauldron) | | Finale | 45 (moon) | - **Nav:** 56px tall. Only the logo (left) and Tickets (right) remain. - **Hero copy:** at `artH × .11`, title 9.6vw with `--ls: .14em`, subtitle 11px with .42em tracking at `top: artH × .305`. - **Section copy:** full width (left and right 20px, top 24 % of the scene, below the band) on a panel `linear-gradient(rgba(17,10,42,.78), rgba(17,10,42,.5))` with a 2px backdrop blur and 18px padding. `h2` is 30px, paragraphs 13.5px. - **Finale copy:** at top 26 %, with no panel. - **Seam bands:** follow the lower scene's focus, like `.art`. ## Reduced motion - Glows, mist and moonglow stop animating. - Copy is shown without the rise. - The scroll easing is instant. - Canvases draw a single still frame (t = 0), and nothing drifts. ## Acceptance checklist 1. **Load:** at 1440 × 810 the hero fills the screen. HOLLOWMERE rises letter by letter over the moon and castle, the subtitle opens from the centre, and the ghost-light falls stream into the misty pool. 2. **Cursor:** moving it near a ghost makes the ghost glide away. 3. **Descent:** scrolling glides down with momentum. The hero lags and its title spreads apart. At every join a drawn rock band (ground above, cave ceiling below) bridges the scenes, and the waterfall pours through its opening as one continuous glowing stream. No gradient fades anywhere. 4. **Copy:** "Our Story", "The Rites" and "Plan Your Night" rise line by line into the dark areas of their scenes. The mill throws spray, the cauldron pours three lava streams and bubbles, and the jack-o'-lanterns and candles flicker. 5. **Finale:** "See you at midnight." over the lantern lake, with shimmering moonlight and flickering lanterns. The page ends there.

# Prompt: Halden, AI teammate for port operators (bowl-glow scroll hero) Give me the superdetailed exact prompt to recreate this page exactly as it is, including the correct asset URL, all elements, animations, and fonts. This is that prompt. ## What it is Build a B2B SaaS landing hero for a fictional maritime-logistics AI company, **Halden**, whose AI agent is called **Hal**. Use one HTML file with plain CSS and vanilla JavaScript: no framework, no build step, no libraries. The page is three scenes stacked in one scroll: 1. **Hero.** A white page with a soft, rounded, **bowl-shaped sky-cyan glow** hanging from the top edge. It has a pale periwinkle rim and fades to white at the sides and bottom. Over it sit: - a floating white pill navbar; - a big two-line navy headline; - a "trust" line; - a large "Get a demo" pill; - a 4×2 grid of fictional partner wordmarks. 2. **Statement.** As you scroll, the hero content scrolls away while the bowl deepens and widens until the whole screen is flooded sky-cyan. A centred four-line statement rises from below and pins in the middle. It reveals **letter by letter as you scroll**: each letter goes from invisible to blurred white, then blue, then navy. When about 40% is revealed, a "Get a demo" pill pops into the navbar, first as a dot, then a circle, then stretching to a full pill. 3. **Dark split.** After the statement finishes, a deep navy panel scrolls up over it. - **Left 58.3%:** thin guide lines, a white headline revealing letter by letter with scroll, and a ruled row that fades up. - **Right 41.7%:** a full-height aerial photo of a container ship in a fjord, slowly zooming out as the panel arrives. Every "Get a demo" button has the same hover: its small glowing cyan dot grows into a cyan circle holding a navy chevron. ## Media: every asset URL There is exactly **one image** and **one font stylesheet**. Nothing else is loaded. | Asset | URL | |---|---| | Aerial container ship in a misty fjord (right half of the dark split) | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261029_050506_a830ff21-4c71-4272-bc39-b61cacb54463.png&w=1400&q=85` | | Google Fonts: Inter Tight 400/500/600 | `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter+Tight:wght@400;500;600&display=swap` | About the ship photo: - It is a 2:3 portrait, generated with Higgsfield and served through the images.higgs.ai resizer as WebP, 1400px wide, quality 85. - The scene is shot from a high drone angle down the length of a long dark Norwegian fjord: a loaded container ship in the lower-centre third, a white foamy V-wake trailing to the bottom edge, steep snow-dusted forested cliffs on both sides receding into low cloud at the top, and cold teal-navy water. - Use it as `` with `object-fit:cover`, absolutely filling its column. - Alt text: "Aerial view of a container ship sailing up a misty fjord". The background glow is not an image. The exponent 0.72 curves the walls, flaring them outward near the top. 2. **Distance.** For each pixel, take the exact distance to the nearest **segment** of that polyline (not the nearest point, which would leave gaps and spikes). like you work". - Reveal progress: `p2 = clamp((.8 − splitTop/innerHeight)/.65)`, so it reveals while the panel's top travels from 80% to 15% of the viewport. - **Row `#row`:** - Layout: `margin-top:6.4vh`, 1px top border in the panel line colour, which runs from the guide line to the image. ` hidden. - Split: one column, rows `auto 70vh`. h2 padding `16vh 0 0 6vw`, row single-column with padding `3vh 6vw 6vh`. - There must be no horizontal scrolling at 390px wide.
