- **Right side**, 2.4vw apart:
  - "Sign in".
  - A white pill "Start reading": radius .4vw, padding .55vw 1vw, lifting 1px on hover.

### Wordmark (z 1)

- **Text:** "Folio", centred, `--fs: min(46vh, 32vw)`, `font: 400 var(--fs)/1 Libre Caslon Display`, letter-spacing −.02em.
- **Position:** `top: calc(46.5vh − var(--fs)·.8)`, so its baseline sits at about 46vh.

### Link row (z 1)

- **Box:** top 51.1vh, centred, gap 2.1vw, Inter 500 `max(10px, .74vw)`.
- **Links:** "New Releases, Bestsellers, Fiction, Nonfiction, Poetry, Classics, Independent Voices, Gift Cards".

### Canvas (z 2)

A full-screen transparent WebGL canvas above the wordmark and links and below the nav.

## Three.js scene

### Renderer

- `antialias`, `alpha`, pixel ratio `min(dpr, 2)`.
- ACESFilmic tone mapping at exposure 1.05, sRGB output.

### Lighting

- **Environment:** `PMREMGenerator.fromScene(new RoomEnvironment(), .04)` with `environmentIntensity .55`.
- **Key:** DirectionalLight `#fff3e4`, 2.4, at (−4, 6, 6).
- **Rim:** `#bfd2ff`, 1.1, at (6, 3, −4).
- **Ambient:** white, .12.

### Camera

- PerspectiveCamera with fov 19.5 (40 when width < height) at (3.6, 2.15, 7.4), looking at (−1.4, .05, −.6).

### Books

- **Geometry:** one shared `BoxGeometry(1, 1.5, .2)`. Face materials in order +x, −x, +y, −y, +z, −z:
  1. **Fore-edge:** MeshStandard, roughness .9, with a 256px canvas of cream `#efe7d6` and 1px brown lines every 2px (alpha .05 to .17), horizontal.
  2. **Spine:** MeshPhysical in the cover's spine colour ×.62, roughness .55, clearcoat .3.
  3. **Top** and 4. **Bottom:** the same page texture with vertical lines.
  5. **Cover:** MeshPhysical with the cover texture, roughness .42, clearcoat .55, clearcoatRoughness .35.
  6. **Back:** spine colour ×.62, roughness .6.
- **Groups:** each book is a mesh inside a group.
  - Group position: `(1.55 + i·(−.5), −1.12, .9 + i·(−.2))` with `rotation.y = .32`, where i = 0 is the front book at the bottom right.
  - The mesh moves inside the group for the lift.

### Pointer wave

- **Projection:** each frame, project the point (0, .1, 0) of each book mesh to screen pixels (sx, sy).
- **Influence:** with `s = max(innerWidth, innerHeight)·.085`, `influence = exp(−((sx−x)² + ((sy−y)·.55)²) / s²)`.
- **Target lift:** `.78·influence`, or 0 when the pointer has left the window or the window is blurred.

### Springs

Every book has a vertical spring and a forward spring (target `lift·.35` in local z), both with `K = 70`, `C = 12.5`.

- Integrate in 4 sub-steps per frame, with `dt` capped at .05s: `v += ((target − y)·K − v·C)·h; y += v·h`.

- **Books:** start at y = −3. Each one's target stays −3 until `t > .25 + (32 − i)·.035` seconds, so the row rises from the back to the front, each book springing up.
- **Wordmark:** Web Animations API, 1400ms after a 150ms delay: opacity 0 → 1, translateY(4vh) → 0, blur(14px) → 0, with `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`.
- **Nav:** fades down from −1.2vh at 700ms (900ms long).
- **Link row:** fades up from 1.2vh at 850ms (900ms long).

### Touch and idle

On `(pointer: coarse)`, or after 4s without pointer movement, a virtual cursor sweeps along the row with `u = (sin(t·.45) + 1)/2`, between book 29 and book 1 projected to the screen.

## Phones (≤760px)

- **Nav:** left and right 5vw, top 2.5vh. Only the logo and the pill stay.
- **Wordmark:** `--fs: 36vw` at top 14vh.
- **Link row:** wraps at top 36vh with 8vw side padding.
- **Camera:** fov 40.

  1. **Fore-edge:** MeshStandard, roughness .9, with a 256px canvas of cream `#efe7d6` and 1px brown lines every 2px (alpha .05 to .17), horizontal.
  2. **Spine:** MeshPhysical in the cover's spine colour ×.62, roughness .55, clearcoat .3.
  3. **Top** and 4. **Bottom:** the same page texture with vertical lines.
  5. **Cover:** MeshPhysical with the cover texture, roughness .42, clearcoat .55, clearcoatRoughness .35.
  6. **Back:** spine colour ×.62, roughness .6.
- **Groups:** each book is a mesh inside a group.
  - Group position: `(1.55 + i·(−.5), −1.12, .9 + i·(−.2))` with `rotation.y = .32`, where i = 0 is the front book at the bottom right.
  - The mesh moves inside the group for the lift.

## Motion

### Pointer wave

- **Projection:** each frame, project the point (0, .1, 0) of each book mesh to screen pixels (sx, sy).
- **Influence:** with `s = max(innerWidth, innerHeight)·.085`, `influence = exp(−((sx−x)² + ((sy−y)·.55)²) / s²)`.
- **Target lift:** `.78·influence`, or 0 when the pointer has left the window or the window is blurred.

### Springs

Every book has a vertical spring and a forward spring (target `lift·.35` in local z), both with `K = 70`, `C = 12.5`.

- Integrate in 4 sub-steps per frame, with `dt` capped at .05s: `v += ((target − y)·K − v·C)·h; y += v·h`.
- `mesh.rotation.x = −v·.012`, so a book leans slightly while it moves.

### Intro

- **Books:** start at y = −3. Each one's target stays −3 until `t > .25 + (32 − i)·.035` seconds, so the row rises from the back to the front, each book springing up.
- **Wordmark:** Web Animations API, 1400ms after a 150ms delay: opacity 0 → 1, translateY(4vh) → 0, blur(14px) → 0, with `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`.
- **Nav:** fades down from −1.2vh at 700ms (900ms long).
- **Link row:** fades up from 1.2vh at 850ms (900ms long).

### Touch and idle

On `(pointer: coarse)`, or after 4s without pointer movement, a virtual cursor sweeps along the row with `u = (sin(t·.45) + 1)/2`, between book 29 and book 1 projected to the screen.

## Phones (≤760px)

- **Nav:** left and right 5vw, top 2.5vh. Only the logo and the pill stay.
- **Wordmark:** `--fs: 36vw` at top 14vh.
- **Link row:** wraps at top 36vh with 8vw side padding.
- **Camera:** fov 40.

items.title: Phoenix ignis
items.prompt_text:
# Myth Atlas ‚Äî Interactive 3D Creature Field Guide (exact recreation prompt)

Build a single-file, full-viewport web app called **Myth Atlas**: an interactive 3D field guide to creatures that never existed. It looks like a museum specimen plate on warm sandstone paper. A phoenix and a kraken sit in the centre as real textured 3D models you can drag, zoom and spin. A left sidebar, two specimen tabs, and a right catalogue card surround them. Clicking a tab flies one model out and springs the other in, while the card's copy swaps with a staggered rise. A sun button flips the whole page and the 3D lighting to a dark dusk mode.

Vanilla HTML, CSS and JS in one file, using Three.js r170 from a CDN import map. No frameworks and no build step. Reproduce every value, string, icon, URL and timing below exactly.

---

## 1. Head and external resources

- `<!DOCTYPE html>`, `lang="en"`, charset utf-8, viewport `width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover`.
- Title: `Myth Atlas ‚Äî Featured creatures`
- Meta description: `Turn a phoenix and a kraken in your hands. An interactive 3D field guide to creatures that never existed.`
- Preconnect to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin).
- Fonts stylesheet, exactly:
  `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300;0,9..144,400;0,9..144,500;1,9..144,300;1,9..144,400&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap`
- Import map:
  ```json
  { "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
  } }
  ```
- Script is `type="module"` and imports: `THREE`; `GLTFLoader` from `three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`; `DRACOLoader` from `three/addons/loaders/DRACOLoader.js`; `MeshoptDecoder` from `three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js`; `RoomEnvironment` from `three/addons/environments/RoomEnvironment.js`.
- Draco decoder path: `https://www.gstatic.com/draco/versioned/decoders/1.5.7/`

## 2. Assets (use exactly these URLs)

| Asset | URL |
|---|---|
| Phoenix image (thumbnail, featured card, close-up lens, fallback) | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261031_020340_4815bb8d-68c3-48c4-ad05-6307d085e896.png&w=900&q=85` |
| Phoenix 3D model (GLB, ‚âà72 MB) | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261031_015714_12c0e407-828a-4b1f-957c-2efe1fe83be1.glb` |
| Kraken image (same uses) | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261031_020342_3e375b40-2c06-4189-995a-acbc21f06142.png&w=900&q=85` |
| Kraken 3D model (GLB, ‚âà60 MB) | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261031_013537_0dc2c71f-4f11-4a86-ab93-91a59535d5b7.glb` |

No other images or media. All icons are inline SVG (section 9).

## 3. Design tokens

```css
:root {
  --bg:#ebe1cd; --panel:#f8f2e6; --line:#d6c9ae; --ink:#241c14; --muted:#7a6b58;
  --accent:#b4532a; --accent-ink:#ffffff; --accent-tint:#f3dfcd; --chip:#e4d8c2;
  --shadow:70,48,24;
  --serif:"Fraunces","Iowan Old Style",Georgia,serif;
  --sans:"Instrument Sans","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.24,1);
}
.hero[data-light="dusk"] {
  --bg:#17120d; --panel:#211a13; --line:#3d3225; --ink:#f1e7d6; --muted:#a89880;
  --accent:#e08a4f; --accent-ink:#17120d; --accent-tint:#3b2415; --chip:#2d251b;
  --shadow:0,0,0;
}
```

Base: `*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}`. `html,body{height:100%}`. Body uses `--bg`, `--sans`, `--ink`, `overflow:hidden`, antialiased. Buttons reset (`font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0`). `:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:3px}`. `svg{display:block}`. Icon class `.ico`: 20√ó20, `fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.5; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; flex:none`.

Radii are small and archival: 3px almost everywhere.

## 4. Layout

`main.hero#hero[data-light="day"]`: `position:relative; height:100vh; height:100dvh; display:grid; grid-template-columns:196px minmax(0,1fr) clamp(300px,27vw,356px); overflow:hidden; background:var(--bg); transition: background-color .6s var(--ease), color .6s var(--ease)`.

`canvas#gl` is the first child: `position:absolute; inset:0; width/height:100%; z-index:5; pointer-events:none`. The canvas spans the **whole hero**, so a model flying out is never cropped by a column.

### 4.1 Sidebar `aside.side` (aria-label "Atlas sections")
- Flex column, padding `22px 12px 18px 24px`, `border-right:1px solid var(--line)`.
- `.brand`: "Myth Atlas" in serif 27px weight 400, letter-spacing ‚àí.02em, `font-variation-settings:"opsz" 48`, nowrap. Inside, a `small` block: "Cryptozoology ¬∑ Vol. I", mono 9.5px, letter-spacing .18em, uppercase, muted, margin-top 4px.
- `ul.nav`: `margin:20px 0 12px; display:grid; gap:2px; overflow:hidden`. Each button is full width, flex, gap 16px, padding 7px 10px, radius 3px, font-size 14px, line-height 1.15, `box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 transparent`. Hover background `--chip`. `aria-current="page"` gets background `--accent-tint` and `box-shadow:inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent)`. Sub-labels are `small`: mono 10.5px, muted, margin-top 3px.
- Items in order (icon, label, sub-label): i-home Home ¬∑ i-star **Featured** (current) ¬∑ i-flame Fire birds "6 legends" ¬∑ i-wave Sea monsters "14 legends" ¬∑ i-claw Dragons "22 legends" ¬∑ i-skull Chimeras "9 legends" ¬∑ i-peak Giants "11 legends" ¬∑ i-mask Tricksters "8 legends".
- `.feature` card pinned to the bottom (`margin-top:auto`): background `--panel`, 1px line border, `border-left:3px solid var(--accent)`, radius 3px, padding `14px 14px 16px`. Contents:
  - `.eyebrow` "Featured creature": mono 9.5px, .2em tracking, uppercase, muted, weight 500.
  - `img#featImg`: 92√ó76, `object-fit:contain`, `margin:4px auto 2px`.
  - `h3#featTitle`: serif 18px weight 400, line-height 1.15, ‚àí.01em.
  - `p#featText`: 12px, line-height 1.4, muted, margin-top 6px.
  - `a[href="#detail"]` "Learn more" + i-arrow (14px): inline-flex, gap 6px, margin-top 10px, 12px, ink, underline offset 3px.

### 4.2 Centre `section.main`
Grid rows `auto minmax(0,1fr)`, padding `48px 18px 14px 26px`.

**Tabs** `.tabs#tabs` (role tablist, aria-label "Featured creatures"): flex, gap 10px. Generated from data. Each `.tab` (role tab, `id="tab-{id}"`, `data-no="01"`): width 130px, padding `8px 8px 11px`, grid centred, panel background, 1px line border, radius 3px, relative.
- `::before`: the `data-no` number at top-left (left 8px, top 6px), mono 9.5px, muted, .1em.
- `::after`: 2px accent bar along the bottom, `scaleX(0)` ‚Üí `scaleX(1)` when selected, .35s ease.
- `img` 58√ó52 contain. `b` name: serif 15.5px, margin-top 2px, ‚àí.01em. `i` latin: serif italic 12px, muted.
- Hover: `translateY(-2px)`, border `--muted`. Selected: border `--ink`.
- ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move focus and select, wrapping. Roving tabindex.

**Stage** `.stage#stage` (`tabindex="0"`, aria-label "3D creature model. Drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom, double-click to reset."): relative, `touch-action:none; cursor:grab; user-select:none`, radius 3px. `.dragging` ‚Üí `cursor:grabbing`. Children in order:
- `.plate`: `position:absolute; inset:10px 0 24px; z-index:1`, containing four 14√ó14 `i` corner brackets drawn with 1px `--line` borders. They frame the stage like a plate in a book.
- `.ground`: contact shadow. `left:50%; bottom:15%; width:min(62%,460px); height:44px; translateX(-50%)`, `radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(var(--shadow),.22), rgba(var(--shadow),0))`, transitions opacity .5s, transform .7s var(--ease). While `.stage.switching`: opacity 0, `translateX(-50%) scaleX(.4)`.
- `.fallback#fallback`: `inset:6% 10% 16%`, hidden, `background:center/contain no-repeat`. Shown with `.stage.failed`.
- `.loader#loader`: "Preparing the specimen‚Ä¶", centred mono 11px, .08em, uppercase, muted. `::before` is a 30px ring with 1px `--line` border and `--accent` top, spinning 1s linear. Fades by `.show`, .35s.
- `.hint`: top-right (right 4px, top 8px), z-index 6, i-hand 15px + "Drag to turn ¬∑ scroll to zoom", mono 10.5px, muted. Fades out on `.hero.touched` (.6s).
- `.rail` (toolbar, aria-label "Viewer tools"): left 0, vertically centred, grid gap 9px, z-index 6. 38√ó38 buttons, panel bg, line border, radius 3px, icons 17px. Hover border accent, active `scale(.92)`. `.on` = accent bg, accent-ink, accent border. Buttons: `#zoomIn` i-plus (starts `.on`), `#zoomOut` i-search, `#expand` i-expand, `#light` i-sun. Aria labels: "Zoom in", "Zoom out", "Expand viewer", "Switch to dusk lighting".
- `.turn`: `left:50%; bottom:46px`, centred, z-index 6, flex gap 2px, panel bg, line border, radius 3px, padding 3px 4px, mono 12px. Buttons 28px tall, min-width 32px, hover chip. `#turnL` i-ccw, `#turnFull` text "360¬∞", `#turnR` i-cw.
- `.scale#scale`: left 0, bottom 30px, mono 10px, muted, .08em. `::before` is a 72√ó6px scale bar with 1px muted borders and no top border, margin-bottom 4px. Text comes from data.
- `p.caption#caption`: absolute bottom 0, full width, centred, serif italic weight 300, `font-size:clamp(17px,1.65vw,22px)`, ‚àí.01em.

### 4.3 Right `section.info`
Grid rows `auto minmax(0,1fr)`, gap 16px, padding `13px 26px 14px 0`.

**Top bar** `.top`: flex, gap 10px.
- `label.search`: flex 1, height 32px, padding 0 12px, panel bg, line border, radius 3px, muted, gap 9px. i-search 15px, then a search input with placeholder "Search creatures, legends, or regions‚Ä¶", 11.5px. `:focus-within` border accent.
- `.iconbtn` (32px circle, hover chip): i-bell "Notifications". Then "Account" with `.avatar`: a 24px ink circle holding i-user 15px, stroke 1.8.

**Card** `.card`: panel bg, 1px line border, radius 3px, `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--panel), inset 0 0 0 5px var(--line)` (a double museum-plate rule), padding `26px 24px 20px`, `overflow-y:auto; overscroll-behavior:contain; scrollbar-width:thin`.

Inside, `article.detail#detail[aria-live="polite"]`, flex column, min-height 100%. Rows rendered from data, in this order, each with `style="--i:n"`:
0. `.eyebrow`: `{family} ¬∑ Specimen {no}`
1. `h1`: name in serif weight 300, `clamp(42px,4.4vw,58px)`, line-height .96, ‚àí.035em, margin-top 8px, `"opsz" 144`. Inside it `em`: latin, italic 300, block, `.36em`, letter-spacing 0, muted, margin-top 8px.
2. `.tags`: flex wrap, gap 8px, margin-top 16px. Each `span`: mono 10.5px, .04em, padding 5px 9px, radius 2px, 1px line border.
3. `p.lede`: 13.5px, line-height 1.55, margin-top 16px, `text-wrap:pretty`.
4. Era timeline `.era` (margin-top 14px, see 4.4).
5. `h2` "Field notes": mono 500 10px, .2em, uppercase, muted, margin-top 18px, padding-top 14px, border-top 1px line.
6. `dl.traits`: margin-top 10px, grid gap 9px. Each row is a flex baseline with gap 10px, 13px text: icon (18px, muted), `dt` muted with a dotted leader (`::after` flex 1, `border-bottom:1px dotted var(--line)`, margin 0 8px, translateY ‚àí3px), `dd` right-aligned weight 500.
7. `h2` "Haunts".
8. `.habitat`: flex, gap 16px, margin-top 12px, 13px: t-reed icon + habitat text.
9. `.closeup-wrap` (`margin-top:auto; padding-top:16px`) with `button.closeup#closeup` (`aria-pressed`): grid `76px 1fr 18px`, gap 14px, padding 10px, line border, radius 3px. `.lens` is 76√ó76, radius 2px, chip bg, the creature image as `background-size:520%`, `background-position` = data `lens`. Then `b` "Close-up Detail" (serif 18px) with `small` closeup text (11.5px, muted). Then i-chev 18px, rotated 180¬∞ when pressed (.3s). Hover or pressed: border accent, bg accent-tint.

Row animation: `.detail > *{animation:rise .6s var(--ease) both; animation-delay:calc(var(--i,0)*45ms)}` with `@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}}`. Leaving: `.detail.leaving > *{animation:sink .2s ease-in both;animation-delay:0s}` with `@keyframes sink{to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px)}}`.

### 4.4 Era timeline
Span = ‚àí800 to 1900. `.bar`: relative grid `1300fr 1000fr 400fr`, height 6px, radius 2px. Three `b` segments in `--chip` with a 1px panel divider (outer corners rounded 2px). `u` marker: absolute, top ‚àí3px, height 12px, min-width 3px, accent, radius 1px, `left = pct(from)`, `width = max(.6, pct(to)‚àípct(from))` percent, `data-l` = eraLabel. `u::after` shows the label: absolute, right 0, top 15px, mono 9.5px, accent, nowrap, .04em. If `pct(from) < 50`, add class `l` so the label anchors left instead (`right:auto;left:0`). `.lab` below uses the same grid, margin-top 20px, mono 9px, .12em, uppercase, muted: Antiquity ¬∑ Medieval ¬∑ Modern.

### 4.5 Focus view
`.hero.focus`: `.side` fades and moves ‚àí24px X, `.info` fades and moves +24px X, `.tabs` fades and moves ‚àí16px Y, each `pointer-events:none`, all `.5s var(--ease)`. The stage measure becomes the entire hero, so the model glides to centre and grows. Escape closes it.

### 4.6 Responsive
- `max-width:1100px`: columns `minmax(0,1fr) clamp(280px,36vw,340px)`, `.side` hidden, `.main` padding-left 20px.
- `max-width:760px`: `.hero` flex column, `.info{display:contents}`. `.top` order 1, padding `10px 14px 0`, with `::before` "Myth Atlas" serif 21px, margin-right auto. `.search` collapses to a 32px circle, input hidden. `.main` order 2, flex 1, padding `10px 14px 6px`. Tabs gap 8px, `.tab` flex 1, grid `44px 1fr` with image spanning two rows (44√ó40), padding 6px 10px, b 15px, i 12px. Rail buttons 34px, gap 7px. `.turn` bottom 30px. Caption 15px. Hint hidden. Ground `bottom:17%; height:30px`. `.card` order 3, relative, z-index 7, `flex:0 0 auto; max-height:40dvh`, radius `10px 10px 0 0`, border-top only, no shadow, padding `14px 16px calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))`, `transition: transform .5s var(--ease), background-color .6s`. `h1` 34px, margin-top 4px. Tags margin-top 10px. Lede margin-top 10px, 13px. h2 margin-top 12px, padding-top 10px. In focus: card absolute at the bottom, `translateY(105%)`; `.top` hidden.
- `max-height:620px and min-width:761px`: `.main` padding-top 16px, `.side` padding-top 14px, nav margin-top 12px, featured image and paragraph hidden.
- `prefers-reduced-motion`: all animation and transition durations .01s, delays 0. Idle motion off, `DUR = 1`, info swap instant.

## 5. Data (use verbatim; array is named `DINOS`)

```js
const DINOS = [
  {
    id: 'phoenix', no: 'MA-001', era: [-800, -430], eraLabel: 'Herodotus, 430 BC', scale: '1 m',
    name: 'Phoenix', latin: 'Phoenix ignis', family: 'Fire birds',

```

## 6. Three.js scene

- Renderer: `{canvas, alpha:true, antialias:true, powerPreference:'high-performance'}`, pixel ratio `min(devicePixelRatio,2)`, `SRGBColorSpace`, `NeutralToneMapping`, exposure 1.05.
- `scene.environment = new PMREMGenerator(renderer).fromScene(new RoomEnvironment(), 0.04).texture`, `environmentIntensity = .95`.
- `PerspectiveCamera(26, 1, .1, 100)`.
- `key = DirectionalLight(0xfff4e2, 1.6)` at (2.5, 4, 5). `rim = DirectionalLight(0xbfd8ff, .5)` at (‚àí4, 2, ‚àí3).
- Light presets:
  ```js
  day:  { env:.95, key:1.6, rim:.5, keyColor:0xfff4e2, exposure:1.05 }
  dusk: { env:.28, key:2.6, rim:1.9, keyColor:0xffc98a, exposure:1.0 }
  ```
- One rig per creature: `pivot` (slide, scale, sway) > `spin` (free rotation from the hand) > `holder` > `model`. `home` quaternion = `Euler(pitch, yaw, 0, 'YXZ')`, applied to `spin`.
- Loading: `GLTFLoader` with `DRACOLoader` and `MeshoptDecoder`. Compute the bounding sphere, subtract its centre from `model.position`, wrap in `holder` scaled `1/radius` so every model has radius 1. Each mesh: `frustumCulled=false`, `map.anisotropy = max`, `envMapIntensity = 1`. On failure log, set `rig.failed` and show `.fallback`. Each model loads once (cache the promise).

### Camera placement (critical)
The canvas spans the hero while the model is centred on the stage. Do this with a shifted principal point, not by moving the canvas:
```js
// measure(): s = focus ? heroRect : stageRect
goal.cx = s.left - h.left + s.width/2;
goal.cy = s.top - h.top + s.height * (focus ? .5 : .44);
goal.px = Math.min(s.width*.5, s.height*.6) * 1.16;   // pixels per world unit
goal.sw = s.width;
renderer.setSize(W, H, false); camera.aspect = W/H;
// every frame:
camera.position.z = H / (2*Math.tan(degToRad(26/2)) * view.px * zoom);
camera.setViewOffset(W, H, W/2 - view.cx, H/2 - view.cy, W, H);
```
`view` eases toward `goal` at rate 7. First measure snaps. ResizeObservers on hero and stage, plus `orientationchange`.

## 7. Interaction

All easing below uses `f(rate) = 1 - exp(-dt*rate)`, with `dt` capped at .05s.

- **Drag:** pointer capture on stage (ignore buttons). `k = PI / max(260, view.px*1.6)`, about half a turn per model width. `vel = delta*k`. `turnBy` premultiplies `spin.quaternion` by a Y-axis rotation then an X-axis rotation (world axes). Adds `.dragging`, clears `yawQueue`.
- **Inertia:** when released, keep applying `vel`, decaying by `exp(-dt*4.5)`.
- **Zoom:** `zoom` eases to `zoomGoal` at rate 6, clamped .55‚Äì3.4. Wheel: `zoomGoal*exp(-deltaY*(ctrlKey ? .01 : .0016))`, non-passive `preventDefault`. Two-finger pinch scales by the distance ratio. Rail buttons multiply or divide by 1.35. `#zoomIn.on` when `zoomGoal>=1`, `#zoomOut.on` otherwise. `#closeup` `aria-pressed` = `zoomGoal>2.2`.
- **Turn buttons:** `yawQueue` ¬±œÄ/2, 360¬∞ adds 2œÄ. Consumed with `step = yawQueue*f(4.2)`.
- **Double-click / key 0:** reset. `homing` slerps `spin` to `home` at rate 6 until within .002 rad; `setZoom(1)`.
- **Keyboard on stage:** arrows turn ¬±.18 rad; `+`/`=` zoom √ó1.2; `-` zoom √∑1.2.
- **Close-up button:** toggles zoom 2.6 ‚Üî 1.
- **Expand:** toggles `.focus`, `.on`, aria-pressed and aria-label ("Close expanded viewer" / "Expand viewer"), then calls `measure()`.
- **Light button:** toggles `data-light` day/dusk, `document.body.style.background = dusk ? '#14170f' : ''`, `.on`, aria-pressed and aria-label ("Switch to daylight" / "Switch to dusk lighting"). All light values ease at rate 4, key colour via `lerp`.
- Any interaction calls `touched()`: records `lastTouch`, cancels homing, adds `.hero.touched`.

## 8. Tab switch and idle life

`select(i)`:
1. Ignore if already active. `dir = sign(i - from)`. Update `aria-selected` and tabindex.
2. `paintInfo(i)`: add `.leaving`, then after 200ms fill the card, caption, scale text, featured card and fallback image, and reset card scroll.
3. Add `.stage.switching`, clear velocity and queue, `setZoom(1)`.
4. `anim = {from, to:-1, dir, t0:now}`: the old model leaves at once. If the new one isn't loaded, show the loader and await it. Bail if the user moved on.
5. Reset `spin` to `home`, set `anim.to = i` and `t1 = now`, remove `.switching`.

Timing with `DUR = 780`ms; `inCubic(t)=t¬≥`, `outCubic(t)=1-(1-t)¬≥`, `outBack(t)=1+2.2(t-1)¬≥+1.2(t-1)¬≤`, `slide = goal.sw*.95/view.px` world units:
- **Outgoing** over `DUR*.6`, `e=inCubic(t)`: `k=1-e`, `x=-dir*e*slide`, `twist=-dir*e*1.4`.
- **Incoming** over `DUR`, `e=outCubic(t)`: `k=max(.0001,outBack(t))*(.25+.75e)`, `x=dir*(1-e)*slide`, `twist=dir*(1-e)*1.6`.

Every frame each visible rig gets:
- `pivot.scale = k`
- `pivot.position = (x, sin(s*1.3+i)*.028, 0)`: a constant slow hover
- `pivot.rotation = (sin(s*.9)*.03*idle, twist + sin(s*.55)*.16*idle, 0)`

Here `s` is seconds and `idle = clamp01((now - lastTouch - 1800)/1500)`, so sway eases back in 1.8s after the hand lets go.

Boot: `paintInfo(0,true)`, `measure()`, show the loader, start the loop, load the active model, hide the loader, play the intro as an incoming `anim` (`from:-1`), then warm the other model.

## 10. Feel

A quiet natural-history museum plate that happens to be alive. Warm paper, hairline rules, deadpan scholarly copy, and one vivid creature that weighs something in your hand: momentum when you flick it, a soft spring when it arrives, a slow breath when left alone. Do not add gradients, glows or extra colour.

sections.title: Phoenix ignis — Master Specification
sections.content:
# Myth Atlas ‚Äî Interactive 3D Creature Field Guide (exact recreation prompt)

Build a single-file, full-viewport web app called **Myth Atlas**: an interactive 3D field guide to creatures that never existed. It looks like a museum specimen plate on warm sandstone paper. A phoenix and a kraken sit in the centre as real textured 3D models you can drag, zoom and spin. A left sidebar, two specimen tabs, and a right catalogue card surround them. Clicking a tab flies one model out and springs the other in, while the card's copy swaps with a staggered rise. A sun button flips the whole page and the 3D lighting to a dark dusk mode.

Vanilla HTML, CSS and JS in one file, using Three.js r170 from a CDN import map. No frameworks and no build step. Reproduce every value, string, icon, URL and timing below exactly.

---

## 1. Head and external resources

- `<!DOCTYPE html>`, `lang="en"`, charset utf-8, viewport `width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover`.
- Title: `Myth Atlas ‚Äî Featured creatures`
- Meta description: `Turn a phoenix and a kraken in your hands. An interactive 3D field guide to creatures that never existed.`
- Preconnect to `https://fonts.googleapis.com` and `https://fonts.gstatic.com` (crossorigin).
- Fonts stylesheet, exactly:
  `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,300;0,9..144,400;0,9..144,500;1,9..144,300;1,9..144,400&family=Instrument+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap`
- Import map:
  ```json
  { "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
  } }
  ```
- Script is `type="module"` and imports: `THREE`; `GLTFLoader` from `three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`; `DRACOLoader` from `three/addons/loaders/DRACOLoader.js`; `MeshoptDecoder` from `three/addons/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js`; `RoomEnvironment` from `three/addons/environments/RoomEnvironment.js`.
- Draco decoder path: `https://www.gstatic.com/draco/versioned/decoders/1.5.7/`

## 2. Assets (use exactly these URLs)

| Asset | URL |
|---|---|
| Phoenix image (thumbnail, featured card, close-up lens, fallback) | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261031_020340_4815bb8d-68c3-48c4-ad05-6307d085e896.png&w=900&q=85` |
| Phoenix 3D model (GLB, ‚âà72 MB) | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261031_015714_12c0e407-828a-4b1f-957c-2efe1fe83be1.glb` |
| Kraken image (same uses) | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261031_020342_3e375b40-2c06-4189-995a-acbc21f06142.png&w=900&q=85` |
| Kraken 3D model (GLB, ‚âà60 MB) | `https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261031_013537_0dc2c71f-4f11-4a86-ab93-91a59535d5b7.glb` |

No other images or media. All icons are inline SVG (section 9).

## 3. Design tokens

```css
:root {
  --bg:#ebe1cd; --panel:#f8f2e6; --line:#d6c9ae; --ink:#241c14; --muted:#7a6b58;
  --accent:#b4532a; --accent-ink:#ffffff; --accent-tint:#f3dfcd; --chip:#e4d8c2;
  --shadow:70,48,24;
  --serif:"Fraunces","Iowan Old Style",Georgia,serif;
  --sans:"Instrument Sans","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --mono:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.24,1);
}
.hero[data-light="dusk"] {
  --bg:#17120d; --panel:#211a13; --line:#3d3225; --ink:#f1e7d6; --muted:#a89880;
  --accent:#e08a4f; --accent-ink:#17120d; --accent-tint:#3b2415; --chip:#2d251b;
  --shadow:0,0,0;
}
```

Base: `*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}`. `html,body{height:100%}`. Body uses `--bg`, `--sans`, `--ink`, `overflow:hidden`, antialiased. Buttons reset (`font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0`). `:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:3px}`. `svg{display:block}`. Icon class `.ico`: 20√ó20, `fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.5; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; flex:none`.

Radii are small and archival: 3px almost everywhere.

## 4. Layout

`main.hero#hero[data-light="day"]`: `position:relative; height:100vh; height:100dvh; display:grid; grid-template-columns:196px minmax(0,1fr) clamp(300px,27vw,356px); overflow:hidden; background:var(--bg); transition: background-color .6s var(--ease), color .6s var(--ease)`.

## 6. Three.js scene

- Renderer: `{canvas, alpha:true, antialias:true, powerPreference:'high-performance'}`, pixel ratio `min(devicePixelRatio,2)`, `SRGBColorSpace`, `NeutralToneMapping`, exposure 1.05.
- `scene.environment = new PMREMGenerator(renderer).fromScene(new RoomEnvironment(), 0.04).texture`, `environmentIntensity = .95`.
- `PerspectiveCamera(26, 1, .1, 100)`.
- `key = DirectionalLight(0xfff4e2, 1.6)` at (2.5, 4, 5). `rim = DirectionalLight(0xbfd8ff, .5)` at (‚àí4, 2, ‚àí3).
- Light presets:
  ```js
  day:  { env:.95, key:1.6, rim:.5, keyColor:0xfff4e2, exposure:1.05 }
  dusk: { env:.28, key:2.6, rim:1.9, keyColor:0xffc98a, exposure:1.0 }
  ```
- One rig per creature: `pivot` (slide, scale, sway) > `spin` (free rotation from the hand) > `holder` > `model`. `home` quaternion = `Euler(pitch, yaw, 0, 'YXZ')`, applied to `spin`.
- Loading: `GLTFLoader` with `DRACOLoader` and `MeshoptDecoder`. Compute the bounding sphere, subtract its centre from `model.position`, wrap in `holder` scaled `1/radius` so every model has radius 1. Each mesh: `frustumCulled=false`, `map.anisotropy = max`, `envMapIntensity = 1`. On failure log, set `rig.failed` and show `.fallback`. Each model loads once (cache the promise).

### Camera placement (critical)
The canvas spans the hero while the model is centred on the stage. Do this with a shifted principal point, not by moving the canvas:
```js
// measure(): s = focus ? heroRect : stageRect
goal.cx = s.left - h.left + s.width/2;
goal.cy = s.top - h.top + s.height * (focus ? .5 : .44);
goal.px = Math.min(s.width*.5, s.height*.6) * 1.16;   // pixels per world unit
goal.sw = s.width;
renderer.setSize(W, H, false); camera.aspect = W/H;
// every frame:
camera.position.z = H / (2*Math.tan(degToRad(26/2)) * view.px * zoom);
camera.setViewOffset(W, H, W/2 - view.cx, H/2 - view.cy, W, H);
```
`view` eases toward `goal` at rate 7. First measure snaps. ResizeObservers on hero and stage, plus `orientationchange`.

## 7. Interaction

All easing below uses `f(rate) = 1 - exp(-dt*rate)`, with `dt` capped at .05s.

- **Drag:** pointer capture on stage (ignore buttons). `k = PI / max(260, view.px*1.6)`, about half a turn per model width. `vel = delta*k`. `turnBy` premultiplies `spin.quaternion` by a Y-axis rotation then an X-axis rotation (world axes). Adds `.dragging`, clears `yawQueue`.
- **Inertia:** when released, keep applying `vel`, decaying by `exp(-dt*4.5)`.
- **Zoom:** `zoom` eases to `zoomGoal` at rate 6, clamped .55‚Äì3.4. Wheel: `zoomGoal*exp(-deltaY*(ctrlKey ? .01 : .0016))`, non-passive `preventDefault`. Two-finger pinch scales by the distance ratio. Rail buttons multiply or divide by 1.35. `#zoomIn.on` when `zoomGoal>=1`, `#zoomOut.on` otherwise. `#closeup` `aria-pressed` = `zoomGoal>2.2`.
- **Turn buttons:** `yawQueue` ¬±œÄ/2, 360¬∞ adds 2œÄ. Consumed with `step = yawQueue*f(4.2)`.
- **Double-click / key 0:** reset. `homing` slerps `spin` to `home` at rate 6 until within .002 rad; `setZoom(1)`.
- **Keyboard on stage:** arrows turn ¬±.18 rad; `+`/`=` zoom √ó1.2; `-` zoom √∑1.2.
- **Close-up button:** toggles zoom 2.6 ‚Üî 1.
- **Expand:** toggles `.focus`, `.on`, aria-pressed and aria-label ("Close expanded viewer" / "Expand viewer"), then calls `measure()`.
- **Light button:** toggles `data-light` day/dusk, `document.body.style.background = dusk ? '#14170f' : ''`, `.on`, aria-pressed and aria-label ("Switch to daylight" / "Switch to dusk lighting"). All light values ease at rate 4, key colour via `lerp`.
- Any interaction calls `touched()`: records `lastTouch`, cancels homing, adds `.hero.touched`.

## 8. Tab switch and idle life

`select(i)`:
1. Ignore if already active. `dir = sign(i - from)`. Update `aria-selected` and tabindex.
2. `paintInfo(i)`: add `.leaving`, then after 200ms fill the card, caption, scale text, featured card and fallback image, and reset card scroll.
3. Add `.stage.switching`, clear velocity and queue, `setZoom(1)`.
4. `anim = {from, to:-1, dir, t0:now}`: the old model leaves at once. If the new one isn't loaded, show the loader and await it. Bail if the user moved on.
5. Reset `spin` to `home`, set `anim.to = i` and `t1 = now`, remove `.switching`.

Timing with `DUR = 780`ms; `inCubic(t)=t¬≥`, `outCubic(t)=1-(1-t)¬≥`, `outBack(t)=1+2.2(t-1)¬≥+1.2(t-1)¬≤`, `slide = goal.sw*.95/view.px` world units:
- **Outgoing** over `DUR*.6`, `e=inCubic(t)`: `k=1-e`, `x=-dir*e*slide`, `twist=-dir*e*1.4`.
- **Incoming** over `DUR`, `e=outCubic(t)`: `k=max(.0001,outBack(t))*(.25+.75e)`, `x=dir*(1-e)*slide`, `twist=dir*(1-e)*1.6`.

Every frame each visible rig gets:
- `pivot.scale = k`
- `pivot.position = (x, sin(s*1.3+i)*.028, 0)`: a constant slow hover
- `pivot.rotation = (sin(s*.9)*.03*idle, twist + sin(s*.55)*.16*idle, 0)`

Here `s` is seconds and `idle = clamp01((now - lastTouch - 1800)/1500)`, so sway eases back in 1.8s after the hand lets go.

Boot: `paintInfo(0,true)`, `measure()`, show the loader, start the loop, load the active model, hide the loader, play the intro as an incoming `anim` (`from:-1`), then warm the other model.

## 10. Feel

A quiet natural-history museum plate that happens to be alive. Warm paper, hairline rules, deadpan scholarly copy, and one vivid creature that weighs something in your hand: momentum when you flick it, a soft spring when it arrives, a slow breath when left alone. Do not add gradients, glows or extra colour.

Heavy use of clamp() for fluid typography. The entire design scales gracefully from mobile to ultra-wide screens. 6. She feels alive. It is built from 59 separately generated pictures of the same face, all pixel-aligned, swapped on a soft stretchy sheet in WebGL. Use the exact picture ids in the code below. Do not fake expressions with code. Hard rules, because each of these was a real bug: - Only ONE picture is ever on screen. Never composite eye patches, hair masks or overlays over a face: they cause double eyes, double chins, black outlines and spots. Changes between pictures are a crossfade of 70ms at most. - Gaze is whole pictures, 16 directions plus half and closed lids. - The sheet must never fold. Overlapping triangles draw as a comb of cuts, so every frame each row and column is forced back into order with a minimum gap (the untangle step). The hand's radius and pull limit are also chosen so the slope cannot fold. - Physics runs at a fixed 1/240s step whatever the frame rate, otherwise it tears into spikes on large screens. - She never changes her expression on her own while the visitor is active. Self-playing acts only start after 30 to 45 seconds with no input, and any input ends them at once. Behaviour: - Page load: her eyes are closed. The first pointer move wakes her through half to open. - Moving the cursor: her eyes follow it in 16 directions everywhere on the page, and she blinks every 2.2 to 5.6 seconds. Her head leans slightly toward the cursor. - Hover, reacting after 80ms: lips kiss, nose goes cross-eyed, either eye winks. The forehead, cheeks, chin and hair do not change her face on hover; her eyes keep following. - Tap: forehead angry, eyes ouch, nose plays the sneeze act, lips tongue out, cheek puffed, chin laugh. - Tap on hair: cycles pink, blue, blonde and back to her own hair. Colours persist. The colour pictures face forward, so her eyes rest while coloured, and expressions show her own hair. - Grab and pull anywhere: the skin stretches like dough and ripples back. Pull distance moves her from shock to ouch to scared. On release she looks scrunched or dizzy; after 5 pulls in 14 seconds she gets angry, after 8 she cries. - Shaking the cursor fast blows her hair, and keeping it up turns her sick. - Hovering the Contact Me button gives heart eyes, and leaving it gives a grin. - Scrolling makes her look down. - Idle acts, in rotation: yawn, shifty eyes, a gum bubble that pops on her face, a fly that lands on her nose and is blown off, flirt, eye roll, sneeze, trying on hair colours, a ghost hand tugging her cheek, cross-eyed fish face, whistle, dozing off and snoring, cheeky tongue, starry eyes, and crying. Build a 3D Creator portfolio landing page with an interactive living portrait for "Mina" using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Lucide React. The page has a dark theme (#0C0C0C background) with the font Kanit (Google Fonts, weights 300-900). The page title is "Mina -- 3D Creator". FONT Load exactly: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Kanit:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap with preconnect to https://fonts.googleapis.com and https://fonts.gstatic.com (crossorigin). GLOBAL STYLES Background: #0C0C0C on html, body, #root, and the main wrapper Font family: 'Kanit', sans-serif Global reset: box-sizing border-box, margin 0, padding 0 CSS class .hero-heading: gradient text using background: linear-gradient(180deg, #646973 0%, #BBCCD7 100%) with -webkit-background-clip: text and -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent Main wrapper has overflowX: 'clip' SECTION ORDER HeroSection MarqueeSection AboutSection ServicesSection ProjectsSection 1. HERO SECTION Full viewport height (h-screen), flex column layout with overflowX: clip. Navbar: Horizontal nav bar with 4 links -- "About", "Price", "Projects", "Contact" -- evenly spaced with justify-between. Text color #D7E2EA, font-medium, uppercase, tracking-wider. Sizes: text-sm md:text-lg lg:text-[1.4rem]. Padding: px-6 md:px-10 pt-6 md:pt-8. Hover: opacity 70% with 200ms transition. Hero Heading: Massive h1 with text "Hi, i'm mina" (lowercase "i", curly apostrophe via '). Uses the .hero-heading gradient text class. Font-black, uppercase, tracking-tight, leading-none, whitespace-nowrap, w-full. Font sizes: text-[14vw] sm:text-[15vw] md:text-[16vw] lg:text-[17.5vw]. Margin top: mt-6 sm:mt-4 md:-mt-5. Wrapped in overflow-hidden container. Bottom bar: Flexbox justify-between items-end with pb-7 sm:pb-8 md:pb-10: Left: paragraph text "a 3d creator driven by crafting striking and unforgettable projects", color #D7E2EA, font-light, uppercase, tracking-wide, leading-snug. Font size: clamp(0.75rem, 1.4vw, 1.5rem). Max-width: max-w-[160px] sm:max-w-[220px] md:max-w-[260px]. Right: ContactButton component (see below) Hero Portrait: The Living Portrait, exactly as specified in section 6 below. It is centred in the hero both ways (absolute, left 50%, top 50%, translate(-50%, -50%), z-10). Width: 400px, 500px from 640px, 600px from 768px, clamp(640px, 78vh, 46vw) from 1024px. There is NO Magnet effect on it any more. FadeIn animations: Navbar fades in with delay 0, y -20. Heading: delay 0.15, y 40. Left text: delay 0.35, y 20. Contact button: delay 0.5, y 20. Portrait: delay 0.6, y 30. 2. MARQUEE SECTION Two rows of images that scroll horizontally based on page scroll position. Background #0C0C0C. Padding: pt-24 sm:pt-32 md:pt-40 pb-10. 21 GIF images from motionsites.ai (exact URLs): https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-space-voyage-preview-eECLH3Yc.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-codenest-preview-Cgppc2qV.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-vex-ventures-preview-BczMFIiw.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-stellar-ai-v2-preview-DjvxjG3C.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-asme-preview-B_nGDnTP.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-transform-data-preview-Cx5OU29N.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-vitara-preview-Cjz2QYyU.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-terra-preview-BFjrCr7T.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-skyelite-preview-DHaZIgUv.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-aethera-preview-DknSlcTa.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-designpro-preview-D8c5_een.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-stellar-ai-preview-D3HL6bw1.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-xportfolio-preview-D4A8maiC.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-orbit-web3-preview-BXt4OttD.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-nexora-preview-cx5HmUgo.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-evr-ventures-preview-DZxeVFEX.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-planet-orbit-preview-DWAP8Z1P.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-new-era-preview-CocuDUm9.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-wealth-preview-B70idl_u.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-luminex-preview-CxOP7ce6.gif https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-celestia-preview-0yO3jXO8.gif Row 1: first 11 images, tripled for seamless scrolling. She feels alive. It is built from 59 separately generated pictures of the same face, all pixel-aligned, swapped on a soft stretchy sheet in WebGL. Use the exact picture ids in the code below. Do not fake expressions with code. Hard rules, because each of these was a real bug: - Only ONE picture is ever on screen. Never composite eye patches, hair masks or overlays over a face: they cause double eyes, double chins, black outlines and spots. Changes between pictures are a crossfade of 70ms at most. - Gaze is whole pictures, 16 directions plus half and closed lids. - The sheet must never fold. Her head leans slightly toward the cursor. - Hover, reacting after 80ms: lips kiss, nose goes cross-eyed, either eye winks. The forehead, cheeks, chin and hair do not change her face on hover; her eyes keep following. - Tap: forehead angry, eyes ouch, nose plays the sneeze act, lips tongue out, cheek puffed, chin laugh. - Tap on hair: cycles pink, blue, blonde and back to her own hair. Colours persist. The colour pictures face forward, so her eyes rest while coloured, and expressions show her own hair. - Grab and pull anywhere: the skin stretches like dough and ripples back. Pull distance moves her from shock to ouch to scared. - **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#38BDF8`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

items.title: Spider Web
items.prompt_text:
# Found — The Curiosity Cabinet with a Web-Spinning Spider (exact recreation prompt) Give me a single-file, full-screen home page for **found**, a personal archive of curious objects called "the curiosity cabinet". The page is flat electric blue with a giant white wordmark `found` in the middle. Collectible cut-out objects float around it: a "Main Character" mug, a frosted glass radio player, a retro laptop in a glass sleeve, a pink book with an iPod, and a "CALL MY LAWYER" t-shirt at the bottom edge. A photo-real jumping spider lives on the page. It drops in on a silk thread, chases a fly that replaces the mouse cursor, and walks on inverse-kinematics legs cut from one photo. As it moves, it spins real-looking silk threads between the letters and objects: sagging verlet ropes with dew drops, fuzz, iridescence and shadows that fall only on the objects. Click to make it pounce on the fly and wrap it in silk. Press Delete to shake the web off. When it rests, its head crossfades to a cute face that blinks, and later it falls asleep. All of it runs in one HTML file with a single 2D canvas and no libraries. The live original was a small Preact app, and plain DOM plus vanilla JS is fine. The only external resources are the Inter font, which the supplied file embeds, and three radio streams. **Source of truth:** the supplied **HTML Code** section is the complete working page. It has all 18 images as base64 data URIs and Inter embedded. Reproduce every value below exactly. When in doubt, copy the behaviour of that file. --- ## 1. Page basics - Title `Found`. The viewport meta includes `viewport-fit=cover`. - Font: Inter 400 / 500 / 600 (`https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap`). The standalone embeds the latin subset as a woff2 data URI. Stack: `"Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif`. - Colours: `--blue: #1129e2` (page), `--ink: #ffffff`, `--ink-70: rgba(255,255,255,0.7)`, `--glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.1)`. `color-scheme: dark`. - Design frame: a Figma frame 2000 × 1125. `--u: min(calc(100vw / 2000), calc(100dvh / 1125))`. - Horizontal positions are in vw (`x / 20 * 1vw`). Vertical positions are in dvh (`y / 11.25 * 1dvh`). Sizes use `--u`, so the composition fills any screen while objects keep their proportions. - `body` is blue with `overflow: hidden`. `.page` is `100vw × 100dvh`. - `.frame` holds every element, absolutely positioned, white Inter 400, `user-select: none`. - Layer order, bottom to top: 1. `.frame` (all content). 2. `.web-layer`: one full-size canvas, `pointer-events: none`. 3. `.over`: a second copy of the big wordmark in which only the letter **o** is visible. This makes the spider crawl *under* the "o" but over the other letters. - Global cursor: `html, body { cursor: none; touch-action: none; overscroll-behavior: none; user-select: none; -webkit-touch-callout: none }`. Buttons, links and inputs get `cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation`. ## 2. Layout (desktop, sizes in u) - **Nav** `.top-nav`: - Position: left/right `max(16px, 7vw)`, top `max(12px, 38/11.25 dvh)`, height `56u` (min 40px). A flex row with space-between. - **Logo:** 157 × 44u. - Two stacked outline-folder PNGs: back 53 × 41 at top 6.33u, front 53 × 34 at top 12.33u. - Wordmark `found` at left 70u, 36u / 44u line height, tracking −0.08em. - **Links:** `home, archive, oddities, experiments, the drawer, about, contact`. - 22u, tracking −0.08em, gap 32u, no wrap. - The first (`home`) is active: weight 500 with `text-decoration: line-through`. - **Right icons:** search and menu (26u PNGs), gap 32u, in a 157u-wide right-aligned box. - **Big wordmark** `.found`: - Centred at left 50%, top `547/11.25 dvh − 48u`, `translate(-50%,-50%)`. - 350u, line height 240u, tracking −0.1em, `text-indent: -0.1em`. - Each letter is a span: `f`, `o` (transparent in `.frame`, visible in `.over`), `und`. - **Mug** (241 × 220 PNG, "Main Character" in handwriting): left `205/20 vw`, top `359/11.25 dvh − 48u`, width 241u. - **iBook in a glass sleeve** (312 × 377 PNG): right `162/20 vw`, top `323/11.25 dvh`, width 312u. - **Book and iPod in a glass sleeve** (293 × 322 PNG): right `376/20 vw`, top `689.5/11.25 dvh`, width 293u. - **T-shirt** (250 × 226 PNG, "CALL MY LAWYER (888) 799-2021" in handwriting): centred, `bottom: 0`, width 250u. - **Radio player** `.player`: - Box: left `max(16px, 7vw)`, top `509/11.25 dvh − 48u`, 291 × 172u. Padding 16u, radius 24u, column gap 12u. - Glass: `rgba(255,255,255,.1)`, `backdrop-filter: blur(12u)` and `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25)`. - **Head:** 40u art thumbnail (radius 12u), title `Support the arts` (18u, weight 600) and sub `date an artist` (12u, 70% white). A 20u heart icon sits on the right. - **Progress:** a 4u bar on `rgba(255,255,255,.2)` with a 46% white fill. - **Times row** (10u, weight 600, 70% white, tabular numerals): on the left, a 6u dot plus the uppercase status `live`; on the right, the station name. - **Controls row:** shuffle 16u (55% opacity), previous 24u, play 48u (a white circle), next 24u, repeat 16u (55% opacity). - **Playing:** - The play icon becomes a white 48u circle with two 4.5 × 16u blue bars. - The bar becomes a flowing gradient: `linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.35), #fff 40%, rgba(255,255,255,.35) 80%)`, size 200%, animated to `-200%` over 2.4s linear infinite. - The dot turns `#ff5a5a` and pulses to 35% opacity over 1.6s. - **Status texts:** `live`, `tuning…`, `offline`. - **Stations:** Groove Salad `https://ice1.somafm.com/groovesalad-128-mp3`, Lush `https://ice1.somafm.com/lush-128-mp3`, Drone Zone `https://ice1.somafm.com/dronezone-128-mp3`. Previous and next cycle through them; play toggles a `new Audio()` (preload none). - **Headline** `.cabinet` `the curiosity
cabinet`: left `max(16px,7vw)`, top `775/11.25 dvh`, width 396u, 80u / 80u, tracking −0.1em. - **Tagline** `A personal archive of the wonderfully random.`: left `max(16px,7vw)`, top `959/11.25 dvh`, 24u / 26u, tracking −0.06em. - **Hint:** `#spider-instructions`, fixed bottom-right at `max(12px, safe-area)`, `11px/1.5 Arial`, tracking .02em, `rgba(255,255,255,.65)`. - Desktop text: `Del / Backspace — clear web · Double-click — make the spider jump`. - Touch (`hover:none and pointer:coarse`), 10.5px / 1.6: `Hold — clear web
Double-tap — make the spider jump`. - **Web anchors:** every element the web can stick to carries `data-web-anchor`: the logo word, each nav link, both nav icons, the big wordmark, the mug, iBook, book, player, headline, tagline and t-shirt. The t-shirt also has `data-stick="bottom"`. ## 3. Responsive - **Landscape and short** (`min-aspect-ratio:1/1` and `max-height:560px`): `--u: 100dvh/900`. Hide the tagline and mug. Book at right `120/20 vw`. - **Landscape at 1100px wide or less:** hide the nav links. - **Portrait** (`max-aspect-ratio:1/1`): `--u: min(100vw/560, 1px)`. Hide the links. Nav top 16px. Then stack from the bottom up: - T-shirt 226u at the bottom. - Tagline at bottom `226u + 16px`, left and right 16px, wrapping, `max(13px, 26u)`, line height 1.2. - Headline at bottom `288u + 32px`, left 16px, 80u. - Player at bottom `448u + 56px`, left 16px. - Book at right 3vw, bottom `440u + 50px`, width 210u. - Wordmark at top `min(31dvh, 100dvh − 700u − 56px)`, 195u / 150u. - Mug at left 2vw, top `56px + 1dvh`, width 165u. - iBook at right 3vw, top `50px + 1dvh`, width 165u. - **Portrait at 700px tall or less:** hide the mug and iBook. - **Spider scale** `t`: - Portrait: `clamp(w/480, .78, 1.1)`. - Height under 560: `max(.68, h/620)`. - Otherwise: `min(w/1440, h/810)`. - Final clamp: .6–1.25. - Then spider `size = 1.63·t`, `flySize = max(.75, 1.05·t)`, and the unit `K = size·0.12` px per sprite unit. ## 4. Images (all embedded as data URIs in the supplied file) | Image | Format, size | Used for | |---|---|---| | Spider photo | WebP 560 × 560 | Top view of a brown and cream banded jumping spider. Sliced into the body, head and 8 legs. Sprite space is 1254 units wide, so the image scale is `560/1254`. | | Idle head | WebP 308 × 308 | Cute big-eyed spider face. Sprite space 308. | | Fly | WebP 240 × 246 | Top view of a house fly. Sprite space 920 × 945. | | Objects | PNG | Book 293 × 322, iBook 312 × 377, mug 241 × 220, t-shirt 250 × 226, all with transparency. | | UI icons | PNG | Player art 40, logo back 53 × 41, logo front 53 × 34, search 26, menu 26, heart 20, shuffle 16, previous 24, play 48, next 24, repeat 16. | ## 5. Spider rig (sprite units, 1254 base) - **Body points:** - pivot `(627,600)`, waist `(627,548)`, spinneret `(627,150)`. - Abdomen ellipse `(628,345) r 220×205`. - Head ellipses `(630,680) r 172×148`, `(545,880) r 74×70`, `(712,880) r 74×70`. - **Masks:** the abdomen and head layers are cut from the photo with these ellipses, drawn black with `blur(2·scale px)` and applied `destination-in`. - **Legs:** four legs per side, each as hip, knee and foot in the image. The left side mirrors the right with `x → 1254 − x`. - `[(470,760),(370,830),(400,1160)]` - `[(460,665),(300,690),(100,955)]` - `[(480,605),(370,580),(55,475)]` - `[(490,560),(360,420),(410,52)]` - **Leg strips:** each leg is resampled from the photo into a straight strip: - Length = femur + tibia. Width `legWidth 92`. - Bilinear sampling along the hip→knee→foot polyline. - Alpha fades out over the outer 28% of the half-width. - `split` = femur share of the strip, used to draw the femur and tibia halves separately. - **Body space:** image point → body point `(y − 600, −(x − 627))`, so the head points along +x of the heading. Each leg stores `hip` and `rest` (its foot) in body space, and `a` / `b` are the femur and tibia lengths. - If `a+b < 1.15·|rest−hip|`, scale a and b up to that. - Gait group = `(legIndex + (rightSide?0:1)) % 2`, an alternating tetrapod gait. ## 6. Spider motion (per frame, `dt = min(0.033 s, real delta)`) - **Target:** the fly's position, or the raw pointer when there is no fly image. The spider keeps a gap of `560·K` (`330·K` without the fly). - Speed `min(760, (distance − gap)·4)` px/s, eased with `1 − e^(−10dt)`. - Heading turns toward the target with `1 − e^(−8dt)`. - Position is clamped 10px inside the canvas. - Body sway `z = clamp(−angularVelocity·0.08, ±0.35)`, eased with `1 − e^(−6dt)`, rotating the abdomen about the waist. - **Intro:** - Start: x = W/2, y = −760K, heading straight down, with a live silk thread from an anchor at `(W/2, −2)`. - After 3s it drops to H/2 over 2.3s with `1 − (1 − v)^2.4`. - Then a damped bounce `14·e^(−3.2v)·sin(6.5v)`, x sway `sin(1.8u)·8·e^(−0.5u)` and a tiny heading wobble. - 1.3s after arriving it lands: squash, and the web vibrates in a 140px radius at strength 2. - **Feet:** - Target = the rest point placed in world space, plus velocity × 0.09. - **Step trigger:** foot more than `130K` from its target (front pair `0.7×`), or more than 30% of that when nearly stopped. Also when overextended (more than 98% of reach) or when a front foot falls behind the hip. - A leg only steps if no leg of the other group is mid-step, unless it is overextended or more than 1.6× the trigger distance. - **Step duration:** `clamp(0.15 − speed/3200, 0.055, 0.15)` s, with cubic ease-out from the old to the new foot position. - Each footfall vibrates nearby threads (radius 30, strength 0.6). - **IK:** two-bone law of cosines. Choose the knee solution that bends outward for that side. - While stepping, the knee lifts outward by `sin(π·t)·26K` (front legs 12K) and the foot by `sin(π·t)·20K`, both away from the body centre. - Each bone is drawn as its slice of the leg strip, rotated along the bone, with 12% overlap at the ends. - **Drawing order:** legs, back to front, then the abdomen, then the head. - **Abdomen:** breathes with scale `1 + sin(phase)·(0.025 + 0.03·sleep)`; phase speed is `3.2 − 1.8·smooth(sleep)`. - **Landing squash:** `lt` decays 4/s; the abdomen scale is `(2 − y, y)` with `y = 1 − 0.1·lt`. - **Compositing:** the whole spider is rendered to an offscreen canvas, then composited with a shadow. - Colour `rgba(0,0,0, 0.42 − min(0.24, h/500))`, blur `7 + 0.14h`, offset `(5 + 0.35h, 9 + 0.6h)`. - `h` is the current jump height. The spider also scales by `1 + h/260`, so it reads as lifting off the page. - **Rest face:** - When the pointer has been still for more than 0.25s, with no jump, speed under 25 and all feet planted, `qt` ramps up 3.2/s (down 6/s). - The photo head fades to 15% and the idle head image fades in on top: scale `3.3·(0.9 + 0.1x)`, mapping `(154,150)` → `(630,690)`. - **Blinks:** after 1.5s, a 0.2s blink, then a second blink 0.33s later, then every 3–5s. - Each of the 6 eyes (`[139,158,12.5]`, `[170,158,12.5]`, `[117,150,7.5]`, `[192,150,7.5]`, `[112,136,4]`, `[197,136,4]`) gets an eyelid. - The eyelid is a curved shape filled with the head's own sampled skin colour (darkened ×0.82 / 0.78 / 0.75), sweeping down inside a clip circle, with a `rgba(40,22,12,.7)` lid line. - **Sleep:** - After 8s at rest, `sleep` ramps over 1.6s. Legs tuck to 62% of their reach, the eyes stay shut and the body shrinks 3%. - Three white `z` letters drift up and right from body point `(260,−170)`: - Weight 700, system-ui, size `(12 + 14c)·scale`. - Rising 70px with a 25% black shadow and fading in and out as `sin(π·c)`. - A landed fly also snores at half size. - **Waking:** moving the pointer while `sleep > 0.6` makes a small startled hop (0.3s, height 26) and vibrates the web. ## 7. The fly cursor - **Drawing:** the fly is drawn at `79·flySize` px wide. The wings are cut from the photo with an 11-point polygon, `(398,380) (330,415) (250,515) (180,615) (132,720) (148,795) (212,805) (305,742) (385,652) (410,560) (414,455)`, mirrored for the right wing. Wing hinge `(388,405)`. The body is the photo minus the wings. - **Following:** - The fly follows the pointer with ease `1 − e^(−(28 − 20·recoil)·dt)`. - Buzz jitter: `(sin(23.1B) + 0.6·sin(37.7B + 1.3))·2.2` and `(sin(29.3B + 0.7) + 0.6·sin(41.9B))·2.2`, scaled by `1 − landed`. - It turns along its motion above 60 px/s. - **Landing:** after 1.2s still, `landed` ramps up 3/s (down 10/s). - **Wings:** - Flying: four ghost copies at 34 Hz (46 Hz when caught). Each wing rotates `±0.9·q` around the hinge with `scaleY(1 − 0.25q)`. - Landed: the wings fold. - **Shadow:** `rgba(0,0,0, 0.2 + 0.18·landed)`, blur `3 + 9y`, offset `(3 + 14y, 5 + 26y)`, with a bob of `sin(6B)·1.2·y`, where `y = 1 − landed` is the hover height. - **Hiding:** the fly fades out over buttons, links, inputs and `[data-no-spider]`, where the system pointer shows instead. ## 8. Silk - **Threads:** - Verlet ropes of 12 segments (13 points). - Damping 0.975, gravity `110·dt²`. - Wind `(sin(0.45B)·0.6 + sin(1.3B + 1.7)·0.4)·(0.6 + 0.4·sin(1.1B + 0.012y + phase))·22·dt²` on x. - Four constraint passes with both ends pinned. Rest segment length `distance/12 × 1.01–1.015` gives a slight sag. - The pointer pushes rope points within 36px. - **Live thread:** runs from the last anchor to the spinneret, thickness 1.25. - **Anchor points:** points sampled every 7px along the visible outline of every `[data-web-anchor]` element. - **Text:** each glyph is rasterised to a canvas in its computed font and the edge pixels (alpha > 128) are kept. - **Images:** the alpha edge (alpha > 140). - **Boxes:** rounded-rect perimeters. - These silhouettes are also kept as a mask canvas. - **Attaching:** 1. When the spinneret comes within 70px of an outline point, at least 30px from the live thread's start and more than 54px from it, the live thread is pinned there. 2. That thread gets dew drops. 3. A radial thread (thickness 0.7) joins this point to the nearest earlier anchor within 288px. 4. With 75% probability, another thread (0.85) joins it to the nearest outline point within 204px (not within 45px). 5. A new live thread starts, and the web vibrates in a 60px radius at strength 1.2. - **Free space:** with no anchor elements on the page, a point is dropped every 120px. - **Vibration:** points within a radius get random kicks of `strength·(1 − d/r)`. The whole rope is shaken a little when an end is near. Dew drops on a shaken thread start sliding with a 35% chance. - **Rendering each thread:** 1. A halo: alpha 0.06, width 4×thickness. 2. The main strand per segment: width `thick·(0.9 − 0.35·sin(πi/12))`, alpha 0.8, silk colour `rgba(255,255,255,0.75)`. 3. An iridescent overlay `hsl(190 + 150P, 100%, 74%)` at alpha `0.12 + 0.3P³`, with `P = 0.5 + 0.5·sin(2·angle + 0.3B + phase)`. 4. Two wavy sub-fibres offset ±1.1 / 0.9 × thickness, alpha 0.38, width 0.45. 5. Micro-hairs: about 3 per 1.1px (40% on touch screens), length 0.5–2.7 × thickness, alpha 0.55, width 0.35. 6. Fluff: 40% of threads carry 1–2 clumps, either 5 grey-brown dust dots (`#8a7a6a`) or 10 curling cream fibres (`rgba(240,232,220)`). 7. Dew drops: count `floor(length/55·(0.4 + rand))`, radius 1.6–6.2, drawn with a 64px glass-bead sprite (radial gradient rims, warm caustic `rgba(255,210,150,.45)`, white specular). 8. A white glint segment travels along each thread at 0.6 per second. - Threads fade to 50% over 90s. - Each anchor point gets 30 tiny hair tufts and a 3px bead. - **Shadows:** all threads and drops are drawn in black on an offscreen canvas with shadow `rgba(8,14,70,.42)`, blur 3.5, offset (7, 11). That canvas is masked (`destination-in`) by the anchor silhouettes, so web shadows fall only on letters and objects, never on the blue. - **Drops:** - Sliding drops move with the slope (`du += slope·9dt`, ×0.95). - They fall off when the slope is steep, when they reach the ends, or randomly when they are big. - Falling drops use gravity 1100. - A drop that lands on an object or letter silhouette after falling more than 10px becomes a splat: a squashed bead with a soft shadow. At most 400 splats. ## 9. Objects react The images that are anchors (mug, iBook, book, t-shirt and the nav icons) wobble as the spider walks past. - Within `260K` of the image box, at speed over 40: - Torque `cross(offset, velocity)/size²`, clamped ±2.5, ×120·dt. - Push `0.85·velocity·dt`. - Damping `e^(−2.8dt)`. Angle spring beyond 24° (×8) and offset spring beyond 50px (×8). - The t-shirt (`data-stick="bottom"`) pivots at `50% 100%`, never translates, and springs back harder beyond 8° (×20). - Applied through CSS `rotate` and `translate`. - Anchors are re-sampled 0.3s after everything stops moving. - A jump landing spins nearby objects by ±16–28°. ## 10. Input - **Mouse click** (or double-tap on touch), anywhere except controls: the spider pounces at the fly. - It lands where its mouth (heading × 360K) meets the fly, travelling at most 360K. - Duration `clamp(distance/1100, 0.28, 0.6)` s, ease-in-out quad. - Jump height `max(22, min(0.3·distance, 130))`, shown as scale and shadow. - On landing: squash, web vibration (140, 3) and nudged objects. - **Catching:** if the fly is within `55·flySize` of the mouth, it is caught for 3–4.2s. - It trembles at 47 and 31 Hz and its wings buzz. - It is wrapped in a silk cocoon: 7 ellipse strokes of radius `30·flySize` drawing on progressively, plus 70 short fibres. - Then it breaks free and is flung 150px away, while the cocoon fades. - **Delete / Backspace** (outside inputs): clear the web. - Every dew drop falls, the threads fade out at 2.6 per second and the web shakes hard. - Splats drop off-screen, and a fresh live thread starts from the spinneret. - **Touch:** hold 650ms to clear the web (with a 30ms vibration), double-tap to move the fly and jump. - **Pointer leaving the window:** the fly disappears and the spider stays put. ## 11. Loop and setup - **Canvas:** DPR capped at 2, sized by a ResizeObserver. - **Anchors** are sampled on resize, on `document.fonts.ready`, on `load` and after 600ms. - **Frame order:** 1. Update the fly. 2. Update the image nudges. 3. Update the spider (intro, jump, follow, feet). 4. Update the rest and sleep state. 5. Update the anchoring and the silk physics. - **Draw order:** 1. Web shadows. 2. Threads, splats and drops. 3. The spider through its shadowed offscreen. 4. The z letters. 5. The fly, and the cocoon when it is caught.

# Found — The Curiosity Cabinet with a Web-Spinning Spider (exact recreation prompt) Give me a single-file, full-screen home page for **found**, a personal archive of curious objects called "the curiosity cabinet". The page is flat electric blue with a giant white wordmark `found` in the middle. Collectible cut-out objects float around it: a "Main Character" mug, a frosted glass radio player, a retro laptop in a glass sleeve, a pink book with an iPod, and a "CALL MY LAWYER" t-shirt at the bottom edge. A photo-real jumping spider lives on the page. It drops in on a silk thread, chases a fly that replaces the mouse cursor, and walks on inverse-kinematics legs cut from one photo. As it moves, it spins real-looking silk threads between the letters and objects: sagging verlet ropes with dew drops, fuzz, iridescence and shadows that fall only on the objects. Click to make it pounce on the fly and wrap it in silk. Press Delete to shake the web off. When it rests, its head crossfades to a cute face that blinks, and later it falls asleep. All of it runs in one HTML file with a single 2D canvas and no libraries. The live original was a small Preact app, and plain DOM plus vanilla JS is fine. The only external resources are the Inter font, which the supplied file embeds, and three radio streams. **Source of truth:** the supplied **HTML Code** section is the complete working page. It has all 18 images as base64 data URIs and Inter embedded. Reproduce every value below exactly. When in doubt, copy the behaviour of that file. --- ## 1. Page basics - Title `Found`. The viewport meta includes `viewport-fit=cover`. - Font: Inter 400 / 500 / 600 (`https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap`). The standalone embeds the latin subset as a woff2 data URI. Stack: `"Inter", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif`. - Colours: `--blue: #1129e2` (page), `--ink: #ffffff`, `--ink-70: rgba(255,255,255,0.7)`, `--glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.1)`. `color-scheme: dark`. - Design frame: a Figma frame 2000 × 1125. `--u: min(calc(100vw / 2000), calc(100dvh / 1125))`. - Horizontal positions are in vw (`x / 20 * 1vw`). Vertical positions are in dvh (`y / 11.25 * 1dvh`). Sizes use `--u`, so the composition fills any screen while objects keep their proportions. - `body` is blue with `overflow: hidden`. `.page` is `100vw × 100dvh`. - `.frame` holds every element, absolutely positioned, white Inter 400, `user-select: none`. - Layer order, bottom to top: 1. `.frame` (all content). 2. `.web-layer`: one full-size canvas, `pointer-events: none`. 3. `.over`: a second copy of the big wordmark in which only the letter **o** is visible. This makes the spider crawl *under* the "o" but over the other letters. - Global cursor: `html, body { cursor: none; touch-action: none; overscroll-behavior: none; user-select: none; -webkit-touch-callout: none }`. Buttons, links and inputs get `cursor: pointer; touch-action: manipulation`. ## 2. Layout (desktop, sizes in u) - **Nav** `.top-nav`: - Position: left/right `max(16px, 7vw)`, top `max(12px, 38/11.25 dvh)`, height `56u` (min 40px). A flex row with space-between. - **Logo:** 157 × 44u. - Two stacked outline-folder PNGs: back 53 × 41 at top 6.33u, front 53 × 34 at top 12.33u. - Wordmark `found` at left 70u, 36u / 44u line height, tracking −0.08em. - **Links:** `home, archive, oddities, experiments, the drawer, about, contact`. - 22u, tracking −0.08em, gap 32u, no wrap. - The first (`home`) is active: weight 500 with `text-decoration: line-through`. - **Right icons:** search and menu (26u PNGs), gap 32u, in a 157u-wide right-aligned box. - **Big wordmark** `.found`: - Centred at left 50%, top `547/11.25 dvh − 48u`, `translate(-50%,-50%)`. - 350u, line height 240u, tracking −0.1em, `text-indent: -0.1em`. - Each letter is a span: `f`, `o` (transparent in `.frame`, visible in `.over`), `und`. - **Mug** (241 × 220 PNG, "Main Character" in handwriting): left `205/20 vw`, top `359/11.25 dvh − 48u`, width 241u. - **iBook in a glass sleeve** (312 × 377 PNG): right `162/20 vw`, top `323/11.25 dvh`, width 312u. - **Book and iPod in a glass sleeve** (293 × 322 PNG): right `376/20 vw`, top `689.5/11.25 dvh`, width 293u. - **T-shirt** (250 × 226 PNG, "CALL MY LAWYER (888) 799-2021" in handwriting): centred, `bottom: 0`, width 250u. - **Radio player** `.player`: - Box: left `max(16px, 7vw)`, top `509/11.25 dvh − 48u`, 291 × 172u. Padding 16u, radius 24u, column gap 12u. - Glass: `rgba(255,255,255,.1)`, `backdrop-filter: blur(12u)` and `inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.25)`. - **Head:** 40u art thumbnail (radius 12u), title `Support the arts` (18u, weight 600) and sub `date an artist` (12u, 70% white). A 20u heart icon sits on the right. - **Progress:** a 4u bar on `rgba(255,255,255,.2)` with a 46% white fill. - **Times row** (10u, weight 600, 70% white, tabular numerals): on the left, a 6u dot plus the uppercase status `live`; on the right, the station name. - **Controls row:** shuffle 16u (55% opacity), previous 24u, play 48u (a white circle), next 24u, repeat 16u (55% opacity). - **Playing:** - The play icon becomes a white 48u circle with two 4.5 × 16u blue bars. - The bar becomes a flowing gradient: `linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,.35), #fff 40%, rgba(255,255,255,.35) 80%)`, size 200%, animated to `-200%` over 2.4s linear infinite. - The dot turns `#ff5a5a` and pulses to 35% opacity over 1.6s. - **Status texts:** `live`, `tuning…`, `offline`. - **Stations:** Groove Salad `https://ice1.somafm.com/groovesalad-128-mp3`, Lush `https://ice1.somafm.com/lush-128-mp3`, Drone Zone `https://ice1.somafm.com/dronezone-128-mp3`. Previous and next cycle through them; play toggles a `new Audio()` (preload none). - **Headline** `.cabinet` `the curiosity
cabinet`: left `max(16px,7vw)`, top `775/11.25 dvh`, width 396u, 80u / 80u, tracking −0.1em. - **Tagline** `A personal archive of the wonderfully random.`: left `max(16px,7vw)`, top `959/11.25 dvh`, 24u / 26u, tracking −0.06em. - **Hint:** `#spider-instructions`, fixed bottom-right at `max(12px, safe-area)`, `11px/1.5 Arial`, tracking .02em, `rgba(255,255,255,.65)`. - Desktop text: `Del / Backspace — clear web · Double-click — make the spider jump`. - Touch (`hover:none and pointer:coarse`), 10.5px / 1.6: `Hold — clear web

Book at right `120/20 vw`. - **Landscape at 1100px wide or less:** hide the nav links. - **Portrait** (`max-aspect-ratio:1/1`): `--u: min(100vw/560, 1px)`. Hide the links. Nav top 16px. Sprite space 308. | | Fly | WebP 240 × 246 | Top view of a house fly. The wings are cut from the photo with an 11-point polygon, `(398,380) (330,415) (250,515) (180,615) (132,720) (148,795) (212,805) (305,742) (385,652) (410,560) (414,455)`, mirrored for the right wing. Wing hinge `(388,405)`. The body is the photo minus the wings. - **Following:** - The fly follows the pointer with ease `1 − e^(−(28 − 20·recoil)·dt)`. - Buzz jitter: `(sin(23.1B) + 0.6·sin(37.7B + 1.3))·2.2` and `(sin(29.3B + 0.7) + 0.6·sin(41.9B))·2.2`, scaled by `1 − landed`. - It turns along its motion above 60 px/s. - **Landing:** after 1.2s still, `landed` ramps up 3/s (down 10/s). - **Wings:** - Flying: four ghost copies at 34 Hz (46 Hz when caught). Each wing rotates `±0.9·q` around the hinge with `scaleY(1 − 0.25q)`. - Landed: the wings fold. - **Shadow:** `rgba(0,0,0, 0.2 + 0.18·landed)`, blur `3 + 9y`, offset `(3 + 14y, 5 + 26y)`, with a bob of `sin(6B)·1.2·y`, where `y = 1 − landed` is the hover height. - **Hiding:** the fly fades out over buttons, links, inputs and `[data-no-spider]`, where the system pointer shows instead. ## 8. Silk - **Threads:** - Verlet ropes of 12 segments (13 points). - Damping 0.975, gravity `110·dt²`. - Wind `(sin(0.45B)·0.6 + sin(1.3B + 1.7)·0.4)·(0.6 + 0.4·sin(1.1B + 0.012y + phase))·22·dt²` on x. - Four constraint passes with both ends pinned. Rest segment length `distance/12 × 1.01–1.015` gives a slight sag. - The pointer pushes rope points within 36px. - **Live thread:** runs from the last anchor to the spinneret, thickness 1.25. - **Anchor points:** points sampled every 7px along the visible outline of every `[data-web-anchor]` element. - **Text:** each glyph is rasterised to a canvas in its computed font and the edge pixels (alpha > 128) are kept. - **Images:** the alpha edge (alpha > 140). - **Boxes:** rounded-rect perimeters. - These silhouettes are also kept as a mask canvas. - **Attaching:** 1. When the spinneret comes within 70px of an outline point, at least 30px from the live thread's start and more than 54px from it, the live thread is pinned there. 2. That thread gets dew drops. 3. A radial thread (thickness 0.7) joins this point to the nearest earlier anchor within 288px. 4. With 75% probability, another thread (0.85) joins it to the nearest outline point within 204px (not within 45px). 5. A new live thread starts, and the web vibrates in a 60px radius at strength 1.2. - **Free space:** with no anchor elements on the page, a point is dropped every 120px. - **Vibration:** points within a radius get random kicks of `strength·(1 − d/r)`. The whole rope is shaken a little when an end is near. Dew drops on a shaken thread start sliding with a 35% chance. - **Rendering each thread:** 1. A halo: alpha 0.06, width 4×thickness. 2. The main strand per segment: width `thick·(0.9 − 0.35·sin(πi/12))`, alpha 0.8, silk colour `rgba(255,255,255,0.75)`. 3. An iridescent overlay `hsl(190 + 150P, 100%, 74%)` at alpha `0.12 + 0.3P³`, with `P = 0.5 + 0.5·sin(2·angle + 0.3B + phase)`. 4. Two wavy sub-fibres offset ±1.1 / 0.9 × thickness, alpha 0.38, width 0.45. 5. Micro-hairs: about 3 per 1.1px (40% on touch screens), length 0.5–2.7 × thickness, alpha 0.55, width 0.35. 6. Fluff: 40% of threads carry 1–2 clumps, either 5 grey-brown dust dots (`#8a7a6a`) or 10 curling cream fibres (`rgba(240,232,220)`). 7. Dew drops: count `floor(length/55·(0.4 + rand))`, radius 1.6–6.2, drawn with a 64px glass-bead sprite (radial gradient rims, warm caustic `rgba(255,210,150,.45)`, white specular). 8. A white glint segment travels along each thread at 0.6 per second. - Threads fade to 50% over 90s. - Each anchor point gets 30 tiny hair tufts and a 3px bead. - **Shadows:** all threads and drops are drawn in black on an offscreen canvas with shadow `rgba(8,14,70,.42)`, blur 3.5, offset (7, 11). That canvas is masked (`destination-in`) by the anchor silhouettes, so web shadows fall only on letters and objects, never on the blue. - **Drops:** - Sliding drops move with the slope (`du += slope·9dt`, ×0.95). - They fall off when the slope is steep, when they reach the ends, or randomly when they are big. - Falling drops use gravity 1100. - A drop that lands on an object or letter silhouette after falling more than 10px becomes a splat: a squashed bead with a soft shadow. At most 400 splats. ## 9. Objects react The images that are anchors (mug, iBook, book, t-shirt and the nav icons) wobble as the spider walks past. - Within `260K` of the image box, at speed over 40: - Torque `cross(offset, velocity)/size²`, clamped ±2.5, ×120·dt. - Push `0.85·velocity·dt`. - Damping `e^(−2.8dt)`. Angle spring beyond 24° (×8) and offset spring beyond 50px (×8). - The t-shirt (`data-stick="bottom"`) pivots at `50% 100%`, never translates, and springs back harder beyond 8° (×20). - Applied through CSS `rotate` and `translate`. - Anchors are re-sampled 0.3s after everything stops moving. - A jump landing spins nearby objects by ±16–28°. ## 10. Input - **Mouse click** (or double-tap on touch), anywhere except controls: the spider pounces at the fly. - It lands where its mouth (heading × 360K) meets the fly, travelling at most 360K. - Duration `clamp(distance/1100, 0.28, 0.6)` s, ease-in-out quad. - Jump height `max(22, min(0.3·distance, 130))`, shown as scale and shadow. - On landing: squash, web vibration (140, 3) and nudged objects. - **Catching:** if the fly is within `55·flySize` of the mouth, it is caught for 3–4.2s. - It trembles at 47 and 31 Hz and its wings buzz. - It is wrapped in a silk cocoon: 7 ellipse strokes of radius `30·flySize` drawing on progressively, plus 70 short fibres. - Then it breaks free and is flung 150px away, while the cocoon fades. - **Delete / Backspace** (outside inputs): clear the web. - Every dew drop falls, the threads fade out at 2.6 per second and the web shakes hard. - Splats drop off-screen, and a fresh live thread starts from the spinneret. - **Touch:** hold 650ms to clear the web (with a 30ms vibration), double-tap to move the fly and jump. - **Pointer leaving the window:** the fly disappears and the spider stays put. ## 11. Loop and setup - **Canvas:** DPR capped at 2, sized by a ResizeObserver. - **Anchors** are sampled on resize, on `document.fonts.ready`, on `load` and after 600ms. - **Frame order:** 1. Update the fly. 2. Update the image nudges. 3. Update the spider (intro, jump, follow, feet). 4. Update the rest and sleep state. 5. Update the anchoring and the silk physics. - **Draw order:** 1. Web shadows. 2. Threads, splats and drops. 3. The spider through its shadowed offscreen. 4. The z letters. 5. The fly, and the cocoon when it is caught.

Create a high-craft, production-ready full-page web template for **"Planet Orbit"** in the **SaaS** category.

### 1. Visual Direction & Reference Assets
- **Template ID:** `planet-orbit-hero`
- **Category:** SaaS (hero)
- **Reference Video / Motion Preview:** https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-planet-orbit-preview-DWAP8Z1P.gif
- **High-Res Reference Poster (1280px):** https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-planet-orbit-poster-CuWG70ga.png
- **Design Paradigm:** Kinetic typography & neo-brutalist Swiss grids blended with atmospheric minimalism andchoreographed motion.

### 2. Color & Atmospheric Polarity
- **Primary Background Surface:** `#090A0F`
- **Elevated Card / Module Surface:** `#12151E`
- **Primary Typography Ink:** `#F5F7FA`
- **Primary Accent & Interactive Highlight:** `#6366F1`
- **Border & Hairline Token:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`

### 3. Typography & Scannable Hierarchy
- **Display / Headline Font:** `'Instrument Serif'`, `'Playfair Display'`, or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (`clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.75rem)`, line-height `0.98`, letter-spacing `-0.03em`)
- **UI & Body Font:** `'Inter'` or `'Plus Jakarta Sans'` (400, 500, 600)
- **Technical / Numeric Meta Font:** `'JetBrains Mono'` with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`

### 4. Layout, Spatial Architecture & Interactive Functional Requirements
1. **Top Navigation Bar:** Glassmorphic sticky header with brand wordmark **"Planet Orbit"**, section anchors, interactive theme/mode or live status pill, and primary CTA button.
2. **Primary Hero / Focal Showcase:**
   - Incorporate the motion preview asset (https://motionsites.ai/assets/hero-planet-orbit-preview-DWAP8Z1P.gif) with smooth parallax depth, subtle ambient glow, and crisp frame border.
   - Headline copy tailored to **"Planet Orbit"** (SaaS) with dual action triggers and live telemetry/metrics strip.
3. **Interactive Bento / Feature Architecture:**
   - 3-to-4 interactive cards or live calculator/filter controls depending on the archetype of **"Planet Orbit"**.
   - Micro-interactions on hover (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`), live tab switching, and responsive 4-viewport adaptation (`1440px`, `1024px`, `768px`, `375px`).
